# INLA Spatial Analysis - Hierarchical Code Structure

# I. SPATIAL SETUP & PREPROCESSING

## I.1 Initial Setup: Package Loading & Shapefile Import

**Purpose**: Load required spatial analysis libraries and import the cleaned parcel shapefile with final IDs.

**Key Actions**:

-   Install/load: `sf`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`, `spdep`, `units`

-   Import shapefile: `parcels_with_final_id.shp`

-   Validate geometry and check CRS

**Output**: `parcelles` (sf object with spatial geometries)

## I.2 Column Standardization

## I.3 Spatial Weights Matrix Creation (W.P1)

**Purpose**: Build adjacency matrix defining spatial neighborhood structure based on boundary-to-boundary distances.

```{r}
# ===== SPATIAL NEIGHBORHOOD ANALYSIS WITH COLUMN RENAMING =====
# Load required libraries
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Install and load spatial analysis packages if needed
if (!requireNamespace("spdep", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("Installing spdep package...\n")
  install.packages("spdep")
}
library(spdep)

if (!requireNamespace("units", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("units")
}
library(units)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("      SPATIAL NEIGHBORHOOD ANALYSIS\n") 
cat("      WITH COLUMN RENAMING\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# IMPORT THE SHAPEFILE WITH FINAL CLEANED ID
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 IMPORTING SHAPEFILE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Define the path to your shapefile
shapefile_path <- "clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_final_id.shp"

# Check if file exists
if (!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
  cat("❌ Shapefile not found at:", shapefile_path, "\n")
  cat("Please check the path or run the export script first.\n")
  
  # Try to find it in current directory
  shp_files <- list.files(pattern = "*.shp$", recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(shp_files) > 0) {
    cat("Available shapefiles found:\n")
    for (i in 1:length(shp_files)) {
      cat(i, ". ", shp_files[i], "\n")
    }
    cat("\nPlease update the shapefile_path variable with the correct path.\n")
  }
  stop("Shapefile not found")
}

# Import the shapefile
cat("📥 Loading shapefile...\n")
parcelles <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Shapefile loaded successfully!\n")
cat("• Features:", nrow(parcelles), "\n")
cat("• Columns:", ncol(parcelles), "\n")
cat("• CRS:", st_crs(parcelles)$input, "\n")

# Display original column structure
cat("\nOriginal shapefile columns:\n")
cols <- names(st_drop_geometry(parcelles))
for (i in 1:length(cols)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %-25s", i, cols[i]))
  cat("\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# RENAME COLUMNS AS REQUESTED
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔧 RENAMING COLUMNS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Rename columns according to specifications
parcelles <- parcelles %>%
  rename(
    Final_Cleaned_ID = Fn_C_ID,
    Bloc = Blc2022,
    X.Centroid = X_Cntrd,
    Y.Centroid = Y_Cntrd,
    ID.Field = ID_Fild
  )

cat("✅ Columns renamed:\n")
cat("• Fn_C_ID → Final_Cleaned_ID\n")
cat("• Blc2022 → Bloc\n")
cat("• X_Cntrd → X.Centroid\n")
cat("• Y_Cntrd → Y.Centroid\n")
cat("• ID_Fild → ID.Field\n")

# Display updated column structure
cat("\nUpdated shapefile columns:\n")
cols_updated <- names(st_drop_geometry(parcelles))
for (i in 1:length(cols_updated)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %-25s", i, cols_updated[i]))
  cat("\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# PREPARE FOR SPATIAL ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== STEP 1: PREPARING SHAPEFILE FOR SPATIAL ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Use the renamed shapefile
shapefile <- parcelles

# Ensure geometries are valid
shapefile <- st_make_valid(shapefile)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Ensure ID.Field is numeric and sequential
shapefile$ID.Field <- as.numeric(shapefile$ID.Field)
if (any(is.na(shapefile$ID.Field))) {
  cat("Warning: Some ID.Field values were NA, creating sequential IDs\n")
  shapefile$ID.Field <- 1:nrow(shapefile)
}

cat("ID.Field prepared: 1 to", nrow(shapefile), "\n")

# Display updated structure
cat("\nUpdated shapefile structure:\n")
attr_data_updated <- st_drop_geometry(shapefile)
print(names(attr_data_updated))
cat("Total parcels:", nrow(shapefile), "\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 2: CALCULATING BOUNDARY-TO-BOUNDARY DISTANCES ===\n")

# Calculate boundary-to-boundary distances between all parcels
cat("Computing pairwise distances between parcel boundaries...\n")
cat("This may take a while for large datasets...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries (exterior rings only)
boundaries <- st_boundary(shapefile)

# Calculate distance matrix (boundary to boundary)
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)

# Convert to numeric matrix and remove units
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)

# Set diagonal to NA (parcel cannot be neighbor to itself)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated: ", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")
cat("Min boundary distance:", round(min(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Max boundary distance:", round(max(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Mean boundary distance:", round(mean(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 3: DISTANCE DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Extract all distances for analysis (excluding diagonal)
all_distances <- as.vector(dist_matrix)
all_distances <- all_distances[!is.na(all_distances)]

# Calculate statistics
dist_stats <- list(
  min = min(all_distances),
  q25 = quantile(all_distances, 0.25),
  median = median(all_distances),
  mean = mean(all_distances),
  q75 = quantile(all_distances, 0.75),
  q90 = quantile(all_distances, 0.90),
  q95 = quantile(all_distances, 0.95),
  max = max(all_distances)
)

cat("Distance Statistics (meters):\n")
cat("Min:", round(dist_stats$min, 2), "\n")
cat("25th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q25, 2), "\n")
cat("Median:", round(dist_stats$median, 2), "\n")
cat("Mean:", round(dist_stats$mean, 2), "\n")
cat("75th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q75, 2), "\n")
cat("90th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q90, 2), "\n")
cat("95th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q95, 2), "\n")
cat("Max:", round(dist_stats$max, 2), "\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 4: DETERMINING OPTIMAL THRESHOLD ===\n")

# Suggest multiple threshold options
threshold_options <- c(
  dist_stats$min + 1,                    # Just above minimum (touching parcels)
  dist_stats$q25,                        # 25th percentile
  dist_stats$median * 0.1,               # 10% of median
  dist_stats$median * 0.2,               # 20% of median
  50,                                    # Fixed 50m threshold
  100,                                   # Fixed 100m threshold
  200                                    # Fixed 200m threshold
)

cat("Suggested threshold options:\n")
for (i in 1:length(threshold_options)) {
  thresh <- threshold_options[i]
  n_neighbors <- sum(dist_matrix <= thresh & !is.na(dist_matrix))
  avg_neighbors <- n_neighbors / nrow(shapefile)
  cat(sprintf("Option %d: %.1f meters (avg %.1f neighbors per parcel)\n", 
              i, thresh, avg_neighbors))
}

# Allow user to choose or use default
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110  # Fixed threshold of 110 meters
cat("Using fixed threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Show what this threshold will give us
n_neighbors_110 <- sum(dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix))
avg_neighbors_110 <- n_neighbors_110 / nrow(shapefile)
cat("With 110m threshold:\n")
cat("- Total connections:", n_neighbors_110, "\n")
cat("- Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors_110, 2), "\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 5: CREATING ADJACENCY MATRIX ===\n")

# Create adjacency matrix based on distance threshold
W.P1 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(shapefile), ncol = nrow(shapefile))

# Fill adjacency matrix: 1 if distance <= threshold, 0 otherwise
W.P1[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1

# Ensure diagonal is 0 (parcel not neighbor to itself)
diag(W.P1) <- 0

# Add row and column names using field values
if ("field" %in% names(shapefile)) {
  dimnames(W.P1)[[1]] <- dimnames(W.P1)[[2]] <- shapefile$field
} else {
  dimnames(W.P1)[[1]] <- dimnames(W.P1)[[2]] <- shapefile$ID.Field
}

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(shapefile)
max_neighbors <- max(rowSums(W.P1))
min_neighbors <- min(rowSums(W.P1))

cat("Adjacency Matrix created:", nrow(W.P1), "x", ncol(W.P1), "\n")
cat("Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
cat("Min neighbors:", min_neighbors, "\n")
cat("Max neighbors:", max_neighbors, "\n")
cat("Parcels with no neighbors:", sum(rowSums(W.P1) == 0), "\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 6: CREATING REFERENCE TABLE FOR INLA ===\n")

# Create reference table (map_sp equivalent)
map_sp <- data.frame(
  field = if("field" %in% names(shapefile)) shapefile$field else shapefile$ID.Field,
  ID.Field = shapefile$ID.Field
)

# Ensure ID.Field is numeric
map_sp$ID.Field <- as.numeric(map_sp$ID.Field)

cat("Reference table created:\n")
print(head(map_sp, 10))
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(map_sp), "rows x", ncol(map_sp), "columns\n")

cat("\n=== STEP 7: CREATING VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Set output folder
output_folder <- "spatial_analysis_output"
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("Created output folder:", output_folder, "\n")
}

# Plot 1: Distance distribution histogram
p_dist_hist <- ggplot(data.frame(distance = all_distances), aes(x = distance)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 110, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Boundary-to-Boundary Distances",
    subtitle = "Red line = Selected threshold (110m)",
    x = "Distance (meters)",
    y = "Frequency",
    caption = paste("Total parcel pairs:", length(all_distances))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Plot 2: Distance distribution (zoomed on lower values)
p_dist_zoom <- ggplot(data.frame(distance = all_distances[all_distances <= quantile(all_distances, 0.95)]), 
                      aes(x = distance)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 110, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance Distribution (Zoomed - 95th Percentile)",
    subtitle = "Red line = Selected threshold (110m)",
    x = "Distance (meters)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Plot 3: Number of neighbors per parcel
neighbor_counts <- rowSums(W.P1)
p_neighbors <- ggplot(data.frame(neighbors = neighbor_counts), aes(x = neighbors)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Neighbor Counts",
    subtitle = paste("Threshold: 110m | Avg neighbors:", round(avg_neighbors, 2)),
    x = "Number of Neighbors",
    y = "Number of Parcels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Plot 4: Spatial plot showing neighbor connections
# Sample some connections to avoid overcrowding
set.seed(123)
sample_parcels <- sample(1:nrow(shapefile), min(50, nrow(shapefile)))

# Create connection lines
connection_lines <- data.frame()
for (i in sample_parcels) {
  neighbors <- which(W.P1[i, ] == 1)
  if (length(neighbors) > 0) {
    for (j in neighbors) {
      connection_lines <- rbind(connection_lines, data.frame(
        x1 = shapefile$X.Centroid[i],
        y1 = shapefile$Y.Centroid[i],
        x2 = shapefile$X.Centroid[j],
        y2 = shapefile$Y.Centroid[j]
      ))
    }
  }
}

p_spatial <- ggplot(shapefile) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = rowSums(W.P1)), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Neighbors", option = "plasma") +
  {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                                               aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                                               color = "red", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.2)} +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Neighborhood Network",
    subtitle = paste("Color = Number of neighbors | Red lines = Sample connections (", 
                    nrow(connection_lines), "shown)"),
    caption = "Threshold: 110m"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Save plots
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "distance_distribution.png"), p_dist_hist, 
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "distance_distribution_zoomed.png"), p_dist_zoom, 
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "neighbor_counts.png"), p_neighbors, 
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "spatial_network.png"), p_spatial, 
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# Display plots
print(p_dist_hist)
print(p_dist_zoom)
print(p_neighbors)
print(p_spatial)

cat("\n=== STEP 8: UPDATING MAIN SHAPEFILE ===\n")

# The parcelles object is already updated with renamed columns and ID.Field
cat("Main shapefile already updated with renamed columns and ID.Field\n")
cat("Final attribute structure:\n")
print(names(st_drop_geometry(parcelles)))
```

## I.4. Spatial Network Plot

```{r}
# ===== COMPLETE SPATIAL NETWORK PLOT - STANDALONE CODE =====
# Load required libraries
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Assuming you already have these objects from previous analysis:
# - shapefile: your sf object with parcels
# - W.P1: adjacency matrix
# - DISTANCE_THRESHOLD: threshold value (110m)

cat("Creating complete spatial network plot...\n")

# ============================================================================
# CREATE CONNECTION LINES FOR ALL NEIGHBORS
# ============================================================================

cat("Generating connection lines for all neighbor relationships...\n")

# Create connection lines for ALL parcels (not just sample)
connection_lines <- data.frame()

# Progress tracking
total_parcels <- nrow(shapefile)
cat("Processing", total_parcels, "parcels...\n")

# Create connections for all parcels
for (i in 1:nrow(shapefile)) {
  # Show progress every 100 parcels
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("Processed", i, "of", total_parcels, "parcels\n")
  }
  
  # Find neighbors for current parcel
  neighbors <- which(W.P1[i, ] == 1)
  
  if (length(neighbors) > 0) {
    for (j in neighbors) {
      # Only add each connection once (avoid duplicates)
      if (i < j) {  # This ensures each pair is only added once
        connection_lines <- rbind(connection_lines, data.frame(
          parcel1 = i,
          parcel2 = j,
          x1 = shapefile$X.Centroid[i],
          y1 = shapefile$Y.Centroid[i],
          x2 = shapefile$X.Centroid[j],
          y2 = shapefile$Y.Centroid[j]
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("Total unique connections created:", nrow(connection_lines), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# CREATE COMPLETE SPATIAL NETWORK PLOT
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating spatial network plot...\n")

# Calculate neighbor counts for coloring
neighbor_counts <- rowSums(W.P1)

# Create the complete spatial network plot
p_complete_network <- ggplot(shapefile) +
  # Plot parcels colored by number of neighbors
  geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbor_counts), color = "gray90", size = 0.1) +
  
  # Add all connection lines
  {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) {
    geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                 aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                 color = "red", alpha = 0.4, size = 0.3)
  }} +
  
  # Color scale for neighbors
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Number of\nNeighbors", 
                       option = "plasma",
                       guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top")) +
  
  # Labels and titles
  labs(
    title = "Complete Spatial Neighborhood Network",
    subtitle = paste("All neighbor connections shown | Threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters"),
    caption = paste("Total connections:", nrow(connection_lines), 
                    "| Average neighbors per parcel:", round(mean(neighbor_counts), 2))
  ) +
  
  # White background theme
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm")
  )

# Display the plot
print(p_complete_network)

# ============================================================================
# SAVE THE PLOT
# ============================================================================

# Create output folder if it doesn't exist
output_folder <- "spatial_network_plots"
if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save high-resolution plot
output_file <- file.path(output_folder, "complete_spatial_network.png")
ggsave(output_file, p_complete_network, 
       width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("✅ Complete spatial network plot saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# OPTIONAL: CREATE ALTERNATIVE VERSIONS
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating alternative network plot versions...\n")

# Version 2: Simplified version with thinner lines
p_network_simple <- ggplot(shapefile) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbor_counts), color = "white", size = 0.05) +
  {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) {
    geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                 aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                 color = "red", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.15)
  }} +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Neighbors", option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Network - Simplified",
    subtitle = paste("Threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Version 3: High contrast version
p_network_contrast <- ggplot(shapefile) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbor_counts), color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) {
    geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                 aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                 color = "blue", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.2)
  }} +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgray", high = "darkred", name = "Neighbors") +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Network - High Contrast",
    subtitle = paste("Threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Save alternative versions
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "spatial_network_simple.png"), p_network_simple, 
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(output_folder, "spatial_network_contrast.png"), p_network_contrast, 
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== NETWORK SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total parcels:", nrow(shapefile), "\n")
cat("Total unique connections:", nrow(connection_lines), "\n")
cat("Average neighbors per parcel:", round(mean(neighbor_counts), 2), "\n")
cat("Min neighbors:", min(neighbor_counts), "\n")
cat("Max neighbors:", max(neighbor_counts), "\n")
cat("Parcels with no neighbors:", sum(neighbor_counts == 0), "\n")
cat("Distance threshold used:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Connection density
total_possible_connections <- (nrow(shapefile) * (nrow(shapefile) - 1)) / 2
connection_density <- nrow(connection_lines) / total_possible_connections
cat("Network density:", round(connection_density * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

# II. SOIL DATA INTEGRATION

## II.1. Soil Data Import & Type Conversion

**Purpose**: Load soil measurements CSV and ensure proper data types for analysis.

```{r}
# Load tidyverse for convenience
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Import the CSV
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/clean_soil_data_with_matched_parcels.csv", 
               sep = ";", 
               dec = ".", 
               header = TRUE,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert types
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Final_Cleaned_ID = as.factor(Final_Cleaned_ID),
    Detailed_Plot    = as.factor(Detailed_Plot),
    Year             = as.factor(Year),
    Texture          = as.factor(Texture),
    Sampling_Date    = as.Date(Sampling_Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    pH = as.numeric(pH),
    CN_Ratio = as.numeric(CN_Ratio)# adjust if needed
  )

# Round all numeric columns to 3 decimals
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

library(lubridate)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Month = factor(month(Sampling_Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
                   levels = month.abb) # ensures Jan–Dec order
  )

# Check result
table(df$Month)

# Inspect structure
str(df)

```

## II.2. Correspondence analysis before join

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE BEFORE JOIN
# ============================================================================

# Assuming 'parcelles' is shapefile from previous analysis
if (!exists("parcelles")) {
  cat("❌ Shapefile 'parcelles' not found in environment\n")
  cat("Please make sure you've run the previous spatial analysis script first\n")
  stop("Shapefile not available")
}

# Get unique IDs from both datasets
shp_ids <- unique(parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID)
soil_ids <- unique(df$Final_Cleaned_ID)

# Remove NA values
shp_ids <- shp_ids[!is.na(shp_ids)]
soil_ids <- soil_ids[!is.na(soil_ids)]

cat("📊 ID COMPARISON:\n")
cat("Shapefile unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(shp_ids), "\n")
cat("Soil data unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(soil_ids), "\n")

# Find matches
matches <- intersect(shp_ids, soil_ids)
cat("IDs in BOTH datasets:", length(matches), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# PERFORM THE JOIN WITH DECIMAL PRESERVATION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 JOINING DATASETS WITH DECIMAL PRESERVATION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

cat("Performing left join (preserving all decimal values)...\n")

# Define numeric columns from the soil data
numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]

# Before join - check a sample of numeric values
if (length(numeric_cols) > 0) {
  sample_numeric_col <- numeric_cols[1]
  cat("BEFORE JOIN - Sample values from", sample_numeric_col, ":\n")
  sample_vals <- head(df[[sample_numeric_col]][!is.na(df[[sample_numeric_col]])], 5)
  cat(paste(sample_vals, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Perform the join
parcelles_with_soil <- parcelles %>%
  left_join(df, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID")

cat("✅ Join completed!\n")
cat("Joined dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_with_soil), "rows x", ncol(parcelles_with_soil), "columns\n")

# After join - verify decimal preservation
if (length(numeric_cols) > 0 && sample_numeric_col %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
  cat("AFTER JOIN - Sample values from", sample_numeric_col, ":\n")
  sample_vals_after <- head(parcelles_with_soil[[sample_numeric_col]][!is.na(parcelles_with_soil[[sample_numeric_col]])], 5)
  cat(paste(sample_vals_after, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Check if decimals are preserved
  if (all(sample_vals == sample_vals_after, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    cat("✅ Decimal values preserved correctly!\n")
  } else {
    cat("❌ Decimal values may have been altered!\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# VERIFY DECIMAL PRESERVATION IN JOINED DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\n✅ DECIMAL PRESERVATION VERIFICATION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Check all numeric columns from soil data in joined dataset
soil_numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
preserved_decimals <- TRUE

for (col in soil_numeric_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
    # Get sample of non-NA values
    original_vals <- df[[col]][!is.na(df[[col]])]
    joined_vals <- parcelles_with_soil[[col]][!is.na(parcelles_with_soil[[col]])]
    
    # Check if any values have decimals
    has_decimals_orig <- any(original_vals %% 1 != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    has_decimals_joined <- any(joined_vals %% 1 != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (has_decimals_orig && !has_decimals_joined) {
      cat("❌", col, ": Decimals lost in join!\n")
      preserved_decimals <- FALSE
    } else if (has_decimals_orig && has_decimals_joined) {
      cat("✅", col, ": Decimals preserved\n")
    } else {
      cat("•", col, ": Integer values (no decimals to preserve)\n")
    }
  }
}

if (preserved_decimals) {
  cat("\n🎉 ALL DECIMAL VALUES SUCCESSFULLY PRESERVED!\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠️ SOME DECIMAL VALUES MAY HAVE BEEN LOST - CHECK DATA TYPES\n")

# ============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS WITH PROPER DECIMAL HANDLING

cat("\n💾 SAVING RESULTS WITH DECIMAL PRESERVATION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED MAPPING FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ CREATING ENHANCED MAPPING FUNCTION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

create_enhanced_soil_map <- function(data, variable, label, output_dir) {
  
  cat("Creating map for:", variable, "\n")
  
  # Filter data to only include non-NA values for the variable
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(variable)))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0) {
    cat("❌ No data available for", variable, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate statistics
  var_values <- data_clean[[variable]]
  var_mean <- mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  var_median <- median(var_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  var_min <- min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  var_max <- max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  var_q25 <- quantile(var_values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  var_q75 <- quantile(var_values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("  Range:", round(var_min, 3), "-", round(var_max, 3), 
      "| Mean:", round(var_mean, 3), "| Records:", nrow(data_clean), "\n")
  
  # Choose color palette based on variable type
  if (grepl("pH", variable)) {
    colors <- c("#d73027", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#a6d96a", "#66bd63", "#1a9850")
  } else if (grepl("percent|%", variable) || grepl("Clay|Silt|Sand", variable)) {
    colors <- brewer.pal(9, "YlOrBr")
  } else if (grepl("Carbon|Nitrogen|Organic", variable)) {
    colors <- brewer.pal(9, "Greens")
  } else if (grepl("Calcium|Magnesium|Potassium|Sodium", variable)) {
    colors <- brewer.pal(9, "Blues")
  } else {
    colors <- viridis(9, option = "plasma")
  }
  
  # Create the map with enhanced styling
  map <- ggplot(data_clean) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = !!sym(variable)), 
            color = "grey90", 
            size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = colors,
      name = label,
      labels = function(x) format(x, digits = 3, nsmall = 1),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1.5,
        barheight = 15,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        label.position = "right"
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20, 
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        margin = margin(b = 20),
        color = "black"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 14, 
        hjust = 0.5, 
        margin = margin(b = 20),
        color = "grey30"
      ),
      legend.title = element_text(
        size = 12, 
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black"
      ),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white", 
        color = NA
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white", 
        color = NA
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = label,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "N = ", nrow(data_clean), " parcelles | ",
        "Min: ", round(var_min, 2), " | ",
        "Mean: ", round(var_mean, 2), " | ",
        "Max: ", round(var_max, 2)
      )
    )
  
  # Save the map
  filename <- paste0(output_dir, "/", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", variable), "_map.png")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = map,
    width = 16,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 300,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("  ✅ Saved:", basename(filename), "\n")
  
  return(map)
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE MAPS FOR ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🚀 CREATING MAPS FOR ALL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

# Initialize progress tracking
total_vars <- length(soil_variables)
created_maps <- 0
failed_maps <- 0

# Create maps for each variable
for (i in seq_along(soil_variables)) {
  var <- soil_variables[i]
  label <- variable_labels[var]
  
  cat(sprintf("Progress: %d/%d - ", i, total_vars))
  
  # Check if variable exists in the data
  if (!var %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
    cat("❌ Variable", var, "not found in dataset\n")
    failed_maps <- failed_maps + 1
    next
  }
  
  # Create the map
  result <- tryCatch({
    create_enhanced_soil_map(parcelles_with_soil, var, label, output_dir)
    created_maps <- created_maps + 1
    "success"
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error creating map for", var, ":", e$message, "\n")
    failed_maps <- failed_maps + 1
    "failed"
  })
  
  # Add small delay to prevent memory issues
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE SUMMARY STATISTICS TABLE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING SUMMARY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Calculate summary statistics for all variables
summary_stats <- data.frame()

for (var in soil_variables) {
  if (var %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
    values <- parcelles_with_soil[[var]][!is.na(parcelles_with_soil[[var]])]
    
    if (length(values) > 0) {
      stats <- data.frame(
        Variable = variable_labels[var],
        N = length(values),
        Min = round(min(values), 3),
        Q25 = round(quantile(values, 0.25), 3),
        Median = round(median(values), 3),
        Mean = round(mean(values), 3),
        Q75 = round(quantile(values, 0.75), 3),
        Max = round(max(values), 3),
        SD = round(sd(values), 3)
      )
      summary_stats <- rbind(summary_stats, stats)
    }
  }
}

# Save summary statistics
stats_filename <- paste0(output_dir, "/soil_variables_summary_statistics.csv")
write.csv(summary_stats, stats_filename, row.names = FALSE)

cat("✅ Summary statistics saved to:", basename(stats_filename), "\n")
print(head(summary_stats, 10))

# ============================================================================
# CREATE INDEX HTML FILE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🌐 CREATING HTML INDEX:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Create an HTML file to view all maps
html_content <- paste0(
  "<!DOCTYPE html>\n",
  "<html>\n",
  "<head>\n",
  "    <title>Soil Variables Maps</title>\n",
  "    <style>\n",
  "        body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 20px; background: white; }\n",
  "        h1 { color: #2c3e50; text-align: center; }\n",
  "        .map-container { margin: 20px 0; text-align: center; }\n",
  "        .map-container img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; }\n",
  "        .map-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; margin: 10px 0; color: #34495e; }\n",
  "    </style>\n",
  "</head>\n",
  "<body>\n",
  "    <h1>Soil Variables Spatial Distribution Maps</h1>\n",
  "    <p style='text-align: center; color: #7f8c8d;'>Generated from GeoPackage data with preserved decimal precision</p>\n"
)

# Add each map to HTML
for (var in soil_variables) {
  if (var %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
    img_filename <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", var), "_map.png")
    if (file.exists(paste0(output_dir, "/", img_filename))) {
      html_content <- paste0(
        html_content,
        "    <div class='map-container'>\n",
        "        <div class='map-title'>", variable_labels[var], "</div>\n",
        "        <img src='", img_filename, "' alt='", variable_labels[var], "'>\n",
        "    </div>\n"
      )
    }
  }
}

html_content <- paste0(html_content, "</body>\n</html>")

# Save HTML file
html_filename <- paste0(output_dir, "/index.html")
writeLines(html_content, html_filename)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SOIL DATA MAPPING BY YEAR - FACETED MAPS
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  YEARLY FACET MAPPING\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# LOAD AND INSPECT DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING AND INSPECTING DATA:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_data.gpkg"

if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ GeoPackage not found at: ", gpkg_path)
}

parcelles_with_soil <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Data loaded:", nrow(parcelles_with_soil), "features with", ncol(parcelles_with_soil), "columns\n")

# Print column names to understand data structure
cat("\n🔍 COLUMN INSPECTION:\n")
all_columns <- names(parcelles_with_soil)
cat("All columns (", length(all_columns), "):\n")
print(all_columns)

# ============================================================================
# INTELLIGENT YEAR DETECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📅 INTELLIGENT YEAR DETECTION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Look for year-related columns
year_candidates <- all_columns[grepl("year|Year|YEAR|date|Date|DATE|time|Time", all_columns, ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat("Year/Date candidates found:", paste(year_candidates, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Function to extract year from various formats
extract_year <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    # If already numeric, check if it's a reasonable year
    if (all(x >= 1900 & x <= 2100, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      return(as.integer(x))
    }
  }
  
  # Try as character and extract 4-digit year
  x_char <- as.character(x)
  year_match <- regexpr("\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b", x_char)
  years <- regmatches(x_char, year_match)
  
  if (length(years) > 0 && !is.na(years[1])) {
    return(as.integer(years))
  }
  
  # Try parsing as date
  tryCatch({
    dates <- as.Date(x)
    return(as.integer(format(dates, "%Y")))
  }, error = function(e) NA)
}

# Try to find or create Year column
Year_column_created <- FALSE

if ("Year" %in% all_columns) {
  cat("✅ 'Year' column found\n")
  # Check if it's valid
  test_years <- parcelles_with_soil$Year[!is.na(parcelles_with_soil$Year)]
  if (length(test_years) > 0 && all(test_years >= 1900 & test_years <= 2100)) {
    cat("✅ Year column is valid\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠️ Year column exists but contains invalid values, trying to fix...\n")
    parcelles_with_soil$Year <- extract_year(parcelles_with_soil$Year)
    Year_column_created <- TRUE
  }
} else if (length(year_candidates) > 0) {
  cat("🔍 Trying to extract year from:", year_candidates[1], "\n")
  
  # Try each candidate
  for (candidate in year_candidates) {
    test_years <- extract_year(parcelles_with_soil[[candidate]])
    valid_years <- test_years[!is.na(test_years)]
    
    if (length(valid_years) > 0 && all(valid_years >= 1900 & valid_years <= 2100)) {
      parcelles_with_soil$Year <- test_years
      cat("✅ Successfully extracted years from:", candidate, "\n")
      Year_column_created <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (!Year_column_created) {
    cat("❌ Could not extract valid years from any candidate column\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("❌ No year/date columns found. Creating dummy year for demonstration...\n")
  # Create a dummy year based on row groups for demonstration
  n_rows <- nrow(parcelles_with_soil)
  n_years <- min(5, max(1, n_rows %/% 100))  # Create 1-5 years based on data size
  parcelles_with_soil$Year <- rep(2020:(2020 + n_years - 1), length.out = n_rows)
  Year_column_created <- TRUE
  cat("⚠️ Created dummy years:", min(parcelles_with_soil$Year), "-", max(parcelles_with_soil$Year), "\n")
}

# Validate final Year column
if (!"Year" %in% names(parcelles_with_soil)) {
  stop("❌ Could not create or find valid Year column")
}

years_available <- sort(unique(parcelles_with_soil$Year[!is.na(parcelles_with_soil$Year)]))
cat("📅 Final years available (", length(years_available), "):", paste(years_available, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(years_available) == 0) {
  stop("❌ No valid year data found")
}

# ============================================================================
# DEFINE AND VALIDATE SOIL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 SOIL VARIABLES DETECTION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# All possible soil variables
all_soil_variables <- c(
  "pH", "CN_Ratio", "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g", "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", "Clay_percent", "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent", "Fine_Sand_percent", "Coarse_Sand_percent",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille", "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Total_Silt_percent", "Total_Sand_percent", "Organic_Matter_percent",
  "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g", "CaO_g_100g",
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio", "Mg_K_Ratio", "Compaction_Index"
)

# Find existing soil variables
existing_soil_vars <- all_soil_variables[all_soil_variables %in% all_columns]
cat("Soil variables found:", length(existing_soil_vars), "/", length(all_soil_variables), "\n")

# If few standard variables found, look for numeric columns that might be soil variables
if (length(existing_soil_vars) < 5) {
  cat("🔍 Searching for additional numeric soil-like variables...\n")
  
  # Get numeric columns (excluding geometry and Year)
  numeric_cols <- sapply(parcelles_with_soil, function(x) is.numeric(x) && !all(is.na(x)))
  numeric_col_names <- names(numeric_cols)[numeric_cols]
  
  # Exclude geometry and administrative columns
  exclude_patterns <- c("^geom", "^fid", "^id", "^ID", "Year", "year")
  additional_vars <- numeric_col_names[!grepl(paste(exclude_patterns, collapse = "|"), numeric_col_names)]
  
  cat("Additional numeric variables found:", length(additional_vars), "\n")
  if (length(additional_vars) > 0) {
    cat("Additional variables:", paste(head(additional_vars, 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    existing_soil_vars <- c(existing_soil_vars, additional_vars)
  }
}

# Create labels for all variables

# Add specific labels for known variables

  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille" = "Organic Carbon (‰)",

)

  }
}

cat("Final variables to process:", length(existing_soil_vars), "\n")

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
output_dir <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/yearly_facet_maps"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("📁 Created output directory\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# INTELLIGENT HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🧠 SETTING UP INTELLIGENT FUNCTIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Smart grid calculation
get_smart_grid <- function(n_years) {
  if (n_years == 1) return(c(1, 1))
  if (n_years == 2) return(c(1, 2))
  if (n_years <= 4) return(c(2, 2))
  if (n_years <= 6) return(c(2, 3))
  if (n_years <= 9) return(c(3, 3))
  if (n_years <= 12) return(c(3, 4))
  
  # For more years, use square-ish layout
  ncol <- ceiling(sqrt(n_years))
  nrow <- ceiling(n_years / ncol)
  return(c(nrow, ncol))
}

# Smart color palette selection
get_smart_colors <- function(variable, values) {
  # Base the palette on variable name and value distribution
  if (grepl("pH|ph", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c("#d73027", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#a6d96a", "#66bd63", "#1a9850"))
  } else if (grepl("percent|%|Clay|Silt|Sand", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrBr"))
  } else if (grepl("Carbon|Nitrogen|Organic", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))
  } else if (grepl("Calcium|Magnesium|Potassium|Sodium", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
  } else {
    # Use viridis for unknown variables
    return(viridis(9, option = "plasma"))
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# ROBUST YEARLY FACET MAPPING FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ ROBUST MAPPING FUNCTION:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

create_robust_yearly_map <- function(data, variable, output_dir) {
  
  cat("\n🎯 Processing:", variable, "\n")
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (!variable %in% names(data)) {
    cat("❌ Variable not found in data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Prepare data: remove NA values and ensure proper data types
  data_prep <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(variable)) & !is.na(Year)) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.factor(Year),  # Convert to factor for ggplot faceting
      !!variable := as.numeric(!!sym(variable))  # Ensure numeric
    )
  
  if (nrow(data_prep) == 0) {
    cat("❌ No valid data after filtering\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get summary statistics
  years_with_data <- sort(as.numeric(as.character(unique(data_prep$Year))))
  n_years <- length(years_with_data)
  
  values <- as.numeric(data_prep[[variable]])
  val_range <- range(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_mean <- mean(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("  📊 Years:", paste(years_with_data, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  📈 Range:", round(val_range[1], 3), "-", round(val_range[2], 3), "\n")
  cat("  📈 Mean:", round(val_mean, 3), "\n")
  cat("  📋 Records:", nrow(data_prep), "\n")
  
  # Check data distribution by year
  year_summary <- data_prep %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_val = mean(!!sym(variable), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("  📅 Data by year:\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(year_summary)) {
    cat("    ", year_summary$Year[i], ":", year_summary$n[i], "parcels\n")
  }
  
  # Create background (simplified geometry for better performance)
  # Get the geometry column name (it might be 'geom', 'geometry', or similar)
  geom_col <- attr(data, "sf_column")
  if (is.null(geom_col)) {
    # Fallback: find the geometry column
    geom_col <- names(data)[sapply(data, function(x) inherits(x, "sfc"))]
    if (length(geom_col) == 0) geom_col <- "geometry"  # default fallback
    geom_col <- geom_col[1]  # take first if multiple
  }
  
  background <- data %>%
    select(all_of(geom_col)) %>%
    slice_sample(n = min(1000, nrow(data)))  # Sample for performance
  
  # Get colors and grid
  colors <- get_smart_colors(variable, values)
  grid_dims <- get_smart_grid(n_years)
  
  # Build plot step by step
  cat("  🎨 Creating plot...\n")
  
  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot()
  
  # Add background if reasonable size
  if (nrow(background) < 2000) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = background, 
                     fill = "grey98", 
                     color = "grey95", 
                     size = 0.05,
                     alpha = 0.4)
  }
  
  # Add data layer
  p <- p + geom_sf(data = data_prep, 
                   aes(fill = !!sym(variable)), 
                   color = "white", 
                   size = 0.1)
  
  # Add color scale
  p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = colors,
    name = variable_labels[variable],
    limits = val_range,
    labels = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 1),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 1,
      barheight = 10,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  )
  
  # Add faceting - This is the key fix!
  p <- p + facet_wrap(
    vars(Year),  # Use vars() instead of ~Year
    ncol = grid_dims[2],
    nrow = grid_dims[1],
    scales = "fixed",
    labeller = labeller(Year = function(x) paste("Year", x))
  )
  
  # Apply theme
  p <- p + theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", size = 0.3),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  # Add labels
  p <- p + labs(
    title = paste("Yearly Distribution:", variable_labels[variable]),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Years: ", min(years_with_data), "-", max(years_with_data),
      " | Range: ", round(val_range[1], 2), "-", round(val_range[2], 2),
      " | Records: ", nrow(data_prep)
    )
  )
  
  # Calculate dimensions
  map_width <- max(8, 3 * grid_dims[2] + 2)
  map_height <- max(6, 2.5 * grid_dims[1] + 1.5)
  
  # Save plot
  filename <- paste0(output_dir, "/", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", variable), "_yearly_facet.png")
  
  tryCatch({
    ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = p,
      width = map_width,
      height = map_height,
      dpi = 300,
      units = "in",
      bg = "white"
    )
    cat("  ✅ Saved successfully:", basename(filename), "\n")
    return(p)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ❌ Save failed:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🚀 PROCESSING ALL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Test with first variable to ensure everything works
if (length(existing_soil_vars) > 0) {
  cat("🧪 Testing with first variable:", existing_soil_vars[1], "\n")
  test_result <- create_robust_yearly_map(parcelles_with_soil, existing_soil_vars[1], output_dir)
  
  if (!is.null(test_result)) {
    cat("✅ Test successful! Processing remaining variables...\n")
    
    # Process remaining variables
    successful_maps <- 1  # Count the test
    failed_maps <- 0
    
    if (length(existing_soil_vars) > 1) {
      for (i in 2:length(existing_soil_vars)) {
        var <- existing_soil_vars[i]
        cat("\n📍 Progress:", i, "/", length(existing_soil_vars), "-", var, "\n")
        
        result <- tryCatch({
          map_result <- create_robust_yearly_map(parcelles_with_soil, var, output_dir)
          if (!is.null(map_result)) {
            successful_maps <- successful_maps + 1
            "success"
          } else {
            failed_maps <- failed_maps + 1
            "failed"
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("❌ Unexpected error:", e$message, "\n")
          failed_maps <- failed_maps + 1
          "error"
        })
        
        # Memory cleanup
        if (i %% 3 == 0) {
          gc()
          Sys.sleep(0.5)
        }
      }
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("❌ Test failed! Check your data structure\n")
    successful_maps <- 0
    failed_maps <- 1
  }
} else {
  cat("❌ No soil variables found to process\n")
  successful_maps <- 0
  failed_maps <- 0
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE SIMPLE HTML INDEX
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🌐 CREATING HTML INDEX:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")

# List all PNG files created
png_files <- list.files(output_dir, pattern = ".*_yearly_facet\\.png$", full.names = FALSE)

if (length(png_files) > 0) {
  html_content <- paste0(
    "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html><head>\n",
    "<title>Yearly Facet Maps</title>\n",
    "<style>body{font-family:Arial;margin:20px;} .map{text-align:center;margin:30px 0;} ",
    ".map img{max-width:100%;border:1px solid #ccc;} h1{color:#333;}</style>\n",
    "</head><body>\n",
    "<h1>Soil Variables - Yearly Facet Maps</h1>\n",
    "<p>Generated on: ", Sys.Date(), " | Maps created: ", length(png_files), "</p>\n"
  )
  
  for (png_file in png_files) {
    var_name <- gsub("_yearly_facet\\.png$", "", png_file)
    var_name <- gsub("_", " ", var_name)
    html_content <- paste0(html_content, 
                          "<div class='map'><h3>", var_name, "</h3>",
                          "<img src='", png_file, "' alt='", var_name, "'></div>\n")
  }
  
  html_content <- paste0(html_content, "</body></html>")
  
  html_file <- paste0(output_dir, "/index.html")
  writeLines(html_content, html_file)
  
  cat("✅ HTML index created:", basename(html_file), "\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️ No PNG files found to include in HTML\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED JOIN WITH ALL PARCELS AND ALL YEARS (1992-2025)
# ============================================================================

# Assuming 'parcelles' is shapefile from previous analysis
if (!exists("parcelles")) {
  cat("❌ Shapefile 'parcelles' not found in environment\n")
  cat("Please make sure you've run the previous spatial analysis script first\n")
  stop("Shapefile not available")
}

# Check if df (soil data) exists
if (!exists("df")) {
  cat("❌ Soil data 'df' not found in environment\n")
  cat("Please make sure you've loaded the soil data first\n")
  stop("Soil data not available")
}

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readr)

# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE BEFORE JOIN
# ============================================================================

# Get unique IDs from both datasets
shp_ids <- unique(parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID)
soil_ids <- unique(df$Final_Cleaned_ID)

# Remove NA values
shp_ids <- shp_ids[!is.na(shp_ids)]
soil_ids <- soil_ids[!is.na(soil_ids)]

cat("📊 ID COMPARISON:\n")
cat("Shapefile unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(shp_ids), "\n")
cat("Soil data unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(soil_ids), "\n")

# Find matches
matches <- intersect(shp_ids, soil_ids)
cat("IDs in BOTH datasets:", length(matches), "\n")
cat("Parcels WITHOUT soil data:", length(shp_ids) - length(matches), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# CREATE EXPANDED DATASET WITH ALL YEARS (1992-2025)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📅 CREATING EXPANDED DATASET WITH ALL YEARS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Define the year range
years <- 1992:2025
cat("Creating rows for years:", min(years), "to", max(years), "(", length(years), "years )\n")

# Step 1: Create base parcel-year combinations
cat("Step 1: Expanding parcels to include all years...\n")

# Get all unique parcel IDs (including those without soil data)
all_parcel_ids <- unique(parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID)
all_parcel_ids <- all_parcel_ids[!is.na(all_parcel_ids)]

# Create expanded parcel dataset with all years
parcelles_expanded <- parcelles %>%
  # Convert to regular dataframe temporarily to avoid geometry duplication issues
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # Keep only unique parcels (remove any duplicates)
  distinct(Final_Cleaned_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Create all year combinations
  slice(rep(1:n(), each = length(years))) %>%
  # Add year column
  mutate(Year = rep(years, times = n()/length(years)))

cat("✅ Expanded parcels dataset created:", nrow(parcelles_expanded), "rows\n")
cat("   (", length(all_parcel_ids), "parcels ×", length(years), "years )\n")

# ============================================================================
# PREPARE SOIL DATA FOR JOIN
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 2: Preparing soil data for join...\n")

# Check if soil data has a Year column, if not, try to infer it
if (!"Year" %in% names(df)) {
  cat("⚠️ No 'Year' column found in soil data\n")
  cat("Available columns in soil data:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Try to find year-related columns
  year_cols <- names(df)[grepl("year|Year|YEAR|date|Date|DATE|time|Time", names(df))]
  if (length(year_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Potential year columns found:", paste(year_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("⚠️ Please manually specify which column contains the year information\n")
  }
  
  # For now, we'll assume all soil data is from a single year or create a placeholder
  cat("Creating placeholder year column - please adjust as needed\n")
  df$Year <- 2020  # Default year - ADJUST THIS BASED ON YOUR DATA
}

# ============================================================================
# FIX DATA TYPE INCOMPATIBILITY FOR YEAR COLUMNS
# ============================================================================
cat("🔧 FIXING DATA TYPES FOR JOIN:\n")

# Check and display current data types
cat("Current data types:\n")
cat("• parcelles_expanded$Year:", class(parcelles_expanded$Year), "\n")
cat("• df$Year:", class(df$Year), "\n")

# Convert both Year columns to integer to ensure compatibility
cat("Converting Year columns to integer...\n")

# Convert expanded parcels Year to integer (should already be, but ensure)
parcelles_expanded$Year <- as.integer(parcelles_expanded$Year)

# Convert soil data Year to integer (this fixes the factor issue)
if (is.factor(df$Year)) {
  cat("Converting Year from factor to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(as.character(df$Year))
} else if (is.character(df$Year)) {
  cat("Converting Year from character to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(df$Year)
} else {
  cat("Converting Year to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(df$Year)
}

# Verify conversion
cat("After conversion:\n")
cat("• parcelles_expanded$Year:", class(parcelles_expanded$Year), "\n")
cat("• df$Year:", class(df$Year), "\n")

# Check for any NA values created during conversion
na_count_parcelles <- sum(is.na(parcelles_expanded$Year))
na_count_soil <- sum(is.na(df$Year))

if (na_count_parcelles > 0) {
  cat("⚠️ Warning: ", na_count_parcelles, " NA values in parcelles Year column\n")
}
if (na_count_soil > 0) {
  cat("⚠️ Warning: ", na_count_soil, " NA values in soil data Year column\n")
}

# Get unique years in soil data

soil_years <- soil_years[!is.na(soil_years)]
cat("Years available in soil data:", paste(sort(soil_years), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Identify soil data columns (excluding ID and Year)
soil_data_columns <- names(df)[!names(df) %in% c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year")]
numeric_soil_cols <- soil_data_columns[sapply(df[soil_data_columns], is.numeric)]

cat("Soil data columns to join:", length(soil_data_columns), "\n")
cat("Numeric soil columns:", length(numeric_soil_cols), "\n")

# ============================================================================

# Before join - check sample numeric values

  sample_col <- numeric_soil_cols[1]
  cat("BEFORE JOIN - Sample values from", sample_col, ":\n")
  sample_vals <- head(df[[sample_col]][!is.na(df[[sample_col]])], 5)
  cat(paste(sample_vals, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Perform the enhanced join
cat("Performing left join on Final_Cleaned_ID AND Year...\n")
parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_expanded %>%
  left_join(df, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"))

cat("✅ Enhanced join completed!\n")
cat("Final dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_with_soil_complete), "rows x", ncol(parcelles_with_soil_complete), "columns\n")

# ============================================================================

geometry_data <- parcelles %>%
  dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, geometry)

# Join geometry back to the complete dataset
parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_with_soil_complete %>%

  left_join(geometry_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
  st_sf()

cat("✅ Geometry added back to dataset\n")

# ============================================================================
# VERIFY RESULTS AND DATA QUALITY
# ============================================================================

cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Check data completeness
total_rows <- nrow(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
rows_with_soil_data <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_with_soil_complete[[soil_data_columns[1]]]), na.rm = TRUE)
rows_without_soil_data <- total_rows - rows_with_soil_data

cat("Total rows in final dataset:", total_rows, "\n")

cat("Rows WITHOUT soil data (NA values):", rows_without_soil_data, "\n")

# Check year distribution

# Verify decimal preservation

  for (col in head(numeric_soil_cols, 3)) {  # Check first 3 numeric columns
    if (col %in% names(parcelles_with_soil_complete)) {

        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# SAVE ENHANCED RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Define output paths

# Save attributes as CSV (full decimal precision)
st_drop_geometry(parcelles_with_soil_complete) %>%
```

```{r}
# Check if soil data has a Year column, if not, try to infer it
if (!"Year" %in% names(df)) {
  cat("⚠️ No 'Year' column found in soil data\n")
  cat("Available columns in soil data:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Try to find year-related columns
  year_cols <- names(df)[grepl("year|Year|YEAR|date|Date|DATE|time|Time", names(df))]
  if (length(year_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Potential year columns found:", paste(year_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("⚠️ Please manually specify which column contains the year information\n")
  }
  
  # For now, we'll assume all soil data is from a single year or create a placeholder
  cat("Creating placeholder year column - please adjust as needed\n")
  df$Year <- 2020  # Default year - ADJUST THIS BASED ON YOUR DATA
}

# ============================================================================
# FIX DATA TYPE INCOMPATIBILITY FOR YEAR COLUMNS
# ============================================================================
cat("🔧 FIXING DATA TYPES FOR JOIN:\n")

# Check and display current data types
cat("Current data types:\n")
cat("• parcelles_expanded$Year:", class(parcelles_expanded$Year), "\n")
cat("• df$Year:", class(df$Year), "\n")

# Convert both Year columns to integer to ensure compatibility
cat("Converting Year columns to integer...\n")

# Convert expanded parcels Year to integer (should already be, but ensure)
parcelles_expanded$Year <- as.integer(parcelles_expanded$Year)

# Convert soil data Year to integer (this fixes the factor issue)
if (is.factor(df$Year)) {
  cat("Converting Year from factor to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(as.character(df$Year))
} else if (is.character(df$Year)) {
  cat("Converting Year from character to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(df$Year)
} else {
  cat("Converting Year to integer...\n")
  df$Year <- as.integer(df$Year)
}

# FILTER SOIL DATA TO 2003-2025 RANGE
cat("🔍 FILTERING SOIL DATA TO 2003-2025 RANGE:\n")
original_soil_rows <- nrow(df)
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Year >= 2003 & Year <= 2025)

cat("Original soil data rows:", original_soil_rows, "\n")
cat("Filtered soil data rows (2003-2025):", nrow(df_filtered), "\n")
cat("Rows dropped (outside 2003-2025):", original_soil_rows - nrow(df_filtered), "\n")

# Update df to use filtered version
df <- df_filtered

# Verify conversion
cat("After conversion and filtering:\n")
cat("• parcelles_expanded$Year:", class(parcelles_expanded$Year), "\n")
cat("• df$Year:", class(df$Year), "\n")

# Check for any NA values created during conversion
na_count_parcelles <- sum(is.na(parcelles_expanded$Year))
na_count_soil <- sum(is.na(df$Year))

if (na_count_parcelles > 0) {
  cat("⚠️ Warning: ", na_count_parcelles, " NA values in parcelles Year column\n")
}
if (na_count_soil > 0) {
  cat("⚠️ Warning: ", na_count_soil, " NA values in soil data Year column\n")
}

# Get unique years in soil data (after filtering)
soil_years <- unique(df$Year)
soil_years <- soil_years[!is.na(soil_years)]
cat("Years available in filtered soil data:", paste(sort(soil_years), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Identify soil data columns (excluding ID and Year)
soil_data_columns <- names(df)[!names(df) %in% c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year")]
numeric_soil_cols <- soil_data_columns[sapply(df[soil_data_columns], is.numeric)]

cat("Soil data columns to join:", length(soil_data_columns), "\n")
cat("Numeric soil columns:", length(numeric_soil_cols), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# PERFORM ENHANCED JOIN
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 PERFORMING ENHANCED JOIN (2003-2025):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

# Before join - check sample numeric values
if (length(numeric_soil_cols) > 0) {
  sample_col <- numeric_soil_cols[1]
  cat("BEFORE JOIN - Sample values from", sample_col, ":\n")
  sample_vals <- head(df[[sample_col]][!is.na(df[[sample_col]])], 5)
  cat(paste(sample_vals, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Perform the enhanced join
cat("Performing left join on Final_Cleaned_ID AND Year (2003-2025 range)...\n")
parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_expanded %>%
  left_join(df, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"))

cat("✅ Enhanced join completed!\n")
cat("Final dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_with_soil_complete), "rows x", ncol(parcelles_with_soil_complete), "columns\n")

# ============================================================================
# ADD GEOMETRY BACK TO THE DATASET - MULTIPLE METHODS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ ADDING GEOMETRY BACK TO DATASET:\n")

# First, let's check what columns exist in parcelles
cat("Checking available columns in parcelles:\n")
cat(paste(names(parcelles), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Check if Final_Cleaned_ID exists
if (!"Final_Cleaned_ID" %in% names(parcelles)) {
  cat("⚠️ Final_Cleaned_ID not found in parcelles. Available ID columns:\n")
  id_cols <- names(parcelles)[grepl("id|ID|Id", names(parcelles), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  cat(paste(id_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  stop("Please check the correct ID column name")
}

# METHOD 1: Direct geometry extraction (most robust)
cat("Method 1: Direct geometry extraction...\n")
tryCatch({
  # Extract geometry directly and create lookup
  geom_lookup <- data.frame(
    Final_Cleaned_ID = parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  geom_lookup$geometry <- st_geometry(parcelles)
  geometry_data <- st_sf(geom_lookup)
  
  cat("✅ Method 1 successful - Geometry data prepared with", nrow(geometry_data), "features\n")
  method_used <- 1
  
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("❌ Method 1 failed:", e$message, "\n")
  
  # METHOD 2: Using dplyr but with bracket notation
  cat("Method 2: Using bracket selection...\n")
  tryCatch({
    geometry_data <<- parcelles[, c("Final_Cleaned_ID")]
    cat("✅ Method 2 successful - Geometry data prepared with", nrow(geometry_data), "features\n")
    method_used <<- 2
    
  }, error = function(e2) {
    cat("❌ Method 2 failed:", e2$message, "\n")
    
    # METHOD 3: Manual approach
    cat("Method 3: Manual geometry handling...\n")
    tryCatch({
      # Create a simple dataframe with ID and geometry
      temp_df <- data.frame(
        Final_Cleaned_ID = parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # Add geometry manually
      temp_df$geometry <- st_geometry(parcelles)
      
      # Convert to sf
      geometry_data <<- st_sf(temp_df)
      cat("✅ Method 3 successful - Geometry data prepared with", nrow(geometry_data), "features\n")
      method_used <<- 3
      
    }, error = function(e3) {
      cat("❌ All methods failed. Using fallback approach...\n")
      
      # METHOD 4: Fallback - store geometry separately
      cat("Method 4: Fallback geometry storage...\n")
      geometry_vector <<- st_geometry(parcelles)
      id_vector <<- parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID
      geometry_data <<- NULL
      method_used <<- 4
      cat("✅ Method 4: Geometry stored as vector\n")
    })
  })
})

# Join geometry back to the complete dataset
cat("\nJoining geometry back to expanded dataset...\n")

if (exists("method_used") && method_used == 4) {
  # Fallback method - add geometry directly
  cat("Using fallback geometry join...\n")
  
  # Ensure we start with a regular dataframe (no geometry)
  parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_with_soil_complete %>%
    {if("sf" %in% class(.)) st_drop_geometry(.) else .}
  
  # Add geometry by matching IDs
  geometry_indices <- match(parcelles_with_soil_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID, id_vector)
  parcelles_with_soil_complete$geometry <- geometry_vector[geometry_indices]
  
  # Convert to sf
  parcelles_with_soil_complete <- st_sf(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
  
} else if (!is.null(geometry_data)) {
  # Normal method - join with geometry data
  parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_with_soil_complete %>%
    # Ensure we start with a regular dataframe (no geometry)
    {if("sf" %in% class(.)) st_drop_geometry(.) else .} %>%
    # Join with the spatial data to get geometry back
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(geometry_data), by = "Final_Cleaned_ID")
  
  # Add geometry column
  geometry_indices <- match(parcelles_with_soil_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID, geometry_data$Final_Cleaned_ID)
  parcelles_with_soil_complete$geometry <- st_geometry(geometry_data)[geometry_indices]
  
  # Convert to sf
  parcelles_with_soil_complete <- st_sf(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
}

# Verify it's an sf object
if (!"sf" %in% class(parcelles_with_soil_complete)) {
  cat("⚠️ Converting back to sf object...\n")
  parcelles_with_soil_complete <- st_as_sf(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
}

cat("✅ Geometry added back to dataset\n")
cat("Dataset class:", paste(class(parcelles_with_soil_complete), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check geometry column name
if ("sf" %in% class(parcelles_with_soil_complete)) {
  geom_col_name <- attr(parcelles_with_soil_complete, "sf_column")
  cat("Geometry column name:", geom_col_name, "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# VERIFY RESULTS AND DATA QUALITY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n✅ VERIFYING RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Check data completeness
total_rows <- nrow(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
if (length(soil_data_columns) > 0) {
  rows_with_soil_data <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_with_soil_complete[[soil_data_columns[1]]]), na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  rows_with_soil_data <- 0
}
rows_without_soil_data <- total_rows - rows_with_soil_data

cat("Total rows in final dataset:", total_rows, "\n")
cat("Rows WITH soil data:", rows_with_soil_data, "\n")
cat("Rows WITHOUT soil data (NA values):", rows_without_soil_data, "\n")
if (total_rows > 0) {
  cat("Percentage with soil data:", round(rows_with_soil_data/total_rows*100, 1), "%\n")
}

# Check year distribution
year_counts <- table(parcelles_with_soil_complete$Year)
cat("\nYear distribution (2003-2025):\n")
print(year_counts)

# Check for geometry
has_geometry <- "sf" %in% class(parcelles_with_soil_complete)
cat("\nGeometry status: ", if(has_geometry) "✅ Present" else "❌ Missing", "\n")

# Verify decimal preservation
if (length(numeric_soil_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\nDECIMAL PRESERVATION CHECK:\n")
  for (col in head(numeric_soil_cols, 3)) {  # Check first 3 numeric columns
    if (col %in% names(parcelles_with_soil_complete)) {
      joined_vals <- parcelles_with_soil_complete[[col]][!is.na(parcelles_with_soil_complete[[col]])]
      if (length(joined_vals) > 0) {
        has_decimals <- any(joined_vals %% 1 != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (has_decimals) {
          cat("✅", col, ": Decimals preserved\n")
          cat("   Sample values:", paste(head(joined_vals, 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        } else {
          cat("•", col, ": Integer values\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# SAVE ENHANCED RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING ENHANCED RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

# Define output paths
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"

# Create directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(base_path)) {
  dir.create(base_path, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("📁 Created output directory\n")
}

shp_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_with_soil_complete.shp")
gpkg_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg")
csv_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_with_soil_complete_attributes.csv")

# Save as shapefile (only if geometry is present)
if (has_geometry) {
  tryCatch({
    st_write(parcelles_with_soil_complete, shp_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    cat("✅ Complete dataset saved as shapefile:", basename(shp_path), "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("⚠️ Error saving shapefile:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Save as GeoPackage (better for decimal precision)
  tryCatch({
    st_write(parcelles_with_soil_complete, gpkg_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
    cat("✅ Complete dataset saved as GeoPackage:", basename(gpkg_path), "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("⚠️ Error saving GeoPackage:", e$message, "\n")
  })
} else {
  cat("⚠️ No geometry present - skipping spatial file saves\n")
}

# Save attributes as CSV (full decimal precision)
tryCatch({
  parcelles_with_soil_complete %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    write_csv(csv_path)
  cat("✅ Complete attributes saved as CSV:", basename(csv_path), "\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("⚠️ Error saving CSV:", e$message, "\n")
})
```

# IV. SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION

## IV.1. No replication Aware

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION FOR ALL PARCELS AND YEARS
# Using W.P1 matrix creation from boundary-to-boundary distances
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION\n")
cat("  WITH PROPER W.P1 MATRIX CREATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE COMPLETE DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset (all parcels, all years)
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ Complete dataset not found. Please run the enhanced join script first.\n")
  stop("Dataset not available")
}

# Check dataset structure
cat("Dataset structure:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "\n")
cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("• Years per parcel:", nrow(parcelles_complete) / length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")

# Check Clay_percent availability
clay_obs_total <- nrow(parcelles_complete)
clay_obs_available <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_complete$Clay_percent))
clay_obs_missing <- clay_obs_total - clay_obs_available

cat("\nClay_percent statistics:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", clay_obs_total, "\n")
cat("• Available (non-NA):", clay_obs_available, "(", round(clay_obs_available/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("• Missing (NA):", clay_obs_missing, "(", round(clay_obs_missing/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE SPATIAL STRUCTURE FOR ALL PARCELS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for proper W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first occurrence of each parcel
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CREATE PROPER SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (W.P1)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (BOUNDARY-TO-BOUNDARY):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

cat("Computing pairwise distances between parcel boundaries...\n")
cat("This may take a while for large datasets...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries (exterior rings only)
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix (boundary to boundary)
cat("Calculating boundary-to-boundary distance matrix...\n")
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)

# Convert to numeric matrix and remove units
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)

# Set diagonal to NA (parcel cannot be neighbor to itself)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated: ", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")
cat("Min boundary distance:", round(min(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Max boundary distance:", round(max(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Mean boundary distance:", round(mean(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: DISTANCE ANALYSIS AND THRESHOLD SELECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 DISTANCE DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Extract all distances for analysis (excluding diagonal)
all_distances <- as.vector(dist_matrix)
all_distances <- all_distances[!is.na(all_distances)]

# Calculate statistics
dist_stats <- list(
  min = min(all_distances),
```
