```{r}
  q25 = quantile(all_distances, 0.25),
  median = median(all_distances),
  mean = mean(all_distances),
  q75 = quantile(all_distances, 0.75),
  q90 = quantile(all_distances, 0.90),
  q95 = quantile(all_distances, 0.95),
  max = max(all_distances)
)

cat("Distance Statistics (meters):\n")
cat("Min:", round(dist_stats$min, 2), "\n")
cat("25th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q25, 2), "\n")
cat("Median:", round(dist_stats$median, 2), "\n")
cat("Mean:", round(dist_stats$mean, 2), "\n")
cat("75th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q75, 2), "\n")
cat("90th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q90, 2), "\n")
cat("95th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q95, 2), "\n")
cat("Max:", round(dist_stats$max, 2), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold of 110 meters
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("\nUsing distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Show what this threshold will give us
n_neighbors_preview <- sum(dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix))
avg_neighbors_preview <- n_neighbors_preview / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("With", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m threshold:\n")
cat("- Total connections:", n_neighbors_preview, "\n")
cat("- Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors_preview, 2), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Create adjacency matrix based on distance threshold
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))

# Fill adjacency matrix: 1 if distance <= threshold, 0 otherwise
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1

# Ensure diagonal is 0 (parcel not neighbor to itself)
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0

# Add row and column names using sequential IDs
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
max_neighbors <- max(rowSums(W.P1_complete))
min_neighbors <- min(rowSums(W.P1_complete))

cat("✅ Adjacency Matrix W.P1 created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
cat("• Min neighbors:", min_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Max neighbors:", max_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Isolated parcels (no neighbors):", sum(rowSums(W.P1_complete) == 0), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PREPARE COMPLETE INLA DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔧 PREPARING COMPLETE INLA DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Prepare year mapping
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# Create complete INLA dataset (INCLUDING ALL OBSERVATIONS, even with NA response)
df_inla_complete <- parcelles_complete %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    Y = Clay_percent,  # Keep NAs - INLA will predict these
    ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
    ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
    Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
    Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
    Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
    irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
  ) %>%
  # DO NOT filter out NAs - keep all observations
  filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
  arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)

cat("Complete INLA dataset prepared:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(df_inla_complete), "\n")
cat("• Observations with Clay data:", sum(!is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
cat("• Observations to predict:", sum(is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
cat("• ID.Field range:", min(df_inla_complete$ID.Field), "-", max(df_inla_complete$ID.Field), "\n")
cat("• ID.Year range:", min(df_inla_complete$ID.Year), "-", max(df_inla_complete$ID.Year), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: VERIFY COMPATIBILITY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n✅ VERIFYING COMPATIBILITY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")

max_field_id <- max(df_inla_complete$ID.Field)
max_year_id <- max(df_inla_complete$ID.Year)

cat("Compatibility check:\n")
cat("• Max ID.Field:", max_field_id, "vs W.P1 size:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Max ID.Year:", max_year_id, "\n")

if (max_field_id <= nrow(W.P1_complete)) {
  cat("✅ Spatial structure compatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- FALSE
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: FIT SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL WITH PREDICTION
# ============================================================================
if (compatibility_ok) {
  cat("\n🚀 FITTING SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL:\n")
  cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")
  
  # Define priors
  prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
  
  cat("Fitting spatio-temporal model (this may take several minutes)...\n")
  cat("Model includes:\n")
  cat("• Spatial random effect (Besag model with proper boundary distances)\n")
  cat("• Temporal correlation (AR1)\n")
  cat("• Fixed effects (Bloc, Var, irrg_ty, Month)\n")
  cat("• Prediction for ALL missing values\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  tryCatch({
    # Fit the complete spatio-temporal model
    fit_complete <- inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + Var + irrg_ty + Month +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla_complete,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),  # Enable predictions
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    end_time <- Sys.time()
    fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
    
    if (!is.null(fit_complete) && !is.null(fit_complete$summary.fitted.values)) {
      cat("✅ SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_complete$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_complete$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 9: EXTRACT PREDICTIONS AND CREATE COMPLETE DATASET
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n📊 EXTRACTING PREDICTIONS:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Get fitted values (predictions)
      predictions <- fit_complete$summary.fitted.values
      
      # Add predictions to the dataset
      df_complete_predicted <- df_inla_complete %>%
        mutate(
          Clay_predicted = predictions$mean,
          Clay_predicted_sd = predictions$sd,
          Clay_predicted_lower = predictions$`0.025quant`,
          Clay_predicted_upper = predictions$`0.975quant`,
          # Create final complete clay values (observed where available, predicted otherwise)
          Clay_complete = ifelse(is.na(Y), Clay_predicted, Y),
          Prediction_type = ifelse(is.na(Y), "Predicted", "Observed")
        )
      
      cat("Predictions extracted:\n")
      cat("• Observed values:", sum(df_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Observed"), "\n")
      cat("• Predicted values:", sum(df_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Predicted"), "\n")
      cat("• Total complete dataset:", nrow(df_complete_predicted), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 10: MERGE BACK WITH SPATIAL DATA (FIXED FOR DUPLICATES)
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n🗺️ MERGING WITH SPATIAL DATA:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Check for potential many-to-many relationships before merging
      original_keys <- parcelles_complete %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      prediction_keys <- df_complete_predicted %>%
        select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      if (nrow(original_keys) > 0) {
        cat("Warning: Found", nrow(original_keys), "duplicate ID-Year combinations in original data\n")
        cat("Removing duplicates to ensure unique combinations...\n")
      }
      
      if (nrow(prediction_keys) > 0) {
        cat("Warning: Found", nrow(prediction_keys), "duplicate ID-Year combinations in predictions\n")
        cat("Removing duplicates to ensure unique combinations...\n")
      }
      
      # Remove duplicates from both datasets before merging
      # Keep the first occurrence of each ID-Year combination
      parcelles_complete_unique <- parcelles_complete %>%
        group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        slice(1) %>%  # Keep only the first row for each ID-Year combination
        ungroup()
      
      df_complete_predicted_unique <- df_complete_predicted %>%
        group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        slice(1) %>%  # Keep only the first row for each ID-Year combination
        ungroup()
      
      cat("After removing duplicates:\n")
      cat("• Original data: ", nrow(parcelles_complete), "->", nrow(parcelles_complete_unique), "rows\n")
      cat("• Prediction data: ", nrow(df_complete_predicted), "->", nrow(df_complete_predicted_unique), "rows\n")
      
      # Now merge the unique datasets
      parcelles_complete_predicted <- parcelles_complete_unique %>%
        left_join(
          df_complete_predicted_unique %>% 
            select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, Clay_predicted, Clay_predicted_sd, 
                   Clay_predicted_lower, Clay_predicted_upper, Clay_complete, Prediction_type),
          by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"),
          relationship = "one-to-one"  # This should work now with unique combinations
        )
      
      cat("✅ Spatial data merged with predictions\n")
      cat("Complete dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_complete_predicted), "×", ncol(parcelles_complete_predicted), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 11: SAVE COMPLETE PREDICTED DATASET (GEOPACKAGE ONLY)
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n💾 SAVING COMPLETE PREDICTED DATASET:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Define output paths
      base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
      
      # Save as GeoPackage (best for spatial data with predictions)
      gpkg_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_complete_with_predictions.gpkg")
      st_write(parcelles_complete_predicted, gpkg_output, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      cat("✅ Complete predicted dataset saved as GeoPackage:", basename(gpkg_output), "\n")
      
      # Save attributes as CSV
      csv_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_complete_predictions_attributes.csv")
      st_drop_geometry(parcelles_complete_predicted) %>%
        write_csv(csv_output)
      cat("✅ Complete predicted attributes saved as CSV:", basename(csv_output), "\n")
      
      # Save W.P1 matrix for future use
      w_matrix_path <- paste0(base_path, "W_P1_adjacency_matrix.RData")
      save(W.P1_complete, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, field_mapping, file = w_matrix_path)
      cat("✅ W.P1 adjacency matrix saved:", basename(w_matrix_path), "\n")
      
      # Save model summary
      model_summary_path <- paste0(base_path, "spatiotemporal_model_summary.txt")
      sink(model_summary_path)
      cat("SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUMMARY\n")
      cat("============================\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_complete$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_complete$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      cat("Distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")
      cat("W.P1 dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
      cat("Total observations:", nrow(df_inla_complete), "\n")
      cat("Observed values:", sum(!is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
      cat("Predicted values:", sum(is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
      cat("\nFixed Effects Summary:\n")
      print(fit_complete$summary.fixed)
      cat("\nSpatial Effect Summary:\n")
      print(fit_complete$summary.hyperpar)
      sink()
      cat("✅ Model summary saved:", basename(model_summary_path), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 12: CREATE VALIDATION PLOTS
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n📈 CREATING VALIDATION PLOTS:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Plot 1: Observed vs Predicted for validation
      validation_data <- df_complete_predicted_unique %>%
        filter(Prediction_type == "Observed")
      
      if (nrow(validation_data) > 0) {
        p1 <- ggplot(validation_data, aes(x = Y, y = Clay_predicted)) +
          geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
          geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
          labs(
            title = "Model Validation: Observed vs Predicted Clay%",
            x = "Observed Clay%",
            y = "Predicted Clay%"
          ) +
          theme_minimal()
        
        ggsave(paste0(base_path, "validation_observed_vs_predicted.png"), p1, width = 10, height = 8)
        cat("✅ Validation plot saved\n")
      }
      
      # Plot 2: Prediction uncertainty
      p2 <- ggplot(df_complete_predicted_unique, aes(x = Clay_predicted, y = Clay_predicted_sd, color = Prediction_type)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(
          title = "Prediction Uncertainty",
          x = "Predicted Clay%",
          y = "Prediction Standard Deviation",
          color = "Data Type"
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "blue", "Predicted" = "red")) +
        theme_minimal()
      
      ggsave(paste0(base_path, "prediction_uncertainty.png"), p2, width = 10, height = 8)
      cat("✅ Uncertainty plot saved\n")
      
      # Plot 3: Spatial network visualization
      # Sample connections for visualization
      set.seed(123)
      sample_parcels <- sample(1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), min(50, nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)))
      
      # Create connection lines
      connection_lines <- data.frame()
      for (i in sample_parcels) {
        neighbors <- which(W.P1_complete[i, ] == 1)
        if (length(neighbors) > 0) {
          for (j in neighbors) {
            if (i < j) {  # Avoid duplicate lines
              connection_lines <- rbind(connection_lines, data.frame(
                x1 = unique_parcels_spatial$X.Centroid[i],
                y1 = unique_parcels_spatial$Y.Centroid[i],
                x2 = unique_parcels_spatial$X.Centroid[j],
                y2 = unique_parcels_spatial$Y.Centroid[j]
              ))
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      neighbor_counts <- rowSums(W.P1_complete)
      unique_parcels_spatial$neighbor_count <- neighbor_counts
      
      p3 <- ggplot(unique_parcels_spatial) +
        geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbor_count), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Neighbors", option = "plasma") +
        {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                                                     aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                                                     color = "red", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.2)} +
        labs(
          title = "Spatial Neighborhood Network",
          subtitle = paste("Boundary-based neighbors | Threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m |",
                          nrow(connection_lines), "connections shown"),
          caption = paste("Avg neighbors:", round(avg_neighbors, 2))
        ) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "bottom"
        )
      
      ggsave(paste0(base_path, "spatial_network_proper.png"), p3, width = 12, height = 10)
      cat("✅ Spatial network plot saved\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # FINAL SUMMARY
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n🎉 COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 55), "\n", sep="")
      
      cat("✅ Model fitted successfully with proper boundary-based W.P1 matrix\n")
      cat("✅ All missing values predicted/imputed\n")
      cat("✅ Complete dataset created for all parcels and years\n")
      cat("✅ Spatial and temporal structure preserved\n")
      cat("✅ Uncertainty quantified for all predictions\n")
      cat("✅ Duplicate combinations handled properly\n")
      
      cat("\nDataset Summary:\n")
      cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete_predicted), "\n")
      cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete_predicted$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
      cat("• Years covered:", min(years_unique), "-", max(years_unique), "\n")
      cat("• Original observations:", sum(parcelles_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Observed", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      cat("• Imputed observations:", sum(parcelles_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Predicted", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      
      cat("\nSpatial Structure Summary:\n")
      cat("• Distance threshold used:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")
      cat("• W.P1 matrix dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("• Total spatial connections:", sum(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
      cat("• Isolated parcels:", sum(rowSums(W.P1_complete) == 0), "\n")
      
      cat("\nKey Variables Created:\n")
      cat("• Clay_complete: Complete clay values (observed + predicted)\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted: All predicted values (including for observed locations)\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted_sd: Prediction standard deviations\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted_lower/upper: 95% credible intervals\n")
      cat("• Prediction_type: 'Observed' or 'Predicted'\n")
      
      cat("\n🎯 Your complete dataset is ready for analysis!\n")
      cat("Use 'parcels_complete_with_predictions.gpkg' for spatial analysis\n")
      
      # Make the complete dataset available in environment
      assign("parcelles_complete_predicted", parcelles_complete_predicted, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("fit_spatiotemporal_complete", fit_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("field_mapping", field_mapping, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      
    } else {
      cat("❌ Model fitting failed - no predictions available\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error fitting spatio-temporal model:\n")
    cat(e$message, "\n")
    
    # Try simpler model as fallback
    cat("\nTrying simplified spatial model as fallback...\n")
    
    # Filter to only observed data for fallback model
    df_observed <- df_inla_complete %>% filter(!is.na(Y))
    
    if (nrow(df_observed) > 0) {
      tryCatch({
        fit_fallback <- inla(
          Y ~ 1 + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_observed,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
        
        if (!is.null(fit_fallback)) {
          cat("✅ Fallback spatial model successful\n")
          cat("DIC:", round(fit_fallback$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
          
          assign("fit_spatial_fallback", fit_fallback, envir = .GlobalEnv)
          assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        }
      }, error = function(e2) {
        cat("❌ Fallback model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  })
} else {
  cat("❌ Cannot proceed with modeling due to compatibility issues\n")
}
```

## IV.2. Replication aware

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION FOR ALL PARCELS AND YEARS
# Using W.P1 matrix creation from boundary-to-boundary distances
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION\n")
cat("  WITH PROPER W.P1 MATRIX CREATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE COMPLETE DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset (all parcels, all years)
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ Complete dataset not found. Please run the enhanced join script first.\n")
  stop("Dataset not available")
}

# Check dataset structure
cat("Dataset structure:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "\n")
cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("• Years per parcel:", nrow(parcelles_complete) / length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")

# Check Clay_percent availability
clay_obs_total <- nrow(parcelles_complete)
clay_obs_available <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_complete$Clay_percent))
clay_obs_missing <- clay_obs_total - clay_obs_available

cat("\nClay_percent statistics:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", clay_obs_total, "\n")
cat("• Available (non-NA):", clay_obs_available, "(", round(clay_obs_available/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("• Missing (NA):", clay_obs_missing, "(", round(clay_obs_missing/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE SPATIAL STRUCTURE FOR ALL PARCELS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for proper W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first occurrence of each parcel
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CREATE PROPER SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (W.P1)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (BOUNDARY-TO-BOUNDARY):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

cat("Computing pairwise distances between parcel boundaries...\n")
cat("This may take a while for large datasets...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries (exterior rings only)
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix (boundary to boundary)
cat("Calculating boundary-to-boundary distance matrix...\n")
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)

# Convert to numeric matrix and remove units
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)

# Set diagonal to NA (parcel cannot be neighbor to itself)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated: ", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")
cat("Min boundary distance:", round(min(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Max boundary distance:", round(max(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Mean boundary distance:", round(mean(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: DISTANCE ANALYSIS AND THRESHOLD SELECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 DISTANCE DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Extract all distances for analysis (excluding diagonal)
all_distances <- as.vector(dist_matrix)
all_distances <- all_distances[!is.na(all_distances)]

# Calculate statistics
dist_stats <- list(
  min = min(all_distances),
  q25 = quantile(all_distances, 0.25),
  median = median(all_distances),
  mean = mean(all_distances),
  q75 = quantile(all_distances, 0.75),
  q90 = quantile(all_distances, 0.90),
  q95 = quantile(all_distances, 0.95),
  max = max(all_distances)
)

cat("Distance Statistics (meters):\n")
cat("Min:", round(dist_stats$min, 2), "\n")
cat("25th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q25, 2), "\n")
cat("Median:", round(dist_stats$median, 2), "\n")
cat("Mean:", round(dist_stats$mean, 2), "\n")
cat("75th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q75, 2), "\n")
cat("90th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q90, 2), "\n")
cat("95th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q95, 2), "\n")
cat("Max:", round(dist_stats$max, 2), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold of 110 meters
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("\nUsing distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Show what this threshold will give us
n_neighbors_preview <- sum(dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix))
avg_neighbors_preview <- n_neighbors_preview / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("With", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m threshold:\n")
cat("- Total connections:", n_neighbors_preview, "\n")
cat("- Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors_preview, 2), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Create adjacency matrix based on distance threshold
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))

# Fill adjacency matrix: 1 if distance <= threshold, 0 otherwise
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1

# Ensure diagonal is 0 (parcel not neighbor to itself)
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0

# Add row and column names using sequential IDs
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
max_neighbors <- max(rowSums(W.P1_complete))
min_neighbors <- min(rowSums(W.P1_complete))

cat("✅ Adjacency Matrix W.P1 created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
cat("• Min neighbors:", min_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Max neighbors:", max_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Isolated parcels (no neighbors):", sum(rowSums(W.P1_complete) == 0), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PREPARE COMPLETE INLA DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔧 PREPARING COMPLETE INLA DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Prepare year mapping
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# Create complete INLA dataset (INCLUDING ALL OBSERVATIONS, even with NA response)
df_inla_complete <- parcelles_complete %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    Y = Clay_percent,  # Keep NAs - INLA will predict these
    ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
    ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
    Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
    Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
    Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
    irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
  ) %>%
  # DO NOT filter out NAs - keep all observations
  filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
  arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)

cat("Complete INLA dataset prepared:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(df_inla_complete), "\n")
cat("• Observations with Clay data:", sum(!is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
cat("• Observations to predict:", sum(is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
cat("• ID.Field range:", min(df_inla_complete$ID.Field), "-", max(df_inla_complete$ID.Field), "\n")
cat("• ID.Year range:", min(df_inla_complete$ID.Year), "-", max(df_inla_complete$ID.Year), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: VERIFY COMPATIBILITY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n✅ VERIFYING COMPATIBILITY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")

max_field_id <- max(df_inla_complete$ID.Field)
max_year_id <- max(df_inla_complete$ID.Year)

cat("Compatibility check:\n")
cat("• Max ID.Field:", max_field_id, "vs W.P1 size:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Max ID.Year:", max_year_id, "\n")

if (max_field_id <= nrow(W.P1_complete)) {
  cat("✅ Spatial structure compatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- FALSE
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: FIT SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL WITH PREDICTION
# ============================================================================
if (compatibility_ok) {
  cat("\n🚀 FITTING SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL:\n")
  cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")
  
  # Define priors
  prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
  
  cat("Fitting spatio-temporal model (this may take several minutes)...\n")
  cat("Model includes:\n")
  cat("• Spatial random effect (Besag model with proper boundary distances)\n")
  cat("• Temporal correlation (AR1)\n")
  cat("• Fixed effects (Bloc, Var, irrg_ty, Month)\n")
  cat("• Prediction for ALL missing values\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  tryCatch({
    # Fit the complete spatio-temporal model
    fit_complete <- inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + Var + irrg_ty + Month +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla_complete,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),  # Enable predictions
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    end_time <- Sys.time()
    fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
    
    if (!is.null(fit_complete) && !is.null(fit_complete$summary.fitted.values)) {
      cat("✅ SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_complete$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_complete$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 9: EXTRACT PREDICTIONS AND CREATE COMPLETE DATASET
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n📊 EXTRACTING PREDICTIONS:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Get fitted values (predictions)
      predictions <- fit_complete$summary.fitted.values
      
      # Add predictions to the dataset
      df_complete_predicted <- df_inla_complete %>%
        mutate(
          Clay_predicted = predictions$mean,
          Clay_predicted_sd = predictions$sd,
          Clay_predicted_lower = predictions$`0.025quant`,
          Clay_predicted_upper = predictions$`0.975quant`,
          # Create final complete clay values (observed where available, predicted otherwise)
          Clay_complete = ifelse(is.na(Y), Clay_predicted, Y),
          Prediction_type = ifelse(is.na(Y), "Predicted", "Observed")
        )
      
      cat("Predictions extracted:\n")
      cat("• Observed values:", sum(df_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Observed"), "\n")
      cat("• Predicted values:", sum(df_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Predicted"), "\n")
      cat("• Total complete dataset:", nrow(df_complete_predicted), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 10: MERGE BACK WITH SPATIAL DATA (HANDLING REPLICATIONS PROPERLY)
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n🗺️ MERGING WITH SPATIAL DATA:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Check for replications (multiple samples per plot per year)
      original_replications <- parcelles_complete %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      prediction_replications <- df_complete_predicted %>%
        select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      if (nrow(original_replications) > 0) {
        cat("Found", nrow(original_replications), "plot-year combinations with replications in original data\n")
        cat("Total replicated samples:", sum(original_replications$n), "\n")
      }
      
      if (nrow(prediction_replications) > 0) {
        cat("Found", nrow(prediction_replications), "plot-year combinations with replications in predictions\n")
        cat("Total prediction replications:", sum(prediction_replications$n), "\n")
      }
      
      # Add row identifiers to handle replications properly
      parcelles_complete_with_id <- parcelles_complete %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())
      
      df_complete_predicted_with_id <- df_complete_predicted %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())
      
      # Option 1: Keep ALL replications (recommended for preserving all data)
      cat("Keeping ALL replications - merging with many-to-many relationship...\n")
      
      parcelles_complete_predicted <- parcelles_complete_with_id %>%
        left_join(
          df_complete_predicted_with_id %>% 
            select(row_id, Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, Clay_predicted, Clay_predicted_sd, 
                   Clay_predicted_lower, Clay_predicted_upper, Clay_complete, Prediction_type),
          by = c("row_id", "Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"),
          relationship = "one-to-one"  # Should work with row_id as unique identifier
        ) %>%
        select(-row_id)  # Remove the helper column
      
      cat("✅ Spatial data merged with predictions (ALL replications preserved)\n")
      cat("Complete dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_complete_predicted), "×", ncol(parcelles_complete_predicted), "\n")
      
      # Provide summary of replications in final dataset
      final_replications <- parcelles_complete_predicted %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      if (nrow(final_replications) > 0) {
        cat("Final dataset contains", nrow(final_replications), "plot-year combinations with replications\n")
        cat("Average replications per plot-year:", round(mean(final_replications$n), 2), "\n")
        cat("Max replications for any plot-year:", max(final_replications$n), "\n")
      }
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 11: SAVE COMPLETE PREDICTED DATASET (GEOPACKAGE ONLY)
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n💾 SAVING COMPLETE PREDICTED DATASET:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Define output paths
      base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
      
      # Save as GeoPackage (best for spatial data with predictions)
      gpkg_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_complete_with_predictions.gpkg")
      st_write(parcelles_complete_predicted, gpkg_output, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      cat("✅ Complete predicted dataset saved as GeoPackage:", basename(gpkg_output), "\n")
      
      # Save attributes as CSV
      csv_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_complete_predictions_attributes.csv")
      st_drop_geometry(parcelles_complete_predicted) %>%
        write_csv(csv_output)
      cat("✅ Complete predicted attributes saved as CSV:", basename(csv_output), "\n")
      
      # Save W.P1 matrix for future use
      w_matrix_path <- paste0(base_path, "W_P1_adjacency_matrix.RData")
      save(W.P1_complete, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, field_mapping, file = w_matrix_path)
      cat("✅ W.P1 adjacency matrix saved:", basename(w_matrix_path), "\n")
      
      # Save model summary
      model_summary_path <- paste0(base_path, "spatiotemporal_model_summary.txt")
      sink(model_summary_path)
      cat("SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUMMARY\n")
      cat("============================\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_complete$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_complete$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      cat("Distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")
      cat("W.P1 dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
      cat("Total observations:", nrow(df_inla_complete), "\n")
      cat("Observed values:", sum(!is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
      cat("Predicted values:", sum(is.na(df_inla_complete$Y)), "\n")
      cat("\nFixed Effects Summary:\n")
      print(fit_complete$summary.fixed)
      cat("\nSpatial Effect Summary:\n")
      print(fit_complete$summary.hyperpar)
      sink()
      cat("✅ Model summary saved:", basename(model_summary_path), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 12: CREATE VALIDATION PLOTS
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n📈 CREATING VALIDATION PLOTS:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Plot 1: Observed vs Predicted for validation
      validation_data <- df_complete_predicted %>%
        filter(Prediction_type == "Observed")
      
      if (nrow(validation_data) > 0) {
        p1 <- ggplot(validation_data, aes(x = Y, y = Clay_predicted)) +
          geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
          geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
          labs(
            title = "Model Validation: Observed vs Predicted Clay%",
            x = "Observed Clay%",
            y = "Predicted Clay%"
          ) +
          theme_minimal()
        
        ggsave(paste0(base_path, "validation_observed_vs_predicted.png"), p1, width = 10, height = 8)
        cat("✅ Validation plot saved\n")
      }
      
      # Plot 2: Prediction uncertainty
      p2 <- ggplot(df_complete_predicted, aes(x = Clay_predicted, y = Clay_predicted_sd, color = Prediction_type)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(
          title = "Prediction Uncertainty",
          x = "Predicted Clay%",
          y = "Prediction Standard Deviation",
          color = "Data Type"
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "blue", "Predicted" = "red")) +
        theme_minimal()
      
      ggsave(paste0(base_path, "prediction_uncertainty.png"), p2, width = 10, height = 8)
      cat("✅ Uncertainty plot saved\n")
      
      # Plot 3: Spatial network visualization
      # Sample connections for visualization
      set.seed(123)
      sample_parcels <- sample(1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), min(50, nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)))
      
      # Create connection lines
      connection_lines <- data.frame()
      for (i in sample_parcels) {
        neighbors <- which(W.P1_complete[i, ] == 1)
        if (length(neighbors) > 0) {
          for (j in neighbors) {
            if (i < j) {  # Avoid duplicate lines
              connection_lines <- rbind(connection_lines, data.frame(
                x1 = unique_parcels_spatial$X.Centroid[i],
                y1 = unique_parcels_spatial$Y.Centroid[i],
                x2 = unique_parcels_spatial$X.Centroid[j],
                y2 = unique_parcels_spatial$Y.Centroid[j]
              ))
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      neighbor_counts <- rowSums(W.P1_complete)
      unique_parcels_spatial$neighbor_count <- neighbor_counts
      
      p3 <- ggplot(unique_parcels_spatial) +
        geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbor_count), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Neighbors", option = "plasma") +
        {if(nrow(connection_lines) > 0) geom_segment(data = connection_lines, 
                                                     aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2), 
                                                     color = "red", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.2)} +
        labs(
          title = "Spatial Neighborhood Network",
          subtitle = paste("Boundary-based neighbors | Threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m |",
                          nrow(connection_lines), "connections shown"),
          caption = paste("Avg neighbors:", round(avg_neighbors, 2))
        ) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "bottom"
        )
      
      ggsave(paste0(base_path, "spatial_network_proper.png"), p3, width = 12, height = 10)
      cat("✅ Spatial network plot saved\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # FINAL SUMMARY
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n🎉 COMPLETE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 55), "\n", sep="")
      
      cat("✅ Model fitted successfully with proper boundary-based W.P1 matrix\n")
      cat("✅ All missing values predicted/imputed\n")
      cat("✅ Complete dataset created for all parcels and years\n")
      cat("✅ Spatial and temporal structure preserved\n")
      cat("✅ Uncertainty quantified for all predictions\n")
      cat("✅ Duplicate combinations handled properly\n")
      
      cat("\nDataset Summary:\n")
      cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete_predicted), "\n")
      cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete_predicted$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
      cat("• Years covered:", min(years_unique), "-", max(years_unique), "\n")
      cat("• Original observations:", sum(parcelles_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Observed", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      cat("• Imputed observations:", sum(parcelles_complete_predicted$Prediction_type == "Predicted", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      
      cat("\nSpatial Structure Summary:\n")
      cat("• Distance threshold used:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")
      cat("• W.P1 matrix dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("• Total spatial connections:", sum(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
      cat("• Isolated parcels:", sum(rowSums(W.P1_complete) == 0), "\n")
      
      cat("\nKey Variables Created:\n")
      cat("• Clay_complete: Complete clay values (observed + predicted)\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted: All predicted values (including for observed locations)\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted_sd: Prediction standard deviations\n")
      cat("• Clay_predicted_lower/upper: 95% credible intervals\n")
      cat("• Prediction_type: 'Observed' or 'Predicted'\n")
      
      cat("\n🎯 Your complete dataset is ready for analysis!\n")
      cat("Use 'parcels_complete_with_predictions.gpkg' for spatial analysis\n")
      
      # Make the complete dataset available in environment
      assign("parcelles_complete_predicted", parcelles_complete_predicted, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("fit_spatiotemporal_complete", fit_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("field_mapping", field_mapping, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      
    } else {
      cat("❌ Model fitting failed - no predictions available\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error fitting spatio-temporal model:\n")
    cat(e$message, "\n")
    
    # Try simpler model as fallback
    cat("\nTrying simplified spatial model as fallback...\n")
    
    # Filter to only observed data for fallback model
    df_observed <- df_inla_complete %>% filter(!is.na(Y))
    
    if (nrow(df_observed) > 0) {
      tryCatch({
        fit_fallback <- inla(
          Y ~ 1 + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_observed,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
        
        if (!is.null(fit_fallback)) {
          cat("✅ Fallback spatial model successful\n")
          cat("DIC:", round(fit_fallback$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
          
          assign("fit_spatial_fallback", fit_fallback, envir = .GlobalEnv)
          assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        }
      }, error = function(e2) {
        cat("❌ Fallback model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  })
} else {
  cat("❌ Cannot proceed with modeling due to compatibility issues\n")
}

```

## IV.3. SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT
# Using W.P1 matrix creation from boundary-to-boundary distances
# Added 80/20 train/val split for robust R² calculation
# CORRECTED: Fixed select() syntax issue
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)
library(readr)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION\n")
cat("  WITH TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT (80/20)\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE COMPLETE DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset (all parcels, all years)
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ Complete dataset not found. Please run the enhanced join script first.\n")
  stop("Dataset not available")
}

# Check dataset structure
cat("Dataset structure:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "\n")
cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("• Years per parcel:", nrow(parcelles_complete) / length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")

# Check Clay_percent availability
clay_obs_total <- nrow(parcelles_complete)
clay_obs_available <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_complete$Clay_percent))
clay_obs_missing <- clay_obs_total - clay_obs_available

cat("\nClay_percent statistics:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", clay_obs_total, "\n")
cat("• Available (non-NA):", clay_obs_available, "(", round(clay_obs_available/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("• Missing (NA):", clay_obs_missing, "(", round(clay_obs_missing/clay_obs_total*100, 1), "%)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: CREATE TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT (80/20)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🎯 CREATING TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT (80/20):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

# Filter to only observations with available Clay_percent for splitting
observed_data <- parcelles_complete %>%
  filter(!is.na(Clay_percent))

cat("Observations with Clay data for train/val split:", nrow(observed_data), "\n")

# Set seed for reproducible split
set.seed(123)

# Create stratified split by parcel to ensure spatial balance
unique_parcels_with_clay <- observed_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.8, 0.2)))

cat("Unique parcels with Clay data:", nrow(unique_parcels_with_clay), "\n")
cat("Parcels in training set:", sum(unique_parcels_with_clay$split == "train"), "\n")
cat("Parcels in validation set:", sum(unique_parcels_with_clay$split == "val"), "\n")

# Apply split to all observations
parcelles_complete_split <- parcelles_complete %>%
  left_join(unique_parcels_with_clay, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    # Create train/val assignment for observed data
    data_split = case_when(
      is.na(Clay_percent) ~ "predict",  # Missing values to predict
      split == "train" ~ "train",       # Training observations
      split == "val" ~ "validation",    # Validation observations (treat as missing during training)
      TRUE ~ "predict"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-split)  # Remove temporary column - CORRECTED with explicit dplyr::

# Count observations by split
split_counts <- table(parcelles_complete_split$data_split)
cat("\nData split summary:\n")
for (split_type in names(split_counts)) {
  cat("•", split_type, ":", split_counts[split_type], 
      "(", round(split_counts[split_type]/nrow(parcelles_complete_split)*100, 1), "%)\n")
}

# Verify split balance
train_obs <- sum(parcelles_complete_split$data_split == "train")
val_obs <- sum(parcelles_complete_split$data_split == "validation")
total_clay_obs <- train_obs + val_obs

cat("\nSplit verification:\n")
cat("• Training observations:", train_obs, "(", round(train_obs/total_clay_obs*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("• Validation observations:", val_obs, "(", round(val_obs/total_clay_obs*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("• Train/Val ratio:", round(train_obs/val_obs, 2), ":1\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: PREPARE SPATIAL STRUCTURE FOR ALL PARCELS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for proper W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete_split %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first occurrence of each parcel
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CREATE PROPER SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (W.P1)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX (BOUNDARY-TO-BOUNDARY):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

cat("Computing pairwise distances between parcel boundaries...\n")
cat("This may take a while for large datasets...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries (exterior rings only)
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix (boundary to boundary)
cat("Calculating boundary-to-boundary distance matrix...\n")
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)

# Convert to numeric matrix and remove units
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)

# Set diagonal to NA (parcel cannot be neighbor to itself)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated: ", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")
cat("Min boundary distance:", round(min(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Max boundary distance:", round(max(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")
cat("Mean boundary distance:", round(mean(dist_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "meters\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: DISTANCE ANALYSIS AND THRESHOLD SELECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 DISTANCE DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Extract all distances for analysis (excluding diagonal)
all_distances <- as.vector(dist_matrix)
all_distances <- all_distances[!is.na(all_distances)]

# Calculate statistics
dist_stats <- list(
  min = min(all_distances),
  q25 = quantile(all_distances, 0.25),
  median = median(all_distances),
  mean = mean(all_distances),
  q75 = quantile(all_distances, 0.75),
  q90 = quantile(all_distances, 0.90),
  q95 = quantile(all_distances, 0.95),
  max = max(all_distances)
)

cat("Distance Statistics (meters):\n")
cat("Min:", round(dist_stats$min, 2), "\n")
cat("25th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q25, 2), "\n")
cat("Median:", round(dist_stats$median, 2), "\n")
cat("Mean:", round(dist_stats$mean, 2), "\n")
cat("75th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q75, 2), "\n")
cat("90th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q90, 2), "\n")
cat("95th percentile:", round(dist_stats$q95, 2), "\n")
cat("Max:", round(dist_stats$max, 2), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold of 110 meters
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("\nUsing distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Show what this threshold will give us
n_neighbors_preview <- sum(dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix))
avg_neighbors_preview <- n_neighbors_preview / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("With", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "m threshold:\n")
cat("- Total connections:", n_neighbors_preview, "\n")
cat("- Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors_preview, 2), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: CREATE ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING ADJACENCY MATRIX W.P1:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Create adjacency matrix based on distance threshold
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))

# Fill adjacency matrix: 1 if distance <= threshold, 0 otherwise
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1

# Ensure diagonal is 0 (parcel not neighbor to itself)
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0

# Add row and column names using sequential IDs
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
max_neighbors <- max(rowSums(W.P1_complete))
min_neighbors <- min(rowSums(W.P1_complete))

cat("✅ Adjacency Matrix W.P1 created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
cat("• Min neighbors:", min_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Max neighbors:", max_neighbors, "\n")
cat("• Isolated parcels (no neighbors):", sum(rowSums(W.P1_complete) == 0), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: PREPARE INLA TRAINING DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔧 PREPARING INLA TRAINING DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Prepare year mapping
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete_split$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# Create INLA training dataset (training data + validation data with NA response)
df_inla_train <- parcelles_complete_split %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    # Set response: keep training data, set validation and predict to NA
    Y = case_when(
      data_split == "train" ~ Clay_percent,
      data_split == "validation" ~ NA_real_,  # Validation treated as missing for training
      data_split == "predict" ~ NA_real_,     # Originally missing values
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Y_true = Clay_percent,  # Keep true values for validation evaluation
    ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
    ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
    Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
    Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
    Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
    irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
  arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)

cat("INLA training dataset prepared:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(df_inla_train), "\n")
cat("• Training observations (Y not NA):", sum(!is.na(df_inla_train$Y)), "\n")
cat("• Validation observations (to predict):", sum(df_inla_train$data_split == "validation"), "\n")
cat("• Missing observations (to predict):", sum(df_inla_train$data_split == "predict"), "\n")
cat("• ID.Field range:", min(df_inla_train$ID.Field), "-", max(df_inla_train$ID.Field), "\n")
cat("• ID.Year range:", min(df_inla_train$ID.Year), "-", max(df_inla_train$ID.Year), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: VERIFY COMPATIBILITY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n✅ VERIFYING COMPATIBILITY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 25), "\n", sep="")

max_field_id <- max(df_inla_train$ID.Field)
max_year_id <- max(df_inla_train$ID.Year)

cat("Compatibility check:\n")
cat("• Max ID.Field:", max_field_id, "vs W.P1 size:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Max ID.Year:", max_year_id, "\n")

if (max_field_id <= nrow(W.P1_complete)) {
  cat("✅ Spatial structure compatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible\n")
  compatibility_ok <- FALSE
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 9: FIT SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL WITH PREDICTION
# ============================================================================
if (compatibility_ok) {
  cat("\n🚀 FITTING SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL:\n")
  cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")
  
  # Define priors
  prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
  
  cat("Fitting spatio-temporal model (this may take several minutes)...\n")
  cat("Model includes:\n")
  cat("• Spatial random effect (Besag model with proper boundary distances)\n")
  cat("• Temporal correlation (AR1)\n")
  cat("• Fixed effects (Bloc, Var, irrg_ty, Month)\n")
  cat("• Training on", sum(!is.na(df_inla_train$Y)), "observations\n")
  cat("• Predicting", sum(is.na(df_inla_train$Y)), "missing values\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  tryCatch({
    # Fit the spatio-temporal model
    fit_enhanced <- inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + Var + irrg_ty + Month +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla_train,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),  # Enable predictions
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    end_time <- Sys.time()
    fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
    
    if (!is.null(fit_enhanced) && !is.null(fit_enhanced$summary.fitted.values)) {
      cat("✅ SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_enhanced$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_enhanced$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 10: EXTRACT PREDICTIONS AND CALCULATE VALIDATION METRICS
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n📊 EXTRACTING PREDICTIONS AND CALCULATING VALIDATION METRICS:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 65), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Get fitted values (predictions)
      predictions <- fit_enhanced$summary.fitted.values
      
      # Add predictions to the dataset
      df_enhanced_predicted <- df_inla_train %>%
        mutate(
          Clay_predicted = predictions$mean,
          Clay_predicted_sd = predictions$sd,
          Clay_predicted_lower = predictions$`0.025quant`,
          Clay_predicted_upper = predictions$`0.975quant`,
          # Create final complete clay values
          Clay_complete = case_when(
            data_split == "train" ~ Y,  # Use observed training values
            TRUE ~ Clay_predicted       # Use predicted for validation and missing
          ),
          Prediction_type = case_when(
            data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
            data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation",
            data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
          )
        )
      
      # Calculate validation metrics
      validation_data <- df_enhanced_predicted %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation") %>%
        filter(!is.na(Y_true), !is.na(Clay_predicted))
      
      if (nrow(validation_data) > 0) {
        # Calculate R²
        ss_res <- sum((validation_data$Y_true - validation_data$Clay_predicted)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((validation_data$Y_true - mean(validation_data$Y_true))^2)
        r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
        
        # Calculate other metrics
        rmse <- sqrt(mean((validation_data$Y_true - validation_data$Clay_predicted)^2))
        mae <- mean(abs(validation_data$Y_true - validation_data$Clay_predicted))
        correlation <- cor(validation_data$Y_true, validation_data$Clay_predicted)
        
        # Calculate bias metrics
        mean_error <- mean(validation_data$Y_true - validation_data$Clay_predicted)
        mean_abs_error_pct <- mean(abs(validation_data$Y_true - validation_data$Clay_predicted) / validation_data$Y_true) * 100
        
        cat("🎯 VALIDATION RESULTS:\n")
        cat("• Validation observations:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
        cat("• R² (coefficient of determination):", round(r_squared, 4), "\n")
        cat("• Correlation coefficient:", round(correlation, 4), "\n")
        cat("• RMSE (Root Mean Square Error):", round(rmse, 3), "\n")
        cat("• MAE (Mean Absolute Error):", round(mae, 3), "\n")
        cat("• Mean Error (Bias):", round(mean_error, 3), "\n")
        cat("• Mean Absolute Percentage Error:", round(mean_abs_error_pct, 2), "%\n")
        
        # Coverage probability for prediction intervals
        in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true >= validation_data$Clay_predicted_lower & 
                          validation_data$Y_true <= validation_data$Clay_predicted_upper)
        coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
        cat("• 95% Prediction Interval Coverage:", round(coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
      } else {
        cat("❌ No validation data available for metrics calculation\n")
        r_squared <- NA
        rmse <- NA
        mae <- NA
        correlation <- NA
      }
      
      cat("\nPredictions extracted:\n")
      prediction_counts <- table(df_enhanced_predicted$Prediction_type)
      for (pred_type in names(prediction_counts)) {
        cat("•", pred_type, "values:", prediction_counts[pred_type], "\n")
      }
      cat("• Total enhanced dataset:", nrow(df_enhanced_predicted), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 11: MERGE BACK WITH SPATIAL DATA
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n🗺️ MERGING WITH SPATIAL DATA:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Add row identifiers to handle replications properly
      parcelles_complete_split_with_id <- parcelles_complete_split %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())
      
      df_enhanced_predicted_with_id <- df_enhanced_predicted %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())
      
      # Merge predictions with spatial data
      parcelles_enhanced_predicted <- parcelles_complete_split_with_id %>%
        left_join(
          df_enhanced_predicted_with_id %>% 
            dplyr::select(row_id, Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, Clay_predicted, Clay_predicted_sd, 
                   Clay_predicted_lower, Clay_predicted_upper, Clay_complete, 
                   Prediction_type, data_split, Y_true),
          by = c("row_id", "Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"),
          relationship = "one-to-one"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(-row_id)  # Remove the helper column
      
      cat("✅ Spatial data merged with enhanced predictions\n")
      cat("Enhanced dataset dimensions:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced_predicted), "×", ncol(parcelles_enhanced_predicted), "\n")
      
      # ============================================================================
      # STEP 12: SAVE ENHANCED PREDICTED DATASET
      # ============================================================================
      cat("\n💾 SAVING ENHANCED PREDICTED DATASET:\n")
      cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")
      
      # Define output paths
      base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
      
      # Save as GeoPackage (best for spatial data with predictions)
      gpkg_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_enhanced_with_predictions_trainval.gpkg")
      st_write(parcelles_enhanced_predicted, gpkg_output, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      cat("✅ Enhanced predicted dataset saved as GeoPackage:", basename(gpkg_output), "\n")
      
      # Save attributes as CSV
      csv_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_enhanced_predictions_attributes_trainval.csv")
      st_drop_geometry(parcelles_enhanced_predicted) %>%
        write_csv(csv_output)
      cat("✅ Enhanced predicted attributes saved as CSV:", basename(csv_output), "\n")
      
      # Save W.P1 matrix for future use
      w_matrix_path <- paste0(base_path, "W_P1_adjacency_matrix_enhanced.RData")
      save(W.P1_complete, DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, field_mapping, file = w_matrix_path)
      cat("✅ W.P1 adjacency matrix saved:", basename(w_matrix_path), "\n")
      
      # Save enhanced model summary with validation metrics
      model_summary_path <- paste0(base_path, "spatiotemporal_model_summary_enhanced_trainval.txt")
      sink(model_summary_path)
      cat("ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL SUMMARY WITH TRAIN/VAL SPLIT\n")
      cat("===========================================================\n")
      cat("Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("DIC:", round(fit_enhanced$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
      cat("WAIC:", round(fit_enhanced$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
      cat("Distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")
      cat("W.P1 dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
      cat("Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")
      cat("\nData Split:\n")
      cat("Training observations:", sum(!is.na(df_inla_train$Y)), "\n")
      cat("Validation observations:", sum(df_inla_train$data_split == "validation"), "\n")
      cat("Missing observations:", sum(df_inla_train$data_split == "predict"), "\n")
      cat("\nValidation Metrics:\n")
      if (!is.na(r_squared)) {
        cat("R² (coefficient of determination):", round(r_squared, 4), "\n")
        cat("Correlation coefficient:", round(correlation, 4), "\n")
        cat("RMSE:", round(rmse, 3), "\n")
        cat("MAE:", round(mae, 3), "\n")
        cat("95% Coverage Probability:", round(coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
      }
      cat("\nFixed Effects Summary:\n")
      print(fit_enhanced$summary.fixed)
      cat("\nSpatial Effect Summary:\n")
      print(fit_enhanced$summary.hyperpar)
      sink()
      cat("✅ Enhanced model summary saved:", basename(model_summary_path), "\n")
      
      # Make the enhanced dataset available in environment
      assign("parcelles_enhanced_predicted", parcelles_enhanced_predicted, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("fit_spatiotemporal_enhanced", fit_enhanced, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("field_mapping", field_mapping, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign("validation_metrics", list(
        r_squared = r_squared,
        correlation = correlation,
        rmse = rmse,
        mae = mae,
        coverage_probability = coverage_prob,
        n_validation = nrow(validation_data)
      ), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      
      
      if (!is.na(r_squared)) {
        cat("\n🎯 VALIDATION PERFORMANCE:\n")
        cat("• R² (Real predictive performance):", round(r_squared, 4), "\n")
        cat("• RMSE:", round(rmse, 3), "Clay%\n")
        cat("• MAE:", round(mae, 3), "Clay%\n")
        cat("• 95% Prediction Interval Coverage:", round(coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
        
        # Performance interpretation
        if (r_squared >= 0.8) {
          cat("• 🎯 EXCELLENT predictive performance (R² ≥ 0.8)\n")
        } else if (r_squared >= 0.6) {
          cat("• ✅ GOOD predictive performance (R² ≥ 0.6)\n")
        } else if (r_squared >= 0.4) {
          cat("• ⚠️  MODERATE predictive performance (R² ≥ 0.4)\n")
        } else {
          cat("• ❌ POOR predictive performance (R² < 0.4)\n")
        }
      }
      
    } else {
      cat("❌ Model fitting failed - no predictions available\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error fitting enhanced spatio-temporal model:\n")
    cat(e$message, "\n")
    
    # Try simpler model as fallback
    cat("\nTrying simplified spatial model as fallback...\n")
    
    # Filter to only observed training data for fallback model
    df_observed_train <- df_inla_train %>% filter(!is.na(Y))
    
    if (nrow(df_observed_train) > 0) {
      tryCatch({
        fit_fallback <- inla(
          Y ~ 1 + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W.P1_complete, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_observed_train,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
        
        if (!is.null(fit_fallback)) {
          cat("✅ Fallback spatial model successful\n")
          cat("DIC:", round(fit_fallback$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
          
          assign("fit_spatial_fallback", fit_fallback, envir = .GlobalEnv)
          assign("W.P1_complete", W.P1_complete, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        }
      }, error = function(e2) {
        cat("❌ Fallback model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  })
} else {
  cat("❌ Cannot proceed with modeling due to compatibility issues\n")
}

cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
cat("🏁 ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION COMPLETE\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
```

## IV.4. MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT
# Loops through ALL soil variables and applies the same enhanced imputation process
# Creates comprehensive outputs for each variable + combined final dataset
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL       \n")
cat("  IMPUTATION WITH TRAIN/VAL SPLIT      \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE COMPLETE DATASET AND IDENTIFY SOIL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET AND IDENTIFYING SOIL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ Complete dataset not found. Please run the enhanced join script first.\n")
  stop("Dataset not available")
}

# Define all soil variables to process
soil_variables <- c(
  "pH",
  "CN_Ratio", 
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg",
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent", 
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Total_Silt_percent",
  "Total_Sand_percent", 
  "Organic_Matter_percent",
  "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g",
  "CaO_g_100g",
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
  "Mg_K_Ratio",
  "Compaction_Index"
)

cat("Soil variables to process:", length(soil_variables), "\n")
for (i in seq_along(soil_variables)) {
  var_name <- soil_variables[i]
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_complete[[var_name]]))
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(parcelles_complete[[var_name]]))
  pct_available <- round(n_available/nrow(parcelles_complete)*100, 1)
  cat(sprintf("• %2d. %-35s: %4d available (%5.1f%%), %4d missing\n", 
              i, var_name, n_available, pct_available, n_missing))
}

# Check dataset structure
cat("\nDataset structure:\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "\n")
cat("• Unique parcels:", length(unique(parcelles_complete$Final_Cleaned_ID)), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(parcelles_complete$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE SHARED SPATIAL STRUCTURE (ONE TIME SETUP)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SHARED SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
```
