```{r}
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CREATE SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX W.P1 (ONE TIME SETUP)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING SHARED SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

cat("Computing boundary-to-boundary distances (this may take time)...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated:", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("Using distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Create adjacency matrix
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)

cat("✅ W.P1 matrix created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: PREPARE SHARED TEMPORAL STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: DEFINE IMPUTATION FUNCTION FOR SINGLE VARIABLE
# ============================================================================
impute_single_variable <- function(variable_name, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING VARIABLE:", variable_name, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Check variable availability
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Variable statistics:\n")
    cat("• Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
    cat("• Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing (NA):", n_missing, "(", round(n_missing/n_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
    
    if (n_available > 0) {
      cat("• Min value:", round(min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Max value:", round(max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Mean value:", round(mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Std deviation:", round(sd(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Skip if insufficient data
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create train/validation split
  observed_data <- parcelles_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[variable_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)  # Consistent split across variables
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  # Apply split
  parcelles_data_split <- parcelles_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[variable_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train",
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  train_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "validation")
  pred_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "predict")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Data split:\n")
    cat("• Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict:", pred_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  # Prepare INLA dataset
  df_inla <- parcelles_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[variable_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true = .data[[variable_name]],
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
  
  # Check compatibility
  if (max(df_inla$ID.Field) > nrow(W_matrix)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible. Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("🚀 Fitting spatio-temporal model...\n")
  
  # Fit model
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Full model failed. Trying simpler model...\n")
    
    # Try simpler model
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) {
      if (verbose) cat("❌ Simple model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result) || is.null(fit_result$summary.fitted.values)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model fitting failed completely\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ Model successful! Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$dic)) cat("DIC:", round(fit_result$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$waic)) cat("WAIC:", round(fit_result$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
  }
  
  # Extract predictions
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y,
        TRUE ~ predictions$mean
      ),
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_prediction_type") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
        data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation", 
        data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate validation metrics
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true), !is.na(predictions$mean))
  
  metrics <- list(variable = variable_name)
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {  # Need minimum observations for meaningful metrics
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- r_squared
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$mean_error <- mean(true_vals - pred_vals)
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    # Coverage probability
    in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true >= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower")]] & 
                      validation_data$Y_true <= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper")]])
    metrics$coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("🎯 Validation Results:\n")
      cat("• Validation obs:", metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      cat("• R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Correlation:", round(metrics$correlation, 4), "\n") 
      cat("• RMSE:", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("• MAE:", round(metrics$mae, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Coverage:", round(metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
    }
  } else {
    metrics$r_squared <- NA
    metrics$correlation <- NA
    metrics$rmse <- NA
    metrics$mae <- NA
    metrics$mean_error <- NA
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    metrics$coverage_prob <- NA
    
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient validation data for metrics\n")
  }
  
  # Create return object
  result <- list(
    variable_name = variable_name,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = n_available,
    n_missing = n_missing,
    pct_available = pct_available
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING ALL", length(soil_variables), "SOIL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Initialize results storage
all_results <- list()
all_metrics <- data.frame()
failed_variables <- character(0)

# Process each variable
for (i in seq_along(soil_variables)) {
  var_name <- soil_variables[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(soil_variables), "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  result <- impute_single_variable(
    variable_name = var_name,
    parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
    W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
    field_map = field_mapping,
    year_map = year_mapping,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    all_results[[var_name]] <- result
    
    # Store metrics
    metrics_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      N_Total = result$n_total,
      N_Available = result$n_available,
      N_Missing = result$n_missing,
      Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
      Fitting_Time_Min = result$fitting_time,
      R_Squared = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$r_squared), NA, result$metrics$r_squared),
      Correlation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$correlation), NA, result$metrics$correlation),
      RMSE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$rmse), NA, result$metrics$rmse),
      MAE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$mae), NA, result$metrics$mae),
      Coverage_Prob = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$coverage_prob), NA, result$metrics$coverage_prob),
      N_Validation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$n_validation), 0, result$metrics$n_validation),
      DIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$dic), NA, result$model_fit$dic$dic),
      WAIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$waic), NA, result$model_fit$waic$waic),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
    cat("✅ SUCCESS for", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, var_name)
    cat("❌ FAILED for", var_name, "\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: COMBINE ALL PREDICTIONS 
# ============================================================================

cat("\n🔗 COMBINING ALL PREDICTIONS (ALTERNATIVE APPROACH):\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

successful_variables <- names(all_results)
cat("Successfully processed variables:", length(successful_variables), "\n")

# Create unique identifiers for all duplicates by treating them as replicates
cat("\n🔄 CREATING UNIQUE IDENTIFIERS FOR REPLICATES:\n")

# Start with the original dataset and create replicate IDs
final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
  mutate(
    replicate_id = row_number(),  # 1, 2, 3, etc. for each duplicate
    unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number())

# Add geometry back
final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    final_dataset %>% dplyr::select(original_row_id, replicate_id, unique_key),
    by = "original_row_id"
  )

# Check how many replicates we have
replicate_summary <- final_dataset %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>% 
  count(n, name = "combinations")

cat("📊 REPLICATE SUMMARY:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(replicate_summary)) {
  n_reps <- replicate_summary$n[i]
  n_combinations <- replicate_summary$combinations[i]
  cat("•", n_combinations, "combinations have", n_reps, "replicate(s) each\n")
}

# For each variable, add predictions by matching row positions
for (i in seq_along(successful_variables)) {
  var_name <- successful_variables[i]
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(successful_variables), "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Recreate the df_inla creation process to get the same order
  df_inla_reference <- parcelles_complete %>% 
    st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID"), 
              relationship = "many-to-one") %>%  
    left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year", 
              relationship = "many-to-one") %>%  
    filter(!is.na(Sequential_ID), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>% 
    # Add the same replicate logic here
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = row_number(),
      unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    arrange(Sequential_ID, ID.Year, replicate_id) %>%  # Include replicate_id in sorting
    mutate(inla_row_id = row_number())
  
  cat("  Reference dataset rows:", nrow(df_inla_reference), "\n")
  cat("  Prediction rows:", nrow(result$predictions), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(df_inla_reference) == nrow(result$predictions)) {
    # Perfect match - we can align directly using unique keys
    predictions_aligned <- df_inla_reference %>% 
      dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id, unique_key, original_row_id) %>% 
      bind_cols(
        result$predictions %>% 
          dplyr::select(matches(paste0("^", var_name, "_")))
      )
    
    # Verify no duplicates in unique_key (should be impossible now)
    if (any(duplicated(predictions_aligned$unique_key))) {
      cat("  ❌ Still have duplicates in unique_key - this shouldn't happen!\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Join using unique_key (which is guaranteed to be unique)
    final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% 
      left_join(
        predictions_aligned %>% dplyr::select(-Final_Cleaned_ID, -Year, -replicate_id, -original_row_id),
        by = "unique_key"
      )
    
    # Check success
    first_pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
    var_cols <- colnames(final_dataset)[grepl(paste0("^", var_name), colnames(final_dataset))]
    
    if (first_pred_col %in% colnames(final_dataset)) {
      non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(final_dataset[[first_pred_col]]))
      cat("  ✅ Successfully added", non_null_count, "predictions for", var_name, "\n")
      check_col <- first_pred_col
    } else if (length(var_cols) > 0) {
      cat("  📋 Found columns:", paste(var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(final_dataset[[var_cols[1]]]))
      cat("  ✅ Successfully added", non_null_count, "predictions for", var_name, "\n")
      check_col <- var_cols[1]
    } else {
      cat("  ❌ No prediction columns found for", var_name, "\n")
      check_col <- NULL
    }
    
    # Show replicate distribution for this variable
    if (!is.null(check_col)) {
      replicate_dist <- final_dataset %>% 
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[check_col]])) %>%
        count(replicate_id) %>%
        arrange(replicate_id)
      
      if (nrow(replicate_dist) > 0) {
        cat("    Predictions by replicate:", paste(paste0("rep", replicate_dist$replicate_id, ":", replicate_dist$n), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("  ❌ Row count mismatch for", var_name, "- skipping\n")
    cat("    Reference rows:", nrow(df_inla_reference), "\n")
    cat("    Prediction rows:", nrow(result$predictions), "\n")
  }
  
  # Memory cleanup after each variable
  gc()
}

# Clean up temporary columns but keep replicate info for reference
final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% 
  dplyr::select(-original_row_id)  # Keep unique_key and replicate_id for user reference

cat("\n✅ Final combined dataset created\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(final_dataset), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(final_dataset), "\n")
cat("• Unique combinations (Final_Cleaned_ID + Year):", length(unique(paste0(final_dataset$Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", final_dataset$Year))), "\n")
cat("• Total replicates:", nrow(final_dataset), "\n")

# Verify predictions were added successfully
prediction_cols <- colnames(final_dataset)[grepl("_predicted$|_complete$", colnames(final_dataset))]

if (length(prediction_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\n📊 PREDICTION SUMMARY:\n")
  for (col in prediction_cols) {
    non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(final_dataset[[col]]))
    cat("•", col, ":", non_null_count, "non-null values\n")
    
    # Show distribution across replicates
    if (non_null_count > 0) {
      rep_dist <- final_dataset %>% 
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) %>%
        count(replicate_id, name = "count") %>%
        arrange(replicate_id)
      
      cat("  Distribution:", paste(paste0("rep", rep_dist$replicate_id, ":", rep_dist$count), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("\n⚠️  No prediction columns found with standard naming pattern\n")
  cat("Available columns containing prediction variables:\n")
  
  # Look for any columns that might be predictions
  for (var_name in successful_variables) {
    var_cols <- colnames(final_dataset)[grepl(var_name, colnames(final_dataset))]
    if (length(var_cols) > 0) {
      cat("• Variable", var_name, ":", paste(var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      # Show first few non-null values
      first_col <- var_cols[1]
      non_null_vals <- final_dataset[[first_col]][!is.na(final_dataset[[first_col]])]
      if (length(non_null_vals) > 0) {
        cat("  Sample values:", paste(head(non_null_vals, 3), collapse = ", "), "...\n")
        
        # Show replicate distribution
        rep_dist <- final_dataset %>% 
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          filter(!is.na(.data[[first_col]])) %>%
          count(replicate_id, name = "count") %>%
          arrange(replicate_id)
        
        if (nrow(rep_dist) > 0) {
          cat("  Distribution:", paste(paste0("rep", rep_dist$replicate_id, ":", rep_dist$count), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Final memory cleanup
gc()

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: SAVE COMPREHENSIVE OUTPUTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING COMPREHENSIVE OUTPUTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"

# 1. Save complete enhanced dataset as GeoPackage
gpkg_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions_again.gpkg")
st_write(final_dataset, gpkg_output, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Complete dataset saved:", basename(gpkg_output), "\n")

# 2. Save attributes only as CSV
csv_output <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_predictions_attributes.csv")
st_drop_geometry(final_dataset) %>% write_csv(csv_output)
cat("✅ Attributes saved:", basename(csv_output), "\n")

# 3. Save comprehensive metrics summary
metrics_output <- paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_validation_metrics_summary.csv")
write_csv(all_metrics, metrics_output)
cat("✅ Metrics summary saved:", basename(metrics_output), "\n")

# 4. Save individual model objects
models_path <- paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_model_objects.RData")
save(all_results, W.P1_complete, field_mapping, year_mapping, 
     successful_variables, failed_variables, file = models_path)
```

### IV.4.1. GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS SUM ANALYSIS - TRAINING VS PREDICTED

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================================
# GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS SUM ANALYSIS - TRAINING VS PREDICTED
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 ANALYZING GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS SUM\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Load the enhanced dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions_again.gpkg"

if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced predictions file not found. Please run the imputation script first.")
}

parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n\n")

# Define granulometry fractions
granulo_vars <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE SUMS FOR TRAINING DATA (ORIGINAL OBSERVATIONS)
# ============================================================================

cat("🔬 Calculating sums for training data...\n")

training_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # Filter rows where all 5 fractions have original (non-NA) values
  filter(
    !is.na(Clay_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sum_Granulo = Clay_percent + Fine_Silt_percent + Coarse_Silt_percent + 
                  Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent,
    Data_Type = "Training (Original)"
  )

cat("• Training observations:", nrow(training_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",
    round(max(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE SUMS FOR PREDICTED DATA (ONLY TRUE PREDICTIONS)
# ============================================================================

cat("🔮 Calculating sums for predicted data (excluding training)...\n")

predicted_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # Use the _complete columns which contain predictions for missing values
  # AND filter to only rows where predictions were actually made (not training data)
  filter(
    !is.na(Clay_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent_complete) &
    # Exclude rows where original data existed (i.e., only keep true predictions)
    (is.na(Clay_percent) | is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) | is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) | 
     is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) | is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sum_Granulo = Clay_percent_complete + Fine_Silt_percent_complete + 
                  Coarse_Silt_percent_complete + Fine_Sand_percent_complete + 
                  Coarse_Sand_percent_complete,
    Data_Type = "Predicted (Imputed Only)"
  )

cat("• Predicted observations (imputed only):", nrow(predicted_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",
    round(max(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE DATA FOR PLOTTING
# ============================================================================

plot_data <- bind_rows(
```

```{r}
  filter(

  ) %>%
  mutate(

                  Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent,

  )

cat("• Training observations:", nrow(training_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",

# ============================================================================
# DECILE ANALYSIS FOR TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 DECILE ANALYSIS FOR TRAINING DATA (MEASURED)\n")
cat("================================================\n\n")

# Calculate deciles
deciles <- quantile(training_data$Sum_Granulo, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Decile boundaries:\n")
for(i in 1:(length(deciles)-1)) {
  cat(sprintf("  D%d: %.2f%% - %.2f%%\n", i-1, deciles[i], deciles[i+1]))
}
cat("\n")

# Count samples in each decile
decile_counts <- data.frame(
  Decile = paste0("D", 0:9),
  Lower_Bound = deciles[1:10],
  Upper_Bound = deciles[2:11],
  N_Samples = 0,
  Percentage = 0
)

for(i in 1:10) {
  if(i < 10) {
    count <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo >= deciles[i] & 
                 training_data$Sum_Granulo < deciles[i+1], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # Include the maximum value in the last decile
    count <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo >= deciles[i] & 
                 training_data$Sum_Granulo <= deciles[i+1], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  decile_counts$N_Samples[i] <- count
  decile_counts$Percentage[i] <- round(100 * count / nrow(training_data), 2)
}

cat("Distribution par décile (données mesurées):\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(decile_counts, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# ============================================================================
# ANALYSIS OUTSIDE [96%, 104%] INTERVAL FOR TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================================

cat("📏 ANALYSIS OUTSIDE [96%, 104%] INTERVAL (TRAINING DATA)\n")
cat("=========================================================\n\n")

n_total_training <- nrow(training_data)
n_below_96 <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo < 96, na.rm = TRUE)
n_above_104 <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo > 104, na.rm = TRUE)
n_outside_interval <- n_below_96 + n_above_104
n_within_interval <- n_total_training - n_outside_interval

pct_below_96 <- round(100 * n_below_96 / n_total_training, 2)
pct_above_104 <- round(100 * n_above_104 / n_total_training, 2)
pct_outside <- round(100 * n_outside_interval / n_total_training, 2)
pct_within <- round(100 * n_within_interval / n_total_training, 2)

cat(sprintf("Total échantillons mesurés: %d\n\n", n_total_training))
cat(sprintf("Dans l'intervalle [96%%, 104%%]: %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n", 
            n_within_interval, pct_within))
cat(sprintf("En dehors de [96%%, 104%%]:      %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n\n", 
            n_outside_interval, pct_outside))
cat(sprintf("  • En dessous de 96%%:           %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n", 
            n_below_96, pct_below_96))
cat(sprintf("  • Au-dessus de 104%%:          %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n\n", 
            n_above_104, pct_above_104))

  filter(
```

```{r}
library(sf)

# ============================================================================
# GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS SUM ANALYSIS - TRAINING VS PREDICTED
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 ANALYZING GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS SUM\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Load the enhanced dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions_again.gpkg"

if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced predictions file not found. Please run the imputation script first.")
}

parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n\n")

# Define granulometry fractions
granulo_vars <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE SUMS FOR TRAINING DATA (ORIGINAL OBSERVATIONS)
# ============================================================================

cat("🔬 Calculating sums for training data...\n")

training_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Clay_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sum_Granulo = Clay_percent + Fine_Silt_percent + Coarse_Silt_percent + 
                  Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent,
    Data_Type = "Training (Original)"
  )

cat("• Training observations:", nrow(training_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",
    round(max(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE SUMS FOR PREDICTED DATA (ONLY TRUE PREDICTIONS)
# ============================================================================

cat("🔮 Calculating sums for predicted data (excluding training)...\n")

predicted_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Clay_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent_complete) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent_complete) &
    (is.na(Clay_percent) | is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) | is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) | 
     is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) | is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sum_Granulo = Clay_percent_complete + Fine_Silt_percent_complete + 
                  Coarse_Silt_percent_complete + Fine_Sand_percent_complete + 
                  Coarse_Sand_percent_complete,
    Data_Type = "Predicted (Imputed Only)"
  )

cat("• Predicted observations (imputed only):", nrow(predicted_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",
    round(max(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# DECILE ANALYSIS - QUANTILE VALUES (WHAT SUM VALUES CORRESPOND TO EACH DECILE)
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 DECILE ANALYSIS - QUANTILE VALUES\n")
cat("=====================================\n\n")

# Function to calculate quantile values (decile boundaries)
calculate_decile_values <- function(data, data_name) {
  # Calculate decile boundaries (0%, 10%, 20%, ..., 100%)
  decile_probs <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
  decile_values <- quantile(data$Sum_Granulo, probs = decile_probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  decile_df <- data.frame(
    Decile = paste0("D", 0:10),
    Percentile = paste0(decile_probs * 100, "%"),
    Sum_Value = round(as.numeric(decile_values), 2),
    Data_Type = data_name
  )
  
  # Create label
  decile_df$Decile_Label <- sprintf("%s (%s)", 
                                    decile_df$Decile, 
                                    decile_df$Percentile)
  
  return(decile_df)
}

# Calculate for both datasets SEPARATELY
training_deciles <- calculate_decile_values(training_data, "Training (Original)")
predicted_deciles <- calculate_decile_values(predicted_data, "Predicted (Imputed Only)")

# ============================================================================
# INTERVAL [96%, 104%] ANALYSIS FOR BOTH DATASETS
# ============================================================================

cat("📏 ANALYSIS OUTSIDE [96%, 104%] INTERVAL\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

# Function to calculate interval statistics
calculate_interval_stats <- function(data, data_name) {
  n_total <- nrow(data)
  n_below_96 <- sum(data$Sum_Granulo < 96, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_within <- sum(data$Sum_Granulo >= 96 & data$Sum_Granulo <= 104, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_above_104 <- sum(data$Sum_Granulo > 104, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    Data_Type = data_name,
    Category = c("< 96%", "[96%, 104%]", "> 104%"),
    N_Samples = c(n_below_96, n_within, n_above_104),
    Percentage = round(100 * c(n_below_96, n_within, n_above_104) / n_total, 2)
  )
}

training_interval <- calculate_interval_stats(training_data, "Training (Original)")
predicted_interval <- calculate_interval_stats(predicted_data, "Predicted (Imputed Only)")

cat("Training data interval analysis:\n")
print(training_interval)
cat("\n")

cat("Predicted data interval analysis:\n")
print(predicted_interval)
cat("\n")

# Combine interval data
all_intervals <- bind_rows(training_interval, predicted_interval)

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE DATA FOR PLOTTING
# ============================================================================

plot_data <- bind_rows(
  training_data %>% select(Sum_Granulo, Data_Type),
  predicted_data %>% select(Sum_Granulo, Data_Type)
)

# Calculate statistics for annotations
stats_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Data_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_val = mean(Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_val = min(Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================================
# CREATE NATURE-STYLE 2x2 PLOT
# ============================================================================

cat("\n🎨 Creating publication-quality 2×2 plot...\n")

# Nature journal style parameters - high quality
nature_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    # Text - Nature standard
    text = element_text(family = "sans", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 3)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    
    # Panel - Nature standard
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    
    # Strips for facets
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)),
    
    # Legend
    legend.position = "none",
    
    # Margins
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    
    # Axis ticks
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt")
  )

# Reorder factor levels
plot_data$Data_Type <- factor(
  plot_data$Data_Type,
  levels = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)")
)

stats_summary$Data_Type <- factor(
  stats_summary$Data_Type,
  levels = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)")
)

training_deciles$Data_Type <- factor(
  training_deciles$Data_Type,
  levels = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)")
)

predicted_deciles$Data_Type <- factor(
  predicted_deciles$Data_Type,
  levels = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)")
)

all_intervals$Data_Type <- factor(
  all_intervals$Data_Type,
  levels = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)")
)

all_intervals$Category <- factor(
  all_intervals$Category,
  levels = c("< 96%", "[96%, 104%]", "> 104%")
)

# Reverse decile order for plotting (D10 at top, D0 at bottom)
training_deciles$Decile_Label <- factor(training_deciles$Decile_Label, 
                                        levels = rev(training_deciles$Decile_Label))

predicted_deciles$Decile_Label <- factor(predicted_deciles$Decile_Label, 
                                         levels = rev(predicted_deciles$Decile_Label))

# ---------- PLOT A & B: Distribution histograms (TOP ROW) ----------

p_dist <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Sum_Granulo)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 30,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_density(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = stats_summary,
    aes(xintercept = mean_val),
    color = "#D55E00",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 100),
    color = "#0072B2",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = stats_summary,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = sprintf(
        "N: %d\nRange: [%.1f, %.1f]\nMean: %.1f%%",
        n_obs, min_val, max_val, mean_val
      )
    ),
    hjust = 1.08,
    vjust = 1.4,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "plain",
    lineheight = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Data_Type, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Sum of granulometry fractions (%)",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Distribution of granulometry fraction sums"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(90, 110, by = 5),
    limits = c(
      min(min(plot_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE) - 2, 90),
      max(max(plot_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE) + 2, 110)
    )
  ) +
  nature_theme

# ---------- PLOT C: Training Decile Values (BOTTOM LEFT - LEFT PANEL) ----------

p_deciles_training <- ggplot(training_deciles, aes(x = Sum_Value, y = Decile_Label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#56B4E9", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%", Sum_Value)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sum of granulometry fractions (%)",
    y = "Decile (percentile)",
    title = "Training (Original)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(90, 110, by = 5),
    limits = c(
      min(training_deciles$Sum_Value) - 2,
      max(training_deciles$Sum_Value) + 5
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  nature_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# ---------- PLOT D: Predicted Decile Values (BOTTOM LEFT - RIGHT PANEL) ----------

p_deciles_predicted <- ggplot(predicted_deciles, aes(x = Sum_Value, y = Decile_Label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#E69F00", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%", Sum_Value)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sum of granulometry fractions (%)",
    y = "Decile (percentile)",
    title = "Predicted (Imputed Only)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(90, 110, by = 5),
    limits = c(
      min(predicted_deciles$Sum_Value) - 2,
      max(predicted_deciles$Sum_Value) + 5
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  nature_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# ---------- PLOT E & F: Interval [96%, 104%] - HORIZONTAL BARS (BOTTOM RIGHT) ----------

# Reverse category order for horizontal bars (> 104% at top)
all_intervals$Category <- factor(
  all_intervals$Category,
  levels = c("> 104%", "[96%, 104%]", "< 96%")
)

p_interval <- ggplot(all_intervals, aes(x = Percentage, y = Category, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Data_Type, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("< 96%" = "#E15759", 
               "[96%, 104%]" = "#59A14F", 
               "> 104%" = "#E15759")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage of samples (%)",
    y = "Interval category",
    title = "Distribution relative to [96%, 104%] interval"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    limits = c(0, max(all_intervals$Percentage) * 1.35),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  nature_theme

# ---------- COMBINE INTO 2×2 LAYOUT ----------

combined_plot <- (p_dist) / 
                 ((p_deciles_training | p_deciles_predicted) | p_interval) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1.5))

# Save the combined plot
output_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/granulometry_comprehensive_analysis.png"

ggsave(
  output_path,
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 200,
  height = 200,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("✅ Combined plot saved:", basename(output_path), "\n")
cat("   Dimensions: 200mm × 200mm (constant size)\n")
cat("   Resolution: 600 DPI\n\n")

# Display the plot
print(combined_plot)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n📋 SUMMARY STATISTICS\n")
cat("=====================\n\n")

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Training (Original)", "Predicted (Imputed Only)"),
  N_Samples = c(nrow(training_data), nrow(predicted_data)),
  Mean_Sum = round(c(mean(training_data$Sum_Granulo), mean(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo)), 2),
  SD_Sum = round(c(sd(training_data$Sum_Granulo), sd(predicted_data$Sum_Granulo)), 2),
  Within_96_104_Pct = c(
    training_interval$Percentage[training_interval$Category == "[96%, 104%]"],
    predicted_interval$Percentage[predicted_interval$Category == "[96%, 104%]"]
  ),
  Outside_96_104_Pct = c(
    sum(training_interval$Percentage[training_interval$Category != "[96%, 104%]"]),
    sum(predicted_interval$Percentage[predicted_interval$Category != "[96%, 104%]"])
  )
)

print(summary_table)
```

### IV.4.2. GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS - DECILE BOUNDARIES ANALYSIS (TRAINING DATA ONLY)

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================================
# GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS - DECILE BOUNDARIES ANALYSIS (TRAINING DATA ONLY)
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 ANALYZING GRANULOMETRY DECILE BOUNDARIES - TRAINING DATA\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# Load the enhanced dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions_again.gpkg"

if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced predictions file not found.")
}

parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# TRAINING DATA ONLY - MEASURED VALUES
# ============================================================================

cat("🔬 Extracting training data (measured values only)...\n")

training_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Clay_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) &
    !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) &
    !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sum_Granulo = Clay_percent + Fine_Silt_percent + Coarse_Silt_percent + 
                  Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent
  )

cat("• Training observations:", nrow(training_data), "\n")
cat("• Mean sum:", round(mean(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• SD:", round(sd(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n")
cat("• Range: [", round(min(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ",
    round(max(training_data$Sum_Granulo, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# DECILE BOUNDARIES
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 CALCULATING DECILE BOUNDARIES\n")
cat("==================================\n\n")

# Calculate deciles (boundaries) - now including D0
deciles <- quantile(training_data$Sum_Granulo, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1), na.rm = TRUE)

# Create decile summary table
decile_summary <- data.frame(
  Decile = c("D0-D1", "D1-D2", "D2-D3", "D3-D4", "D4-D5", 
             "D5-D6", "D6-D7", "D7-D8", "D8-D9", "D9-D10"),
  Lower_Bound = round(deciles[1:10], 2),
  Upper_Bound = round(deciles[2:11], 2),
  Range_Width = round(deciles[2:11] - deciles[1:10], 2)
)

cat("Limites des déciles pour la somme des 5 fractions granulo:\n")
cat("===========================================================\n")
print(decile_summary, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# Key decile values - now including D0
cat("Valeurs clés:\n")
cat(sprintf("• D0 (Minimum):         %.2f%%\n", deciles[1]))
cat(sprintf("• D1 (10e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[2]))
cat(sprintf("• D2 (20e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[3]))
cat(sprintf("• D3 (30e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[4]))
cat(sprintf("• D4 (40e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[5]))
cat(sprintf("• D5 (50e percentile - Médiane): %.2f%%\n", deciles[6]))
cat(sprintf("• D6 (60e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[7]))
cat(sprintf("• D7 (70e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[8]))
cat(sprintf("• D8 (80e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[9]))
cat(sprintf("• D9 (90e percentile):  %.2f%%\n", deciles[10]))
cat(sprintf("• D10 (Maximum):        %.2f%%\n", deciles[11]))
cat("\n")

# ============================================================================
# ANALYSIS OUTSIDE [96%, 104%] INTERVAL
# ============================================================================

cat("📏 ANALYSIS OUTSIDE [96%, 104%] INTERVAL\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

n_total <- nrow(training_data)
n_below_96 <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo < 96, na.rm = TRUE)
n_above_104 <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo > 104, na.rm = TRUE)
n_within_interval <- sum(training_data$Sum_Granulo >= 96 & training_data$Sum_Granulo <= 104, na.rm = TRUE)
n_outside_interval <- n_below_96 + n_above_104

pct_below_96 <- round(100 * n_below_96 / n_total, 2)
pct_above_104 <- round(100 * n_above_104 / n_total, 2)
pct_outside <- round(100 * n_outside_interval / n_total, 2)
pct_within <- round(100 * n_within_interval / n_total, 2)

cat(sprintf("Total échantillons mesurés: %d\n\n", n_total))
cat(sprintf("✅ Dans l'intervalle [96%%, 104%%]: %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n", 
            n_within_interval, pct_within))
cat(sprintf("❌ En dehors de [96%%, 104%%]:      %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n\n", 
            n_outside_interval, pct_outside))
cat(sprintf("   • En dessous de 96%%:           %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n", 
            n_below_96, pct_below_96))
cat(sprintf("   • Au-dessus de 104%%:          %d échantillons (%.2f%%)\n\n", 
            n_above_104, pct_above_104))

# ============================================================================
# CREATE INSET BAR PLOT FOR [96%, 104%] ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

cat("🎨 Creating inset bar plot...\n")

# Prepare data for inset
interval_data <- data.frame(
  Category = factor(
    c("Within\n[96-104%]", "Below\n96%", "Above\n104%"),
    levels = c("Within\n[96-104%]", "Below\n96%", "Above\n104%")
  ),
  Percentage = c(pct_within, pct_below_96, pct_above_104),
  N_Samples = c(n_within_interval, n_below_96, n_above_104),
  Fill_Color = c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")
)

# Create inset bar plot
inset_plot <- ggplot(interval_data, aes(x = Category, y = Percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%\n(n=%d)", Percentage, N_Samples)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = interval_data$Fill_Color) +
  labs(
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(interval_data$Percentage) * 1.15),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
  )

# ============================================================================
# CREATE PUBLICATION-QUALITY DECILE BOUNDARIES PLOT
# ============================================================================

cat("🎨 Creating main decile boundaries plot...\n")

# Prepare data for plotting - now including D0
decile_plot_data <- data.frame(
  Decile_Number = 0:10,
  Boundary_Value = deciles[1:11],
  Percentile = seq(0, 100, 10)
)

# Nature journal style theme
nature_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Create the main plot
main_plot <- ggplot(decile_plot_data, aes(x = Decile_Number, y = Boundary_Value)) +
  # Add horizontal reference line at 100%
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 100, 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "#0072B2", 
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Add shaded region for [96%, 104%] interval
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 96, ymax = 104,
    fill = "#56B4E9",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  
  # Add horizontal lines at 96% and 104%
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(96, 104),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "#0072B2",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # Points for each decile
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fill = "#E69F00",
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Line connecting points
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Add value labels for each point
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Boundary_Value)),
    vjust = -1.2,
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Decile",
    y = "Sum of Granulometry Fractions (%)",
    title = ""
  ) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:10,
    labels = paste0("D", 0:10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(90, 110, 2),
    limits = c(
      min(decile_plot_data$Boundary_Value) - 2,
      max(decile_plot_data$Boundary_Value) + 2
    )
  ) +
  
  # Add annotation for acceptable range
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 9.5,
    y = 100,
    label = "[96%-104%]",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3,
    color = "#0072B2",
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  
  # Apply theme
  nature_theme

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE MAIN PLOT WITH INSET
# ============================================================================

cat("🎨 Adding inset to main plot...\n")

# Add inset to main plot using patchwork
final_plot <- main_plot + 
  inset_element(
    inset_plot,
    left = 0.02,    # Position from left
    bottom = 0.58,  # Position from bottom (top left area)
    right = 0.38,   # Width of inset
    top = 0.98      # Height of inset
  )

# Save the plot
output_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/granulometry_decile_boundaries_with_inset.png"

ggsave(
  output_path,
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 180,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("✅ Plot saved:", basename(output_path), "\n")
cat("   Dimensions: 180mm × 120mm\n")
cat("   Resolution: 600 DPI\n\n")

# Display the plot
print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD RESULTS FROM MULTI-VARIABLE IMPUTATION

cat("📂 LOADING MULTI-VARIABLE IMPUTATION RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

# Load the enhanced dataset with all predictions

# Load data

cat("✅ Data loaded successfully:\n")
cat("  Enhanced dataset:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n")
cat("  Successful variables:", length(successful_variables), "\n")
cat("  Failed variables:", length(failed_variables), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# SMART VISUALIZATION FUNCTIONS (ENHANCED FOR ALL VARIABLES)
# ============================================================================

# Enhanced color palette selection for different soil properties
get_smart_colors <- function(variable, values = NULL) {
  variable_lower <- tolower(variable)
  
  if (grepl("ph", variable_lower)) {
    return(c("#d73027", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#a6d96a", "#66bd63", "#1a9850"))
  } else if (grepl("clay|silt|sand|percent", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrBr"))
  } else if (grepl("carbon|nitrogen|organic|matter", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))
  } else if (grepl("uncertainty|sd|residual", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))
  } else if (grepl("calcium|magnesium|potassium|sodium|exchangeable", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
  } else if (grepl("phosphorus|p2o5", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Purples"))
  } else if (grepl("conductivity|electrical", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))
  } else if (grepl("ratio|cn|mg_ca|mg_k", variable_lower)) {
    return(viridis(9, option = "plasma"))
  } else if (grepl("compaction", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greys"))
  } else {
    return(viridis(9, option = "viridis"))
  }
}

# Smart grid calculation
get_smart_grid <- function(n_items) {
  if (n_items <= 1) return(c(1, 1))
  if (n_items == 2) return(c(1, 2))
  if (n_items == 3) return(c(1, 3))
  if (n_items == 4) return(c(2, 2))
  if (n_items <= 6) return(c(2, 3))
  if (n_items <= 9) return(c(3, 3))
  if (n_items <= 12) return(c(3, 4))
  else return(c(ceiling(sqrt(n_items)), ceiling(n_items/ceiling(sqrt(n_items)))))
}

    "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Sodium (meq/100g)",
    "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Potassium (meq/100g)",
    "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" = "Available P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
    "Clay_percent" = "Clay Percentage (%)",
    "Fine_Silt_percent" = "Fine Silt (%)",
    "Coarse_Silt_percent" = "Coarse Silt (%)",
    "Fine_Sand_percent" = "Fine Sand (%)",
    "Coarse_Sand_percent" = "Coarse Sand (%)",
    "Organic_Carbon_per_mille" = "Organic Carbon (‰)",

# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED OUTPUT DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================

create_comprehensive_output_directories <- function() {
  main_dir <- "comprehensive_multivariable_analysis_results"
  subdirs <- c(
    "01_predictions_by_variable",
    "02_uncertainty_by_variable", 
    "03_residuals_by_variable",
    "04_diagnostics_by_variable",
    "05_trends_by_variable",
    "06_comparative_analysis",
    "07_summary_reports"
  )
  
  if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) {
    dir.create(main_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (subdir in subdirs) {
    subdir_path <- file.path(main_dir, subdir)
    if (!dir.exists(subdir_path)) {
      dir.create(subdir_path, recursive = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  # Create individual variable directories
  for (var in successful_variables) {
    var_dir <- file.path(main_dir, "08_individual_variables", var)
    if (!dir.exists(var_dir)) {
      dir.create(var_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(main_dir)
}

# Enhanced save function for high-quality plots
save_comprehensive_plot <- function(plot, filename, subfolder = "", width = 12, height = 8) {
  if (subfolder != "") {
    full_path <- file.path(output_dir, subfolder, filename)
  } else {
    full_path <- file.path(output_dir, filename)
  }
  
  # Ensure directory exists
  plot_dir <- dirname(full_path)
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save PNG (high resolution)
  png_path <- gsub("\\.png$", "", full_path)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(png_path, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Save PDF (vector format)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(png_path, ".pdf"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("    ✓ Saved:", basename(png_path), "(PNG + PDF)\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN ANALYSIS FUNCTION FOR SINGLE VARIABLE
# ============================================================================

analyze_single_variable <- function(var_name, enhanced_data, model_results, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 ANALYZING VARIABLE:", var_name, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Check if variable was successfully processed
  if (!var_name %in% successful_variables) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Variable was not successfully processed. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract model results
  model_result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  if (is.null(model_result)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ No model results found. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Prepare prediction columns
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  sd_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted_sd")
  lower_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted_lower")
  upper_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted_upper")
  complete_col <- paste0(var_name, "_complete")
  type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check if columns exist
  required_cols <- c(pred_col, sd_col, type_col)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(enhanced_data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Missing prediction columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Prepare data for visualization
  data_for_viz <- enhanced_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      pred_mean = .data[[pred_col]],
      pred_sd = .data[[sd_col]],
      prediction_type = .data[[type_col]],
      Year = as.factor(Year)
    ) %>%
    # Remove extreme values for better visualization
    filter(
      pred_mean < quantile(pred_mean, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      pred_mean > quantile(pred_mean, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pred_sd < quantile(pred_sd, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Data prepared for visualization:\n")
    cat("  Total observations:", nrow(data_for_viz), "\n")
    cat("  Years included:", paste(sort(unique(data_for_viz$Year)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("  Value range:", round(min(data_for_viz$pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "-", 
        round(max(data_for_viz$pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
  }
  
  # Get years and grid dimensions
  unique_years <- sort(unique(data_for_viz$Year))
  n_years <- length(unique_years)
  grid_dims <- get_smart_grid(n_years)
  
  # Get variable-specific colors and labels
  pred_colors <- get_smart_colors(var_name)
  var_label <- get_variable_label(var_name)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 1: SPATIO-TEMPORAL PREDICTIONS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("📊 Creating prediction maps...\n")
  
  val_range_pred <- range(data_for_viz$pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p_predictions <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = data_for_viz, 
            aes(fill = pred_mean), 
            color = "white", 
            size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = pred_colors,
      name = var_label,
      limits = val_range_pred,
      labels = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1,
        barheight = 10,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Year),
      ncol = grid_dims[2],
      nrow = grid_dims[1],
      scales = "fixed",
      labeller = labeller(Year = function(x) paste("Year", x))
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", size = 0.3),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Spatio-Temporal Predictions:", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Model predictions across years | Range: ", 
        round(val_range_pred[1], 2), "-", round(val_range_pred[2], 2), " | ",
        "Records: ", nrow(data_for_viz)
      )
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 2: UNCERTAINTY MAPS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("📊 Creating uncertainty maps...\n")
  
  uncert_colors <- get_smart_colors("uncertainty")
  val_range_uncert <- range(data_for_viz$pred_sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p_uncertainty <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = data_for_viz, 
            aes(fill = pred_sd), 
            color = "white", 
            size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = uncert_colors,
      name = "Uncertainty\n(SD)",
      limits = val_range_uncert,
      labels = function(x) format(round(x, 3), nsmall = 3),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1,
        barheight = 10,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Year),
      ncol = grid_dims[2],
      nrow = grid_dims[1],
      scales = "fixed",
      labeller = labeller(Year = function(x) paste("Year", x))
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", size = 0.3),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Prediction Uncertainty:", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Model uncertainty across years | Range: ", 
        round(val_range_uncert[1], 3), "-", round(val_range_uncert[2], 3), " | ",
        "Mean uncertainty: ", round(mean(data_for_viz$pred_sd, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
      )
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 3: TEMPORAL TRENDS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("📊 Creating temporal trends analysis...\n")
  
  # Calculate temporal trends by field
  temporal_trends <- data_for_viz %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n(),
      mean_value = mean(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      trend_slope = ifelse(n_years > 1, 
                          coef(lm(pred_mean ~ as.numeric(as.character(Year))))[2], 
                          NA),
      trend_pvalue = ifelse(n_years > 1, 
                           summary(lm(pred_mean ~ as.numeric(as.character(Year))))$coefficients[2,4], 
                           NA),
      value_variance = var(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      trend_significant = ifelse(!is.na(trend_pvalue), trend_pvalue < 0.05, FALSE),
      trend_direction = case_when(
        !trend_significant ~ "No significant trend",
        trend_slope > 0 ~ "Increasing",
        trend_slope < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
        TRUE ~ "Stable"
      )
    )
  
  # Yearly summary
  yearly_summary <- data_for_viz %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_prediction = mean(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_prediction = median(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_prediction = sd(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = quantile(pred_mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(pred_mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year)))
  
  # Trend histogram
  p_trends <- temporal_trends %>%
    filter(!is.na(trend_slope)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = trend_slope)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of Temporal Trends:", var_label),
      x = paste("Trend Slope (", var_label, " per year)"),
      y = "Number of Fields"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Yearly evolution
  p_yearly_evolution <- yearly_summary %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_prediction), color = "darkblue", size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = mean_prediction), color = "darkblue", size = 3) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_prediction - sd_prediction, 
                    ymax = mean_prediction + sd_prediction), 
                alpha = 0.3, fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Temporal Evolution:", var_label),
      subtitle = "Mean predictions with standard deviation bands",
      x = "Year",
      y = var_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # MODEL DIAGNOSTICS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("📊 Creating model diagnostics...\n")
  
  # Get model fit information
  model_fit <- model_result$model_fit
  predictions_df <- model_result$predictions
  
  # Calculate residuals for observations with true values
  diagnostics_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Y_true), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = .data[[pred_col]],
      residuals = Y_true - fitted
    )
  
  # R-squared and other metrics
  r_squared <- if(nrow(diagnostics_data) > 5) {
    cor(diagnostics_data$Y_true, diagnostics_data$fitted, use = "complete.obs")^2
  } else { NA }
  
  # Diagnostic plots
  p_obs_pred <- if(nrow(diagnostics_data) > 5) {
    ggplot(diagnostics_data, aes(x = fitted, y = Y_true)) + 
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Observed vs Predicted: ", var_label, 
                      ifelse(!is.na(r_squared), paste0(" (R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), ")"), "")),
        x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
        y = paste("Observed", var_label)
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  } else { NULL }
  
  p_residuals <- if(nrow(diagnostics_data) > 5) {
    ggplot(diagnostics_data, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) + 
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Residuals vs Fitted:", var_label),
        x = "Fitted Values",
        y = "Residuals"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  } else { NULL }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # SAVE ALL PLOTS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("💾 Saving plots...\n")
  
  # Calculate plot dimensions
  map_width <- max(8, 3 * grid_dims[2] + 2)
  map_height <- max(6, 2.5 * grid_dims[1] + 1.5)
  
  # Save main visualizations
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_predictions, paste0(var_name, "_predictions_yearly.png"), 
                         "01_predictions_by_variable", width = map_width, height = map_height)
  
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_uncertainty, paste0(var_name, "_uncertainty_yearly.png"), 
                         "02_uncertainty_by_variable", width = map_width, height = map_height)
  
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_trends, paste0(var_name, "_trends_histogram.png"), 
                         "05_trends_by_variable", width = 10, height = 6)
  
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_yearly_evolution, paste0(var_name, "_yearly_evolution.png"), 
                         "05_trends_by_variable", width = 10, height = 6)
  
  # Save diagnostics if available
  if (!is.null(p_obs_pred)) {
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_obs_pred, paste0(var_name, "_observed_vs_predicted.png"), 
                           "04_diagnostics_by_variable", width = 8, height = 6)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(p_residuals)) {
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_residuals, paste0(var_name, "_residuals_vs_fitted.png"), 
                           "04_diagnostics_by_variable", width = 8, height = 6)
  }
  
  # Save to individual variable folder
  var_folder <- file.path("08_individual_variables", var_name)
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_predictions, paste0(var_name, "_predictions.png"), 
                         var_folder, width = map_width, height = map_height)
  save_comprehensive_plot(p_uncertainty, paste0(var_name, "_uncertainty.png"), 
                         var_folder, width = map_width, height = map_height)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # RETURN ANALYSIS RESULTS
  # ============================================================================
  
  analysis_results <- list(
    variable_name = var_name,
    variable_label = var_label,
    n_observations = nrow(data_for_viz),
    n_years = n_years,
    value_range = val_range_pred,
    uncertainty_range = val_range_uncert,
    r_squared = r_squared,
    temporal_trends = temporal_trends,
    yearly_summary = yearly_summary,
    plots = list(
      predictions = p_predictions,
      uncertainty = p_uncertainty,
      trends = p_trends,
      yearly_evolution = p_yearly_evolution,
      obs_pred = p_obs_pred,
      residuals = p_residuals
    )
  )
  
  if (verbose) cat("✅ Analysis completed for", var_name, "\n")
  
  return(analysis_results)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: RUN COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🚀 RUNNING COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Create output directories
output_dir <- create_comprehensive_output_directories()
cat("📁 Output directory created:", output_dir, "\n")

# Initialize storage for all results
all_analysis_results <- list()
processing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(0),
  Status = character(0),
  N_Observations = numeric(0),
  N_Years = numeric(0),
  Value_Range_Min = numeric(0),
  Value_Range_Max = numeric(0),
  R_Squared = numeric(0),
  Processing_Time_Sec = numeric(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Process each successful variable
total_vars <- length(successful_variables)
cat("Processing", total_vars, "variables:\n\n")

for (i in seq_along(successful_variables)) {
  var_name <- successful_variables[i]
  
  cat("[", i, "/", total_vars, "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  tryCatch({
    analysis_result <- analyze_single_variable(
      var_name = var_name,
      enhanced_data = parcelles_enhanced,
      model_results = all_results,
      verbose = FALSE  # Set to TRUE for detailed output
    )
    
    if (!is.null(analysis_result)) {
      all_analysis_results[[var_name]] <- analysis_result
      
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      # Add to summary
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Status = "Success",
        N_Observations = analysis_result$n_observations,
        N_Years = analysis_result$n_years,
        Value_Range_Min = analysis_result$value_range[1],
        Value_Range_Max = analysis_result$value_range[2],
        R_Squared = ifelse(is.null(analysis_result$r_squared) || is.na(analysis_result$r_squared), 
                          NA, analysis_result$r_squared),
        Processing_Time_Sec = processing_time,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("    ✅ SUCCESS (", round(processing_time, 1), "s)\n")
      
    } else {
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Status = "Failed - No Analysis",
        N_Observations = NA,
        N_Years = NA,
        Value_Range_Min = NA,
        Value_Range_Max = NA,
        R_Squared = NA,
        Processing_Time_Sec = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("    ❌ FAILED - Analysis returned NULL\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      N_Observations = NA,
      N_Years = NA,
      Value_Range_Min = NA,
      Value_Range_Max = NA,
      R_Squared = NA,
      Processing_Time_Sec = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
    cat("    ❌ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  cat("\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CREATE COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔬 CREATING COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Prepare comparative data
successful_analyses <- names(all_analysis_results)
cat("Creating comparative visualizations for", length(successful_analyses), "variables\n")

if (length(successful_analyses) > 1) {
  
  # ============================================================================
  # COMPARATIVE VISUALIZATION 1: VALUE RANGES COMPARISON
  # ============================================================================
  
  cat("📊 Creating value ranges comparison...\n")
  
  range_data <- processing_summary %>%
    filter(Status == "Success", !is.na(Value_Range_Min), !is.na(Value_Range_Max)) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable_Label = sapply(Variable, get_variable_label),
      Range_Width = Value_Range_Max - Value_Range_Min,
      Mid_Point = (Value_Range_Min + Value_Range_Max) / 2
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Range_Width))
  
  if (nrow(range_data) > 0) {
    p_ranges <- range_data %>%
```
