```{r}
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Range_Width))) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = Value_Range_Min, ymax = Value_Range_Max),
        width = 0.3,
        color = "steelblue",
        size = 1
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(y = Mid_Point),
        color = "darkred",
        size = 2
      ) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = "Variable Value Ranges Comparison",
        subtitle = "Bars show min-max range, dots show midpoints",
        x = "Variable",
        y = "Value Range"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_ranges, "variable_ranges_comparison.png", 
                           "06_comparative_analysis", width = 12, height = max(6, nrow(range_data) * 0.4))
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # COMPARATIVE VISUALIZATION 2: MODEL PERFORMANCE COMPARISON
  # ============================================================================
  
  cat("📊 Creating model performance comparison...\n")
  
  performance_data <- processing_summary %>%
    filter(Status == "Success", !is.na(R_Squared)) %>%
    mutate(Variable_Label = sapply(Variable, get_variable_label)) %>%
    arrange(desc(R_Squared))
  
  if (nrow(performance_data) > 0) {
    p_performance <- performance_data %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, R_Squared), y = R_Squared)) +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = round(R_Squared, 3)),
        hjust = -0.1,
        size = 3.5
      ) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(performance_data$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)) +
      labs(
        title = "Model Performance Comparison (R²)",
        subtitle = "Higher R² indicates better model fit",
        x = "Variable",
        y = "R² Value"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_performance, "model_performance_comparison.png", 
                           "06_comparative_analysis", width = 12, height = max(6, nrow(performance_data) * 0.4))
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # COMPARATIVE VISUALIZATION 3: PROCESSING EFFICIENCY
  # ============================================================================
  
  cat("📊 Creating processing efficiency comparison...\n")
  
  efficiency_data <- processing_summary %>%
    filter(Status == "Success") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable_Label = sapply(Variable, get_variable_label),
      Obs_Per_Second = N_Observations / Processing_Time_Sec
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Processing_Time_Sec))
  
  if (nrow(efficiency_data) > 0) {
    p_efficiency <- efficiency_data %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Processing_Time_Sec), y = Processing_Time_Sec)) +
      geom_col(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = paste0(round(Processing_Time_Sec, 1), "s")),
        hjust = -0.1,
        size = 3.5
      ) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(efficiency_data$Processing_Time_Sec, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)) +
      labs(
        title = "Processing Time Comparison",
        subtitle = "Time taken to analyze each variable",
        x = "Variable",
        y = "Processing Time (seconds)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_efficiency, "processing_time_comparison.png", 
                           "06_comparative_analysis", width = 12, height = max(6, nrow(efficiency_data) * 0.4))
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # COMPARATIVE VISUALIZATION 4: CORRELATION MATRIX OF VARIABLES
  # ============================================================================
  
  cat("📊 Creating variable correlation analysis...\n")
  
  # Prepare correlation data
  correlation_data <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(paste0(successful_analyses, "_predicted"))) %>%
    rename_with(~gsub("_predicted", "", .x)) %>%
    select_if(~sum(!is.na(.x)) > 10)  # Only variables with sufficient data
  
  if (ncol(correlation_data) > 1) {
    # Calculate correlation matrix
    cor_matrix <- cor(correlation_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    
    # Convert to long format
    cor_long <- expand.grid(
      Variable1 = rownames(cor_matrix),
      Variable2 = colnames(cor_matrix)
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Correlation = as.vector(cor_matrix),
        Variable1_Label = sapply(Variable1, get_variable_label),
        Variable2_Label = sapply(Variable2, get_variable_label)
      )
    
    p_correlation <- cor_long %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Variable1_Label, y = Variable2_Label, fill = Correlation)) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)),
        color = ifelse(abs(cor_long$Correlation) > 0.5, "white", "black"),
        size = 3
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
        midpoint = 0,
        name = "Correlation",
        limits = c(-1, 1)
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
        legend.position = "right"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Variable Correlation Matrix",
        subtitle = "Correlation between predicted values",
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      coord_fixed()
    
    save_comprehensive_plot(p_correlation, "variable_correlation_matrix.png", 
                           "06_comparative_analysis", 
                           width = max(10, ncol(correlation_data) * 0.8), 
                           height = max(8, ncol(correlation_data) * 0.8))
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CREATE COMPREHENSIVE SUMMARY REPORT
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📋 CREATING SUMMARY REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Generate summary statistics
total_successful <- sum(processing_summary$Status == "Success")
total_failed <- nrow(processing_summary) - total_successful
total_observations <- sum(processing_summary$N_Observations, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_processing_time <- mean(processing_summary$Processing_Time_Sec, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_r_squared <- mean(processing_summary$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create summary report
summary_report <- paste0(
  "# COMPREHENSIVE MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL ANALYSIS REPORT\n",
  "Generated on: ", Sys.Date(), "\n\n",
  
  "## PROCESSING SUMMARY\n",
  "- Total variables processed: ", nrow(processing_summary), "\n",
  "- Successfully analyzed: ", total_successful, " (", round(100*total_successful/nrow(processing_summary), 1), "%)\n",
  "- Failed analyses: ", total_failed, "\n",
  "- Total observations processed: ", format(total_observations, big.mark = ","), "\n",
  "- Average processing time per variable: ", round(mean_processing_time, 1), " seconds\n",
  "- Average model R²: ", round(mean_r_squared, 3), "\n\n",
  
  "## VARIABLE DETAILS\n"
)

# Add details for each successfully processed variable
for (var_name in successful_analyses) {
  result <- all_analysis_results[[var_name]]
  var_summary <- processing_summary[processing_summary$Variable == var_name, ]
  
  summary_report <- paste0(
    summary_report,
    "### ", result$variable_label, " (", var_name, ")\n",
    "- Observations: ", format(result$n_observations, big.mark = ","), "\n",
    "- Years covered: ", result$n_years, "\n",
    "- Value range: ", round(result$value_range[1], 3), " to ", round(result$value_range[2], 3), "\n",
    "- Uncertainty range: ", round(result$uncertainty_range[1], 4), " to ", round(result$uncertainty_range[2], 4), "\n",
    "- Model R²: ", ifelse(is.na(result$r_squared), "N/A", round(result$r_squared, 3)), "\n",
    "- Processing time: ", round(var_summary$Processing_Time_Sec, 1), " seconds\n\n"
  )
}

# Add failed variables section if any
if (length(failed_variables) > 0) {
  summary_report <- paste0(
    summary_report,
    "## FAILED VARIABLES\n",
    "The following variables could not be processed during imputation:\n"
  )
  
  for (failed_var in failed_variables) {
    summary_report <- paste0(summary_report, "- ", failed_var, "\n")
  }
  summary_report <- paste0(summary_report, "\n")
}

# Add file structure information
summary_report <- paste0(
  summary_report,
  "## OUTPUT STRUCTURE\n",
  "Results are organized in the following directories:\n",
  "- 01_predictions_by_variable/: Spatio-temporal prediction maps\n",
  "- 02_uncertainty_by_variable/: Uncertainty maps\n",
  "- 03_residuals_by_variable/: Residual analysis plots\n",
  "- 04_diagnostics_by_variable/: Model diagnostic plots\n",
  "- 05_trends_by_variable/: Temporal trend analyses\n",
  "- 06_comparative_analysis/: Cross-variable comparisons\n",
  "- 07_summary_reports/: This report and data summaries\n",
  "- 08_individual_variables/: Complete results by variable\n\n",
  
  "## VALIDATION METRICS\n",
  "Detailed validation metrics are available in: ALL_VARIABLES_validation_metrics_summary.csv\n\n",
  
  "## TECHNICAL NOTES\n",
  "- All visualizations saved in both PNG (300 DPI) and PDF formats\n",
  "- Spatial data preserved in GeoPackage format\n",
  "- Model objects saved for reproducibility\n",
  "- Analysis reproducible with saved R workspace\n\n",
  
  "Analysis completed successfully!\n"
)

# Write summary report
writeLines(summary_report, file.path(output_dir, "07_summary_reports", "COMPREHENSIVE_ANALYSIS_REPORT.txt"))

# Save processing summary as CSV
write_csv(processing_summary, file.path(output_dir, "07_summary_reports", "processing_summary.csv"))

# Save validation metrics copy
if (file.exists(metrics_path)) {
  file.copy(metrics_path, file.path(output_dir, "07_summary_reports", "validation_metrics_summary.csv"))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: SAVE FINAL ANALYSIS RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("💾 Saving final analysis results...\n")

# Save all analysis results
save(
  all_analysis_results,
  processing_summary,
  successful_analyses,
  output_dir,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "07_summary_reports", "comprehensive_analysis_results.RData")
)

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
cat("🎉 COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
cat("\n📊 FINAL STATISTICS:\n")
cat("  • Variables successfully analyzed:", total_successful, "out of", nrow(processing_summary), "\n")
cat("  • Total observations processed:", format(total_observations, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  • Average model performance (R²):", round(mean_r_squared, 3), "\n")
cat("  • Total processing time:", round(sum(processing_summary$Processing_Time_Sec, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "seconds\n")
cat("  • Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")

cat("\n📁 OUTPUT STRUCTURE:\n")
output_files <- list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\.(png|pdf|csv|txt|RData)$")
cat("  • Total files generated:", length(output_files), "\n")

# Count files by type
file_counts <- table(tools::file_ext(output_files))
for (ext in names(file_counts)) {
  cat("  •", toupper(ext), "files:", file_counts[[ext]], "\n")
}

cat("\n✅ All visualizations, reports, and data files have been saved successfully!\n")
cat("📖 See 'COMPREHENSIVE_ANALYSIS_REPORT.txt' for detailed results summary.\n")
cat("\n")

# Display top performing variables
if (total_successful > 0) {
  cat("🏆 TOP PERFORMING VARIABLES (by R²):\n")
  top_vars <- processing_summary %>%
    filter(Status == "Success", !is.na(R_Squared)) %>%
    arrange(desc(R_Squared)) %>%
    head(5) %>%
    mutate(Variable_Label = sapply(Variable, get_variable_label))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_vars)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", top_vars$Variable_Label[i], " (R² = ", round(top_vars$R_Squared[i], 3), ")\n", sep="")
  }
}

cat("\n🔍 Analysis complete! Check the output directories for detailed results.\n")
```

## V.1. INDIVIDUAL YEARLY MAPS WITH OBSERVED/PREDICTED DISTINCTION

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# INDIVIDUAL YEARLY MAPS WITH OBSERVED/PREDICTED DISTINCTION
# Creates separate maps for each year and variable
# Uses observed data when available, predicted otherwise
# Distinguishes visually between observed and predicted values
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA (assuming previous script was run)
# ============================================================================
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")

parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)

# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

get_smart_colors <- function(variable, values = NULL) {
  variable_lower <- tolower(variable)
  
  if (grepl("ph", variable_lower)) {
    return(c("#d73027", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#a6d96a", "#66bd63", "#1a9850"))
  } else if (grepl("clay|silt|sand|percent", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrBr"))
  } else if (grepl("carbon|nitrogen|organic|matter", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))
  } else if (grepl("calcium|magnesium|potassium|sodium|exchangeable", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
  } else if (grepl("phosphorus|p2o5", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Purples"))
  } else if (grepl("conductivity|electrical", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))
  } else if (grepl("ratio|cn|mg_ca|mg_k", variable_lower)) {
    return(viridis(9, option = "plasma"))
  } else if (grepl("compaction", variable_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greys"))
  } else {
    return(viridis(9, option = "viridis"))
  }
}

get_variable_label <- function(var_name) {
  labels <- list(
    "pH" = "Soil pH",
    "CN_Ratio" = "C:N Ratio",
    "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" = "Electrical Conductivity (mmho/cm)",
    "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Calcium (meq/100g)",
    "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Magnesium (meq/100g)",
    "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Sodium (meq/100g)",
    "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g" = "Exchangeable Potassium (meq/100g)",
    "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" = "Available P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
    "Clay_percent" = "Clay Percentage (%)",
    "Fine_Silt_percent" = "Fine Silt (%)",
    "Coarse_Silt_percent" = "Coarse Silt (%)",
    "Fine_Sand_percent" = "Fine Sand (%)",
    "Coarse_Sand_percent" = "Coarse Sand (%)",
    "Organic_Carbon_per_mille" = "Organic Carbon (‰)",
    "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille" = "Total Nitrogen (‰)",
    "Total_Silt_percent" = "Total Silt (%)",
    "Total_Sand_percent" = "Total Sand (%)",
    "Organic_Matter_percent" = "Organic Matter (%)",
    "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g" = "Sum of Exchangeable Bases (meq/100g)",
    "CaO_g_100g" = "CaO (g/100g)",
    "Mg_Ca_Ratio" = "Mg:Ca Ratio",
    "Mg_K_Ratio" = "Mg:K Ratio",
    "Compaction_Index" = "Compaction Index"
  )
  return(labels[[var_name]] %||% var_name)
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN FUNCTION: CREATE YEARLY MAPS WITH OBS/PRED DISTINCTION
# ============================================================================

create_yearly_maps_with_distinction <- function(var_name, data, output_dir) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  cat("Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  original_col <- var_name
  type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check if columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% names(data)) {
    cat("❌ No predictions found for", var_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Prepare data: use observed when available, predicted otherwise
  data_prepared <- data %>%
    mutate(
      # Create the display value column
      display_value = case_when(
        !is.na(.data[[original_col]]) ~ .data[[original_col]],  # Use observed
        !is.na(.data[[pred_col]]) ~ .data[[pred_col]],          # Use predicted
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      # Create data type indicator
      data_type = case_when(
        !is.na(.data[[original_col]]) ~ "Observed",
        !is.na(.data[[pred_col]]) ~ "Predicted",
        TRUE ~ "Missing"
      ),
      Year = as.factor(Year)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(display_value), data_type != "Missing")
  
  if (nrow(data_prepared) == 0) {
    cat("❌ No valid data for", var_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get years
  unique_years <- sort(unique(data_prepared$Year))
  n_years <- length(unique_years)
  
  cat("Years found:", paste(unique_years, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Total observations:", nrow(data_prepared), "\n")
  
  # Count observed vs predicted
  type_counts <- data_prepared %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    count(data_type)
  cat("Data composition:\n")
  print(type_counts)
  
  # Get color palette and label
  pred_colors <- get_smart_colors(var_name)
  var_label <- get_variable_label(var_name)
  
  # Calculate global value range across all years (for consistent legend)
  val_range <- range(data_prepared$display_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("Value range:", round(val_range[1], 3), "to", round(val_range[2], 3), "\n")
  
  # Create output directory for this variable
  var_output_dir <- file.path(output_dir, var_name)
  if (!dir.exists(var_output_dir)) {
    dir.create(var_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Create individual map for each year
  plots_list <- list()
  
  for (year in unique_years) {
    cat("  Creating map for year", year, "...\n")
    
    # Filter data for this year
    data_year <- data_prepared %>%
      filter(Year == year)
    
    # Count data types for this year
    year_counts <- data_year %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      count(data_type)
    
    n_observed <- year_counts$n[year_counts$data_type == "Observed"]
    n_predicted <- year_counts$n[year_counts$data_type == "Predicted"]
    
    if (length(n_observed) == 0) n_observed <- 0
    if (length(n_predicted) == 0) n_predicted <- 0
    
    # Create the map
    p <- ggplot() +
      # Plot predicted values (if any) with regular border
      geom_sf(
        data = data_year %>% filter(data_type == "Predicted"),
        aes(fill = display_value),
        color = "white",
        size = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.9
      ) +
      # Plot observed values (if any) with thicker black border
      geom_sf(
        data = data_year %>% filter(data_type == "Observed"),
        aes(fill = display_value),
        color = "black",
        size = 0.5,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = pred_colors,
        name = var_label,
        limits = val_range,
        labels = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2),
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barwidth = 1.5,
          barheight = 15,
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5
        )
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(b = 5)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, 
                                    margin = margin(b = 10), color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   margin = margin(t = 10), color = "grey40"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(var_label, "- Year", year),
        subtitle = sprintf(
          "Range: %.2f - %.2f | Total parcels: %d",
          min(data_year$display_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(data_year$display_value, na.rm = TRUE),
          nrow(data_year)
        ),
        caption = paste0(
          "■ Observed data: ", n_observed, " parcels (thick black borders)\n",
          "■ Predicted data: ", n_predicted, " parcels (white borders)"
        )
      )
    
    plots_list[[as.character(year)]] <- p
    
    # Save individual map
    filename <- sprintf("%s_year_%s.png", var_name, year)
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(var_output_dir, filename),
      plot = p,
      width = 12,
      height = 10,
      dpi = 300,
      units = "in",
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    # Also save as PDF
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(var_output_dir, gsub(".png", ".pdf", filename)),
      plot = p,
      width = 12,
      height = 10,
      units = "in",
      bg = "white"
    )
    
    cat("    ✓ Saved:", filename, "\n")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Completed", var_name, "-", n_years, "maps created\n")
  
  return(plots_list)
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================================

output_main <- "yearly_maps_observed_predicted"
if (!dir.exists(output_main)) {
  dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("  YEARLY MAPS GENERATION               \n")
cat("  WITH OBS/PRED DISTINCTION            \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# IDENTIFY SUCCESSFUL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

# Find all predicted columns
predicted_cols <- grep("_predicted$", names(parcelles_enhanced), value = TRUE)
successful_variables <- gsub("_predicted$", "", predicted_cols)

cat("Found", length(successful_variables), "variables to process:\n")
for (var in successful_variables) {
  cat("  •", var, "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

cat("\n")
cat("Starting processing...\n")
cat("Output directory:", output_main, "\n\n")

all_plots <- list()
processing_log <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(0),
  Status = character(0),
  N_Years = numeric(0),
  N_Observed = numeric(0),
  N_Predicted = numeric(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(successful_variables)) {
  var_name <- successful_variables[i]
  
  cat("[", i, "/", length(successful_variables), "] ", sep="")
  
  tryCatch({
    plots <- create_yearly_maps_with_distinction(
      var_name = var_name,
      data = parcelles_enhanced,
      output_dir = output_main
    )
    
    if (!is.null(plots)) {
      all_plots[[var_name]] <- plots
      
      # Calculate statistics
      pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
      original_col <- var_name
      
      stats <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[pred_col]]) | !is.na(.data[[original_col]])) %>%
        summarise(
          n_years = n_distinct(Year),
          n_observed = sum(!is.na(.data[[original_col]])),
          n_predicted = sum(is.na(.data[[original_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[pred_col]]))
        )
      
      log_entry <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Status = "Success",
        N_Years = stats$n_years,
        N_Observed = stats$n_observed,
        N_Predicted = stats$n_predicted,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      processing_log <- rbind(processing_log, log_entry)
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
    
    log_entry <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      N_Years = NA,
      N_Observed = NA,
      N_Predicted = NA,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    processing_log <<- rbind(processing_log, log_entry)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# SAVE PROCESSING LOG
# ============================================================================

write.csv(
  processing_log,
  file.path(output_main, "processing_log.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## V.2. VALIDATION DIAGNOSTICS FOR MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# VALIDATION DIAGNOSTICS FOR MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION
# Creates proper validation diagnostics using the holdout validation set
# Produces both individual and combined diagnostic plots
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  VALIDATION DIAGNOSTICS ANALYSIS      \n")
cat("  FOR MULTI-VARIABLE IMPUTATION        \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD DATA AND RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING DATA AND RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Load the enhanced dataset and model results
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")
models_path <- paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_model_objects.RData")

# Check files exist
if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced dataset not found. Please run the multi-variable imputation script first.")
}

if (!file.exists(models_path)) {
  stop("❌ Model objects not found. Please run the multi-variable imputation script first.")
}

# Load data
parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
#load(models_path)  # This loads all_results, successful_variables, failed_variables, etc.

cat("✅ Data loaded successfully:\n")
cat("  Enhanced dataset:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n")
cat("  Successful variables:", length(successful_variables), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================================
output_dir <- "validation_diagnostics_results"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

individual_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "individual_variables")
if (!dir.exists(individual_dir)) {
  dir.create(individual_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

combined_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "combined_plots")
if (!dir.exists(combined_dir)) {
  dir.create(combined_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: VALIDATION DIAGNOSTICS FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

create_validation_diagnostics <- function(var_name, enhanced_data, model_results, save_plots = TRUE) {
  
  cat("\n🔬 Creating validation diagnostics for:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Check if variable was successfully processed
  if (!var_name %in% successful_variables || is.null(all_results[[var_name]])) {
    cat("❌ Variable not found in results. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get model results and predictions
  model_result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  predictions_df <- model_result$predictions
  
  # Extract VALIDATION data only (this is the true holdout set)
  validation_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true)) %>%
    mutate(
      observed = Y_true,
      predicted = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted")),
      residuals = observed - predicted,
      predicted_sd = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted_sd")),
      predicted_lower = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted_lower")),
      predicted_upper = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted_upper"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(predicted))
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) < 5) {
    cat("❌ Insufficient validation data (n =", nrow(validation_data), "). Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("  Validation observations:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
  
  # Calculate validation metrics
  correlation <- cor(validation_data$observed, validation_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")
  r_squared <- correlation^2
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(validation_data$residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae <- mean(abs(validation_data$residuals), na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_bias <- mean(validation_data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Coverage probability (for uncertainty intervals)
  in_interval <- sum(validation_data$observed >= validation_data$predicted_lower & 
                    validation_data$observed <= validation_data$predicted_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
  coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
  
  # Create variable label
  var_label <- case_when(
    var_name == "pH" ~ "Soil pH",
    var_name == "CN_Ratio" ~ "C:N Ratio",
    var_name == "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" ~ "Electrical Conductivity (mmho/cm)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Calcium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Magnesium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Sodium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Potassium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" ~ "Available P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
    var_name == "Clay_percent" ~ "Clay Percentage (%)",
    var_name == "Fine_Silt_percent" ~ "Fine Silt (%)",
    var_name == "Coarse_Silt_percent" ~ "Coarse Silt (%)",
    var_name == "Fine_Sand_percent" ~ "Fine Sand (%)",
    var_name == "Coarse_Sand_percent" ~ "Coarse Sand (%)",
    var_name == "Organic_Carbon_per_mille" ~ "Organic Carbon (‰)",
    var_name == "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille" ~ "Total Nitrogen (‰)",
    var_name == "Total_Silt_percent" ~ "Total Silt (%)",
    var_name == "Total_Sand_percent" ~ "Total Sand (%)",
    var_name == "Organic_Matter_percent" ~ "Organic Matter (%)",
    var_name == "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g" ~ "Sum of Exchangeable Bases (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "CaO_g_100g" ~ "CaO (g/100g)",
    var_name == "Mg_Ca_Ratio" ~ "Mg:Ca Ratio",
    var_name == "Mg_K_Ratio" ~ "Mg:K Ratio",
    var_name == "Compaction_Index" ~ "Compaction Index",
    TRUE ~ var_name
  )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # PLOT 1: OBSERVED vs PREDICTED (VALIDATION)
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_obs_pred <- ggplot(validation_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Validation: Observed vs Predicted -", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(validation_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(rmse, 3), " | ",
        "Correlation = ", round(correlation, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = paste("Observed", var_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Add R² annotation
  p_obs_pred <- p_obs_pred +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
      label = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3)),
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "darkred"
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # PLOT 2: RESIDUALS vs PREDICTED (VALIDATION)
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_residuals <- ggplot(validation_data, aes(x = predicted, y = residuals)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "orange") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkred", fill = "pink", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Validation: Residuals vs Predicted -", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(validation_data), " | ",
        "Mean Bias = ", round(mean_bias, 3), " | ",
        "MAE = ", round(mae, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(rmse, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = "Residuals (Observed - Predicted)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # PLOT 3: RESIDUALS HISTOGRAM (VALIDATION)
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_residuals_hist <- ggplot(validation_data, aes(x = residuals)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = min(30, max(10, nrow(validation_data)/5)), 
                   fill = "lightcoral", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_bias, color = "blue", linetype = "solid", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Validation: Residuals Distribution -", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Mean = ", round(mean_bias, 3), " | ",
        "SD = ", round(sd(validation_data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE), 3), " | ",
        "Skewness ≈ ", round(moments::skewness(validation_data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
      ),
      x = "Residuals (Observed - Predicted)",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Add normal overlay if enough data
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 20) {
    p_residuals_hist <- p_residuals_hist +
      stat_function(
        fun = function(x) dnorm(x, mean = mean_bias, sd = sd(validation_data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE)) * 
              nrow(validation_data) * diff(range(validation_data$residuals)) / 30,
        color = "blue", size = 1, alpha = 0.7
      )
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # PLOT 4: PREDICTION INTERVALS (VALIDATION)
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_intervals <- validation_data %>%
    arrange(predicted) %>%
    mutate(obs_id = row_number()) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = obs_id)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = predicted_lower, ymax = predicted_upper), 
                alpha = 0.3, fill = "lightblue") +
    geom_line(aes(y = predicted), color = "blue", size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = observed), color = "red", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Validation: Prediction Intervals -", var_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Coverage Probability = ", round(coverage_prob * 100, 1), "% | ",
        "Target: 95% | ",
        "Points in interval: ", in_interval, "/", nrow(validation_data)
      ),
      x = "Observation (ordered by predicted value)",
      y = var_label,
      caption = "Blue ribbon: 95% prediction interval | Red points: observed values | Blue line: predicted"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # SAVE INDIVIDUAL PLOTS
  # ============================================================================
  
  if (save_plots) {
    # Save individual plots
    ggsave(file.path(individual_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_obs_vs_pred.png")), 
           p_obs_pred, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file.path(individual_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_residuals_vs_pred.png")), 
           p_residuals, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file.path(individual_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_residuals_hist.png")), 
           p_residuals_hist, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggsave(file.path(individual_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_intervals.png")), 
           p_intervals, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    cat("    ✓ Individual plots saved\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # CREATE COMBINED PLOT
  # ============================================================================
  
  combined_plot <- ggarrange(
    p_obs_pred, p_residuals, p_residuals_hist, p_intervals,
    ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
    labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    font.label = list(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
  
  # Add overall title
  combined_plot <- annotate_figure(
    combined_plot,
    top = text_grob(
      paste("Validation Diagnostics:", var_label),
      face = "bold", size = 18
    ),
    bottom = text_grob(
      paste0("Model Performance: R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), " | RMSE = ", round(rmse, 3), 
             " | Coverage = ", round(coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%"),
      hjust = 0.5, size = 12, color = "grey40"
    )
  )
  
  if (save_plots) {
    ggsave(file.path(combined_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_diagnostics_combined.png")), 
           combined_plot, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Also save as PDF
    ggsave(file.path(combined_dir, paste0(var_name, "_validation_diagnostics_combined.pdf")), 
           combined_plot, width = 16, height = 12, bg = "white")
    
    cat("    ✓ Combined plot saved\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # RETURN RESULTS
  # ============================================================================
  
  results <- list(
    variable_name = var_name,
    variable_label = var_label,
    validation_data = validation_data,
    metrics = list(
      n_validation = nrow(validation_data),
      correlation = correlation,
      r_squared = r_squared,
      rmse = rmse,
      mae = mae,
      mean_bias = mean_bias,
      coverage_probability = coverage_prob
    ),
    plots = list(
      obs_pred = p_obs_pred,
      residuals = p_residuals,
      residuals_hist = p_residuals_hist,
      intervals = p_intervals,
      combined = combined_plot
    )
  )
  
  cat("    ✅ Diagnostics completed\n")
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING VALIDATION DIAGNOSTICS FOR ALL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 55), "\n", sep="")

# Variables to exclude from combined plots
excluded_variables <- c(
  "Total_Silt_percent", 
  "Total_Sand_percent", 
  "Organic_Matter_percent", 
  "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g", 
  "CaO_g_100g"
)

# Filter successful variables to exclude specified ones
filtered_variables <- successful_variables[!successful_variables %in% excluded_variables]

cat("Variables excluded from combined plots:", paste(excluded_variables, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Variables to process:", length(filtered_variables), "out of", length(successful_variables), "total\n")

# Initialize storage
all_validation_results <- list()
validation_summary <- data.frame()

# Process each filtered variable
total_vars <- length(filtered_variables)
cat("Processing", total_vars, "variables:\n")

for (i in seq_along(successful_variables)) {
  var_name <- successful_variables[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", total_vars, "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    result <- create_validation_diagnostics(
      var_name = var_name,
      enhanced_data = parcelles_enhanced,
      model_results = all_results,
      save_plots = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      all_validation_results[[var_name]] <- result
      
      # Add to summary
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Variable_Label = result$variable_label,
        N_Validation = result$metrics$n_validation,
        R_Squared = result$metrics$r_squared,
        Correlation = result$metrics$correlation,
        RMSE = result$metrics$rmse,
        MAE = result$metrics$mae,
        Mean_Bias = result$metrics$mean_bias,
        Coverage_Probability = result$metrics$coverage_probability,
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      validation_summary <- rbind(validation_summary, summary_row)
      
    } else {
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Variable_Label = var_name,
        N_Validation = 0,
        R_Squared = NA,
        Correlation = NA,
        RMSE = NA,
        MAE = NA,
        Mean_Bias = NA,
        Coverage_Probability = NA,
        Status = "Failed - Insufficient Data",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      validation_summary <- rbind(validation_summary, summary_row)
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("    ❌ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
    
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Variable_Label = var_name,
      N_Validation = 0,
      R_Squared = NA,
      Correlation = NA,
      RMSE = NA,
      MAE = NA,
      Mean_Bias = NA,
      Coverage_Probability = NA,
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    validation_summary <- rbind(validation_summary, summary_row)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE OVERALL VALIDATION SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING VALIDATION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

successful_validations <- validation_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")

if (nrow(successful_validations) > 0) {
  
  # Summary statistics
  mean_r2 <- mean(successful_validations$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_rmse <- mean(successful_validations$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_coverage <- mean(successful_validations$Coverage_Probability, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Performance summary plot
  p_performance_summary <- successful_validations %>%
    arrange(desc(R_Squared)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, R_Squared), y = R_Squared)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(R_Squared, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(successful_validations$R_Squared) * 1.1)) +
    labs(
      title = "Validation Performance Summary (R²)",
      subtitle = paste0("Mean R² = ", round(mean_r2, 3), " | ",
                       "Variables: ", nrow(successful_validations), " | ",
                       "Mean Coverage: ", round(mean_coverage * 100, 1), "%"),
      x = "Variable",
      y = "R² (Validation Set)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Coverage probability plot
  p_coverage_summary <- successful_validations %>%
    mutate(Coverage_Percent = Coverage_Probability * 100) %>%
    arrange(desc(Coverage_Percent)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Coverage_Percent), y = Coverage_Percent)) +
    geom_col(fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 95, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Coverage_Percent, 1), "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = "Prediction Interval Coverage",
      subtitle = "Target: 95% coverage (red line)",
      x = "Variable",
      y = "Coverage Probability (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Save summary plots
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "validation_performance_summary.png"), 
         p_performance_summary, width = 12, height = max(8, nrow(successful_validations) * 0.4), dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "validation_coverage_summary.png"), 
         p_coverage_summary, width = 12, height = max(8, nrow(successful_validations) * 0.4), dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("✅ Summary plots saved\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: SAVE RESULTS AND CREATE REPORT
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING RESULTS AND CREATING REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

# Save validation summary
write_csv(validation_summary, file.path(output_dir, "validation_diagnostics_summary.csv"))

# Save all results
save(all_validation_results, validation_summary, file = file.path(output_dir, "validation_diagnostics_results.RData"))
```

## V.3. SIDE-BY-SIDE TRAIN vs TEST DIAGNOSTICS COMPARISON

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SIDE-BY-SIDE TRAIN vs TEST DIAGNOSTICS COMPARISON
# Creates observed vs fitted plots for both training and test sets
# Shows comparison for each variable (excluding specified ones)
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  TRAIN vs TEST DIAGNOSTICS COMPARISON \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD DATA AND RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING DATA AND RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Load the enhanced dataset and model results
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_path <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")
models_path <- paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_model_objects.RData")

# Check files exist
if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced dataset not found. Please run the multi-variable imputation script first.")
}

if (!file.exists(models_path)) {
  stop("❌ Model objects not found. Please run the multi-variable imputation script first.")
}

# Load data
parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
##load(models_path)  # This loads all_results, successful_variables, failed_variables, etc.

cat("✅ Data loaded successfully:\n")
cat("  Enhanced dataset:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n")
cat("  Successful variables:", length(successful_variables), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================================
output_dir <- "train_test_comparison_results"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: DEFINE VARIABLES TO PROCESS (EXCLUDING SPECIFIED ONES)
# ============================================================================

# Variables to exclude
excluded_variables <- c(
  "Total_Silt_percent", 
  "Total_Sand_percent", 
  "Organic_Matter_percent", 
  "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g", 
  "CaO_g_100g"
)

# Filter successful variables to exclude specified ones
variables_to_process <- successful_variables[!successful_variables %in% excluded_variables]

cat("Variables excluded:", paste(excluded_variables, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Variables to process:", length(variables_to_process), "out of", length(successful_variables), "total\n")
cat("Processing list:", paste(variables_to_process, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: FUNCTION TO CREATE TRAIN vs TEST COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

create_train_test_comparison <- function(var_name, model_results) {
  
  cat("\n🔬 Creating train vs test comparison for:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Check if variable was successfully processed
  if (!var_name %in% successful_variables || is.null(all_results[[var_name]])) {
    cat("❌ Variable not found in results. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get model results and predictions
  model_result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  predictions_df <- model_result$predictions
  
  # Create variable label
  var_label <- case_when(
    var_name == "pH" ~ "Soil pH",
    var_name == "CN_Ratio" ~ "C:N Ratio",
    var_name == "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" ~ "Electrical Conductivity (mmho/cm)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Calcium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Magnesium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Sodium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Potassium (meq/100g)",
    var_name == "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" ~ "Available P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
    var_name == "Clay_percent" ~ "Clay Percentage (%)",
    var_name == "Fine_Silt_percent" ~ "Fine Silt (%)",
    var_name == "Coarse_Silt_percent" ~ "Coarse Silt (%)",
    var_name == "Fine_Sand_percent" ~ "Fine Sand (%)",
    var_name == "Coarse_Sand_percent" ~ "Coarse Sand (%)",
    var_name == "Organic_Carbon_per_mille" ~ "Organic Carbon (‰)",
    var_name == "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille" ~ "Total Nitrogen (‰)",
    var_name == "Mg_Ca_Ratio" ~ "Mg:Ca Ratio",
    var_name == "Mg_K_Ratio" ~ "Mg:K Ratio",
    var_name == "Compaction_Index" ~ "Compaction Index",
    TRUE ~ var_name
  )
  
  # Extract TRAINING data (data_split == "train")
  train_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(data_split == "train", !is.na(Y_true)) %>%
    mutate(
      observed = Y_true,
      predicted = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted")),
      residuals = observed - predicted
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(predicted))
  
  # Extract TEST/VALIDATION data (data_split == "validation")
  test_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true)) %>%
    mutate(
      observed = Y_true,
      predicted = get(paste0(var_name, "_predicted")),
      residuals = observed - predicted
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(predicted))
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
    cat("❌ Insufficient training data (n =", nrow(train_data), "). Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(test_data) < 5) {
    cat("❌ Insufficient test data (n =", nrow(test_data), "). Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("  Training observations:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
  cat("  Test observations:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
  
  # Calculate metrics for both datasets
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$observed, train_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean(train_data$residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  train_correlation <- cor(train_data$observed, train_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")
  
  test_r2 <- cor(test_data$observed, test_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")^2
  test_rmse <- sqrt(mean(test_data$residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  test_correlation <- cor(test_data$observed, test_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Determine common axis limits for both plots
  all_observed <- c(train_data$observed, test_data$observed)
  all_predicted <- c(train_data$predicted, test_data$predicted)
  
  x_limits <- range(all_predicted, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits <- range(all_observed, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Extend limits slightly for better visualization
  x_range <- diff(x_limits)
  y_range <- diff(y_limits)
  x_limits <- c(x_limits[1] - 0.05 * x_range, x_limits[2] + 0.05 * x_range)
  y_limits <- c(y_limits[1] - 0.05 * y_range, y_limits[2] + 0.05 * y_range)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # TRAINING PLOT
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_train <- ggplot(train_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Training Set",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(train_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(train_r2, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(train_rmse, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(train_correlation, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = paste("Observed", var_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    ) +
    # Add R² annotation in corner
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
      label = paste0("R² = ", round(train_r2, 3)),
      size = 4,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "darkblue"
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # TEST PLOT
  # ============================================================================
  
  p_test <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Test Set (Validation)",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(test_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(test_r2, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(test_rmse, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(test_correlation, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = paste("Observed", var_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    ) +
    # Add R² annotation in corner
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
      label = paste0("R² = ", round(test_r2, 3)),
      size = 4,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "darkorange"
    )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # COMBINE PLOTS SIDE BY SIDE
  # ============================================================================
  
  combined_plot <- ggarrange(
    p_train, p_test,
    ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
    labels = c("TRAINING", "VALIDATION"),
    font.label = list(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    align = "hv"
  )
  
  # Add overall title and subtitle
  combined_plot <- annotate_figure(
    combined_plot,
    top = text_grob(
      paste("Train vs Test Comparison:", var_label),
      face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"
    ),
    bottom = text_grob(
      paste0("Performance Drop: ΔR² = ", round(train_r2 - test_r2, 3), 
             " | ΔRMSE = ", round(test_rmse - train_rmse, 3),
             " | Train-Test R² Ratio: ", round(test_r2/train_r2, 2)),
      hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "grey40"
    )
  )
  
  # ============================================================================
  # SAVE PLOT
  # ============================================================================
  
  filename <- paste0(var_name, "_train_vs_test_comparison.png")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename), combined_plot, 
         width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Also save as PDF
  filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_train_vs_test_comparison.pdf")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename_pdf), combined_plot, 
         width = 14, height = 7, bg = "white")
  
  cat("    ✓ Comparison plot saved:", filename, "\n")
  
  # ============================================================================
  # RETURN RESULTS
  # ============================================================================
  
  results <- list(
    variable_name = var_name,
    variable_label = var_label,
    train_metrics = list(
      n = nrow(train_data),
      r_squared = train_r2,
      rmse = train_rmse,
      correlation = train_correlation
    ),
    test_metrics = list(
      n = nrow(test_data),
      r_squared = test_r2,
      rmse = test_rmse,
      correlation = test_correlation
    ),
    performance_drop = list(
      delta_r2 = train_r2 - test_r2,
      delta_rmse = test_rmse - train_rmse,
      r2_ratio = test_r2 / train_r2
    ),
    plots = list(
      train = p_train,
      test = p_test,
      combined = combined_plot
    )
  )
  
  return(results)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING TRAIN vs TEST COMPARISONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

# Initialize storage
all_comparison_results <- list()
comparison_summary <- data.frame()

# Process each variable
total_vars <- length(variables_to_process)
cat("Processing", total_vars, "variables:\n")

for (i in seq_along(variables_to_process)) {
  var_name <- variables_to_process[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", total_vars, "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    result <- create_train_test_comparison(
      var_name = var_name,
      model_results = all_results
    )
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      all_comparison_results[[var_name]] <- result
      
      # Add to summary
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Variable_Label = result$variable_label,
        Train_N = result$train_metrics$n,
        Train_R2 = result$train_metrics$r_squared,
        Train_RMSE = result$train_metrics$rmse,
        Test_N = result$test_metrics$n,
        Test_R2 = result$test_metrics$r_squared,
        Test_RMSE = result$test_metrics$rmse,
        Delta_R2 = result$performance_drop$delta_r2,
        Delta_RMSE = result$performance_drop$delta_rmse,
        R2_Ratio = result$performance_drop$r2_ratio,
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      comparison_summary <- rbind(comparison_summary, summary_row)
      
    } else {
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Variable_Label = var_name,
        Train_N = 0,
        Train_R2 = NA,
        Train_RMSE = NA,
        Test_N = 0,
        Test_R2 = NA,
        Test_RMSE = NA,
        Delta_R2 = NA,
        Delta_RMSE = NA,
        R2_Ratio = NA,
        Status = "Failed - Insufficient Data",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      comparison_summary <- rbind(comparison_summary, summary_row)
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("    ❌ ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
    
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Variable_Label = var_name,
      Train_N = 0,
      Train_R2 = NA,
      Train_RMSE = NA,
      Test_N = 0,
      Test_R2 = NA,
      Test_RMSE = NA,
      Delta_R2 = NA,
      Delta_RMSE = NA,
      R2_Ratio = NA,
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    comparison_summary <- rbind(comparison_summary, summary_row)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: CREATE OVERALL COMPARISON SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING OVERALL COMPARISON SUMMARY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

successful_comparisons <- comparison_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")

if (nrow(successful_comparisons) > 0) {
  
  # Summary statistics
  mean_train_r2 <- mean(successful_comparisons$Train_R2, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_test_r2 <- mean(successful_comparisons$Test_R2, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_delta_r2 <- mean(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_r2_ratio <- mean(successful_comparisons$R2_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Performance drop analysis plot
  p_performance_drop <- successful_comparisons %>%
    arrange(desc(Delta_R2)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Delta_R2))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = Delta_R2), fill = "coral", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(aes(y = Delta_R2, label = round(Delta_R2, 3)), 
              hjust = ifelse(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2 >= 0, -0.1, 1.1), 
              size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Performance Drop: Training vs Test R²",
      subtitle = paste0("Mean ΔR² = ", round(mean_delta_r2, 3), " | Positive = Overfitting"),
      x = "Variable",
      y = "ΔR² (Training R² - Test R²)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Train vs Test R² scatter plot
  p_r2_scatter <- successful_comparisons %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Train_R2, y = Test_R2)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Variable), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = "Training vs Test R² Comparison",
      subtitle = "Points below diagonal indicate overfitting",
      x = "Training R²",
      y = "Test R²",
      caption = "Dashed line: perfect agreement (Test R² = Training R²)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Save summary plots
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "performance_drop_summary.png"), 
         p_performance_drop, width = 12, height = max(8, nrow(successful_comparisons) * 0.4), 
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "train_vs_test_r2_scatter.png"), 
         p_r2_scatter, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("✅ Summary plots saved\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: SAVE RESULTS AND CREATE REPORT
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING RESULTS AND CREATING REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

# Save comparison summary
write_csv(comparison_summary, file.path(output_dir, "train_test_comparison_summary.csv"))

# Save all results
save(all_comparison_results, comparison_summary, 
     variables_to_process, excluded_variables,
     file = file.path(output_dir, "train_test_comparison_results.RData"))

# Create comprehensive report
report_content <- paste0(
  "# TRAIN vs TEST COMPARISON REPORT\n",
  "Generated: ", Sys.time(), "\n\n",
  
  "## OVERVIEW\n",
  "This report compares model performance between training and test (validation) sets.\n",
  "Training set: Data used to fit the model (90% of available data)\n",
  "Test set: Holdout data not used for training (10% of available data)\n\n",
  
  "## PROCESSING SUMMARY\n",
  "- Total variables available: ", length(successful_variables), "\n",
  "- Variables excluded: ", length(excluded_variables), " (", paste(excluded_variables, collapse = ", "), ")\n",
  "- Variables processed: ", nrow(comparison_summary), "\n",
  "- Successfully compared: ", sum(comparison_summary$Status == "Success"), "\n",
  "- Failed comparisons: ", sum(comparison_summary$Status != "Success"), "\n\n"
)

if (nrow(successful_comparisons) > 0) {
  report_content <- paste0(
    report_content,
    "## OVERALL PERFORMANCE METRICS\n",
    "- Mean Training R²: ", round(mean_train_r2, 3), "\n",
    "- Mean Test R²: ", round(mean_test_r2, 3), "\n",
    "- Mean Performance Drop (ΔR²): ", round(mean_delta_r2, 3), "\n",
    "- Mean R² Ratio (Test/Train): ", round(mean_r2_ratio, 3), "\n\n",
    
    "## INTERPRETATION\n",
    "- ΔR² > 0: Indicates overfitting (training performs better than test)\n",
    "- ΔR² ≈ 0: Good generalization (similar performance on both sets)\n",
    "- ΔR² < 0: Unusual (test performing better than training)\n",
    "- R² Ratio close to 1.0: Good generalization\n",
    "- R² Ratio << 1.0: Strong overfitting\n\n",
    
    "## VARIABLES BY PERFORMANCE DROP\n"
  )
  
  # Sort by performance drop (largest overfitting first)
  sorted_vars <- successful_comparisons %>%
    arrange(desc(Delta_R2))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(sorted_vars)) {
    var_row <- sorted_vars[i, ]
    report_content <- paste0(
      report_content,
      i, ". ", var_row$Variable_Label, " (", var_row$Variable, ")\n",
      "   Train R² = ", round(var_row$Train_R2, 3),
      " | Test R² = ", round(var_row$Test_R2, 3),
      " | ΔR² = ", round(var_row$Delta_R2, 3),
      " | Ratio = ", round(var_row$R2_Ratio, 3), "\n"
    )
  }
}

report_content <- paste0(
  report_content, "\n## OUTPUT FILES\n",
  "- Individual comparisons: *_train_vs_test_comparison.png\n",
  "- Summary plots: performance_drop_summary.png, train_vs_test_r2_scatter.png\n",
  "- Summary data: train_test_comparison_summary.csv\n",
  "- All results: train_test_comparison_results.RData\n\n",
  
  "## TECHNICAL NOTES\n",
  "- Training data: Used for model fitting (data_split == 'train')\n",
  "- Test data: Holdout validation set (data_split == 'validation')\n",
  "- Both plots use same axis scales for direct comparison\n",
  "- Red dashed line: perfect prediction (observed = predicted)\n",
  "- Blue/orange lines: fitted trends for each dataset\n"
)

writeLines(report_content, file.path(output_dir, "TRAIN_TEST_COMPARISON_REPORT.txt"))

cat("✅ Report saved\n")

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
cat("🎉 TRAIN vs TEST COMPARISON COMPLETED!\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

cat("\n📊 SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  • Variables processed:", nrow(comparison_summary), "\n")
cat("  • Successful comparisons:", sum(comparison_summary$Status == "Success"), "\n")
cat("  • Variables excluded:", length(excluded_variables), "\n")

if (nrow(successful_comparisons) > 0) {
  cat("  • Average training R²:", round(mean_train_r2, 3), "\n")
  cat("  • Average test R²:", round(mean_test_r2, 3), "\n")
  cat("  • Average performance drop:", round(mean_delta_r2, 3), "\n")
  
  # Identify most and least overfitted variables
  most_overfitted <- successful_comparisons$Variable_Label[which.max(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2)]
  least_overfitted <- successful_comparisons$Variable_Label[which.min(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2)]
  
  cat("  • Most overfitted variable:", most_overfitted, 
      "(ΔR² =", round(max(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2), 3), ")\n")
  cat("  • Best generalizing variable:", least_overfitted, 
      "(ΔR² =", round(min(successful_comparisons$Delta_R2), 3), ")\n")
}

cat("\n📁 Output saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
cat("  • Individual comparisons: *_train_vs_test_comparison.png/.pdf\n")
cat("  • Summary report:", file.path(output_dir, "TRAIN_TEST_COMPARISON_REPORT.txt"), "\n")
cat("  • Summary data:", file.path(output_dir, "train_test_comparison_summary.csv"), "\n")
```

# VI. MULTI-VARIABLE ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH COMPOSITIONAL DATA

## VI.1. Isometric Log-Ratio (ILR)

```{r}
# MULTI-VARIABLE ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION WITH COMPOSITIONAL DATA
# Handles granulometry fractions as compositional data using ILR transformation
# Ensures all 5 fractions sum to exactly 100% after imputation
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(compositions)  # For compositional data analysis

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  MULTI-VARIABLE SPATIO-TEMPORAL       \n")
cat("  IMPUTATION WITH COMPOSITIONAL DATA   \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMPOSITIONAL DATA SETUP
# ============================================================================
# Define granulometry fractions (compositional data)
GRANULO_FRACTIONS <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent", 
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

# Define all other soil variables (non-compositional)
OTHER_SOIL_VARS <- c(
  "pH",
  "CN_Ratio", 
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Total_Silt_percent",
  "Total_Sand_percent",
```
