```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: COMPOSITIONAL DATA TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

# Function to perform ILR transformation
ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  # composition_matrix: n x 5 matrix of the 5 granulometry fractions
  # Returns: n x 4 matrix of ILR coordinates
  
  # Close the composition (ensure it sums to 1)
  comp_closed <- compositions::clo(composition_matrix)
  
  # Apply ILR transformation
  ilr_coords <- compositions::ilr(comp_closed)
  
  return(ilr_coords)
}

# Function to perform inverse ILR transformation
ilr_inverse <- function(ilr_coords) {
  # ilr_coords: n x 4 matrix of ILR coordinates
  # Returns: n x 5 matrix of compositions (summing to 1)
  
  comp <- compositions::ilrInv(ilr_coords)
  
  # Ensure strictly positive values and closure
  comp[comp <= 0] <- 1e-6
  comp <- compositions::clo(comp)
  
  return(comp)
}

# ============================================================================
# MODIFIED IMPUTATION FUNCTION FOR COMPOSITIONAL DATA
# ============================================================================
impute_compositional_granulometry <- function(parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY DATA\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Extract complete granulometry observations
  complete_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(has_complete_granulo) %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number())
  
  n_complete <- nrow(complete_obs)
  n_incomplete <- nrow(parcelles_data) - n_complete
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Compositional data statistics:\n")
    cat("• Complete observations:", n_complete, "\n")
    cat("• Incomplete observations:", n_incomplete, "\n")
  }
  
  if (n_complete < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient complete observations for ILR modeling\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract composition matrix (5 fractions)
  comp_matrix <- complete_obs %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Transform to ILR space (5 fractions -> 4 ILR coordinates)
  ilr_coords <- ilr_transform(comp_matrix)
  colnames(ilr_coords) <- paste0("ILR_", 1:4)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ILR transformation complete: 5 fractions -> 4 ILR coordinates\n")
  }
  
  # Add ILR coordinates to complete observations
  complete_obs_ilr <- complete_obs %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(ilr_coords))
  
  # Create train/validation split
  set.seed(123)
  unique_parcels_with_data <- complete_obs_ilr %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  complete_obs_split <- complete_obs_ilr %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        split == "train" ~ "train",
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "train"
      )
    )
  
  train_obs <- sum(complete_obs_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(complete_obs_split$data_split == "validation")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Data split:\n")
    cat("• Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  # Fit INLA models for each ILR coordinate
  ilr_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    
    if (verbose) cat("\n  Fitting model for", ilr_var, "...\n")
    
    # Prepare INLA dataset
    df_inla <- complete_obs_split %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
      left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
      mutate(
        Y = case_when(
          data_split == "train" ~ .data[[ilr_var]],
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        Y_true = .data[[ilr_var]],
        ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
        ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
        Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
        Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
        Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
        irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
      arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
    
    # Fit model
    fit_result <- tryCatch({
      prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
      
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
          f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
            group = ID.Year, 
            control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
            hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
            constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
        control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (verbose) cat("    ⚠️ Full model failed, trying simpler model...\n")
      tryCatch({
        inla(
          Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_inla,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e2) NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
      predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
      
      df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
        mutate(
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd
        )
      
      # Calculate validation metrics
      validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true))
      
      metrics <- list()
      if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
        pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted")]]
        true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true
        
        ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
        
        metrics$r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
        metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
      }
      
      ilr_results[[ilr_var]] <- list(
        model = fit_result,
        predictions = df_predicted,
        metrics = metrics
      )
      
      if (verbose) {
        cat("    ✅", ilr_var, "complete")
        if (!is.null(metrics$r_squared)) {
          cat(" | R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4))
        }
        cat("\n")
      }
    } else {
      if (verbose) cat("    ❌", ilr_var, "failed\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Combine ILR predictions
  if (verbose) cat("\n🔄 Combining ILR predictions and transforming back to composition...\n")
  
  # Get complete predictions for all ILR coordinates
  all_predictions <- ilr_results[[1]]$predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, data_split, row_id, 
                  ILR_1_predicted, ILR_1_predicted_sd)
  
  for (i in 2:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    pred_cols <- ilr_results[[ilr_var]]$predictions %>%
      dplyr::select(row_id, 
                    !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted"),
                    !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd"))
    
    all_predictions <- all_predictions %>%
      left_join(pred_cols, by = "row_id")
  }
  
  # Extract ILR predictions matrix
  ilr_pred_matrix <- all_predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(ILR_1_predicted, ILR_2_predicted, ILR_3_predicted, ILR_4_predicted) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Transform back to compositional space
  comp_predicted <- ilr_inverse(ilr_pred_matrix)
  
  # Convert back to percentages
  comp_predicted_pct <- comp_predicted * 100
  colnames(comp_predicted_pct) <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ Back-transformation complete\n")
    cat("• All fractions sum to 100%:", 
        all(abs(rowSums(comp_predicted_pct) - 100) < 0.01), "\n")
  }
  
  # Create final results with both original and predicted values
  final_results <- all_predictions %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(comp_predicted_pct) %>%
                rename_with(~paste0(., "_predicted"), all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)))
  
  # Add "_complete" columns (original for training, predicted for validation)
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    original_vals <- complete_obs_split[[frac]]
    pred_vals <- final_results[[paste0(frac, "_predicted")]]
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_complete")]] <- ifelse(
      final_results$data_split == "train",
      original_vals,
      pred_vals
    )
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_prediction_type")]] <- final_results$data_split
  }
  
  # Calculate overall validation metrics
  overall_metrics <- list()
  
  validation_subset <- final_results %>% filter(data_split == "validation")
  if (nrow(validation_subset) > 5) {
    # Calculate metrics for each fraction
    frac_metrics <- list()
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      true_vals <- complete_obs_split %>% 
        filter(data_split == "validation") %>% 
        pull(!!frac)
      pred_vals <- validation_subset[[paste0(frac, "_predicted")]]
      
      if (length(true_vals) == length(pred_vals)) {
        ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
        
        frac_metrics[[frac]] <- list(
          r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot),
          rmse = sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)),
          mae = mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
        )
      }
    }
    overall_metrics$fraction_metrics <- frac_metrics
    overall_metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_subset)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 Validation Results (Compositional Space):\n")
      cat("• Validation observations:", overall_metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
        if (!is.null(frac_metrics[[frac]])) {
          cat("• ", frac, ":\n")
          cat("  R²:", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared, 4), "\n")
          cat("  RMSE:", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$rmse, 4), "%\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    predictions = final_results,
    ilr_results = ilr_results,
    metrics = overall_metrics,
    n_complete = n_complete,
    n_incomplete = n_incomplete
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# MODIFIED SINGLE VARIABLE IMPUTATION (FOR NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES)
# ============================================================================
impute_single_variable <- function(variable_name, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING VARIABLE:", variable_name, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Variable statistics:\n")
    cat("• Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
    cat("• Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing (NA):", n_missing, "(", round(n_missing/n_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
    
    if (n_available > 0) {
      cat("• Min value:", round(min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Max value:", round(max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Mean value:", round(mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Std deviation:", round(sd(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  observed_data <- parcelles_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[variable_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  parcelles_data_split <- parcelles_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[variable_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train",
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  train_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "validation")
  pred_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "predict")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Data split:\n")
    cat("• Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict:", pred_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  df_inla <- parcelles_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[variable_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true = .data[[variable_name]],
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
  
  if (max(df_inla$ID.Field) > nrow(W_matrix)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible. Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("🚀 Fitting spatio-temporal model...\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Full model failed. Trying simpler model...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) {
      if (verbose) cat("❌ Simple model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result) || is.null(fit_result$summary.fitted.values)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model fitting failed completely\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ Model successful! Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$dic)) cat("DIC:", round(fit_result$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$waic)) cat("WAIC:", round(fit_result$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
  }
  
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  # FIXED: Complete the mutate statement properly
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y,
        TRUE ~ predictions$mean
      ),
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_prediction_type") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
        data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation", 
        data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
      )
    )
  
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true), !is.na(predictions$mean))
  
  metrics <- list(variable = variable_name)
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- r_squared
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$mean_error <- mean(true_vals - pred_vals)
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true >= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower")]] & 
                      validation_data$Y_true <= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper")]])
    metrics$coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("🎯 Validation Results:\n")
      cat("• Validation obs:", metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      cat("• R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Correlation:", round(metrics$correlation, 4), "\n") 
      cat("• RMSE:", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("• MAE:", round(metrics$mae, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Coverage:", round(metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
    }
  } else {
    metrics$r_squared <- NA
    metrics$correlation <- NA
    metrics$rmse <- NA
    metrics$mae <- NA
    metrics$mean_error <- NA
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    metrics$coverage_prob <- NA
    
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient validation data for metrics\n")
  }
  
  result <- list(
    variable_name = variable_name,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = n_available,
    n_missing = n_missing,
    pct_available = pct_available
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# ============================================================================
```
```{r}
# STEP 2-4: SPATIAL AND TEMPORAL STRUCTURES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")

unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%

year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:length(years_unique)
)

cat("Years:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMPOSITIONAL DATA FUNCTIONS - SIMPLIFIED APPROACH
# ============================================================================

# Additive log-ratio transformation (simpler than ILR)
alr_transform <- function(composition_matrix, ref_index = 5) {
  # Use last component (Coarse_Sand) as reference
  n_comp <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  alr <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(composition_matrix), ncol = n_comp - 1)
  
  for (i in 1:(n_comp - 1)) {
    alr[, i] <- log(composition_matrix[, i] / composition_matrix[, ref_index])
  }
  
  return(alr)
}

# Inverse ALR transformation
alr_inverse <- function(alr_matrix, ref_index = 5) {
  n_obs <- nrow(alr_matrix)
  n_comp <- ncol(alr_matrix) + 1
  
  composition <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_obs, ncol = n_comp)
  
  # Reconstruct all components
  for (i in 1:(n_comp - 1)) {
    composition[, i] <- exp(alr_matrix[, i])
  }
  composition[, n_comp] <- 1  # Reference component
  
  # Close to sum to 1
  row_sums <- rowSums(composition)
  composition <- composition / row_sums
  
  return(composition)
}

# ============================================================================
# IMPROVED COMPOSITIONAL IMPUTATION
# ============================================================================
impute_compositional_granulometry <- function(parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Separate sampled and unsampled parcels
  sampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(has_complete_granulo)
  
  unsampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(!has_complete_granulo)
  
  n_sampled <- nrow(sampled_obs)
  n_unsampled <- nrow(unsampled_obs)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Sampled observations:", n_sampled, "\n")
    cat("• Unsampled observations:", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  if (n_sampled < 20) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient sampled observations\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and normalize composition
  comp_matrix <- sampled_obs %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Ensure positive values and normalize
  comp_matrix[comp_matrix <= 0] <- 0.01
  row_sums <- rowSums(comp_matrix)
  comp_matrix <- comp_matrix / row_sums * 100
  
  # Transform to ALR space (4 log-ratios)
  alr_coords <- alr_transform(comp_matrix / 100)  # Work with proportions
  colnames(alr_coords) <- paste0("ALR_", 1:4)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ALR transformation: 5 fractions -> 4 log-ratios\n")
  }
  
  sampled_obs_alr <- sampled_obs %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(alr_coords))
  
  # Train/validation split on SAMPLED data only
  set.seed(123)
  unique_sampled_parcels <- sampled_obs_alr %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.85, 0.15)))
  
  sampled_obs_split <- sampled_obs_alr %>%
    left_join(unique_sampled_parcels, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(data_split = ifelse(split == "train", "train", "validation"))
  
  # Combine sampled and unsampled for full prediction
  all_obs_for_prediction <- bind_rows(
    sampled_obs_split %>% mutate(obs_type = "sampled"),
    unsampled_obs %>% mutate(obs_type = "unsampled", data_split = "predict")
  )
  
  train_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "validation")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict (unsampled):", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  # Fit models for each ALR coordinate
  alr_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    alr_var <- paste0("ALR_", i)
    
    if (verbose) cat("\n  Fitting", alr_var, "...\n")
    
    df_inla <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
      left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
      mutate(
        Y = case_when(
          data_split == "train" ~ .data[[alr_var]],
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        Y_true = .data[[alr_var]],
        ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
        ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
        Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
        Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
        irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
      arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
    
    fit_result <- tryCatch({
      prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
      
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
          f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
            group = ID.Year, 
            control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
            hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
            constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
        control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tryCatch({
        inla(
          Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_inla,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e2) NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
      predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
      
      df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
        mutate(
          !!paste0(alr_var, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
          !!paste0(alr_var, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd
        )
      
      # Validation metrics
      val_data <- df_predicted %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true))
      
      metrics <- list()
      if (nrow(val_data) > 5) {
        pred_vals <- val_data[[paste0(alr_var, "_predicted")]]
        true_vals <- val_data$Y_true
        
        ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
        
        metrics$r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
        metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
      }
      
      alr_results[[alr_var]] <- list(
        model = fit_result,
        predictions = df_predicted,
        metrics = metrics
      )
      
      if (verbose && !is.null(metrics$r_squared)) {
        cat("    ✅ R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      }
    } else {
      if (verbose) cat("    ❌ Failed\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Combine predictions
  if (verbose) cat("\n🔄 Transforming back to composition...\n")
  
  all_predictions <- alr_results[[1]]$predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, data_split, obs_type,
                  ALR_1_predicted, ALR_1_predicted_sd)
  
  for (i in 2:4) {
    alr_var <- paste0("ALR_", i)
    pred_cols <- alr_results[[alr_var]]$predictions %>%
      dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year,
                    !!paste0(alr_var, "_predicted"),
                    !!paste0(alr_var, "_predicted_sd"))
    
    all_predictions <- all_predictions %>%
      left_join(pred_cols, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"))
  }
  
  # Back-transform
  alr_pred_matrix <- all_predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(ALR_1_predicted, ALR_2_predicted, ALR_3_predicted, ALR_4_predicted) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  comp_predicted <- alr_inverse(alr_pred_matrix)
  comp_predicted_pct <- comp_predicted * 100
  colnames(comp_predicted_pct) <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ Back-transformation complete\n")
    sums_check <- rowSums(comp_predicted_pct)
    cat("• Sum range:", round(min(sums_check), 2), "to", round(max(sums_check), 2), "%\n")
  }
  
  # Create final results
  final_results <- all_predictions %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(comp_predicted_pct) %>%
                rename_with(~paste0(., "_predicted"), all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)))
  
  # Add complete columns
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    # Get original values for sampled data
    original_map <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, !!frac) %>%
      rename(original_value = !!frac)
    
    final_results <- final_results %>%
      left_join(original_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"))
    
    pred_col <- paste0(frac, "_predicted")
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_complete")]] <- ifelse(
      final_results$data_split == "train",
      final_results$original_value,
      final_results[[pred_col]]
    )
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_prediction_type")]] <- final_results$data_split
    
    final_results <- final_results %>% dplyr::select(-original_value)
  }
  
  # Calculate validation metrics
  overall_metrics <- list()
  val_subset <- final_results %>% filter(data_split == "validation")
  
  if (nrow(val_subset) > 5) {
    frac_metrics <- list()
    
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      # Get true values from sampled data
      true_map <- sampled_obs_split %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation") %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, !!frac) %>%
        rename(true_val = !!frac)
      
      val_comparison <- val_subset %>%
        left_join(true_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year"))
      
      if (sum(!is.na(val_comparison$true_val)) > 5) {
        true_vals <- val_comparison$true_val
        pred_vals <- val_comparison[[paste0(frac, "_predicted")]]
        
        valid_idx <- !is.na(true_vals) & !is.na(pred_vals)
        true_vals <- true_vals[valid_idx]
        pred_vals <- pred_vals[valid_idx]
        
        if (length(true_vals) > 0) {
          ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
          ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
          
          frac_metrics[[frac]] <- list(
            r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)),
            mae = mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    overall_metrics$fraction_metrics <- frac_metrics
    overall_metrics$n_validation <- nrow(val_subset)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 Validation Results:\n")
      cat("• Validation observations:", nrow(val_subset), "\n")
      for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
        if (!is.null(frac_metrics[[frac]])) {
          cat("• ", frac, ": R²=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared, 4),
              " RMSE=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$rmse, 2), "%\n", sep="")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    predictions = final_results,
    alr_results = alr_results,
    metrics = overall_metrics,
    n_sampled = n_sampled,
    n_unsampled = n_unsampled
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# SINGLE VARIABLE IMPUTATION (NON-COMPOSITIONAL)
# ============================================================================
impute_single_variable <- function(variable_name, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING:", variable_name, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Available:", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing:", n_missing, "\n")
  }
  
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  observed_data <- parcelles_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[variable_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  parcelles_data_split <- parcelles_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[variable_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train",
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  df_inla <- parcelles_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[variable_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true = .data[[variable_name]],
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
  
  if (verbose) cat("🚀 Fitting model...\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) NULL)
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model failed\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("✅ Model fit in", round(fitting_time, 1), "min\n")
  
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y,
        TRUE ~ predictions$mean
      ),
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_prediction_type") := data_split
    )
  
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true))
  
  metrics <- list(variable = variable_name)
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("🎯 Validation: R²=", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), 
          " RMSE=", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n", sep="")
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    variable_name = variable_name,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = n_available,
    n_missing = n_missing,
    pct_available = pct_available
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING ALL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

all_results <- list()
all_metrics <- data.frame()
failed_variables <- character(0)

# COMPOSITIONAL DATA
cat("\n[COMPOSITIONAL] Processing granulometry...\n")

granulo_result <- impute_compositional_granulometry(
  parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
  W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
  field_map = field_mapping,
  year_map = year_mapping,
  verbose = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(granulo_result)) {
  all_results[["GRANULOMETRY_COMPOSITIONAL"]] <- granulo_result
  
  if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics)) {
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]])) {
        metrics_row <- data.frame(
          Variable = frac,
          N_Total = nrow(parcelles_complete),
          N_Available = granulo_result$n_sampled,
          N_Missing = granulo_result$n_unsampled,
          Pct_Available = round(granulo_result$n_sampled / nrow(parcelles_complete) * 100, 1),
          R_Squared = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared,
          RMSE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$rmse,
          MAE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$mae,
          N_Validation = granulo_result$metrics$n_validation,
          Compositional = TRUE,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
        all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("✅ SUCCESS for compositional granulometry\n")
} else {
  failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, GRANULO_FRACTIONS)
  cat("❌ FAILED for compositional granulometry\n")
}

# NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES
cat("\n[NON-COMPOSITIONAL] Processing other variables...\n")

for (i in seq_along(OTHER_SOIL_VARS)) {
  var_name <- OTHER_SOIL_VARS[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(OTHER_SOIL_VARS), "] ", var_name, "\n", sep="")
  
  result <- impute_single_variable(
    variable_name = var_name,
    parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
    W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
    field_map = field_mapping,
    year_map = year_mapping,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    all_results[[var_name]] <- result
    
    metrics_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      N_Total = result$n_total,
      N_Available = result$n_available,
      N_Missing = result$n_missing,
      Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
      R_Squared = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$r_squared), NA, result$metrics$r_squared),
      RMSE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$rmse), NA, result$metrics$rmse),
      MAE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$mae), NA, result$metrics$mae),
      N_Validation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$n_validation), 0, result$metrics$n_validation),
      Compositional = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
    cat("✅ SUCCESS\n")
  } else {
    failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, var_name)
    cat("❌ FAILED\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 COMBINING PREDICTIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
  mutate(
    replicate_id = row_number(),
    unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number())

final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    final_dataset %>% dplyr::select(original_row_id, replicate_id, unique_key),
    by = "original_row_id"
  )

# Add compositional predictions
if (!is.null(all_results[["GRANULOMETRY_COMPOSITIONAL"]])) {
  cat("\n📐 Adding compositional predictions...\n")
  
  granulo_preds <- all_results[["GRANULOMETRY_COMPOSITIONAL"]]$predictions
  
  # Create alignment based on ALL data (sampled + unsampled)
  df_reference_granulo <- parcelles_complete %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Sequential_ID), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = row_number(),
      unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sequential_ID, ID.Year, replicate_id)
  
  cat("  Total rows to align:", nrow(df_reference_granulo), "\n")
  cat("  Prediction rows:", nrow(granulo_preds), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(df_reference_granulo) == nrow(granulo_preds)) {
    granulo_aligned <- df_reference_granulo %>%
      dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id, unique_key) %>%
      bind_cols(
        granulo_preds %>%
          dplyr::select(matches("^Clay_|^Fine_Silt_|^Coarse_Silt_|^Fine_Sand_|^Coarse_Sand_"))
      )
    
    final_dataset <- final_dataset %>%
      left_join(
        granulo_aligned %>% dplyr::select(-Final_Cleaned_ID, -Year, -replicate_id),
        by = "unique_key"
      )
    
    # Verify closure
    check_cols <- paste0(GRANULO_FRACTIONS, "_complete")
    if (all(check_cols %in% colnames(final_dataset))) {
      sums <- final_dataset %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        filter(!is.na(Clay_percent_complete)) %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(sum_fractions = sum(c_across(all_of(check_cols)))) %>%
        pull(sum_fractions)
      
      if (length(sums) > 0) {
        cat("  ✅ Closure verified: sum range [", 
            round(min(sums), 2), ", ", round(max(sums), 2), "]%\n", sep="")
      }
    }
    
    cat("  ✅ Compositional predictions added\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ❌ Row mismatch\n")
  }
}

# Add non-compositional predictions
successful_other_vars <- intersect(names(all_results), OTHER_SOIL_VARS)

for (i in seq_along(successful_other_vars)) {
  var_name <- successful_other_vars[i]
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(successful_other_vars), "] Adding ", var_name, "\n", sep="")
  
  df_inla_reference <- parcelles_complete %>% 
    st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%  
    left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%  
    filter(!is.na(Sequential_ID), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>% 
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = row_number(),
      unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Sequential_ID, ID.Year, replicate_id)
  
  if (nrow(df_inla_reference) == nrow(result$predictions)) {
    predictions_aligned <- df_inla_reference %>% 
      dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id, unique_key) %>% 
      bind_cols(
        result$predictions %>% 
          dplyr::select(matches(paste0("^", var_name, "_")))
      )
    
    final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% 
      left_join(
        predictions_aligned %>% dplyr::select(-Final_Cleaned_ID, -Year, -replicate_id),
        by = "unique_key"
      )
    
    cat("  ✅ Added\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ❌ Row mismatch\n")
  }
}

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% dplyr::select(-original_row_id)

cat("\n✅ Final dataset: ", nrow(final_dataset), " rows, ", ncol(final_dataset), " columns\n", sep="")

cat("\n💾 SAVING OUTPUTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

report_path <- paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_COMPREHENSIVE_REPORT.txt")
sink(report_path)

cat("=================================================\n")

cat("COMPOSITIONAL DATA (GRANULOMETRY)\n")
cat("---------------------------------\n")
cat("Method: Additive Log-Ratio (ALR) transformation\n")
cat("Fractions:", paste(GRANULO_FRACTIONS, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Constraint: All fractions sum to 100%\n\n")

if (!is.null(all_results[["GRANULOMETRY_COMPOSITIONAL"]])) {
  granulo_res <- all_results[["GRANULOMETRY_COMPOSITIONAL"]]
  cat("Sampled observations:", granulo_res$n_sampled, "\n")
  cat("Unsampled observations:", granulo_res$n_unsampled, "\n")
  cat("Total predicted:", granulo_res$n_sampled + granulo_res$n_unsampled, "\n\n")
  
  if (!is.null(granulo_res$metrics$fraction_metrics)) {
    cat("Validation metrics:\n")
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      if (!is.null(granulo_res$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]])) {
        cat("  ", frac, ":\n", sep="")
        cat("    R²:   ", round(granulo_res$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared, 4), "\n", sep="")
        cat("    RMSE: ", round(granulo_res$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$rmse, 2), "%\n", sep="")
        cat("    MAE:  ", round(granulo_res$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$mae, 2), "%\n", sep="")
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("\n\nNON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES\n")
cat("---------------------------\n")

for (var_name in successful_other_vars) {
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  cat("\n", var_name, ":\n", sep="")
  cat("  Available: ", result$n_available, " (", round(result$pct_available, 1), "%)\n", sep="")
  cat("  Missing: ", result$n_missing, "\n", sep="")
  if (!is.na(result$metrics$r_squared)) {
    cat("  R²: ", round(result$metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n", sep="")
    cat("  RMSE: ", round(result$metrics$rmse, 4), "\n", sep="")
  }
}

if (length(failed_variables) > 0) {
  cat("\n\nFAILED VARIABLES\n")
  cat("----------------\n")
  for (failed_var in failed_variables) {
    cat("• ", failed_var, "\n", sep="")
  }
}

cat("\n\nVALIDATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("------------------\n")
valid_metrics <- all_metrics[!is.na(all_metrics$R_Squared), ]
if (nrow(valid_metrics) > 0) {
  cat("Variables validated: ", nrow(valid_metrics), "\n", sep="")
  cat("Mean R²: ", round(mean(valid_metrics$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n", sep="")
  cat("Median R²: ", round(median(valid_metrics$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n", sep="")
  
  comp_metrics <- valid_metrics %>% filter(Compositional == TRUE)
  non_comp_metrics <- valid_metrics %>% filter(Compositional == FALSE)
  
  if (nrow(comp_metrics) > 0) {
    cat("\nCompositional:\n")
    cat("  Mean R²: ", round(mean(comp_metrics$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n", sep="")
    cat("  Mean RMSE: ", round(mean(comp_metrics$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n", sep="")
  }
  
  if (nrow(non_comp_metrics) > 0) {
    cat("\nNon-compositional:\n")
    cat("  Mean R²: ", round(mean(non_comp_metrics$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n", sep="")
    cat("  Mean RMSE: ", round(mean(non_comp_metrics$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n", sep="")
  }
}

sink()
cat("✅ Report: ALL_VARIABLES_COMPREHENSIVE_REPORT.txt\n")

# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING VISUALIZATIONS:\n")

if (nrow(all_metrics) > 0) {
  all_metrics_plot <- all_metrics %>%
    mutate(Type = ifelse(Compositional, "Compositional", "Non-Compositional"))
  
  # Performance plot
  p1 <- ggplot(all_metrics_plot %>% filter(!is.na(R_Squared)), 
               aes(x = reorder(Variable, R_Squared), y = R_Squared, fill = Type)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Compositional" = "#E74C3C", "Non-Compositional" = "#3498DB")) +
    labs(
      title = "Validation Performance (R²)",
      subtitle = "Compositional data: ALR transformation | Non-compositional: Direct modeling",
      x = NULL,
      y = "R² (Validation)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  ggsave(paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_validation_performance.png"), 
         p1, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✅ Performance plot\n")
  
  # Data availability plot
  p2 <- ggplot(all_metrics_plot, 
               aes(x = reorder(Variable, Pct_Available), y = Pct_Available, fill = Type)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Compositional" = "#E74C3C", "Non-Compositional" = "#27AE60")) +
    labs(
      title = "Data Availability by Variable", 
      subtitle = "Percentage of non-missing observations",
      x = NULL,
      y = "% Available Data"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  ggsave(paste0(base_path, "ALL_VARIABLES_data_availability.png"), 
         p2, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✅ Availability plot\n")
}
```

## VI.3. SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION FOR GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS ONLY

```{r}
# SPATIO-TEMPORAL IMPUTATION FOR GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS ONLY
# ILR (Isometric Log-Ratio) Transformation Approach 
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS IMPUTATION    \n")
cat("  ILR TRANSFORMATION - FIXED           \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMPOSITIONAL DATA SETUP
# ============================================================================
GRANULO_FRACTIONS <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent", 
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

cat("📊 COMPOSITIONAL DATA CONFIGURATION:\n")
cat("• Granulometry fractions (compositional):", length(GRANULO_FRACTIONS), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  stop("❌ Complete dataset not found.")
}

cat("\nGranulometry variables to process:\n")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) {
  var_name <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS[i]
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(parcelles_complete[[var_name]]))
  pct_available <- round(n_available/nrow(parcelles_complete)*100, 1)
  cat(sprintf("  %d. %-35s: %4d available (%5.1f%%)\n", 
              i, var_name, n_available, pct_available))
}

# ============================================================================
# COMPOSITIONAL DATA VALIDATION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔍 VALIDATING COMPOSITIONAL DATA:\n")

parcelles_complete <- parcelles_complete %>%
  mutate(
    has_complete_granulo = !is.na(Clay_percent) & 
                          !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent) & 
                          !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent) & 
                          !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent) & 
                          !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent),
    granulo_sum = Clay_percent + Fine_Silt_percent + Coarse_Silt_percent + 
                  Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent
  )

complete_granulo <- sum(parcelles_complete$has_complete_granulo, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("• Observations with complete granulometry:", complete_granulo, "\n")

if(complete_granulo > 0) {
  sum_stats <- parcelles_complete %>%
    filter(has_complete_granulo) %>%
    pull(granulo_sum) %>%
    summary()
  cat("• Sum range:", round(sum_stats[1], 2), "to", round(sum_stats[6], 2), "%\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2-4: SPATIAL AND TEMPORAL STRUCTURES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ PREPARING SPATIAL STRUCTURE:\n")

unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)

field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

cat("\n🔗 CREATING SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX:\n")

boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

cat("✅ Spatial matrix:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors:", round(sum(W.P1_complete) / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), 2), "\n")

years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:length(years_unique)
)

cat("Years:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# ILR TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

ilr_inverse <- function(ilr_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(ilr_matrix) + 1
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- ilr_matrix %*% V
  composition <- exp(log_comp)
  row_sums <- rowSums(composition)
  composition <- composition / row_sums
  return(composition)
}

# ============================================================================
# FIXED GRANULOMETRY IMPUTATION WITH ILR
# ============================================================================
impute_compositional_granulometry <- function(parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY (ILR)\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # FIX 1: Add unique observation ID to track replicates
  parcelles_data <- parcelles_data %>%
    mutate(obs_id = row_number())
  
  # Separate sampled and unsampled parcels
  sampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(has_complete_granulo)
  
  unsampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(!has_complete_granulo)
  
  n_sampled <- nrow(sampled_obs)
  n_unsampled <- nrow(unsampled_obs)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Sampled observations:", n_sampled, "\n")
    cat("• Unsampled observations:", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  if (n_sampled < 20) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient sampled observations\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and normalize composition
  comp_matrix <- sampled_obs %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  comp_matrix[comp_matrix <= 0] <- 0.01
  row_sums <- rowSums(comp_matrix)
  comp_matrix <- comp_matrix / row_sums * 100
  
  # Transform to ILR space
  ilr_coords <- ilr_transform(comp_matrix / 100)
  colnames(ilr_coords) <- paste0("ILR_", 1:4)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ILR transformation: 5 fractions -> 4 orthonormal coordinates\n")
  }
  
  sampled_obs_ilr <- sampled_obs %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(ilr_coords))
  
  # FIX 2: Split at PARCEL level, not observation level
  set.seed(123)
  unique_sampled_parcels <- sampled_obs_ilr %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.85, 0.15)))
  
  cat("• Unique parcels in training:", sum(unique_sampled_parcels$split == "train"), "\n")
  cat("• Unique parcels in validation:", sum(unique_sampled_parcels$split == "val"), "\n")
  
  sampled_obs_split <- sampled_obs_ilr %>%
    left_join(unique_sampled_parcels, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(data_split = ifelse(split == "train", "train", "validation"))
  
  # Combine sampled and unsampled
  all_obs_for_prediction <- bind_rows(
    sampled_obs_split %>% mutate(obs_type = "sampled"),
    unsampled_obs %>% mutate(obs_type = "unsampled", data_split = "predict")
  )
  
  train_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "validation")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Training observations:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation observations:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict (unsampled):", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  # Fit models for each ILR coordinate
  ilr_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    
    if (verbose) cat("\n  Fitting", ilr_var, "...\n")
    
    df_inla <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
      left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
      mutate(
        Y = case_when(
          data_split == "train" ~ .data[[ilr_var]],
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        Y_true = .data[[ilr_var]],
        ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
        ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
        Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
        Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
        irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
      arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
    
    fit_result <- tryCatch({
      prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
      
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
          f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
            group = ID.Year, 
            control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
            hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
            constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
        control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tryCatch({
        inla(
          Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_inla,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e2) NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
      predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
      
      df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
        mutate(
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd
        )
      
      # FIX 3: Calculate validation metrics only on validation set
      val_data <- df_predicted %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true))
      
      metrics <- list()
      if (nrow(val_data) > 5) {
        pred_vals <- val_data[[paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted")]]
        true_vals <- val_data$Y_true
        
        ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
        
        metrics$r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
        metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
        metrics$n_val <- nrow(val_data)
      }
      
      ilr_results[[ilr_var]] <- list(
        model = fit_result,
        predictions = df_predicted,
        metrics = metrics
      )
      
      if (verbose && !is.null(metrics$r_squared)) {
        cat("    ✅ R² (validation):", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), 
            "| n =", metrics$n_val, "\n")
      }
    } else {
      if (verbose) cat("    ❌ Failed\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Combine predictions
  if (verbose) cat("\n🔄 Transforming back to composition...\n")
  
  all_predictions <- ilr_results[[1]]$predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(obs_id, Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, data_split, obs_type,
                  ILR_1_predicted, ILR_1_predicted_sd)
  
  for (i in 2:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    pred_cols <- ilr_results[[ilr_var]]$predictions %>%
      dplyr::select(obs_id, !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted"), !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd"))
    
    all_predictions <- all_predictions %>%
      left_join(pred_cols, by = "obs_id")
  }
  
  # Back-transform using ILR inverse
  ilr_pred_matrix <- all_predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(ILR_1_predicted, ILR_2_predicted, ILR_3_predicted, ILR_4_predicted) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  comp_predicted <- ilr_inverse(ilr_pred_matrix)
  comp_predicted_pct <- comp_predicted * 100
  colnames(comp_predicted_pct) <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ILR back-transformation complete\n")
    sums_check <- rowSums(comp_predicted_pct)
    cat("• Sum range:", round(min(sums_check), 2), "to", round(max(sums_check), 2), "%\n")
  }
  
  # Create final results
  final_results <- all_predictions %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(comp_predicted_pct) %>%
                rename_with(~paste0(., "_predicted"), all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)))
  
  # Add complete columns
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    # FIX 4: Use obs_id for exact matching
    original_map <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      dplyr::select(obs_id, !!frac) %>%
      rename(original_value = !!frac)
    
    final_results <- final_results %>%
      left_join(original_map, by = "obs_id")
    
    pred_col <- paste0(frac, "_predicted")
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_complete")]] <- ifelse(
      final_results$data_split == "train",
      final_results$original_value,
      final_results[[pred_col]]
    )
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_prediction_type")]] <- final_results$data_split
    
    final_results <- final_results %>% dplyr::select(-original_value)
  }
  
  # FIX 5: Calculate validation metrics properly
  overall_metrics <- list()
  val_subset <- final_results %>% filter(data_split == "validation")
  
  if (nrow(val_subset) > 5) {
    frac_metrics <- list()
    
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      # Get true values using obs_id
      true_map <- sampled_obs_split %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation") %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::select(obs_id, !!frac) %>%
        rename(true_val = !!frac)
      
      val_comparison <- val_subset %>%
        left_join(true_map, by = "obs_id")
      
      if (sum(!is.na(val_comparison$true_val)) > 5) {
        true_vals <- val_comparison$true_val
        pred_vals <- val_comparison[[paste0(frac, "_predicted")]]
        
        valid_idx <- !is.na(true_vals) & !is.na(pred_vals)
        true_vals <- true_vals[valid_idx]
        pred_vals <- pred_vals[valid_idx]
        
        if (length(true_vals) > 0) {
          ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
          ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
          
          frac_metrics[[frac]] <- list(
            r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)),
            mae = mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals)),
            n = length(true_vals)
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    overall_metrics$fraction_metrics <- frac_metrics
    overall_metrics$n_validation <- nrow(val_subset)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 Validation Results (Back-transformed Fractions):\n")
      cat("• Validation observations:", nrow(val_subset), "\n")
      for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
        if (!is.null(frac_metrics[[frac]])) {
          cat("• ", frac, ": R²=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared, 4),
              " RMSE=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$rmse, 2), "% (n=", 
              frac_metrics[[frac]]$n, ")\n", sep="")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    predictions = final_results,
    ilr_results = ilr_results,
    metrics = overall_metrics,
    n_sampled = n_sampled,
    n_unsampled = n_unsampled
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# PROCESS GRANULOMETRY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING GRANULOMETRY FRACTIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

cat("\n[COMPOSITIONAL - ILR] Processing granulometry...\n")

granulo_result <- impute_compositional_granulometry(
  parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
  W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
  field_map = field_mapping,
  year_map = year_mapping,
  verbose = TRUE
)

if (is.null(granulo_result)) {
  stop("❌ Granulometry processing failed!")
}

cat("\n✅ SUCCESS for compositional granulometry (ILR)\n")

# ============================================================================
# PREPARE METRICS SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
all_metrics <- data.frame()

if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics)) {
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]])) {
      metrics_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = frac,
        N_Total = nrow(parcelles_complete),
        N_Available = granulo_result$n_sampled,
        N_Missing = granulo_result$n_unsampled,
        Pct_Available = round(granulo_result$n_sampled / nrow(parcelles_complete) * 100, 1),
        R_Squared = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared,
        RMSE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$rmse,
        MAE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$mae,
        N_Validation = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$n,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
    }
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE PREDICTIONS WITH ORIGINAL DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 COMBINING PREDICTIONS WITH ORIGINAL DATA:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
```

# Checking - GRANULOMETRY CLOSURE VERIFICATION

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# GRANULOMETRY CLOSURE VERIFICATION
# Check if the 5 fractions sum to 100% in original data
# ============================================================================

cat("\n🔍 CHECKING GRANULOMETRY CLOSURE (SUM = 100%)\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

# Define fractions
GRANULO_FRACTIONS <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent", 
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

# Calculate sum for observations with complete granulometry
closure_check <- parcelles_complete %>%
  filter(has_complete_granulo) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    fraction_sum = Clay_percent + Fine_Silt_percent + Coarse_Silt_percent + 
                   Fine_Sand_percent + Coarse_Sand_percent,
    deviation = fraction_sum - 100,
    abs_deviation = abs(deviation)
  )

cat("\n📊 SUMMARY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Total observations with complete granulometry:", nrow(closure_check), "\n\n")

cat("Sum statistics:\n")
cat("  Min:    ", round(min(closure_check$fraction_sum), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Q1:     ", round(quantile(closure_check$fraction_sum, 0.25), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Median: ", round(median(closure_check$fraction_sum), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Mean:   ", round(mean(closure_check$fraction_sum), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Q3:     ", round(quantile(closure_check$fraction_sum, 0.75), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Max:    ", round(max(closure_check$fraction_sum), 2), "%\n\n", sep="")

cat("Deviation from 100%:\n")
cat("  Min:    ", round(min(closure_check$deviation), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Median: ", round(median(closure_check$deviation), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Max:    ", round(max(closure_check$deviation), 2), "%\n", sep="")
cat("  Mean absolute deviation: ", round(mean(closure_check$abs_deviation), 2), "%\n\n", sep="")

# Categorize by deviation ranges
cat("\n📈 DISTRIBUTION BY DEVIATION RANGES:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------\n")

closure_summary <- closure_check %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      abs_deviation < 0.01 ~ "Perfect (< 0.01%)",
      abs_deviation < 0.1 ~ "Excellent (0.01-0.1%)",
      abs_deviation < 0.5 ~ "Very Good (0.1-0.5%)",
      abs_deviation < 1.0 ~ "Good (0.5-1.0%)",
      abs_deviation < 2.0 ~ "Acceptable (1.0-2.0%)",
      abs_deviation < 5.0 ~ "Poor (2.0-5.0%)",
      TRUE ~ "Very Poor (≥ 5.0%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    pct = round(n() / nrow(closure_check) * 100, 2),
    avg_sum = round(mean(fraction_sum), 2),
    min_sum = round(min(fraction_sum), 2),
    max_sum = round(max(fraction_sum), 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_obs))

print(closure_summary, n = Inf)

# Flag problematic observations
n_perfect <- sum(closure_check$abs_deviation < 0.01)
n_excellent <- sum(closure_check$abs_deviation >= 0.01 & closure_check$abs_deviation < 0.1)
n_good <- sum(closure_check$abs_deviation >= 0.1 & closure_check$abs_deviation < 1.0)
n_problematic <- sum(closure_check$abs_deviation >= 1.0)

cat("\n\n✅ CLOSURE QUALITY ASSESSMENT:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Perfect closure (< 0.01% deviation):    ", n_perfect, " (", 
    round(n_perfect/nrow(closure_check)*100, 1), "%)\n", sep="")
cat("Excellent closure (< 0.1% deviation):   ", n_excellent, " (", 
    round(n_excellent/nrow(closure_check)*100, 1), "%)\n", sep="")
cat("Good closure (0.1-1.0% deviation):      ", n_good, " (", 
    round(n_good/nrow(closure_check)*100, 1), "%)\n", sep="")
cat("Problematic (≥ 1.0% deviation):         ", n_problematic, " (", 
    round(n_problematic/nrow(closure_check)*100, 1), "%)\n", sep="")

if (n_problematic > 0) {
  cat("\n⚠️  WARNING: ", n_problematic, " observations have significant closure issues!\n", sep="")
  
  # Show worst cases
  worst_cases <- closure_check %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_deviation)) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, fraction_sum, deviation, all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS))
  
  cat("\nTop 10 worst cases:\n")
  print(worst_cases, n = 10)
} else {
  cat("\n✅ All observations have acceptable closure!\n")
}

# Additional check: Are all fractions positive?
cat("\n\n🔍 CHECKING FOR NON-POSITIVE VALUES:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------\n")

negative_check <- closure_check %>%
  select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(. <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

has_negatives <- any(negative_check > 0)

if (has_negatives) {
  cat("⚠️  Found non-positive values:\n")
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPARE SHARED SPATIAL STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================

unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
```
