```{r}
cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CREATE SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX W.P1
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 CREATING SHARED SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

cat("Computing boundary-to-boundary distances (this may take time)...\n")

boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated:", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")

DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("Using distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)

cat("✅ W.P1 matrix created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: PREPARE SHARED TEMPORAL STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# ============================================================================
# ILR TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

ilr_inverse <- function(ilr_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(ilr_matrix) + 1
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- ilr_matrix %*% V
  composition <- exp(log_comp)
  row_sums <- rowSums(composition)
  composition <- composition / row_sums
  return(composition)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: DEFINE IMPUTATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

# Non-compositional imputation (same as before)
impute_single_variable <- function(variable_name, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING VARIABLE:", variable_name, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Variable statistics:\n")
    cat("• Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
    cat("• Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing (NA):", n_missing, "(", round(n_missing/n_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
    
    if (n_available > 0) {
      cat("• Min value:", round(min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Max value:", round(max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Mean value:", round(mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Std deviation:", round(sd(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  observed_data <- parcelles_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[variable_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  parcelles_data_split <- parcelles_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[variable_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train",
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  train_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "validation")
  pred_obs <- sum(parcelles_data_split$data_split == "predict")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Data split:\n")
    cat("• Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict:", pred_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  df_inla <- parcelles_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[variable_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true = .data[[variable_name]],
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
  
  if (max(df_inla$ID.Field) > nrow(W_matrix)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible. Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("🚀 Fitting spatio-temporal model...\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = "gaussian",
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Full model failed. Trying simpler model...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) {
      if (verbose) cat("❌ Simple model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result) || is.null(fit_result$summary.fitted.values)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model fitting failed completely\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ Model successful! Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$dic)) cat("DIC:", round(fit_result$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$waic)) cat("WAIC:", round(fit_result$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
  }
  
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y,
        TRUE ~ predictions$mean
      ),
      !!paste0(variable_name, "_prediction_type") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
        data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation", 
        data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
      )
    )
  
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true), !is.na(predictions$mean))
  
  metrics <- list(variable = variable_name)
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- r_squared
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$mean_error <- mean(true_vals - pred_vals)
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true >= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_lower")]] & 
                      validation_data$Y_true <= validation_data[[paste0(variable_name, "_predicted_upper")]])
    metrics$coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("🎯 Validation Results:\n")
      cat("• Validation obs:", metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      cat("• R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Correlation:", round(metrics$correlation, 4), "\n") 
      cat("• RMSE:", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("• MAE:", round(metrics$mae, 4), "\n")
      cat("• Coverage:", round(metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
    }
  } else {
    metrics$r_squared <- NA
    metrics$correlation <- NA
    metrics$rmse <- NA
    metrics$mae <- NA
    metrics$mean_error <- NA
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    metrics$coverage_prob <- NA
    
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient validation data for metrics\n")
  }
  
  result <- list(
    variable_name = variable_name,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = n_available,
    n_missing = n_missing,
    pct_available = pct_available
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# Compositional imputation for granulometry
impute_compositional_granulometry <- function(parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY (ILR)\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  parcelles_data <- parcelles_data %>%
    mutate(obs_id = row_number())
  
  sampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(has_complete_granulo)
  
  unsampled_obs <- parcelles_data %>%
    filter(!has_complete_granulo)
  
  n_sampled <- nrow(sampled_obs)
  n_unsampled <- nrow(unsampled_obs)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Sampled observations:", n_sampled, "\n")
    cat("• Unsampled observations:", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  if (n_sampled < 20) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient sampled observations\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  comp_matrix <- sampled_obs %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  comp_matrix[comp_matrix <= 0] <- 0.01
  row_sums <- rowSums(comp_matrix)
  comp_matrix <- comp_matrix / row_sums * 100
  
  ilr_coords <- ilr_transform(comp_matrix / 100)
  colnames(ilr_coords) <- paste0("ILR_", 1:4)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ILR transformation: 5 fractions -> 4 orthonormal coordinates\n")
  }
  
  sampled_obs_ilr <- sampled_obs %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(ilr_coords))
  
  set.seed(123)
  unique_sampled_parcels <- sampled_obs_ilr %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.85, 0.15)))
  
  cat("• Unique parcels in training:", sum(unique_sampled_parcels$split == "train"), "\n")
  cat("• Unique parcels in validation:", sum(unique_sampled_parcels$split == "val"), "\n")
  
  sampled_obs_split <- sampled_obs_ilr %>%
    left_join(unique_sampled_parcels, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(data_split = ifelse(split == "train", "train", "validation"))
  
  all_obs_for_prediction <- bind_rows(
    sampled_obs_split %>% mutate(obs_type = "sampled"),
    unsampled_obs %>% mutate(obs_type = "unsampled", data_split = "predict")
  )
  
  train_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(sampled_obs_split$data_split == "validation")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("• Training observations:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("• Validation observations:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("• To predict (unsampled):", n_unsampled, "\n")
  }
  
  ilr_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    
    if (verbose) cat("\n  Fitting", ilr_var, "...\n")
    
    df_inla <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
      left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
      mutate(
        Y = case_when(
          data_split == "train" ~ .data[[ilr_var]],
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        Y_true = .data[[ilr_var]],
        ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
        ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
        Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
        Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
        irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
      arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year)
    
    fit_result <- tryCatch({
      prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
      
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
          f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
            group = ID.Year, 
            control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
            hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
            constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = "gaussian",
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
        control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tryCatch({
        inla(
          Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
          data = df_inla,
          family = "gaussian",
          control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
          control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
          verbose = FALSE
        )
      }, error = function(e2) NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
      predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
      
      df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
        mutate(
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted") := predictions$mean,
          !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd
        )
      
      val_data <- df_predicted %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true))
      
      metrics <- list()
      if (nrow(val_data) > 5) {
        pred_vals <- val_data[[paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted")]]
        true_vals <- val_data$Y_true
        
        ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
        ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
        
        metrics$r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
        metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
        metrics$n_val <- nrow(val_data)
      }
      
      ilr_results[[ilr_var]] <- list(
        model = fit_result,
        predictions = df_predicted,
        metrics = metrics
      )
      
      if (verbose && !is.null(metrics$r_squared)) {
        cat("    ✅ R² (validation):", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), 
            "| n =", metrics$n_val, "\n")
      }
    } else {
      if (verbose) cat("    ❌ Failed\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("\n🔄 Transforming back to composition...\n")
  
  all_predictions <- ilr_results[[1]]$predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(obs_id, Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, data_split, obs_type,
                  ILR_1_predicted, ILR_1_predicted_sd)
  
  for (i in 2:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    pred_cols <- ilr_results[[ilr_var]]$predictions %>%
      dplyr::select(obs_id, !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted"), !!paste0(ilr_var, "_predicted_sd"))
    
    all_predictions <- all_predictions %>%
      left_join(pred_cols, by = "obs_id")
  }
  
  ilr_pred_matrix <- all_predictions %>%
    dplyr::select(ILR_1_predicted, ILR_2_predicted, ILR_3_predicted, ILR_4_predicted) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  comp_predicted <- ilr_inverse(ilr_pred_matrix)
  comp_predicted_pct <- comp_predicted * 100
  colnames(comp_predicted_pct) <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("✅ ILR back-transformation complete\n")
    sums_check <- rowSums(comp_predicted_pct)
    cat("• Sum range:", round(min(sums_check), 2), "to", round(max(sums_check), 2), "%\n")
  }
  
  final_results <- all_predictions %>%
    bind_cols(as.data.frame(comp_predicted_pct) %>%
                rename_with(~paste0(., "_predicted"), all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)))
  
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    original_map <- all_obs_for_prediction %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      dplyr::select(obs_id, !!frac) %>%
      rename(original_value = !!frac)
    
    final_results <- final_results %>%
      left_join(original_map, by = "obs_id")
    
    pred_col <- paste0(frac, "_predicted")
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_complete")]] <- ifelse(
      final_results$data_split == "train",
      final_results$original_value,
      final_results[[pred_col]]
    )
    
    final_results[[paste0(frac, "_prediction_type")]] <- final_results$data_split
    
    final_results <- final_results %>% dplyr::select(-original_value)
  }
  
  overall_metrics <- list()
  val_subset <- final_results %>% filter(data_split == "validation")
  
  if (nrow(val_subset) > 5) {
    frac_metrics <- list()
    
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      true_map <- sampled_obs_split %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation") %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::select(obs_id, !!frac) %>%
        rename(true_val = !!frac)
      
      val_comparison <- val_subset %>%
        left_join(true_map, by = "obs_id")
      
      if (sum(!is.na(val_comparison$true_val)) > 5) {
        true_vals <- val_comparison$true_val
        pred_vals <- val_comparison[[paste0(frac, "_predicted")]]
        
        valid_idx <- !is.na(true_vals) & !is.na(pred_vals)
        true_vals <- true_vals[valid_idx]
        pred_vals <- pred_vals[valid_idx]
        
        if (length(true_vals) > 0) {
          ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
          ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
          
          frac_metrics[[frac]] <- list(
            r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)),
            mae = mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals)),
            n = length(true_vals)
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    overall_metrics$fraction_metrics <- frac_metrics
    overall_metrics$n_validation <- nrow(val_subset)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 Validation Results (Back-transformed Fractions):\n")
      cat("• Validation observations:", nrow(val_subset), "\n")
      for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
        if (!is.null(frac_metrics[[frac]])) {
          cat("• ", frac, ": R²=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared, 4),
              " RMSE=", round(frac_metrics[[frac]]$rmse, 2), "% (n=", 
              frac_metrics[[frac]]$n, ")\n", sep="")
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    predictions = final_results,
    ilr_results = ilr_results,
    metrics = overall_metrics,
    n_sampled = n_sampled,
    n_unsampled = n_unsampled
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING ALL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

all_results <- list()
all_metrics <- data.frame()
failed_variables <- character(0)

# Process compositional granulometry first
cat("\n[COMPOSITIONAL] Processing granulometry fractions...\n")

granulo_result <- impute_compositional_granulometry(
  parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
  W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
  field_map = field_mapping,
  year_map = year_mapping,
  verbose = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(granulo_result)) {
  all_results[["Granulometry_Compositional"]] <- granulo_result
  
  if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics)) {
    for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
      if (!is.null(granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]])) {
        metrics_row <- data.frame(
          Variable = frac,
          N_Total = nrow(parcelles_complete),
          N_Available = granulo_result$n_sampled,
          N_Missing = granulo_result$n_unsampled,
          Pct_Available = round(granulo_result$n_sampled / nrow(parcelles_complete) * 100, 1),
          Fitting_Time_Min = NA,
          R_Squared = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$r_squared,
          Correlation = NA,
          RMSE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$rmse,
          MAE = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$mae,
          Coverage_Prob = NA,
          N_Validation = granulo_result$metrics$fraction_metrics[[frac]]$n,
          DIC = NA,
          WAIC = NA,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
        all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
      }
    }
  }
  cat("✅ SUCCESS for compositional granulometry\n")
} else {
  failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, GRANULO_FRACTIONS)
  cat("❌ FAILED for compositional granulometry\n")
}

# Process non-compositional variables
for (i in seq_along(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES)) {
  var_name <- NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES), "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  result <- impute_single_variable(
    variable_name = var_name,
    parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
    W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
    field_map = field_mapping,
    year_map = year_mapping,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    all_results[[var_name]] <- result
    
    metrics_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      N_Total = result$n_total,
      N_Available = result$n_available,
      N_Missing = result$n_missing,
      Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
      Fitting_Time_Min = result$fitting_time,
      R_Squared = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$r_squared), NA, result$metrics$r_squared),
      Correlation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$correlation), NA, result$metrics$correlation),
      RMSE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$rmse), NA, result$metrics$rmse),
      MAE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$mae), NA, result$metrics$mae),
      Coverage_Prob = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$coverage_prob), NA, result$metrics$coverage_prob),
      N_Validation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$n_validation), 0, result$metrics$n_validation),
      DIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$dic), NA, result$model_fit$dic$dic),
      WAIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$waic), NA, result$model_fit$waic$waic),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    all_metrics <- rbind(all_metrics, metrics_row)
    cat("✅ SUCCESS for", var_name, "\n")
  } else {
    failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, var_name)
    cat("❌ FAILED for", var_name, "\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: COMBINE ALL PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 COMBINING ALL PREDICTIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

successful_variables <- names(all_results)
cat("Successfully processed:", length(successful_variables), "variable groups\n")

final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
  mutate(
    replicate_id = row_number(),
    unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number())

final_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>%
  mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    final_dataset %>% dplyr::select(original_row_id, replicate_id, unique_key),
    by = "original_row_id"
  )

replicate_summary <- final_dataset %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>% 
  count(n, name = "combinations")

cat("📊 REPLICATE SUMMARY:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(replicate_summary)) {
  n_reps <- replicate_summary$n[i]
  n_combinations <- replicate_summary$combinations[i]
  cat("•", n_combinations, "combinations have", n_reps, "replicate(s) each\n")
}

# Add granulometry predictions
if ("Granulometry_Compositional" %in% names(all_results)) {

      rowwise() %>%

# Add non-compositional predictions
for (i in seq_along(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES)) {

      arrange(Sequential_ID, ID.Year, replicate_id) %>%
      mutate(inla_row_id = row_number())
    
    cat("  Reference dataset rows:", nrow(df_inla_reference), "\n")
    cat("  Prediction rows:", nrow(result$predictions), "\n")
    
    if (nrow(df_inla_reference) == nrow(result$predictions)) {
      predictions_aligned <- df_inla_reference %>% 
        dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id, unique_key, original_row_id) %>% 
        bind_cols(
          result$predictions %>% 
            dplyr::select(matches(paste0("^", var_name, "_")))
        )
      
      if (any(duplicated(predictions_aligned$unique_key))) {
        cat("  ❌ Still have duplicates in unique_key - this shouldn't happen!\n")
        next
      }
      
      final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% 
        left_join(
          predictions_aligned %>% dplyr::select(-Final_Cleaned_ID, -Year, -replicate_id, -original_row_id),
          by = "unique_key"
        )
      
      first_pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
      var_cols <- colnames(final_dataset)[grepl(paste0("^", var_name), colnames(final_dataset))]
      
      if (first_pred_col %in% colnames(final_dataset)) {
        non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(final_dataset[[first_pred_col]]))
        cat("  ✅ Successfully added", non_null_count, "predictions for", var_name, "\n")
        check_col <- first_pred_col
      } else if (length(var_cols) > 0) {
        cat("  📋 Found columns:", paste(var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
        non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(final_dataset[[var_cols[1]]]))
        cat("  ✅ Successfully added", non_null_count, "predictions for", var_name, "\n")
        check_col <- var_cols[1]
      } else {
        cat("  ❌ No prediction columns found for", var_name, "\n")
        check_col <- NULL
      }
      
      if (!is.null(check_col)) {
        replicate_dist <- final_dataset %>% 
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          filter(!is.na(.data[[check_col]])) %>%
          count(replicate_id) %>%
          arrange(replicate_id)
        
        if (nrow(replicate_dist) > 0) {
          cat("    Predictions by replicate:", paste(paste0("rep", replicate_dist$replicate_id, ":", replicate_dist$n), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        }
      }
      
    } else {
      cat("  ❌ Row count mismatch for", var_name, "- skipping\n")
      cat("    Reference rows:", nrow(df_inla_reference), "\n")
      cat("    Prediction rows:", nrow(result$predictions), "\n")
    }
    
    gc()
  }
}

final_dataset <- final_dataset %>% 
  dplyr::select(-original_row_id)

cat("\n✅ Final combined dataset created\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(final_dataset), "\n")

        }
      }

  }
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: ILR TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

ilr_inverse <- function(ilr_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(ilr_matrix) + 1
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- ilr_matrix %*% V
  composition <- exp(log_comp)
  row_sums <- rowSums(composition)
  composition <- composition / row_sums
  return(composition)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: FUNCTION FOR NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

create_observed_fitted_noncomp <- function(var_name, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n📊 Creating observed vs fitted for:", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Variable label for display
  var_label <- gsub("_", " ", var_name)
  var_label <- gsub("percent", "%", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("per mille", "‰", var_label)
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  pred_lower_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted_lower")
  pred_upper_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted_upper")
  
  # Check if columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Prediction column not found:", pred_col, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (!pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Prediction type column not found:", pred_type_col, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      observed = .data[[var_name]],
      predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      prediction_type = .data[[pred_type_col]],
      residuals = observed - predicted
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ No valid data points\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Separate training and validation
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(prediction_type == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(prediction_type == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Insufficient training data (n =", nrow(train_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Insufficient validation data (n =", nrow(val_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  Training observations:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
    cat("  Validation observations:", nrow(val_data), "\n")
  }
  
  # Calculate metrics
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$observed, train_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")^2
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean(train_data$residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  train_correlation <- cor(train_data$observed, train_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")
  
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$observed, val_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")^2
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean(val_data$residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  val_correlation <- cor(val_data$observed, val_data$predicted, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Determine common axis limits
  all_observed <- c(train_data$observed, val_data$observed)
  all_predicted <- c(train_data$predicted, val_data$predicted)
  
  x_limits <- range(all_predicted, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits <- range(all_observed, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Extend limits slightly
  x_range <- diff(x_limits)
  y_range <- diff(y_limits)
  x_limits <- c(x_limits[1] - 0.05 * x_range, x_limits[2] + 0.05 * x_range)
  y_limits <- c(y_limits[1] - 0.05 * y_range, y_limits[2] + 0.05 * y_range)
  
  # TRAINING PLOT
  p_train <- ggplot(train_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Training Set",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(train_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(train_r2, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(train_rmse, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(train_correlation, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = paste("Observed", var_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
  
  # VALIDATION PLOT
  p_val <- ggplot(val_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Validation Set", 
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(val_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(val_r2, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(val_rmse, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(val_correlation, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted", var_label),
      y = paste("Observed", var_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
  
  # RESIDUALS vs FITTED
  p_resid_train <- ggplot(train_data, aes(x = predicted, y = residuals)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Training)",
      x = paste("Fitted", var_label),
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  p_resid_val <- ggplot(val_data, aes(x = predicted, y = residuals)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Validation)",
      x = paste("Fitted", var_label),
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  # Combine all plots in a 2x2 grid
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plot_grid(p_train, p_val, ncol = 2, 
              labels = c("A. TRAINING", "B. VALIDATION"), 
              label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
    plot_grid(p_resid_train, p_resid_val, ncol = 2, 
              labels = c("C. RESIDUALS (TRAIN)", "D. RESIDUALS (VAL)"),
              label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
    nrow = 2
  )
  
  # Add overall title
  final_plot <- plot_grid(
    ggdraw() + 
      draw_label(
        paste("Model Diagnostics:", var_label),
        fontface = "bold", size = 16
      ) +
      draw_label(
        paste0("Performance Drop: ΔR² = ", round(train_r2 - val_r2, 3),
               " | R² Ratio (Val/Train) = ", round(val_r2 / train_r2, 3)),
        y = 0.3, size = 11, color = "grey40"
      ),
    combined_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.12, 1)
  )
  
  # Save plot
  filename <- paste0(var_name, "_observed_vs_fitted.png")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename), final_plot, 
         width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  if (verbose) cat("  ✓ Plot saved:", filename, "\n")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    variable_name = var_name,
    variable_label = var_label,
    train_metrics = list(
      n = nrow(train_data),
      r_squared = train_r2,
      rmse = train_rmse,
      correlation = train_correlation
    ),
    val_metrics = list(
      n = nrow(val_data),
      r_squared = val_r2,
      rmse = val_rmse,
      correlation = val_correlation
    ),
    performance_drop = list(
      delta_r2 = train_r2 - val_r2,
      delta_rmse = val_rmse - train_rmse,
      r2_ratio = val_r2 / train_r2
    )
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: FUNCTION FOR COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES (ILR + BACK-TRANSFORM)
# ============================================================================

create_observed_fitted_compositional <- function(data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n📊 Creating observed vs fitted for COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY:\n")
  }
  
  # Check if ILR columns exist
  ilr_cols <- paste0("ILR_", 1:4, "_predicted")
  if (!all(ilr_cols %in% colnames(data_sf))) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ ILR prediction columns not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract data with complete granulometry
  comp_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Clay_percent), 
           !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ILR_1_predicted),
           !is.na(ILR_2_predicted),
           !is.na(ILR_3_predicted),
           !is.na(ILR_4_predicted))
  
  if (nrow(comp_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ No complete compositional data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Determine split type (train vs validation)
  # Use Clay_percent_prediction_type as proxy for all fractions
  if ("Clay_percent_prediction_type" %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
    comp_data <- comp_data %>%
      mutate(prediction_type = Clay_percent_prediction_type)
  } else {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No prediction type column, assuming all are validation\n")
    comp_data <- comp_data %>%
      mutate(prediction_type = "validation")
  }
  
  # Separate training and validation
  train_data <- comp_data %>% filter(prediction_type == "train")
  val_data <- comp_data %>% filter(prediction_type == "validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Insufficient training data (n =", nrow(train_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Insufficient validation data (n =", nrow(val_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  Training observations:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
    cat("  Validation observations:", nrow(val_data), "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # PART A: ILR SPACE ANALYSIS
  # ============================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("\n  📐 Analyzing in ILR space...\n")
  
  ilr_results <- list()
  ilr_plots <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    ilr_pred_col <- paste0("ILR_", i, "_predicted")
    
    if (!ilr_pred_col %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
      next
    }
    
    # Extract ILR observed (need to compute from original composition)
    # For training data, compute ILR from observed composition
    train_comp_matrix <- train_data %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    train_comp_matrix[train_comp_matrix <= 0] <- 0.01
    train_comp_matrix <- train_comp_matrix / rowSums(train_comp_matrix) * 100
    train_ilr <- ilr_transform(train_comp_matrix / 100)
    
    train_ilr_data <- train_data %>%
      mutate(
        ilr_observed = train_ilr[, i],
        ilr_predicted = .data[[ilr_pred_col]],
        residuals = ilr_observed - ilr_predicted
      )
    
    # Same for validation
    val_comp_matrix <- val_data %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    val_comp_matrix[val_comp_matrix <= 0] <- 0.01
    val_comp_matrix <- val_comp_matrix / rowSums(val_comp_matrix) * 100
    val_ilr <- ilr_transform(val_comp_matrix / 100)
    
    val_ilr_data <- val_data %>%
      mutate(
        ilr_observed = val_ilr[, i],
        ilr_predicted = .data[[ilr_pred_col]],
        residuals = ilr_observed - ilr_predicted
      )
    
    # Calculate metrics
    train_r2 <- cor(train_ilr_data$ilr_observed, train_ilr_data$ilr_predicted)^2
    train_rmse <- sqrt(mean(train_ilr_data$residuals^2))
    
    val_r2 <- cor(val_ilr_data$ilr_observed, val_ilr_data$ilr_predicted)^2
    val_rmse <- sqrt(mean(val_ilr_data$residuals^2))
    
    ilr_results[[ilr_var]] <- list(
      train_r2 = train_r2,
      train_rmse = train_rmse,
      val_r2 = val_r2,
      val_rmse = val_rmse,
      delta_r2 = train_r2 - val_r2
    )
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("    ", ilr_var, ": Train R²=", round(train_r2, 3), 
          ", Val R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
    }
    
    # Create plots for this ILR coordinate
    all_ilr_obs <- c(train_ilr_data$ilr_observed, val_ilr_data$ilr_observed)
    all_ilr_pred <- c(train_ilr_data$ilr_predicted, val_ilr_data$ilr_predicted)
    
    x_limits <- range(all_ilr_pred)
    y_limits <- range(all_ilr_obs)
    x_range <- diff(x_limits)
    y_range <- diff(y_limits)
    x_limits <- c(x_limits[1] - 0.05 * x_range, x_limits[2] + 0.05 * x_range)
    y_limits <- c(y_limits[1] - 0.05 * y_range, y_limits[2] + 0.05 * y_range)
    
    p_train_ilr <- ggplot(train_ilr_data, aes(x = ilr_predicted, y = ilr_observed)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title = paste(ilr_var, "- Training"),
        subtitle = paste0("R² = ", round(train_r2, 3), " | RMSE = ", round(train_rmse, 3)),
        x = paste("Predicted", ilr_var),
        y = paste("Observed", ilr_var)
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    
    p_val_ilr <- ggplot(val_ilr_data, aes(x = ilr_predicted, y = ilr_observed)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2, color = "darkorange") +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title = paste(ilr_var, "- Validation"),
        subtitle = paste0("R² = ", round(val_r2, 3), " | RMSE = ", round(val_rmse, 3)),
        x = paste("Predicted", ilr_var),
        y = paste("Observed", ilr_var)
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    
    ilr_plots[[ilr_var]] <- list(train = p_train_ilr, val = p_val_ilr)
  }
  
  # Create combined ILR plot
  ilr_combined <- plot_grid(
    ilr_plots$ILR_1$train, ilr_plots$ILR_1$val,
    ilr_plots$ILR_2$train, ilr_plots$ILR_2$val,
    ilr_plots$ILR_3$train, ilr_plots$ILR_3$val,
    ilr_plots$ILR_4$train, ilr_plots$ILR_4$val,
    ncol = 2
  )
  
  ilr_final <- plot_grid(
    ggdraw() + 
      draw_label("ILR Coordinate Space - Model Diagnostics", fontface = "bold", size = 16) +
      draw_label("5 Compositional Fractions → 4 Orthonormal ILR Coordinates", 
                 y = 0.3, size = 11, color = "grey40"),
    ilr_combined,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Granulometry_ILR_space_diagnostics.png"), 
         ilr_final, width = 14, height = 16, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  if (verbose) cat("  ✓ ILR space plot saved\n")
  
  # ============================================================
  # PART B: BACK-TRANSFORMED COMPOSITION SPACE
  # ============================================================
  
  if (verbose) cat("\n  🔄 Analyzing back-transformed composition space...\n")
  
  frac_results <- list()
  frac_plots <- list()
  
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    
    frac_pred_col <- paste0(frac, "_predicted")
    
    if (!frac_pred_col %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
      next
    }
    
    # Extract data
    train_frac_data <- train_data %>%
      mutate(
        observed = .data[[frac]],
        predicted = .data[[frac_pred_col]],
        residuals = observed - predicted
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))
    
    val_frac_data <- val_data %>%
      mutate(
        observed = .data[[frac]],
        predicted = .data[[frac_pred_col]],
        residuals = observed - predicted
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))
    
    # Calculate metrics
    train_r2 <- cor(train_frac_data$observed, train_frac_data$predicted)^2
    train_rmse <- sqrt(mean(train_frac_data$residuals^2))
    
    val_r2 <- cor(val_frac_data$observed, val_frac_data$predicted)^2
    val_rmse <- sqrt(mean(val_frac_data$residuals^2))
    
    frac_results[[frac]] <- list(
      train_r2 = train_r2,
      train_rmse = train_rmse,
      val_r2 = val_r2,
      val_rmse = val_rmse,
      delta_r2 = train_r2 - val_r2
    )
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("    ", frac, ": Train R²=", round(train_r2, 3), 
          ", Val R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
    }
    
    # Determine limits
    all_obs <- c(train_frac_data$observed, val_frac_data$observed)
    all_pred <- c(train_frac_data$predicted, val_frac_data$predicted)
    
    x_limits <- range(all_pred)
    y_limits <- range(all_obs)
    x_range <- diff(x_limits)
    y_range <- diff(y_limits)
    x_limits <- c(x_limits[1] - 0.05 * x_range, x_limits[2] + 0.05 * x_range)
    y_limits <- c(y_limits[1] - 0.05 * y_range, y_limits[2] + 0.05 * y_range)
    
    # Create plots
    frac_label <- gsub("_", " ", frac)
    
    p_train_frac <- ggplot(train_frac_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "steelblue") +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title = "Training Set",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "n = ", nrow(train_frac_data), " | ",
          "R² = ", round(train_r2, 3), " | ",
          "RMSE = ", round(train_rmse, 3), "%"
        ),
        x = paste("Predicted", frac_label, "(%)"),
        y = paste("Observed", frac_label, "(%)")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
      )
    
    p_val_frac <- ggplot(val_frac_data, aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "darkorange") +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      labs(
        title = "Validation Set",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "n = ", nrow(val_frac_data), " | ",
          "R² = ", round(val_r2, 3), " | ",
          "RMSE = ", round(val_rmse, 3), "%"
        ),
        x = paste("Predicted", frac_label, "(%)"),
        y = paste("Observed", frac_label, "(%)")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
      )
    
    p_resid_train_frac <- ggplot(train_frac_data, aes(x = predicted, y = residuals)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
      labs(
        title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Training)",
        x = paste("Fitted", frac_label, "(%)"),
        y = "Residuals (%)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    p_resid_val_frac <- ggplot(val_frac_data, aes(x = predicted, y = residuals)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "darkorange") +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
      labs(
        title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Validation)",
        x = paste("Fitted", frac_label, "(%)"),
        y = "Residuals (%)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    # Combine plots for this fraction
    frac_combined <- plot_grid(
      plot_grid(p_train_frac, p_val_frac, ncol = 2,
                labels = c("A. TRAINING", "B. VALIDATION"),
                label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
      plot_grid(p_resid_train_frac, p_resid_val_frac, ncol = 2,
                labels = c("C. RESIDUALS (TRAIN)", "D. RESIDUALS (VAL)"),
                label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
      nrow = 2
    )
    
    frac_final <- plot_grid(
      ggdraw() + 
        draw_label(
          paste("Back-Transformed Composition Space:", frac_label),
          fontface = "bold", size = 16
        ) +
        draw_label(
          paste0("Performance Drop: ΔR² = ", round(train_r2 - val_r2, 3),
                 " | R² Ratio (Val/Train) = ", round(val_r2 / train_r2, 3)),
          y = 0.3, size = 11, color = "grey40"
        ),
      frac_combined,
      ncol = 1,
      rel_heights = c(0.12, 1)
    )
    
    # Save individual fraction plot
    filename <- paste0(frac, "_observed_vs_fitted.png")
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename), frac_final,
           width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    frac_plots[[frac]] <- frac_final
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("  ✓ Back-transformed fraction plots saved\n")
  
  # Return comprehensive results
  return(list(
    ilr_results = ilr_results,
    fraction_results = frac_results,
    n_train = nrow(train_data),
    n_val = nrow(val_data)
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: PROCESS ALL NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

noncomp_results <- list()
noncomp_summary <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES)) {
  var_name <- NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES), "] Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    result <- create_observed_fitted_noncomp(
      var_name = var_name,
      data_sf = parcelles_all,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      noncomp_results[[var_name]] <- result
      
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Variable_Label = result$variable_label,
        Train_N = result$train_metrics$n,
        Train_R2 = result$train_metrics$r_squared,
        Train_RMSE = result$train_metrics$rmse,
        Train_Correlation = result$train_metrics$correlation,
        Val_N = result$val_metrics$n,
        Val_R2 = result$val_metrics$r_squared,
        Val_RMSE = result$val_metrics$rmse,
        Val_Correlation = result$val_metrics$correlation,
        Delta_R2 = result$performance_drop$delta_r2,
        Delta_RMSE = result$performance_drop$delta_rmse,
        R2_Ratio = result$performance_drop$r2_ratio,
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      noncomp_summary <- rbind(noncomp_summary, summary_row)
      cat("  ✅ SUCCESS\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ❌ FAILED:", e$message, "\n")
    
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Variable_Label = var_name,
      Train_N = NA, Train_R2 = NA, Train_RMSE = NA, Train_Correlation = NA,
      Val_N = NA, Val_R2 = NA, Val_RMSE = NA, Val_Correlation = NA,
      Delta_R2 = NA, Delta_RMSE = NA, R2_Ratio = NA,
      Status = paste("Failed:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    noncomp_summary <- rbind(noncomp_summary, summary_row)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: PROCESS COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

comp_result <- NULL
tryCatch({
  comp_result <- create_observed_fitted_compositional(
    data_sf = parcelles_all,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(comp_result)) {
    cat("  ✅ SUCCESS - Compositional analysis complete\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("  ❌ FAILED:", e$message, "\n")
})

# ============================================================================
# STEP 9: CREATE SUMMARY VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING SUMMARY VISUALIZATIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

if (nrow(noncomp_summary) > 0) {
  successful_noncomp <- noncomp_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")
  
  if (nrow(successful_noncomp) > 0) {
    
    # Performance drop plot
    p_perf_drop <- successful_noncomp %>%
      arrange(desc(Delta_R2)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Delta_R2))) +
      geom_col(aes(y = Delta_R2), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = "Non-Compositional Variables: Performance Drop Analysis",
        subtitle = paste("Analysis of", nrow(successful_noncomp), "successfully validated variables"),
        x = "Variable",
        y = "ΔR² (Training R² - Validation R²)",
        caption = "Positive values indicate overfitting"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "noncomp_performance_drop_summary.png"),
           p_perf_drop, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # R² comparison plot
    p_r2_comp <- successful_noncomp %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Train_R2, y = Val_R2)) +
      geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Variable), vjust = -0.8, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
      labs(
        title = "Training vs Validation R²",
        subtitle = "Points below diagonal indicate overfitting",
        x = "Training R²",
        y = "Validation R²"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "noncomp_train_vs_val_r2_comparison.png"),
           p_r2_comp, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    cat("✅ Non-compositional summary plots saved\n")
  }
}

# Create compositional summary if available
if (!is.null(comp_result)) {
  
  # ILR space summary
  ilr_summary_df <- data.frame(
    ILR_Coordinate = paste0("ILR_", 1:4),
    Train_R2 = sapply(comp_result$ilr_results, function(x) x$train_r2),
    Val_R2 = sapply(comp_result$ilr_results, function(x) x$val_r2),
    Delta_R2 = sapply(comp_result$ilr_results, function(x) x$delta_r2),
    Train_RMSE = sapply(comp_result$ilr_results, function(x) x$train_rmse),
    Val_RMSE = sapply(comp_result$ilr_results, function(x) x$val_rmse)
  )
  
  p_ilr_summary <- ilr_summary_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Train_R2, y = Val_R2)) +
    geom_point(size = 5, color = "purple", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ILR_Coordinate), vjust = -1, size = 4) +
    labs(
      title = "ILR Coordinates: Training vs Validation R²",
      subtitle = "Performance in orthonormal ILR space",
      x = "Training R²",
      y = "Validation R²"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "compositional_ILR_performance.png"),
         p_ilr_summary, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Back-transformed fractions summary
  frac_summary_df <- data.frame(
    Fraction = GRANULO_FRACTIONS,
    Train_R2 = sapply(comp_result$fraction_results, function(x) x$train_r2),
    Val_R2 = sapply(comp_result$fraction_results, function(x) x$val_r2),
    Delta_R2 = sapply(comp_result$fraction_results, function(x) x$delta_r2),
    Train_RMSE = sapply(comp_result$fraction_results, function(x) x$train_rmse),
    Val_RMSE = sapply(comp_result$fraction_results, function(x) x$val_rmse)
  )
  
  p_frac_summary <- frac_summary_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Train_R2, y = Val_R2)) +
    geom_point(size = 5, color = "darkorange", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = gsub("_percent", "", Fraction)), vjust = -1, size = 3.5) +
    labs(
      title = "Back-Transformed Fractions: Training vs Validation R²",
      subtitle = "Performance after ILR inverse transformation",
      x = "Training R²",
      y = "Validation R²"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "compositional_fractions_performance.png"),
         p_frac_summary, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("✅ Compositional summary plots saved\n")
}

# STEP 10: SAVE COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS

cat("\n💾 SAVING COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

# Save summaries
write_csv(noncomp_summary, file.path(output_dir, "noncomp_diagnostics_summary.csv"))

if (!is.null(comp_result)) {
  write_csv(ilr_summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "compositional_ILR_summary.csv"))
  write_csv(frac_summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "compositional_fractions_summary.csv"))
}

# Save all results
save(noncomp_results, comp_result, noncomp_summary,
     file = file.path(output_dir, "all_diagnostics_results.RData"))

cat("✅ Results saved\n")

# ============================================================================
cat("\n📝 CREATING COMPREHENSIVE REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

report_content <- paste0(
  "# COMPREHENSIVE FITTED vs OBSERVED DIAGNOSTICS REPORT\n",
  "Generated: ", Sys.time(), "\n\n",
  
  "## OVERVIEW\n",
  "This report presents model diagnostics for both compositional (granulometry)\n",
  "and non-compositional soil variables.\n\n",
  
  "### Compositional Variables (Granulometry)\n",
  "- Analyzed in ILR (Isometric Log-Ratio) space: 5 fractions → 4 coordinates\n",
  "- Back-transformed to original composition space for interpretation\n",
  "- Ensures compositional constraint (sum = 100%)\n\n",
  
  "### Non-Compositional Variables\n",
  "- Direct modeling without compositional constraints\n",
  "- Standard spatio-temporal framework\n\n"
)

# Add non-compositional results
if (nrow(noncomp_summary) > 0) {
  successful <- noncomp_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")
  
  if (nrow(successful) > 0) {
    report_content <- paste0(
      report_content,
      "## NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES RESULTS\n",
      "Successfully analyzed: ", nrow(successful), " variables\n\n",
      
      "### Overall Performance:\n",
      "- Mean Training R²: ", round(mean(successful$Train_R2), 3), "\n",
      "- Mean Validation R²: ", round(mean(successful$Val_R2), 3), "\n",
      "- Mean Performance Drop (ΔR²): ", round(mean(successful$Delta_R2), 3), "\n",
      "- Mean R² Ratio (Val/Train): ", round(mean(successful$R2_Ratio), 3), "\n\n",
      
      "### Top 5 Performers (by Validation R²):\n"
    )
    
    top5 <- successful %>% arrange(desc(Val_R2)) %>% head(5)
    for (i in 1:nrow(top5)) {
      report_content <- paste0(
        report_content,
        i, ". ", top5$Variable[i], ": Val R² = ", round(top5$Val_R2[i], 3),
        ", ΔR² = ", round(top5$Delta_R2[i], 3), "\n"
      )
    }
    
    report_content <- paste0(report_content, "\n")
  }
}

# Add compositional results
if (!is.null(comp_result)) {
  report_content <- paste0(
    report_content,
    "## COMPOSITIONAL GRANULOMETRY RESULTS\n",
    "Training observations: ", comp_result$n_train, "\n",
    "Validation observations: ", comp_result$n_val, "\n\n",
    
    "### ILR Space Performance:\n"
  )
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", i)
    ilr_res <- comp_result$ilr_results[[ilr_var]]
    report_content <- paste0(
      report_content,
      "- ", ilr_var, ": Train R² = ", round(ilr_res$train_r2, 3),
      ", Val R² = ", round(ilr_res$val_r2, 3),
      ", ΔR² = ", round(ilr_res$delta_r2, 3), "\n"
    )
  }
  
  report_content <- paste0(
    report_content,
    "\n### Back-Transformed Fractions Performance:\n"
  )
  
  for (frac in GRANULO_FRACTIONS) {
    frac_res <- comp_result$fraction_results[[frac]]
    report_content <- paste0(
      report_content,
      "- ", frac, ": Train R² = ", round(frac_res$train_r2, 3),
      ", Val R² = ", round(frac_res$val_r2, 3),
      ", RMSE = ", round(frac_res$val_rmse, 2), "%\n"
    )
  }
  
  report_content <- paste0(report_content, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
output_dir <- "journal_combined_plots"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================

GRANULO_FRACTIONS <- c(
```
