```{r}
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES <- c(
  "pH",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
  "Mg_K_Ratio"
)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: JOURNAL-STYLE COMBINED PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

create_journal_combined_plot <- function(var_name, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("📊", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Clean variable label with shortened nutrient names
  var_label <- gsub("_", " ", var_name)
  var_label <- gsub("percent", "%", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("per mille", "‰", var_label)
  
  # Shorten exchangeable nutrient names
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Calcium", "Exch. Ca", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Magnesium", "Exch. Mg", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Potassium", "Exch. K", var_label)
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ Skipping - columns not found\n")
      cat("     Looking for:", pred_col, "and", pred_type_col, "\n")
      available_cols <- colnames(data_sf)[grepl(var_name, colnames(data_sf))]
      if (length(available_cols) > 0) {
        cat("     Available columns:", paste(available_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ⚠️ No valid data\n")
      # Debug: check what we have
      temp_data <- data_sf %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::select(matches(var_name))
      cat("     Rows in dataset:", nrow(data_sf), "\n")
      cat("     Non-NA in", var_name, ":", sum(!is.na(data_sf[[var_name]])), "\n")
      cat("     Non-NA in", pred_col, ":", sum(!is.na(data_sf[[pred_col]])), "\n")
      if (pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
        cat("     Prediction types:", paste(unique(data_sf[[pred_type_col]]), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate metrics by dataset
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  train_corr <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)
  val_corr <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)
  
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Determine axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Format units for axis labels
  unit_label <- ""
  if (grepl("percent|%", var_label, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- " (%)"
  } else if (grepl("meq", var_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- " (meq/100g)"
  } else if (grepl("mille", var_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- " (‰)"
  } else if (grepl("Ratio", var_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- ""
  } else if (var_name == "pH") {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- ""
  } else {
    unit_label <- ""
    axis_label_suffix <- ""
  }
  
  # Create beautiful combined plot (matching your original style)
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    # 1:1 reference line (prominent)
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    
    # Smooth regression lines with confidence bands
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    
    # Data points on top
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    
    # Color and fill scheme (distinct and colorblind-friendly)
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Shape scheme
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Axis limits (equal aspect ratio)
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    
    # Labels with LARGER fonts
    labs(
      x = paste0("Observed ", var_label, axis_label_suffix),
      y = paste0("Predicted ", var_label, axis_label_suffix),
      title = var_label
    ) +
    
    # Custom annotation for metrics (larger text)
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22, 0.29, 0.36, 0.43) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Training:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse),
        ""
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.50, 0.57, 0.64, 0.71, 0.78) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Validation:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    
    # Beautiful theme with larger fonts
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      # Title
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      
      # Axis titles and text (LARGER)
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      
      # Remove legend (we have annotations)
      legend.position = "none",
      
      # Panel
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  # Save high-resolution figure (larger size for detailed plot)
  # Using 140mm width for better readability with annotations
  filename <- paste0(var_name, "_journal_combined.png")
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Also save PDF version
  filename_pdf <- paste0(var_name, "_journal_combined.pdf")
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename_pdf), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Train: n=", nrow(train_data), ", R²=", round(train_r2, 3), 
        ", RMSE=", round(train_rmse, 3), "\n")
    cat("  ✓ Valid: n=", nrow(val_data), ", R²=", round(val_r2, 3), 
        ", RMSE=", round(val_rmse, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    variable = var_name,
    train_n = nrow(train_data),
    train_r2 = train_r2,
    train_rmse = train_rmse,
    train_corr = train_corr,
    val_n = nrow(val_data),
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    val_rmse = val_rmse,
    val_corr = val_corr
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: ILR TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS (FOR COMPOSITIONAL)
# ============================================================================

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: JOURNAL PLOT FOR ILR COORDINATES
# ============================================================================

create_journal_combined_plot_ilr <- function(ilr_index, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("📊", ilr_var, "\n")
  }
  
  # Check for complete granulometry data
  comp_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Clay_percent), 
           !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ILR_1_predicted))
  
  if (nrow(comp_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No compositional data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Determine dataset split
  if ("Clay_percent_prediction_type" %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
    comp_data <- comp_data %>%
      mutate(Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "train" ~ "Training",
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      ))
  } else {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ No prediction type\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  comp_data <- comp_data %>% filter(!is.na(Dataset))
  
  # Split data
  train_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️ Insufficient data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Compute observed ILR from original composition
  train_comp <- train_data %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  train_comp[train_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  train_comp <- train_comp / rowSums(train_comp) * 100
  train_ilr <- ilr_transform(train_comp / 100)
  
  val_comp <- val_data %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  val_comp[val_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  val_comp <- val_comp / rowSums(val_comp) * 100
  val_ilr <- ilr_transform(val_comp / 100)
  
  # Prepare plot data
  pred_col <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index, "_predicted")
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    train_data %>% mutate(
      Observed = train_ilr[, ilr_index],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]]
    ),
    val_data %>% mutate(
      Observed = val_ilr[, ilr_index],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]]
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  # Calculate metrics
  train_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_subset$Observed, train_subset$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_subset$Observed, val_subset$Predicted)^2
  train_corr <- cor(train_subset$Observed, train_subset$Predicted)
  val_corr <- cor(val_subset$Observed, val_subset$Predicted)
  
  train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_subset$Observed - train_subset$Predicted)^2))
  val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_subset$Observed - val_subset$Predicted)^2))
  
  # Axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Predicted ", ilr_var),
      y = paste0("Observed ", ilr_var),
      title = paste("ILR Coordinate", ilr_index)
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.15, 0.22, 0.29, 0.36, 0.43) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Training:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_subset)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse),
        ""
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.50, 0.57, 0.64, 0.71, 0.78) * val_span,
      label = c(
        "Validation:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_subset)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  # Save
  filename <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index, "_journal_combined.png")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename), p, width = 140, height = 140, 
         units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  
  filename_pdf <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index, "_journal_combined.pdf")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename_pdf), p, width = 140, height = 140, 
         units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✓ Train: n=", nrow(train_subset), ", R²=", round(train_r2, 3), "\n")
    cat("  ✓ Valid: n=", nrow(val_subset), ", R²=", round(val_r2, 3), "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    variable = ilr_var,
    train_n = nrow(train_subset),
    train_r2 = train_r2,
    train_rmse = train_rmse,
    train_corr = train_corr,
    val_n = nrow(val_subset),
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    val_rmse = val_rmse,
    val_corr = val_corr
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: PROCESS ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 CREATING JOURNAL-STYLE COMBINED PLOTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 42), "\n", sep="")

results_summary <- list()

# Process non-compositional variables
cat("\n[NON-COMPOSITIONAL VARIABLES]\n")
for (i in seq_along(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES)) {
  var_name <- NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES[i]
  cat(sprintf("[%2d/%2d] ", i, length(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES)))
  
  result <- create_journal_combined_plot(var_name, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_name]] <- result
  }
}

# Process compositional fractions (back-transformed)
cat("\n[COMPOSITIONAL FRACTIONS - BACK-TRANSFORMED]\n")
for (i in seq_along(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) {
  var_name <- GRANULO_FRACTIONS[i]
  cat(sprintf("[%2d/%2d] ", i, length(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)))
  
  result <- create_journal_combined_plot(var_name, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_name]] <- result
  }
}

# Process ILR coordinates
cat("\n[ILR COORDINATES]\n")
for (i in 1:4) {
  cat(sprintf("[%2d/%2d] ", i, 4))
  
  result <- create_journal_combined_plot_ilr(i, parcelles_all, verbose = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[paste0("ILR_", i)]] <- result
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING SUMMARY TABLE:\n")

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_summary), function(var) {
  res <- results_summary[[var]]
  data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    Train_N = res$train_n,
    Train_R2 = round(res$train_r2, 3),
    Train_RMSE = round(res$train_rmse, 3),
    Train_Corr = round(res$train_corr, 3),
    Val_N = res$val_n,
    Val_R2 = round(res$val_r2, 3),
    Val_RMSE = round(res$val_rmse, 3),
    Val_Corr = round(res$val_corr, 3),
    Delta_R2 = round(res$train_r2 - res$val_r2, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write_csv(summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "journal_combined_plots_summary.csv"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# GRID PLOT FOR ALL VARIABLES

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)  # For combining plots
library(scales)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  ALL VARIABLES GRID PLOT             \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================
base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_all_vars <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")

if (!file.exists(gpkg_all_vars)) {
  stop("❌ Dataset not found.")
}

parcelles_all <- st_read(gpkg_all_vars, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Data loaded:", nrow(parcelles_all), "observations\n")

# Output directory
output_dir <- "journal_combined_plots"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ============================================================================
# ALL VARIABLES WITH CUSTOM LABELS
# ============================================================================
ALL_VARS <- c(
  "Clay_percent",
  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent",
  "pH",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille",
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille",
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
  "Mg_K_Ratio"
)

CUSTOM_LABELS <- c(
  "Clay (%)",
  "Fine Silt (%)",
  "Coarse Silt (%)",
  "Fine Sand (%)",
  "Coarse Sand (%)",
  "pH",
  "Exch. Ca (meq/100g)",
  "Exch. Mg (meq/100g)",
  "Exch. K (meq/100g)",
  "Organic C (‰)",
  "Total N (‰)",
  "Mg/Ca Ratio",
  "Mg/K Ratio"
)

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION TO CREATE INDIVIDUAL PANEL (COMPACT VERSION)
# ============================================================================
create_panel_plot <- function(var_name, panel_label, data_sf) {
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate metrics by dataset
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 || nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  
  # Determine axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create compact panel plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    # 1:1 reference line
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    
    # Smooth regression lines with confidence bands
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8) +
    
    # Data points
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    
    # Color scheme
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Equal aspect ratio
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    
    # Labels (compact)
    labs(
      x = "Observed",
      y = "Predicted",
      title = panel_label
    ) +
    
    # Compact annotation with R² only
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span,
      y = axis_limits[2] - c(0.08, 0.16) * val_span,
      label = c(
        sprintf("Train: R²=%.2f", train_r2),
        sprintf("Valid: R²=%.2f", val_r2)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3,
      color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    
    # Minimal theme for grid
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================================================
# CREATE ALL PANELS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 Creating individual panels...\n")

plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(ALL_VARS)) {
  var_name <- ALL_VARS[i]
  label <- CUSTOM_LABELS[i]
  
  cat(sprintf("[%2d/%2d] %s\n", i, length(ALL_VARS), label))
  
  p <- create_panel_plot(var_name, label, parcelles_all)
  
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_list[[label]] <- p
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️ Skipped\n")
  }
}

cat("\n✅ Created", length(plot_list), "panels\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE INTO SMART GRID
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📐 Assembling grid layout...\n")

if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  # Create a 4x4 grid (adjust based on number of variables)
  n_plots <- length(plot_list)
  n_cols <- 4
  n_rows <- ceiling(n_plots / n_cols)
  
  # Combine all plots using patchwork
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = n_cols) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Model Performance: Observed vs Predicted",
      subtitle = "Training (blue) and Validation (orange) datasets",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10))
      )
    )
  
  # Save high-resolution grid
  width_mm <- 210  # A4 width
  height_mm <- n_rows * 50  # Dynamic height based on rows
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, "ALL_VARIABLES_grid_combined.png"),
    combined_plot,
    width = width_mm,
    height = height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, "ALL_VARIABLES_grid_combined.pdf"),
    combined_plot,
    width = width_mm,
    height = height_mm,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("\n✅ Grid plot saved!\n")
  cat("   Dimensions:", width_mm, "mm ×", height_mm, "mm\n")
  cat("   Layout:", n_rows, "rows ×", n_cols, "columns\n")
  cat("   Variables included:", length(plot_list), "\n")
  
} else {
  cat("\n❌ No valid plots created\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")
cat("✅ ALL VARIABLES GRID PLOT COMPLETE!\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

cat("\n📁 OUTPUT FILES:\n")
cat("  • ALL_VARIABLES_grid_combined.png\n")
cat("  • ALL_VARIABLES_grid_combined.pdf\n")
cat("\n📊 INCLUDED VARIABLES:\n")
for (label in names(plot_list)) {
  cat("  •", label, "\n")
}

cat("\n✅ Publication-ready grid figure created!\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DEFINE CUTE AESTHETIC THEME
# ============================================================================
theme_cute <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      # Plot elements
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11, 
        face = "bold", 
        hjust = 0, 
        margin = margin(b = 10),
        color = "#2c3e50"
      ),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fafafa", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "#bdc3c7", linewidth = 0.8),
      
      # Soft grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "#ecf0f1", 
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      
      # Axis
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "#34495e"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "#34495e", angle = 90, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#95a5a6", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "mm"),
      
      # Legend - compact and subtle
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "#34495e"),
      legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
      legend.key = element_rect(color = "#bdc3c7", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#fafafa", color = NA),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 5, b = 0),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "mm"),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

library(RColorBrewer)

# For 23 blocks, we need to combine multiple palettes
# Use colorful, qualitative palettes from RColorBrewer
if (n_blocs <= 12) {
  # Use Set3 for smaller number of blocks (pastel colors)
  cute_bloc_colors <- brewer.pal(min(n_blocs, 12), "Set3")
} else {
  # For more blocks, combine multiple palettes

  pal2 <- brewer.pal(8, "Pastel2")    # More pastels
  pal3 <- brewer.pal(9, "Pastel1")    # Even more pastels

  # Take only what we need
  cute_bloc_colors <- all_colors[1:n_blocs]
```

# VII.  TRANSFORMATIONS FOR PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# RANSFORMATIONS FOR PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL
# Applies Z-score outlier removal BEFORE transformations to address funnel effects and extreme values
# Processes only: CN_Ratio, Available_P2O5_mg_kg, Compaction_Index, 
#                 Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm, Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(spdep)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  ENHANCED TRANSFORMATIONS WITH         \n")
cat("  Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL               \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD THE COMPLETE DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
  cat("✅ Complete dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_complete), "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ Complete dataset not found. Please run the enhanced join script first.\n")
  stop("Dataset not available")
}

# Define problematic variables with their transformations
problematic_variables <- list(
  "CN_Ratio" = list(
    original = "CN_Ratio",
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for funnel effect",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,  # Will be handled by Z-score
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" = list(
    original = "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", 
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for funnel effect",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,  # Will be handled by Z-score
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Compaction_Index" = list(
    original = "Compaction_Index",
    transformation = "log", 
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation + Student-t distribution for extreme values",
    distribution = "gaussian",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,  # Will be handled by Z-score
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" = list(
    original = "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for variance issues",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,  # Will be handled by Z-score
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" = list(
    original = "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g", 
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for variance issues",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,  # Will be handled by Z-score
    zscore_threshold = 3
  )
)

cat("Variables to process with Z-score outlier removal + transformations:\n")
for (i in seq_along(problematic_variables)) {
  var_info <- problematic_variables[[i]]
  var_name <- names(problematic_variables)[i]
  cat(sprintf("• %s: %s (Z-score threshold: %s)\n", var_name, var_info$description, var_info$zscore_threshold))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: RECREATE SPATIAL STRUCTURES (MEMORY EFFICIENT)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ RECREATING SPATIAL STRUCTURES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# Create spatial weights matrix W.P1
cat("Computing boundary-to-boundary distances (this may take time)...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated:", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("Using distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Create adjacency matrix
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)

cat("✅ W.P1 matrix created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")

# Create temporal structure
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
remove_zscore_outliers <- function(data, variable_name, threshold = 3, verbose = TRUE) {
  # Remove outliers based on Z-score threshold
  # 
  # Args:
  #   data: dataframe containing the variable
  #   variable_name: name of the variable column
  #   threshold: Z-score threshold (default = 3)
  #   verbose: whether to print details
  # 
  # Returns:
  #   Modified dataframe with outliers set to NA
  
  original_values <- data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(original_values)
  n_available_before <- sum(!is.na(original_values))
  
  if (n_available_before < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Insufficient data for Z-score outlier removal\n")
    return(data)
  }
  
  # Calculate Z-scores
  mean_val <- mean(original_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_val <- sd(original_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (sd_val == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Zero standard deviation - no outliers removed\n")
    return(data)
  }
  
  z_scores <- abs((original_values - mean_val) / sd_val)
  
  # Identify outliers
  outliers <- !is.na(z_scores) & z_scores > threshold
  n_outliers <- sum(outliers)
  
  # Remove outliers (set to NA)
  data_modified <- data
  data_modified[[variable_name]][outliers] <- NA
  
  n_available_after <- sum(!is.na(data_modified[[variable_name]]))
  pct_removed <- round((n_outliers / n_available_before) * 100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  🗑️  Z-score outlier removal (threshold =", threshold, "):\n")
    cat("    • Original available:", n_available_before, "\n")
    cat("    • Outliers removed:", n_outliers, "(", pct_removed, "%)\n")
    cat("    • Remaining available:", n_available_after, "\n")
    if (n_outliers > 0) {
      outlier_values <- original_values[outliers]
      cat("    • Outlier range:", round(min(outlier_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "to", 
          round(max(outlier_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("    • Max Z-score removed:", round(max(z_scores[outliers], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  return(data_modified)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: ENHANCED IMPUTATION FUNCTION WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL
# ============================================================================
impute_transformed_variable_with_zscore <- function(variable_info, variable_key, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING TRANSFORMED VARIABLE WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL:", variable_key, "\n")
    cat("Original variable:", variable_info$original, "\n")
    cat("Z-score threshold:", variable_info$zscore_threshold, "\n")
    cat("Transformation:", variable_info$transformation, "\n")
    cat("Description:", variable_info$description, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Get original values
  original_var <- variable_info$original
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[original_var]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Original variable statistics:\n")
    cat("• Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
    cat("• Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing (NA):", n_missing, "(", round(n_missing/n_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
    
    if (n_available > 0) {
      cat("• Min value:", round(min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Max value:", round(max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Mean value:", round(mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Std deviation:", round(sd(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Skip if insufficient data
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create working dataset
  working_data <- parcelles_data
  
  # STEP 1: Apply Z-score outlier removal FIRST
  if (verbose) cat("\n🎯 STEP 1: Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL\n")
  working_data <- remove_zscore_outliers(
    working_data, 
    original_var, 
    threshold = variable_info$zscore_threshold, 
    verbose = verbose
  )
  
  # Check remaining data after Z-score removal
  n_available_after_zscore <- sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
  if (n_available_after_zscore < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data after Z-score removal (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # STEP 2: Apply additional outlier removal if specified (legacy support)
  if (variable_info$outlier_removal && !is.null(variable_info$outlier_threshold)) {
    if (verbose) cat("\n🗑️ STEP 2: ADDITIONAL OUTLIER REMOVAL\n")
    threshold <- variable_info$outlier_threshold
    outliers_removed <- sum(working_data[[original_var]] > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!original_var := ifelse(.data[[original_var]] > threshold, NA, .data[[original_var]]))
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  • Additional threshold:", threshold, "\n")
      cat("  • Additional values removed:", outliers_removed, "\n")
      n_available_after_additional <- sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
      cat("  • Remaining available:", n_available_after_additional, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # STEP 3: Apply transformation
  if (verbose) cat("\n📈 STEP 3: APPLYING TRANSFORMATION\n")
  transform_name <- paste0(original_var, "_transformed")
  
  if (variable_info$transformation == "log") {
    # Use log(x+1) to handle zeros
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!transform_name := log(.data[[original_var]] + 1))
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ✅ Log(x+1) transformation applied\n")
      transformed_values <- working_data[[transform_name]]
      n_transformed <- sum(!is.na(transformed_values))
      if (n_transformed > 0) {
        cat("  • Transformed min:", round(min(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed max:", round(max(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed mean:", round(mean(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed std:", round(sd(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    # No transformation, just copy
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!transform_name := .data[[original_var]])
  }
  
  # Create train/validation split
  observed_data <- working_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[transform_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)  # Consistent split
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  # Apply split
  working_data_split <- working_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[transform_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train", 
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  train_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "validation")
  pred_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "predict")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n📊 STEP 4: DATA SPLIT\n")
    cat("  • Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("  • Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("  • To predict:", pred_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  # Prepare INLA dataset
  df_inla <- working_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[transform_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true_original = .data[[original_var]],
      Y_true_transformed = .data[[transform_name]], 
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = row_number(),
      unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year, replicate_id)
  
  # Check compatibility
  if (max(df_inla$ID.Field) > nrow(W_matrix)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible. Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("\n🚀 STEP 5: FITTING ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL\n")
  
  # Determine distribution family
  family_to_use <- "gaussian"
  if (!is.null(variable_info$distribution) && variable_info$distribution == "t") {
    family_to_use <- "T"  # Student-t distribution in INLA
    if (verbose) cat("  📊 Using Student-t distribution for robustness\n")
  }
  
  # Fit model
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = family_to_use,
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Full model failed. Trying simpler model...\n")
    
    # Try simpler model
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = family_to_use,
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) {
      if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Simple model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result) || is.null(fit_result$summary.fitted.values)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model fitting failed completely\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✅ Model successful! Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$dic)) cat("  • DIC:", round(fit_result$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$waic)) cat("  • WAIC:", round(fit_result$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
  }
  
  # Extract predictions
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  # Back-transform predictions if needed
  if (variable_info$transformation == "log") {
    predictions_original <- list(
      mean = exp(predictions$mean) - 1,
      sd = exp(predictions$mean) * predictions$sd,  # Delta method approximation
      `0.025quant` = exp(predictions$`0.025quant`) - 1,
      `0.975quant` = exp(predictions$`0.975quant`) - 1
    )
    
    # Ensure no negative values after transformation
    predictions_original$mean <- pmax(predictions_original$mean, 0)
    predictions_original$`0.025quant` <- pmax(predictions_original$`0.025quant`, 0)
    predictions_original$`0.975quant` <- pmax(predictions_original$`0.975quant`, 0)
    
    if (verbose) cat("  🔄 Back-transformation applied (exp(x) - 1)\n")
  } else {
    predictions_original <- predictions
  }
  
  # Create predictions dataframe with both scales
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      # Transformed scale predictions
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      
      # Original scale predictions  
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted") := predictions_original$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_sd") := predictions_original$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_lower") := predictions_original$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_upper") := predictions_original$`0.975quant`,
      
      # Complete dataset (original scale)
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y_true_original,
        TRUE ~ predictions_original$mean
      ),
      
      # Prediction type
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_prediction_type") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
        data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation", 
        data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate validation metrics (on original scale)
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true_original), !is.na(predictions_original$mean))
  
  metrics <- list(
    variable = variable_key,
    original_variable = original_var,
    transformation = variable_info$transformation,
    distribution = ifelse(is.null(variable_info$distribution), "gaussian", variable_info$distribution),
    zscore_threshold = variable_info$zscore_threshold,
    n_outliers_removed = n_available - sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
  )
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true_original
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- r_squared
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$mean_error <- mean(true_vals - pred_vals)
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    # Coverage probability (original scale)
    in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true_original >= validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_lower")]] & 
                      validation_data$Y_true_original <= validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_upper")]])
    metrics$coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 STEP 6: VALIDATION RESULTS (ORIGINAL SCALE)\n")
      cat("  • Validation obs:", metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      cat("  • R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • Correlation:", round(metrics$correlation, 4), "\n") 
      cat("  • RMSE:", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • MAE:", round(metrics$mae, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • Coverage:", round(metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("  • Z-score outliers removed:", metrics$n_outliers_removed, "\n")
    }
  } else {
    metrics$r_squared <- NA
    metrics$correlation <- NA
    metrics$rmse <- NA
    metrics$mae <- NA
    metrics$mean_error <- NA
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    metrics$coverage_prob <- NA
    
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient validation data for metrics\n")
  }
  
  # Create return object
  result <- list(
    variable_name = variable_key,
    original_variable = original_var,
    transformation_info = variable_info,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]])),  # After all outlier removal
    n_missing = sum(is.na(working_data[[original_var]])),
    pct_available = round(sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))/n_total*100, 1),
    n_zscore_outliers_removed = metrics$n_outliers_removed
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: PROCESS ALL PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING ALL", length(problematic_variables), "PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")

# Initialize results storage
enhanced_results <- list()
enhanced_metrics <- data.frame()
enhanced_failed <- character(0)
start_processing <- Sys.time()

# Process each problematic variable
for (i in seq_along(problematic_variables)) {
  var_key <- names(problematic_variables)[i]
  var_info <- problematic_variables[[i]]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(problematic_variables), "] Processing:", var_key, "\n")
  
  result <- impute_transformed_variable_with_zscore(
    variable_info = var_info,
    variable_key = var_key,
    parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
    W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
    field_map = field_mapping,
    year_map = year_mapping,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    enhanced_results[[var_key]] <- result
    
    # Store metrics
    metrics_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_key,
      Original_Variable = var_info$original,
      Transformation = var_info$transformation,
      Distribution = ifelse(is.null(var_info$distribution), "gaussian", var_info$distribution),
      ZScore_Threshold = var_info$zscore_threshold,
      ZScore_Outliers_Removed = result$n_zscore_outliers_removed,
      Outlier_Removal = var_info$outlier_removal,
      N_Total = result$n_total,
      N_Available = result$n_available,
      N_Missing = result$n_missing,
      Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
      Fitting_Time_Min = result$fitting_time,
      R_Squared = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$r_squared), NA, result$metrics$r_squared),
      Correlation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$correlation), NA, result$metrics$correlation),
      RMSE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$rmse), NA, result$metrics$rmse),
      MAE = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$mae), NA, result$metrics$mae),
      Coverage_Prob = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$coverage_prob), NA, result$metrics$coverage_prob),
      N_Validation = ifelse(is.null(result$metrics$n_validation), 0, result$metrics$n_validation),
      DIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$dic), NA, result$model_fit$dic$dic),
      WAIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$waic), NA, result$model_fit$waic$waic),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    enhanced_metrics <- rbind(enhanced_metrics, metrics_row)
    cat("✅ SUCCESS for", var_key, "\n")
  } else {
    enhanced_failed <- c(enhanced_failed, var_key)
    cat("❌ FAILED for", var_key, "\n")
  }
  
  # Memory cleanup
  gc()
}

end_processing <- Sys.time()
total_processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_processing, start_processing, units = "mins"))

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: COMBINE ENHANCED PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 COMBINING ENHANCED PREDICTIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 38), "\n", sep="")

successful_enhanced <- names(enhanced_results)
cat("Successfully processed variables:", length(successful_enhanced), "\n")

if (length(successful_enhanced) > 0) {
  # Start with original dataset
  enhanced_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>% 
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = row_number(),
      unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Add geometry back
  enhanced_dataset <- parcelles_complete %>%
    mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(
      enhanced_dataset %>% 
        mutate(original_row_id = row_number()) %>%
        dplyr::select(original_row_id, replicate_id, unique_key),
      by = "original_row_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-original_row_id)
  
  # Add predictions for each variable
  for (i in seq_along(successful_enhanced)) {
    var_key <- successful_enhanced[i]
    result <- enhanced_results[[var_key]]
    
    cat("\n[", i, "/", length(successful_enhanced), "] Adding predictions for:", var_key, "\n")
    
    # Create reference dataset matching INLA processing
    df_inla_reference <- parcelles_complete %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%  
      left_join(year_mapping, by = "Year") %>%  
      filter(!is.na(Sequential_ID), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>% 
      group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year) %>%
      mutate(
        replicate_id = row_number(),
        unique_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep", replicate_id)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(Sequential_ID, ID.Year, replicate_id)
    
    if (nrow(df_inla_reference) == nrow(result$predictions)) {
      # Align predictions
      predictions_aligned <- df_inla_reference %>% 
        dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id, unique_key) %>% 
        bind_cols(
          result$predictions %>% 
            dplyr::select(matches(paste0("^", var_key, "_")))
        )
      
      # Join to main dataset
      enhanced_dataset <- enhanced_dataset %>% 
        left_join(
          predictions_aligned %>% dplyr::select(-Final_Cleaned_ID, -Year, -replicate_id),
          by = "unique_key"
        )
      
      # Check success
      pred_col <- paste0(var_key, "_predicted")
      if (pred_col %in% colnames(enhanced_dataset)) {
        non_null_count <- sum(!is.na(enhanced_dataset[[pred_col]]))
        cat("  ✅ Successfully added", non_null_count, "predictions\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("  ❌ Row count mismatch - skipping\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n✅ Enhanced dataset created\n")
  cat("• Total observations:", nrow(enhanced_dataset), "\n")
  cat("• Total columns:", ncol(enhanced_dataset), "\n")
  
  # Show prediction summary
  pred_cols <- colnames(enhanced_dataset)[grepl("_predicted$", colnames(enhanced_dataset))]
  if (length(pred_cols) > 0) {
    cat("\n📊 ENHANCED PREDICTIONS SUMMARY:\n")

      cat("Skipping", var_key, "- insufficient validation data\n")
      next

    # Extract values for plotting

    upper_col <- paste0(var_key, "_predicted_upper")
    
    observed <- val_data$Y_true_original
    predicted <- val_data[[pred_col]]
    lower <- val_data[[lower_col]]
    upper <- val_data[[upper_col]]
    
    # Create diagnostic plot data
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Observed = observed,
      Predicted = predicted,
      Lower = lower,
      Upper = upper,
      Residuals = observed - predicted
    )
    
    # 1:1 plot with uncertainty
    p_diag <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), alpha = 0.3, color = "gray50") +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Enhanced Model Validation with Z-Score Outlier Removal:", var_key),
        subtitle = paste("Z-outliers removed:", result$n_zscore_outliers_removed,
                        "| Transformation:", result$transformation_info$transformation, 
                        "| R² =", round(result$metrics$r_squared, 3),
                        "| RMSE =", round(result$metrics$rmse, 3)),
        x = paste("Observed", result$original_variable, "(outliers removed)"),
        y = paste("Predicted", result$original_variable),
        caption = paste("Coverage:", round(result$metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
    
    # Save diagnostic plot
    ggsave(paste0(base_path, "ENHANCED_diagnostic_", var_key, ".png"), p_diag, width = 10, height = 6)
    cat("✅ Diagnostic plot saved for", var_key, "\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 10: CREATE Z-SCORE OUTLIER ANALYSIS PLOTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📈 CREATING Z-SCORE OUTLIER ANALYSIS PLOTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

if (length(successful_enhanced) > 0) {
  # Create before/after comparison plots for each variable
  for (var_key in successful_enhanced) {
    result <- enhanced_results[[var_key]]
    original_var <- result$original_variable
    
    # Get original data
    original_values <- parcelles_complete[[original_var]]
    original_values <- original_values[!is.na(original_values)]
    
    if (length(original_values) < 10) next
    
    # Calculate Z-scores
    mean_val <- mean(original_values)
    sd_val <- sd(original_values)
    z_scores <- abs((original_values - mean_val) / sd_val)
    
    # Create data for plotting
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Value = original_values,
      ZScore = z_scores,
      IsOutlier = z_scores > result$transformation_info$zscore_threshold,
      LogValue = log(original_values + 1)
    )
    
    # Before/after histogram
    p_hist <- ggplot() +
      geom_histogram(data = plot_data, aes(x = Value, fill = IsOutlier), 
                     alpha = 0.7, bins = 30) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "red"),
                        name = "Z-Score Outlier") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Z-Score Outlier Detection:", var_key),
        subtitle = paste("Threshold:", result$transformation_info$zscore_threshold, 
                        "| Outliers removed:", result$n_zscore_outliers_removed,
                        "| Remaining:", result$n_available),
        x = paste(original_var, "(Original Scale)"),
        y = "Frequency"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(paste0(base_path, "ZSCORE_outliers_", var_key, ".png"), p_hist, width = 10, height = 6)
    
    # Z-score vs value plot
    p_zscore <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Value, y = ZScore)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = IsOutlier), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = result$transformation_info$zscore_threshold, 
                 color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "red"),
                         name = "Z-Score Outlier") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Z-Score Distribution:", var_key),
        subtitle = paste("Red line shows threshold =", result$transformation_info$zscore_threshold),
        x = paste(original_var, "(Original Scale)"),
        y = "Absolute Z-Score"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(paste0(base_path, "ZSCORE_distribution_", var_key, ".png"), p_zscore, width = 10, height = 6)
    
    cat("✅ Z-score analysis plots saved for", var_key, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMBINED OBSERVED vs FITTED PLOTS
# For Enhanced Transformations with Z-score Outlier Removal
# Training and validation combined - Publication-ready format
# ============================================================================

library(sf)

cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD ENHANCED DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📂 LOADING ENHANCED DATA:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
```
