```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: JOURNAL-STYLE COMBINED PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

create_journal_enhanced_plot <- function(var_key, data_sf, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n📊 Creating journal plot for:", var_key, "\n")
  }
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_key, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_key, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Find the original variable name
  possible_original_names <- c(
    var_key,
    gsub("_", "", var_key),
    paste0(var_key, "_original")
  )
  
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Original variable column not found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check required columns exist
  required_cols <- c(original_col, pred_col, pred_type_col)
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(data_sf)]
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create clean variable label with shortened names for specific variables
  var_label <- gsub("_", " ", var_key)
  
  # Special handling for long variable names
  if (var_key == "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm") {
    var_label <- "EC"
    axis_label_suffix <- " (mmho/cm)"
  } else if (var_key == "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g") {
    var_label <- "Exch. Na"
    axis_label_suffix <- " (meq/100g)"
  } else {
    # Standard label formatting for other variables
    var_label <- gsub("percent", "%", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("per mille", "‰", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("mg kg", "mg/kg", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("meq 100g", "meq/100g", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("mmho cm", "mmho/cm", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("g 100g", "g/100g", var_label)
    
    # Format axis labels with units for standard variables
    axis_label_suffix <- ""
    if (grepl("percent|%", var_label, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- " (%)"
    } else if (grepl("meq", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- " (meq/100g)"
    } else if (grepl("mille", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- " (‰)"
    } else if (grepl("mg.*kg", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- " (mg/kg)"
    } else if (grepl("mmho.*cm", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- " (mmho/cm)"
    } else if (grepl("Ratio", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- ""
    } else if (grepl("Index", var_key, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      axis_label_suffix <- ""
    } else if (var_key == "pH") {
      axis_label_suffix <- ""
    }
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ No valid data points\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Separate training and validation
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 && nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Insufficient data in both sets\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Handle cases where one dataset is too small
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Insufficient training data, using validation only\n")
    plot_data <- val_data
  } else if (nrow(val_data) < 5) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Insufficient validation data, using training only\n")
    plot_data <- train_data
  }
  
  # Recalculate after filtering
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  # Calculate metrics
  train_r2 <- NA
  train_rmse <- NA
  train_corr <- NA
  val_r2 <- NA
  val_rmse <- NA
  val_corr <- NA
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
    train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
    train_rmse <- sqrt(mean((train_data$Observed - train_data$Predicted)^2))
    train_corr <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
    val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((val_data$Observed - val_data$Predicted)^2))
    val_corr <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)
  }
  
  # Determine axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create beautiful combined plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    # 1:1 reference line (prominent red dashed)
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    
    # Smooth regression lines with confidence bands
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    
    # Data points on top
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 3, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.3) +
    
    # Color scheme (colorblind-friendly)
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Shape scheme
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    
    # Equal aspect ratio with proper limits
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    
    # Labels with LARGE fonts
    labs(
      x = paste0("Observed ", var_label, axis_label_suffix),
      y = paste0("Predicted ", var_label, axis_label_suffix),
      title = var_label
    ) +
    
    # Theme with publication-quality settings
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      # Title
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      
      # Axis titles and text (LARGER)
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      
      # Remove legend (we'll use annotations)
      legend.position = "none",
      
      # Panel
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  # Add annotations for metrics
  annotation_y_positions <- axis_limits[2] - seq(0.08, 0.85, length.out = 12) * val_span
  annotation_x <- axis_limits[1] + 0.05 * val_span
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = annotation_x,
      y = annotation_y_positions[1:6],
      label = c(
        "Training:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(train_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", train_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", train_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", train_rmse),
        ""
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    )
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    start_pos <- ifelse(nrow(train_data) >= 5, 7, 1)
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = annotation_x,
      y = annotation_y_positions[start_pos:(start_pos+4)],
      label = c(
        "Validation:",
        sprintf("n = %d", nrow(val_data)),
        sprintf("R² = %.3f", val_r2),
        sprintf("r = %.3f", val_corr),
        sprintf("RMSE = %.3f", val_rmse)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.5,
      color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    )
  }
  
  # Save high-resolution PNG (600 dpi, 140mm square)
  filename_png <- paste0(var_key, "_journal_enhanced.png")
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename_png), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Save PDF version
  filename_pdf <- paste0(var_key, "_journal_enhanced.pdf")
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, filename_pdf), 
    p,
    width = 140,
    height = 140,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  if (verbose) {
    if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
      cat("  ✓ Train: n=", nrow(train_data), ", R²=", round(train_r2, 3), 
          ", RMSE=", round(train_rmse, 3), "\n")
    }
    if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
      cat("  ✓ Valid: n=", nrow(val_data), ", R²=", round(val_r2, 3), 
          ", RMSE=", round(val_rmse, 3), "\n")
    }
    cat("  ✓ Saved:", filename_png, "and", filename_pdf, "\n")
  }
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    variable = var_key,
    original_variable = original_col,
    variable_label = var_label,
    train_n = ifelse(nrow(train_data) >= 5, nrow(train_data), NA),
    train_r2 = train_r2,
    train_rmse = train_rmse,
    train_corr = train_corr,
    val_n = ifelse(nrow(val_data) >= 5, nrow(val_data), NA),
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    val_rmse = val_rmse,
    val_corr = val_corr
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: PROCESS ALL ENHANCED VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🎨 CREATING JOURNAL-STYLE COMBINED PLOTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

results_summary <- list()
failed_variables <- character(0)

for (i in seq_along(enhanced_variables)) {
  var_key <- enhanced_variables[i]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n[%2d/%2d] ", i, length(enhanced_variables)))
  
  result <- tryCatch({
    create_journal_enhanced_plot(
      var_key = var_key,
      data_sf = parcelles_enhanced,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  ❌ Error:", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    results_summary[[var_key]] <- result
  } else {
    failed_variables <- c(failed_variables, var_key)
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: CREATE SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n\n📊 CREATING SUMMARY TABLE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

if (length(results_summary) > 0) {
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_summary), function(var) {
    res <- results_summary[[var]]
    data.frame(
      Variable = var,
      Original_Variable = res$original_variable,
      Variable_Label = res$variable_label,
      Train_N = ifelse(is.na(res$train_n), NA, res$train_n),
      Train_R2 = ifelse(is.na(res$train_r2), NA, round(res$train_r2, 3)),
      Train_RMSE = ifelse(is.na(res$train_rmse), NA, round(res$train_rmse, 3)),
      Train_Corr = ifelse(is.na(res$train_corr), NA, round(res$train_corr, 3)),
      Val_N = ifelse(is.na(res$val_n), NA, res$val_n),
      Val_R2 = ifelse(is.na(res$val_r2), NA, round(res$val_r2, 3)),
      Val_RMSE = ifelse(is.na(res$val_rmse), NA, round(res$val_rmse, 3)),
      Val_Corr = ifelse(is.na(res$val_corr), NA, round(res$val_corr, 3)),
      Delta_R2 = ifelse(is.na(res$train_r2) | is.na(res$val_r2), NA, 
                        round(res$train_r2 - res$val_r2, 3)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  summary_file <- file.path(output_dir, "journal_enhanced_plots_summary.csv")
  write_csv(summary_df, summary_file)
  
  cat("✅ Summary table saved:", basename(summary_file), "\n")
  cat("  • Variables with metrics:", nrow(summary_df), "\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ No successful plots generated\n")
  summary_df <- data.frame()
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: CREATE DETAILED TEXT REPORT
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📝 CREATING DETAILED REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

report_file <- file.path(output_dir, "journal_enhanced_plots_report.txt")

sink(report_file)
cat("JOURNAL-STYLE ENHANCED PLOTS REPORT\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Generated:", as.character(Sys.time()), "\n\n")

cat("DATASET INFORMATION\n")
cat("-------------------\n")
cat("Dataset: Enhanced Transformations with Z-score Outlier Removal\n")
cat("Source file:", basename(gpkg_enhanced), "\n")
cat("Total observations in dataset:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "\n\n")

cat("PROCESSING SUMMARY\n")
cat("------------------\n")
cat("Total variables attempted:", length(enhanced_variables), "\n")
cat("Successfully plotted:", length(results_summary), "\n")
cat("Failed:", length(failed_variables), "\n\n")

if (length(results_summary) > 0) {
  cat("SUCCESSFUL VARIABLES\n")
  cat("--------------------\n\n")
  
  for (var_key in names(results_summary)) {
    res <- results_summary[[var_key]]
    cat(var_key, ":\n", sep = "")
    cat("  Original variable:", res$original_variable, "\n")
    cat("  Display label:", res$variable_label, "\n")
    
    if (!is.na(res$train_n)) {
      cat("  Training:\n")
      cat("    n =", res$train_n, "\n")
      cat("    R² =", round(res$train_r2, 4), "\n")
      cat("    RMSE =", round(res$train_rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("    Correlation =", round(res$train_corr, 4), "\n")
    }
    
    if (!is.na(res$val_n)) {
      cat("  Validation:\n")
      cat("    n =", res$val_n, "\n")
      cat("    R² =", round(res$val_r2, 4), "\n")
      cat("    RMSE =", round(res$val_rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("    Correlation =", round(res$val_corr, 4), "\n")
    }
    
    if (!is.na(res$train_r2) && !is.na(res$val_r2)) {
      delta_r2 <- res$train_r2 - res$val_r2
      r2_ratio <- res$val_r2 / res$train_r2
      cat("  Performance Drop:\n")
      cat("    ΔR² =", round(delta_r2, 4), "\n")
      cat("    R² Ratio (Val/Train) =", round(r2_ratio, 4), "\n")
    }
    
    cat("\n")
  }
}

if (length(failed_variables) > 0) {
  cat("FAILED VARIABLES\n")
  cat("----------------\n")
  for (var in failed_variables) {
    cat("  •", var, "\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  cat("PERFORMANCE STATISTICS\n")
  cat("----------------------\n\n")
  
  valid_train <- summary_df[!is.na(summary_df$Train_R2), ]
  valid_val <- summary_df[!is.na(summary_df$Val_R2), ]
  valid_both <- summary_df[!is.na(summary_df$Train_R2) & !is.na(summary_df$Val_R2), ]
  
  if (nrow(valid_train) > 0) {
    cat("Training Set (", nrow(valid_train), " variables):\n", sep = "")
    cat("  Mean R²:", round(mean(valid_train$Train_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Median R²:", round(median(valid_train$Train_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Range R²:", round(min(valid_train$Train_R2), 4), "to", 
        round(max(valid_train$Train_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Mean RMSE:", round(mean(valid_train$Train_RMSE), 4), "\n\n")
  }
  
  if (nrow(valid_val) > 0) {
    cat("Validation Set (", nrow(valid_val), " variables):\n", sep = "")
    cat("  Mean R²:", round(mean(valid_val$Val_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Median R²:", round(median(valid_val$Val_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Range R²:", round(min(valid_val$Val_R2), 4), "to", 
        round(max(valid_val$Val_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Mean RMSE:", round(mean(valid_val$Val_RMSE), 4), "\n\n")
  }
  
  if (nrow(valid_both) > 0) {
    cat("Performance Drop (Train → Validation) (", nrow(valid_both), " variables):\n", sep = "")
    cat("  Mean ΔR²:", round(mean(valid_both$Delta_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Median ΔR²:", round(median(valid_both$Delta_R2), 4), "\n")
    cat("  Mean R² Ratio:", round(mean(valid_both$Val_R2 / valid_both$Train_R2), 4), "\n\n")
    
    cat("Best Performing Variables (by Validation R²):\n")
    top_vars <- valid_both[order(-valid_both$Val_R2), ][1:min(5, nrow(valid_both)), ]
    for (i in 1:nrow(top_vars)) {
      cat("  ", i, ". ", top_vars$Variable[i], ": R² = ", 
          round(top_vars$Val_R2[i], 4), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
    
    cat("Worst Performing Variables (by Validation R²):\n")
    bottom_vars <- valid_both[order(valid_both$Val_R2), ][1:min(5, nrow(valid_both)), ]
    for (i in 1:nrow(bottom_vars)) {
      cat("  ", i, ". ", bottom_vars$Variable[i], ": R² = ", 
          round(bottom_vars$Val_R2[i], 4), "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
cat("✅ Detailed report saved:", basename(report_file), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n", "🎉", rep("=", 60), "🎉", "\n", sep="")
cat("   JOURNAL-STYLE ENHANCED PLOTS COMPLETE!   \n")
cat("🎉", rep("=", 60), "🎉", "\n", sep="")

cat("\n📊 FINAL SUMMARY:\n")
cat("• Variables attempted:", length(enhanced_variables), "\n")
cat("• Successfully plotted:", length(results_summary), "\n")
cat("• Failed:", length(failed_variables), "\n")

if (length(results_summary) > 0) {
  cat("\n📁 OUTPUT FILES:\n")
  cat("• Individual plots:", length(results_summary) * 2, "files (PNG + PDF)\n")
  cat("• Summary CSV:", "journal_enhanced_plots_summary.csv\n")
  cat("• Detailed report:", "journal_enhanced_plots_report.txt\n")
  cat("• Output directory:", basename(output_dir), "/\n")
}

if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  valid_val <- summary_df %>% filter(!is.na(Val_R2))
  
  if (nrow(valid_val) > 0) {
    cat("\n🏆 PERFORMANCE HIGHLIGHTS:\n")
    
    best_var <- valid_val[which.max(valid_val$Val_R2), ]
    cat("• Best validation R²:", best_var$Variable, 
        "(R² =", round(best_var$Val_R2, 4), ")\n")
    
    cat("• Mean validation R²:", round(mean(valid_val$Val_R2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
    cat("• Median validation R²:", round(median(valid_val$Val_R2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
    
    good_vars <- valid_val %>% filter(Val_R2 > 0.7)
    if (nrow(good_vars) > 0) {
      cat("• Variables with R² > 0.7:", nrow(good_vars), "\n")
    }
    
    decent_vars <- valid_val %>% filter(Val_R2 > 0.5)
    if (nrow(decent_vars) > 0) {
      cat("• Variables with R² > 0.5:", nrow(decent_vars), "\n")
    }
  }
}
```

## VII.2. Log transformed Observed vs Fitted (not back transformed)

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# VARIABLES LOG-SCALE OBSERVED vs FITTED PLOTS
# Creates observed vs fitted plots for both training and test sets
# ON THE ACTUAL LOG-TRANSFORMED SCALE (not back-transformed)
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(viridis)
library(cowplot)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  LOG-SCALE DIAGNOSTICS                \n")
cat("  Observed vs Fitted on Log Scale      \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD ENHANCED DATA AND RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING ENHANCED DATA AND RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"
gpkg_enhanced <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ENHANCED_TRANSFORMATIONS_predictions.gpkg")
models_enhanced <- paste0(base_path, "ENHANCED_TRANSFORMATIONS_model_objects.RData")

# Check files exist
if (!file.exists(gpkg_enhanced)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced dataset not found. Please run the enhanced transformations script first.")
}

if (!file.exists(models_enhanced)) {
  stop("❌ Enhanced model objects not found. Please run the enhanced transformations script first.")
}

# Load data
parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_enhanced, quiet = TRUE)
load(models_enhanced)  # This loads enhanced_results, successful_enhanced, etc.

cat("✅ Data loaded successfully:\n")
cat("  Enhanced dataset:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n")
cat("  Successful enhanced variables:", length(successful_enhanced), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================================
output_dir <- "log_scale_diagnostics_results"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("Output directory created:", output_dir, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: FUNCTION TO CREATE LOG-SCALE OBSERVED vs FITTED PLOTS
# ============================================================================

create_log_scale_observed_fitted <- function(var_key, enhanced_result) {
  
  cat("📊 Creating log-scale observed vs fitted for:", var_key, "\n")
  
  # Get predictions data
  predictions_df <- enhanced_result$predictions
  
  # Debug: Check available columns
  cat("  Available columns:", paste(names(predictions_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Variable label for display
  var_label <- case_when(
    var_key == "CN_Ratio" ~ "C:N Ratio",
    var_key == "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" ~ "Available P₂O₅ (mg/kg)",
    var_key == "Compaction_Index" ~ "Compaction Index", 
    var_key == "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" ~ "Electrical Conductivity (mmho/cm)",
    var_key == "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" ~ "Exchangeable Sodium (meq/100g)",
    TRUE ~ var_key
  )
  
  # Get transformation info
  transformation_type <- enhanced_result$transformation_info$transformation
  
  if (transformation_type != "log") {
    cat("    ⚠️ Skipping - not a log transformation (", transformation_type, ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check what columns exist for transformed values
  transformed_cols <- names(predictions_df)[grepl("transformed|log", names(predictions_df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  cat("  Transformed-related columns:", paste(transformed_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Try different possible column names for transformed predictions
  possible_pred_cols <- c(
    "Y_predicted_transformed", 
    "y_pred_transformed",
    "predicted_transformed",
    paste0(var_key, "_predicted_transformed"),
    "log_predicted",
    "pred_log"
  )
  
  possible_obs_cols <- c(
    "Y_true_transformed",
    "y_true_transformed", 
    "observed_transformed",
    paste0(var_key, "_observed_transformed"),
    "log_observed",
    "obs_log"
  )
  
  # Find the correct column names
  pred_col <- NULL
  obs_col <- NULL
  
  for (col in possible_pred_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(predictions_df)) {
      pred_col <- col
      break
    }
  }
  
  for (col in possible_obs_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(predictions_df)) {
      obs_col <- col
      break
    }
  }
  
  # If we can't find transformed columns, try to create them from original values
  if (is.null(pred_col) || is.null(obs_col)) {
    cat("  Transformed columns not found, attempting to create from original values...\n")
    
    # Check if we have the original variable in the data
    original_var_col <- problematic_variables[[var_key]]$original
    
    if (original_var_col %in% names(predictions_df) && 
        "Y_true_original" %in% names(predictions_df)) {
      
      # Apply log transformation to create the log scale values
      predictions_df <- predictions_df %>%
        mutate(
          observed_log_created = log(Y_true_original + 1),
          predicted_log_created = log(get(paste0(var_key, "_predicted")) + 1)
        )
      
      obs_col <- "observed_log_created"
      pred_col <- "predicted_log_created"
      cat("  Created log-scale columns from original values\n")
    } else {
      cat("  ❌ Cannot find or create transformed scale columns\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  cat("  Using columns - Observed:", obs_col, ", Predicted:", pred_col, "\n")
  
  # Extract TRAINING data (data_split == "train")
  train_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(data_split == "train", !is.na(!!sym(obs_col)), !is.na(!!sym(pred_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      # Use the ACTUAL transformed values (log scale)
      observed_log = !!sym(obs_col),
      predicted_log = !!sym(pred_col),
      residuals_log = observed_log - predicted_log
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(observed_log), is.finite(predicted_log))
  
  # Extract TEST/VALIDATION data (data_split == "validation") 
  test_data <- predictions_df %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(!!sym(obs_col)), !is.na(!!sym(pred_col))) %>%
    mutate(
      # Use the ACTUAL transformed values (log scale)
      observed_log = !!sym(obs_col),
      predicted_log = !!sym(pred_col),
      residuals_log = observed_log - predicted_log
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(observed_log), is.finite(predicted_log))
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
    cat("❌ Insufficient training data (n =", nrow(train_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(test_data) < 5) {
    cat("❌ Insufficient test data (n =", nrow(test_data), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("  Training observations:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
  cat("  Test observations:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
  
  # Calculate metrics on LOG SCALE
  train_r2_log <- cor(train_data$observed_log, train_data$predicted_log, use = "complete.obs")^2
  train_rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(train_data$residuals_log^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  train_correlation_log <- cor(train_data$observed_log, train_data$predicted_log, use = "complete.obs")
  
  test_r2_log <- cor(test_data$observed_log, test_data$predicted_log, use = "complete.obs")^2
  test_rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(test_data$residuals_log^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  test_correlation_log <- cor(test_data$observed_log, test_data$predicted_log, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Determine common axis limits for log scale
  all_observed_log <- c(train_data$observed_log, test_data$observed_log)
  all_predicted_log <- c(train_data$predicted_log, test_data$predicted_log)
  
  x_limits <- range(all_predicted_log, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limits <- range(all_observed_log, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Extend limits slightly
  x_range <- diff(x_limits)
  y_range <- diff(y_limits)
  x_limits <- c(x_limits[1] - 0.05 * x_range, x_limits[2] + 0.05 * x_range)
  y_limits <- c(y_limits[1] - 0.05 * y_range, y_limits[2] + 0.05 * y_range)
  
  # TRAINING PLOT on LOG SCALE
  p_train_log <- ggplot(train_data, aes(x = predicted_log, y = observed_log)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Training Set (Log Scale)",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(train_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(train_r2_log, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(train_rmse_log, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(train_correlation_log, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted log(", var_label, " + 1)"),
      y = paste("Observed log(", var_label, " + 1)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
  
  # TEST PLOT on LOG SCALE
  p_test_log <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = predicted_log, y = observed_log)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Test Set (Log Scale)", 
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", nrow(test_data), " | ",
        "R² = ", round(test_r2_log, 3), " | ",
        "RMSE = ", round(test_rmse_log, 3), " | ",
        "r = ", round(test_correlation_log, 3)
      ),
      x = paste("Predicted log(", var_label, " + 1)"),
      y = paste("Observed log(", var_label, " + 1)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    )
  
  # RESIDUALS vs FITTED on LOG SCALE
  p_resid_train_log <- ggplot(train_data, aes(x = predicted_log, y = residuals_log)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Training - Log Scale)",
      x = paste("Fitted log(", var_label, " + 1)"),
      y = "Residuals (Log Scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  p_resid_test_log <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = predicted_log, y = residuals_log)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, color = "darkorange") +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs Fitted (Test - Log Scale)",
      x = paste("Fitted log(", var_label, " + 1)"),
      y = "Residuals (Log Scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  # Combine all plots in a 2x2 grid
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plot_grid(p_train_log, p_test_log, ncol = 2, 
              labels = c("A. TRAINING (LOG)", "B. TEST (LOG)"), 
              label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
    plot_grid(p_resid_train_log, p_resid_test_log, ncol = 2, 
              labels = c("C. RESIDUALS (TRAIN)", "D. RESIDUALS (TEST)"),
              label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold"),
    nrow = 2
  )
  
  # Add overall title
  final_plot <- plot_grid(
    ggdraw() + 
      draw_label(
        paste("Log-Scale Model Diagnostics:", var_label),
        fontface = "bold", size = 16
      ) +
      draw_label(
        paste0("Transformation: log(x + 1) | Performance on Log Scale | Performance Drop: ΔR² = ", 
               round(train_r2_log - test_r2_log, 3)),
        y = 0.3, size = 11, color = "grey40"
      ),
    combined_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.12, 1)
  )
  
  # Save plot
  filename <- paste0(var_key, "_LOG_SCALE_observed_vs_fitted.png")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, filename), final_plot, 
         width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("  ✓ Log-scale diagnostics saved:", filename, "\n")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    variable_name = var_key,
    variable_label = var_label,
    train_metrics_log = list(
      n = nrow(train_data),
      r_squared = train_r2_log,
      rmse = train_rmse_log,
      correlation = train_correlation_log
    ),
    test_metrics_log = list(
      n = nrow(test_data),
      r_squared = test_r2_log,
      rmse = test_rmse_log,
      correlation = test_correlation_log
    ),
    performance_drop_log = list(
      delta_r2 = train_r2_log - test_r2_log,
      delta_rmse = test_rmse_log - train_rmse_log,
      r2_ratio = test_r2_log / train_r2_log
    ),
    transformation_info = enhanced_result$transformation_info,
    plots = list(
      combined = final_plot
    )
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: PROCESS ALL LOG-TRANSFORMED VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 PROCESSING LOG-TRANSFORMED VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Initialize storage
all_log_scale_comparisons <- list()
log_scale_summary <- data.frame()

# Filter only log-transformed variables
log_transformed_vars <- c()
for (var_key in successful_enhanced) {
  if (enhanced_results[[var_key]]$transformation_info$transformation == "log") {
    log_transformed_vars <- c(log_transformed_vars, var_key)
  }
}

if (length(log_transformed_vars) == 0) {
  stop("❌ No log-transformed variables found in the enhanced results!")
}

cat("Found", length(log_transformed_vars), "log-transformed variables:\n")
cat(paste0("  - ", log_transformed_vars, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# Process each log-transformed variable
for (i in seq_along(log_transformed_vars)) {
  var_key <- log_transformed_vars[i]
  enhanced_result <- enhanced_results[[var_key]]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(log_transformed_vars), "] Processing:", var_key, "\n")
  
  # Create log-scale observed vs fitted comparison
  tryCatch({
    comparison_result <- create_log_scale_observed_fitted(
      var_key = var_key,
      enhanced_result = enhanced_result
    )
    
    if (!is.null(comparison_result)) {
      all_log_scale_comparisons[[var_key]] <- comparison_result
      
      # Add to summary
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_key,
        Variable_Label = comparison_result$variable_label,
        Train_N = comparison_result$train_metrics_log$n,
        Train_R2_Log = comparison_result$train_metrics_log$r_squared,
        Train_RMSE_Log = comparison_result$train_metrics_log$rmse,
        Train_Correlation_Log = comparison_result$train_metrics_log$correlation,
        Test_N = comparison_result$test_metrics_log$n,
        Test_R2_Log = comparison_result$test_metrics_log$r_squared,
        Test_RMSE_Log = comparison_result$test_metrics_log$rmse,
        Test_Correlation_Log = comparison_result$test_metrics_log$correlation,
        Delta_R2_Log = comparison_result$performance_drop_log$delta_r2,
        Delta_RMSE_Log = comparison_result$performance_drop_log$delta_rmse,
        R2_Ratio_Log = comparison_result$performance_drop_log$r2_ratio,
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      log_scale_summary <- rbind(log_scale_summary, summary_row)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("    ❌ Log-scale comparison failed:", e$message, "\n")
    
    # Add failed entry to summary
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_key,
      Variable_Label = var_key,
      Train_N = NA, Train_R2_Log = NA, Train_RMSE_Log = NA, Train_Correlation_Log = NA,
      Test_N = NA, Test_R2_Log = NA, Test_RMSE_Log = NA, Test_Correlation_Log = NA,
      Delta_R2_Log = NA, Delta_RMSE_Log = NA, R2_Ratio_Log = NA,
      Status = paste("Failed:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    log_scale_summary <- rbind(log_scale_summary, summary_row)
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE LOG-SCALE SUMMARY PLOTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING LOG-SCALE SUMMARY PLOTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 35), "\n", sep="")

if (nrow(log_scale_summary) > 0 && any(!is.na(log_scale_summary$Test_R2_Log))) {
  
  successful_log_results <- log_scale_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")
  
  if (nrow(successful_log_results) > 0) {
    
    # Performance comparison plot (log scale)
    p_performance_log <- successful_log_results %>%
      arrange(desc(Delta_R2_Log)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable_Label, Delta_R2_Log))) +
      geom_col(aes(y = Delta_R2_Log), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(
        title = "Log-Scale Models: Performance Drop Analysis",
        subtitle = "Performance measured on actual log-transformed scale",
        x = "Variable",
        y = "ΔR² on Log Scale (Training R² - Test R²)",
        caption = "Positive values indicate overfitting"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
      )
    
    # R² comparison plot (log scale)
    p_r2_comparison_log <- successful_log_results %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Train_R2_Log, y = Test_R2_Log)) +
      geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Variable), vjust = -0.8, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.5) +
      labs(
        title = "Training vs Test R² (Log Scale)",
        subtitle = "Points below diagonal indicate overfitting on log scale",
        x = "Training R² (Log Scale)",
        y = "Test R² (Log Scale)",
        caption = "Performance measured on log-transformed scale"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
      )
    
    # RMSE comparison plot (log scale)
    p_rmse_comparison_log <- successful_log_results %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = Train_RMSE_Log, y = Test_RMSE_Log)) +
      geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkred", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Variable), vjust = -0.8, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.5) +
      labs(
        title = "Training vs Test RMSE (Log Scale)",
        subtitle = "Points above diagonal indicate worse test performance",
        x = "Training RMSE (Log Scale)",
        y = "Test RMSE (Log Scale)",
        caption = "RMSE measured on log-transformed scale"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40")
      )
    
    # Save summary plots
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "log_scale_performance_drop_summary.png"), 
           p_performance_log, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "log_scale_train_vs_test_r2_comparison.png"), 
           p_r2_comparison_log, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "log_scale_train_vs_test_rmse_comparison.png"), 
           p_rmse_comparison_log, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    cat("✅ Log-scale summary plots saved\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: SAVE RESULTS AND CREATE REPORT
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING RESULTS AND CREATING REPORT:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Save summary
write_csv(log_scale_summary, file.path(output_dir, "log_scale_diagnostics_summary.csv"))

# Save all results
save(all_log_scale_comparisons, log_scale_summary, log_transformed_vars,
     file = file.path(output_dir, "log_scale_diagnostics_results.RData"))

# Create report
report_content <- paste0(
  "# LOG-SCALE DIAGNOSTICS REPORT\n",
  "Generated: ", Sys.time(), "\n\n",
  
  "## OVERVIEW\n",
  "This report analyzes log-transformed variables showing performance metrics\n",
  "on the ACTUAL LOG SCALE (not back-transformed scale).\n",
  "This provides clearer insight into model performance on the transformed scale.\n\n",
  
  "## LOG-TRANSFORMED VARIABLES ANALYZED\n"
)

for (i in seq_along(log_transformed_vars)) {
  var_key <- log_transformed_vars[i]
  report_content <- paste0(
    report_content,
    i, ". **", var_key, "**\n",
    "   - Transformation: log(x + 1)\n",
    "   - Analysis: Observed vs Fitted on log scale\n\n"
  )
}

if (nrow(log_scale_summary) > 0) {
  successful_results <- log_scale_summary %>% filter(Status == "Success")
  
  if (nrow(successful_results) > 0) {
    
    mean_train_r2_log <- mean(successful_results$Train_R2_Log, na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_test_r2_log <- mean(successful_results$Test_R2_Log, na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_delta_r2_log <- mean(successful_results$Delta_R2_Log, na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_r2_ratio_log <- mean(successful_results$R2_Ratio_Log, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    report_content <- paste0(
      report_content,
      "## OVERALL PERFORMANCE ON LOG SCALE\n",
      "- Mean Training R² (Log): ", round(mean_train_r2_log, 3), "\n",
      "- Mean Test R² (Log): ", round(mean_test_r2_log, 3), "\n",
      "- Mean Performance Drop (ΔR²): ", round(mean_delta_r2_log, 3), "\n",
      "- Mean R² Ratio (Test/Train): ", round(mean_r2_ratio_log, 3), "\n\n",
      
      "## DETAILED RESULTS BY VARIABLE\n"
    )
    
    # Sort by test R² (log scale)
    sorted_vars <- successful_results %>% arrange(desc(Test_R2_Log))
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(sorted_vars)) {
      var_row <- sorted_vars[i, ]
      report_content <- paste0(
        report_content,
        "### ", i, ". ", var_row$Variable_Label, " (", var_row$Variable, ")\n",
        "- **Performance on Log Scale:**\n",
        "  - Training: R² = ", round(var_row$Train_R2_Log, 3), ", RMSE = ", round(var_row$Train_RMSE_Log, 3), "\n",
        "  - Test: R² = ", round(var_row$Test_R2_Log, 3), ", RMSE = ", round(var_row$Test_RMSE_Log, 3), "\n",
        "  - Performance Drop: ΔR² = ", round(var_row$Delta_R2_Log, 3), "\n",
        "  - Generalization: R² Ratio = ", round(var_row$R2_Ratio_Log, 3), "\n",
        "- **Sample Sizes:** Train = ", var_row$Train_N, ", Test = ", var_row$Test_N, "\n\n"
      )
    }
  }
}

report_content <- paste0(
  report_content,
  "## INTERPRETATION GUIDELINES\n\n",
  
  "### Performance Metrics on Log Scale:\n",
  "- **Higher R² values:** Better model fit on transformed scale\n",
  "- **Lower RMSE values:** More accurate predictions on log scale\n",
  "- **ΔR² close to 0:** Good generalization from training to test\n",
  "- **R² Ratio close to 1:** Consistent performance across datasets\n\n",
  
  "### Why Log Scale Analysis Matters:\n",
  "1. **True Model Performance:** Shows how well the model actually performs\n",
  "2. **Residual Patterns:** Easier to spot remaining issues on transformed scale\n",
  "3. **Assumption Checking:** Log transformation aims for normality/homoscedasticity\n",
  "4. **Model Comparison:** Fair comparison between different transformations\n\n",
  
  "## OUTPUT FILES\n",
  "### Individual Variable Plots:\n",
  "- `*_LOG_SCALE_observed_vs_fitted.png` - 4-panel diagnostic plots on log scale\n\n",
  
  "### Summary Plots:\n",
  "- `log_scale_performance_drop_summary.png` - Performance drop analysis\n",
  "- `log_scale_train_vs_test_r2_comparison.png` - R² comparison on log scale\n",
  "- `log_scale_train_vs_test_rmse_comparison.png` - RMSE comparison on log scale\n\n",
  
  "### Data Files:\n",
  "- `log_scale_diagnostics_summary.csv` - All metrics and results\n",
  "- `log_scale_diagnostics_results.RData` - Complete results for further analysis\n",
  "- `LOG_SCALE_DIAGNOSTICS_REPORT.txt` - This comprehensive report\n\n"
)

if (nrow(successful_results) > 0) {
  # Identify best and worst performing variables on log scale
  best_var_log <- successful_results$Variable[which.max(successful_results$Test_R2_Log)]
  worst_overfitting_log <- successful_results$Variable[which.max(successful_results$Delta_R2_Log)]
  
  report_content <- paste0(
    report_content,
    "## KEY FINDINGS\n",
    "### Best Performing Variable (Log Scale):\n",
    "**", best_var_log, "** - Test R² = ", 
    round(max(successful_results$Test_R2_Log, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n",
    
    "### Most Overfitted Variable (Log Scale):\n", 
    "**", worst_overfitting_log, "** - ΔR² = ",
    round(max(successful_results$Delta_R2_Log, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n"
  )
}

# Write the report
writeLines(report_content, file.path(output_dir, "LOG_SCALE_DIAGNOSTICS_REPORT.txt"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================

library(sf)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD BOTH DATASETS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📂 LOADING DATASETS:\n")

base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"

# Load standard dataset (with compositional and non-compositional)
gpkg_all_vars <- paste0(base_path, "parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg")
parcelles_all <- st_read(gpkg_all_vars, quiet = TRUE)

# Load enhanced transformations dataset

parcelles_enhanced <- st_read(gpkg_enhanced, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Enhanced dataset loaded:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "observations\n")

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
output_dir <- paste0(base_path, "journal_ALL_COMBINED_grid_plots")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {

}

cat("📁 Output directory:", basename(output_dir), "\n")

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔍 DEFINING VARIABLE GROUPS:\n")

# Standard non-compositional variables
NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES <- c(
  "pH",
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g",
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g",

  "Mg_Ca_Ratio",
  "Mg_K_Ratio"
)

# Compositional fractions
GRANULO_FRACTIONS <- c(

  "Fine_Silt_percent",
  "Coarse_Silt_percent",
  "Fine_Sand_percent",
  "Coarse_Sand_percent"
)

# ILR coordinates
ILR_COORDS <- paste0("ILR_", 1:4)

# Enhanced transformations variables
predicted_cols <- colnames(parcelles_enhanced)[grepl("_predicted$", colnames(parcelles_enhanced))]

})]

cat("• Non-compositional variables:", length(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES), "\n")
cat("• Compositional fractions:", length(GRANULO_FRACTIONS), "\n")

cat("• TOTAL VARIABLES:", length(NON_COMPOSITIONAL_VARIABLES) + length(GRANULO_FRACTIONS) + 
    length(ILR_COORDS) + length(ENHANCED_VARIABLES), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: COMPACT PLOTTING FUNCTION FOR STANDARD VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

create_compact_plot_standard <- function(var_name, data_sf, dataset_type = "standard") {
  
  # Column names
  pred_col <- paste0(var_name, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_name, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Check columns exist
  if (!pred_col %in% colnames(data_sf) || !pred_type_col %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create clean variable label with shortened names
  var_label <- gsub("_", " ", var_name)
  var_label <- gsub("percent", "%", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("per mille", "‰", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Calcium", "Exch. Ca", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Magnesium", "Exch. Mg", var_label)
  var_label <- gsub("Exchangeable Potassium", "Exch. K", var_label)
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[var_name]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Separate datasets
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 && nrow(val_data) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculate metrics
  train_r2 <- NA
  val_r2 <- NA
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
    train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  # Axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create compact plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(title = var_label, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  # Add compact annotations
  annotation_y <- axis_limits[2] - seq(0.12, 0.70, length.out = 7) * val_span
  annotation_x <- axis_limits[1] + 0.06 * val_span
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5 && nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[1:4],
      label = c("Train:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(train_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", train_r2), ""),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[5:7],
      label = c("Valid:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(val_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", val_r2)),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain")
    )
  } else if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[1:3],
      label = c("Train:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(train_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", train_r2)),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain")
    )
  } else if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[1:3],
      label = c("Valid:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(val_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", val_r2)),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain")
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    plot = p, 
    var_label = var_label, 
    var_name = var_name,
    train_r2 = train_r2, 
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    category = dataset_type
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: COMPACT PLOTTING FUNCTION FOR ILR COORDINATES
# ============================================================================

create_ilr_basis <- function(D) {
  V <- matrix(0, nrow = D - 1, ncol = D)
  for (i in 1:(D - 1)) {
    V[i, 1:i] <- 1/i
    V[i, i + 1] <- -1
    V[i, ] <- V[i, ] * sqrt(i / (i + 1))
  }
  return(V)
}

ilr_transform <- function(composition_matrix) {
  D <- ncol(composition_matrix)
  V <- create_ilr_basis(D)
  log_comp <- log(composition_matrix)
  ilr_coords <- log_comp %*% t(V)
  return(ilr_coords)
}

create_compact_plot_ilr <- function(ilr_index, data_sf) {
  
  ilr_var <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index)
  
  # Check for complete granulometry data
  comp_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Clay_percent), !is.na(Fine_Silt_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Silt_percent), !is.na(Fine_Sand_percent),
           !is.na(Coarse_Sand_percent)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ILR_1_predicted))
  
  if (nrow(comp_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Determine dataset split
  if ("Clay_percent_prediction_type" %in% colnames(comp_data)) {
    comp_data <- comp_data %>%
      mutate(Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "train" ~ "Training",
          Clay_percent_prediction_type == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      ))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  comp_data <- comp_data %>% filter(!is.na(Dataset))
  
  # Split data
  train_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- comp_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 && nrow(val_data) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # Compute observed ILR
  train_comp <- train_data %>% dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>% as.matrix()
  train_comp[train_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  train_comp <- train_comp / rowSums(train_comp) * 100
  train_ilr <- ilr_transform(train_comp / 100)
  
  val_comp <- val_data %>% dplyr::select(all_of(GRANULO_FRACTIONS)) %>% as.matrix()
  val_comp[val_comp <= 0] <- 0.01
  val_comp <- val_comp / rowSums(val_comp) * 100
  val_ilr <- ilr_transform(val_comp / 100)
  
  # Prepare plot data
  pred_col <- paste0("ILR_", ilr_index, "_predicted")
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    train_data %>% mutate(Observed = train_ilr[, ilr_index], Predicted = .data[[pred_col]]),
    val_data %>% mutate(Observed = val_ilr[, ilr_index], Predicted = .data[[pred_col]])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  # Calculate metrics
  train_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_subset <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  train_r2 <- NA
  val_r2 <- NA
  
  if (nrow(train_subset) >= 5) {
    train_r2 <- cor(train_subset$Observed, train_subset$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_subset) >= 5) {
    val_r2 <- cor(val_subset$Observed, val_subset$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  # Axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17), name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(title = paste("ILR", ilr_index), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  # Add annotations
  annotation_y <- axis_limits[2] - seq(0.12, 0.70, length.out = 7) * val_span
  annotation_x <- axis_limits[1] + 0.06 * val_span
  
  if (nrow(train_subset) >= 5 && nrow(val_subset) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[1:4],
      label = c("Train:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(train_subset)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", train_r2), ""),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[5:7],
      label = c("Valid:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(val_subset)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", val_r2)),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain")
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    plot = p, 
    var_label = paste("ILR", ilr_index),
    var_name = ilr_var,
    train_r2 = train_r2, 
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    category = "compositional"
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: COMPACT PLOTTING FUNCTION FOR ENHANCED VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

create_compact_plot_enhanced <- function(var_key, data_sf) {
  
  pred_col <- paste0(var_key, "_predicted")
  pred_type_col <- paste0(var_key, "_prediction_type")
  
  # Find original variable
  possible_original_names <- c(var_key, gsub("_", "", var_key), paste0(var_key, "_original"))
  original_col <- NULL
  for (name in possible_original_names) {
    if (name %in% colnames(data_sf)) {
      original_col <- name
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(original_col)) return(NULL)
  
  # Create clean variable label
  var_label <- gsub("_", " ", var_key)
  
  if (var_key == "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm") {
    var_label <- "EC"
  } else if (var_key == "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g") {
    var_label <- "Exch. Na"
  } else {
    var_label <- gsub("percent", "%", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("per mille", "‰", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("mg kg", "mg/kg", var_label)
    var_label <- gsub("meq 100g", "meq/100g", var_label)
  }
  
  # Extract and prepare data
  plot_data <- data_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[original_col]]), !is.na(.data[[pred_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      Observed = .data[[original_col]],
      Predicted = .data[[pred_col]],
      Dataset = factor(
        case_when(
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Training" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "train" ~ "Training",
          .data[[pred_type_col]] == "Validation" | .data[[pred_type_col]] == "validation" ~ "Validation",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        levels = c("Training", "Validation")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dataset), is.finite(Observed), is.finite(Predicted))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  train_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Training")
  val_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Dataset == "Validation")
  
  if (nrow(train_data) < 5 && nrow(val_data) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  train_r2 <- NA
  val_r2 <- NA
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5) {
    train_r2 <- cor(train_data$Observed, train_data$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    val_r2 <- cor(val_data$Observed, val_data$Predicted)^2
  }
  
  # Axis limits
  all_vals <- c(plot_data$Observed, plot_data$Predicted)
  val_range <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  val_span <- diff(val_range)
  axis_limits <- c(val_range[1] - 0.05 * val_span, val_range[2] + 0.05 * val_span)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Dataset), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Training" = "#0072B2", "Validation" = "#D55E00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Training" = "#56B4E9", "Validation" = "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Training" = 16, "Validation" = 17), name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
    labs(title = var_label, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 3)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, size = 0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
    )
  
  # Add annotations
  annotation_y <- axis_limits[2] - seq(0.12, 0.70, length.out = 7) * val_span
  annotation_x <- axis_limits[1] + 0.06 * val_span
  
  if (nrow(train_data) >= 5 && nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[1:4],
      label = c("Train:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(train_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", train_r2), ""),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#0072B2",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain", "plain")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = annotation_x, y = annotation_y[5:7],
      label = c("Valid:", sprintf("n=%d", nrow(val_data)), sprintf("R²=%.2f", val_r2)),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#D55E00",
      fontface = c("bold", "plain", "plain")
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    plot = p, 
    var_label = var_label,
    var_name = var_key,
    train_r2 = train_r2, 
    val_r2 = val_r2,
    category = "enhanced"
  ))
}

# ============================================================================

create_smart_grid <- function(plots_list, ncol = 4, title = NULL) {
  
  n_plots <- length(plots_list)
  nrow <- ceiling(n_plots / ncol)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_plot <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = plots_list,
    ncol = ncol,
    nrow = nrow,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  )
  
  # Add common axis labels
  y_label <- textGrob("Predicted", rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  x_label <- textGrob("Observed", gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  
  # Add title if provided
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    title_grob <- textGrob(title, gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"))
    final_plot <- grid.arrange(
      title_grob,
      arrangeGrob(y_label, grid_plot, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.03, 0.97)),
      x_label,
      heights = c(heights = c(0.05, 0.90, 0.05)
    )
  } else {
    final_plot <- grid.arrange(
      arrangeGrob(y_label, grid_plot, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.03, 0.97)),
      x_label,
      heights = c(0.95, 0.05)
    )
  }
  
  return(final_plot)
}

# Moderate performers (0.5 < R² ≤ 0.7)

if (length(moderate_performers) > 0) {

  dev.off()
  
  cat("  ✅ Saved MODERATE PERFORMERS grid\n")
}

# Lower performers (R² ≤ 0.5)
lower_performers <- sorted_vars[val_r2_values[sorted_vars] <= 0.5]

if (length(lower_performers) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Creating LOWER PERFORMERS grid (R² ≤ 0.5):", length(lower_performers), "variables\n")
```

```{r}
# CREATE TRAINING SCATTERPLOT IN LOG SCALE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING TRAINING SCATTERPLOT IN LOG SCALE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 45), "\n", sep="")

if (length(successful_enhanced) > 0) {
  for (var_key in successful_enhanced) {
    result <- enhanced_results[[var_key]]
    
    # Skip if no training data
    if (is.null(result$predictions)) {
      cat("Skipping", var_key, "- no predictions data\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Get training data for plotting (log scale)
    train_data <- result$predictions %>%
      filter(data_split == "train", !is.na(Y_true_transformed))
    
    if (nrow(train_data) < 5) {
      cat("Skipping", var_key, "- insufficient training data\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Extract values for plotting (log scale)
    pred_col_transformed <- paste0(var_key, "_transformed_predicted")
    observed_log <- train_data$Y_true_transformed
    predicted_log <- train_data[[pred_col_transformed]]
    
    # Create training performance data
    train_plot_data <- data.frame(
      Observed_Log = observed_log,
      Predicted_Log = predicted_log,
      Residuals_Log = observed_log - predicted_log
    )
    
    # Calculate training metrics (log scale)
    ss_res_log <- sum((observed_log - predicted_log)^2)
    ss_tot_log <- sum((observed_log - mean(observed_log))^2)
    r_squared_log <- 1 - (ss_res_log / ss_tot_log)
    rmse_log <- sqrt(mean((observed_log - predicted_log)^2))
    mae_log <- mean(abs(observed_log - predicted_log))
    
    # Create training scatterplot (log scale) - same style as validation
    p_train_log <- ggplot(train_plot_data, aes(x = Observed_Log, y = Predicted_Log)) +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Training Performance (Log Scale):", var_key),
        subtitle = paste("Z-outliers removed:", result$n_zscore_outliers_removed,
                        "| Transformation:", result$transformation_info$transformation, 
                        "| Training R² =", round(r_squared_log, 3),
                        "| Training RMSE =", round(rmse_log, 3)),
        x = paste("Observed Log-Transformed", result$original_variable),
        y = paste("Predicted Log-Transformed", result$original_variable),
        caption = paste("Training points:", nrow(train_plot_data))
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
    
    # Add performance metrics to plot
    p_train_log <- p_train_log + 
      annotate("text", x = min(observed_log), y = max(predicted_log),
               label = paste("Training R²:", round(r_squared_log, 3), 
                            "\nTraining RMSE:", round(rmse_log, 3),
                            "\nTraining MAE:", round(mae_log, 3)),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
               color = "darkgreen", fontface = "bold")
    
    # Save training plot
    ggsave(paste0(base_path, "TRAINING_LOG_SCALE_", var_key, ".png"), 
           p_train_log, width = 10, height = 6)
    
    cat("✅ Training log-scale plot saved for", var_key, "\n")
    cat("   • Training R² (log scale):", round(r_squared_log, 3), "\n")
    cat("   • Training RMSE (log scale):", round(rmse_log, 3), "\n")
    cat("   • Training points:", nrow(train_plot_data), "\n")
    
    # Also create a combined plot with both training and validation
    if (!is.na(result$metrics$r_squared)) {
      # Get validation data for combined plot
      val_data <- result$predictions %>%
        filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true_transformed))
      
      if (nrow(val_data) >= 5) {
        val_pred_col_transformed <- paste0(var_key, "_transformed_predicted")
        val_observed_log <- val_data$Y_true_transformed
        val_predicted_log <- val_data[[val_pred_col_transformed]]
        
        # Create combined data
        combined_data <- data.frame(
          Observed_Log = c(observed_log, val_observed_log),
          Predicted_Log = c(predicted_log, val_predicted_log),
          Data_Type = c(rep("Training", length(observed_log)), 
                       rep("Validation", length(val_observed_log)))
        )
        
        # Create combined plot
        p_combined <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Observed_Log, y = Predicted_Log, color = Data_Type)) +
          geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
          geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("Training" = "steelblue", "Validation" = "orange")) +
          labs(
            title = paste("Training vs Validation (Log Scale):", var_key),
            subtitle = paste("Training R²:", round(r_squared_log, 3), 
                            "| Validation R²:", round(result$metrics$r_squared, 3)),
            x = paste("Observed Log-Transformed", result$original_variable),
            y = paste("Predicted Log-Transformed", result$original_variable),
            color = "Data Split"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
        
        ggsave(paste0(base_path, "COMBINED_LOG_SCALE_", var_key, ".png"), 
               p_combined, width = 10, height = 6)
        cat("✅ Combined training/validation plot saved for", var_key, "\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Uses foreach and doParallel for parallel processing of variables
# Applies Z-score outlier removal BEFORE transformations to address funnel effects and extreme values
# Processes only: CN_Ratio, Available_P2O5_mg_kg, Compaction_Index, 
#                 Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm, Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g
# ============================================================================

library(sf)

# Register parallel backend
cl <- makeCluster(cores_to_use)
registerDoParallel(cl)
cat("Parallel cluster registered with", cores_to_use, "workers\n")

# ============================================================================

cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")

# Load the complete dataset
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_with_soil_complete.gpkg"

if (file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  parcelles_complete <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)

} else {

}

# Check for duplicate records that might cause many-to-many joins

if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {

    ) %>%

  cat("✅ Unique identifiers created\n")
} else {

  parcelles_complete <- parcelles_complete %>%
    mutate(
      replicate_id = 1,
      unique_observation_key = paste0(Final_Cleaned_ID, "_", Year, "_rep1")
    )
}

# Define problematic variables with their transformations
problematic_variables <- list(
  "CN_Ratio" = list(
    original = "CN_Ratio",
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for funnel effect",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,

  ),
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg" = list(
    original = "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", 
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for funnel effect",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Compaction_Index" = list(
    original = "Compaction_Index",
    transformation = "log", 
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation + Student-t distribution for extreme values",
    distribution = "gaussian",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,
```
