```{r}
  ),
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm" = list(
    original = "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm",
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for variance issues",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,
    zscore_threshold = 3
  ),
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g" = list(
    original = "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g", 
    transformation = "log",
    description = "Z-score outlier removal + Log transformation for variance issues",
    outlier_removal = FALSE,
    zscore_threshold = 3
  )
)

cat("\nVariables to process with Z-score outlier removal + transformations:\n")
for (i in seq_along(problematic_variables)) {
  var_info <- problematic_variables[[i]]
  var_name <- names(problematic_variables)[i]
  cat(sprintf("• %s: %s (Z-score threshold: %s)\n", var_name, var_info$description, var_info$zscore_threshold))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: RECREATE SPATIAL STRUCTURES (MEMORY EFFICIENT)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🗺️ RECREATING SPATIAL STRUCTURES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Get unique parcels with their geometry for W.P1 creation
unique_parcels_spatial <- parcelles_complete %>%
  group_by(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Final_Cleaned_ID)

cat("Unique parcels for spatial analysis:", nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), "\n")

# Ensure geometries are valid
unique_parcels_spatial <- st_make_valid(unique_parcels_spatial)
cat("Geometries validated\n")

# Create field mapping for sequential IDs (required for INLA)
field_mapping <- data.frame(
  Original_ID = unique_parcels_spatial$Final_Cleaned_ID,
  Sequential_ID = 1:nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)
)

cat("Field mapping created: 1 to", nrow(field_mapping), "\n")

# Add Sequential_ID to the spatial data
unique_parcels_spatial <- unique_parcels_spatial %>%
  left_join(field_mapping, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID")) %>%
  arrange(Sequential_ID)

# Create spatial weights matrix W.P1
cat("Computing boundary-to-boundary distances (this may take time)...\n")

# Get parcel boundaries
boundaries <- st_boundary(unique_parcels_spatial)

# Calculate distance matrix
dist_matrix <- st_distance(boundaries, boundaries)
dist_matrix <- units::drop_units(dist_matrix)
diag(dist_matrix) <- NA

cat("Distance matrix calculated:", nrow(dist_matrix), "x", ncol(dist_matrix), "\n")

# Use fixed threshold
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD <- 110
cat("Using distance threshold:", DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, "meters\n")

# Create adjacency matrix
W.P1_complete <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial), ncol = nrow(unique_parcels_spatial))
W.P1_complete[dist_matrix <= DISTANCE_THRESHOLD & !is.na(dist_matrix)] <- 1
diag(W.P1_complete) <- 0
rownames(W.P1_complete) <- colnames(W.P1_complete) <- 1:nrow(W.P1_complete)

# Calculate adjacency statistics
n_connections <- sum(W.P1_complete)
avg_neighbors <- n_connections / nrow(unique_parcels_spatial)

cat("✅ W.P1 matrix created:\n")
cat("• Dimensions:", nrow(W.P1_complete), "x", ncol(W.P1_complete), "\n")
cat("• Total connections:", n_connections, "\n")
cat("• Average neighbors per parcel:", round(avg_neighbors, 2), "\n")

# Create temporal structure
years_unique <- sort(unique(parcelles_complete$Year))
n_years <- length(years_unique)
year_mapping <- data.frame(
  Year = years_unique,
  ID.Year = 1:n_years
)

cat("Years mapped:", min(years_unique), "to", max(years_unique), "(", n_years, "years)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
remove_zscore_outliers <- function(data, variable_name, threshold = 3, verbose = TRUE) {
  # Remove outliers based on Z-score threshold
  # 
  # Args:
  #   data: dataframe containing the variable
  #   variable_name: name of the variable column
  #   threshold: Z-score threshold (default = 3)
  #   verbose: whether to print details
  # 
  # Returns:
  #   Modified dataframe with outliers set to NA
  
  original_values <- data[[variable_name]]
  n_total <- length(original_values)
  n_available_before <- sum(!is.na(original_values))
  
  if (n_available_before < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Insufficient data for Z-score outlier removal\n")
    return(data)
  }
  
  # Calculate Z-scores
  mean_val <- mean(original_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_val <- sd(original_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (sd_val == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ⚠️  Zero standard deviation - no outliers removed\n")
    return(data)
  }
  
  z_scores <- abs((original_values - mean_val) / sd_val)
  
  # Identify outliers
  outliers <- !is.na(z_scores) & z_scores > threshold
  n_outliers <- sum(outliers)
  
  # Remove outliers (set to NA)
  data_modified <- data
  data_modified[[variable_name]][outliers] <- NA
  
  n_available_after <- sum(!is.na(data_modified[[variable_name]]))
  pct_removed <- round((n_outliers / n_available_before) * 100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  🗑️  Z-score outlier removal (threshold =", threshold, "):\n")
    cat("    • Original available:", n_available_before, "\n")
    cat("    • Outliers removed:", n_outliers, "(", pct_removed, "%)\n")
    cat("    • Remaining available:", n_available_after, "\n")
    if (n_outliers > 0) {
      outlier_values <- original_values[outliers]
      cat("    • Outlier range:", round(min(outlier_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "to", 
          round(max(outlier_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("    • Max Z-score removed:", round(max(z_scores[outliers], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  return(data_modified)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: ENHANCED IMPUTATION FUNCTION WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL (FIXED JOINS)
# ============================================================================
impute_transformed_variable_with_zscore <- function(variable_info, variable_key, parcelles_data, W_matrix, field_map, year_map, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n", "=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
    cat("🔬 PROCESSING TRANSFORMED VARIABLE WITH Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL:", variable_key, "\n")
    cat("Original variable:", variable_info$original, "\n")
    cat("Z-score threshold:", variable_info$zscore_threshold, "\n")
    cat("Transformation:", variable_info$transformation, "\n")
    cat("Description:", variable_info$description, "\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep="")
  }
  
  # Get original values
  original_var <- variable_info$original
  var_values <- parcelles_data[[original_var]]
  n_total <- length(var_values)
  n_available <- sum(!is.na(var_values))
  n_missing <- n_total - n_available
  pct_available <- round(n_available/n_total*100, 1)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Original variable statistics:\n")
    cat("• Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
    cat("• Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
    cat("• Missing (NA):", n_missing, "(", round(n_missing/n_total*100, 1), "%)\n")
    
    if (n_available > 0) {
      cat("• Min value:", round(min(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Max value:", round(max(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Mean value:", round(mean(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("• Std deviation:", round(sd(var_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Skip if insufficient data
  if (n_available < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create working dataset
  working_data <- parcelles_data
  
  # STEP 1: Apply Z-score outlier removal FIRST
  if (verbose) cat("\n🎯 STEP 1: Z-SCORE OUTLIER REMOVAL\n")
  working_data <- remove_zscore_outliers(
    working_data, 
    original_var, 
    threshold = variable_info$zscore_threshold, 
    verbose = verbose
  )
  
  # Check remaining data after Z-score removal
  n_available_after_zscore <- sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
  if (n_available_after_zscore < 10) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient data after Z-score removal (< 10 observations). Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # STEP 2: Apply additional outlier removal if specified (legacy support)
  if (variable_info$outlier_removal && !is.null(variable_info$outlier_threshold)) {
    if (verbose) cat("\n🗑️ STEP 2: ADDITIONAL OUTLIER REMOVAL\n")
    threshold <- variable_info$outlier_threshold
    outliers_removed <- sum(working_data[[original_var]] > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!original_var := ifelse(.data[[original_var]] > threshold, NA, .data[[original_var]]))
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  • Additional threshold:", threshold, "\n")
      cat("  • Additional values removed:", outliers_removed, "\n")
      n_available_after_additional <- sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
      cat("  • Remaining available:", n_available_after_additional, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # STEP 3: Apply transformation
  if (verbose) cat("\n📈 STEP 3: APPLYING TRANSFORMATION\n")
  transform_name <- paste0(original_var, "_transformed")
  
  if (variable_info$transformation == "log") {
    # Use log(x+1) to handle zeros
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!transform_name := log(.data[[original_var]] + 1))
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("  ✅ Log(x+1) transformation applied\n")
      transformed_values <- working_data[[transform_name]]
      n_transformed <- sum(!is.na(transformed_values))
      if (n_transformed > 0) {
        cat("  • Transformed min:", round(min(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed max:", round(max(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed mean:", round(mean(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
        cat("  • Transformed std:", round(sd(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    # No transformation, just copy
    working_data <- working_data %>%
      mutate(!!transform_name := .data[[original_var]])
  }
  
  # Create train/validation split at the parcel level (not observation level)
  # This prevents many-to-many issues
  observed_data <- working_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[transform_name]]))
  
  set.seed(123)  # Consistent split
  unique_parcels_with_data <- observed_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(Final_Cleaned_ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(split = sample(c("train", "val"), n(), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
  
  # Apply split - FIXED: Specify relationship explicitly
  working_data_split <- working_data %>%
    left_join(unique_parcels_with_data, by = "Final_Cleaned_ID", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    mutate(
      data_split = case_when(
        is.na(.data[[transform_name]]) ~ "predict",
        split == "train" ~ "train", 
        split == "val" ~ "validation",
        TRUE ~ "predict"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-split)
  
  train_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "train")
  val_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "validation")
  pred_obs <- sum(working_data_split$data_split == "predict")
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n📊 STEP 4: DATA SPLIT\n")
    cat("  • Training:", train_obs, "\n")
    cat("  • Validation:", val_obs, "\n")
    cat("  • To predict:", pred_obs, "\n")
  }
  
  # Prepare INLA dataset - FIXED: Using unique_observation_key instead of creating duplicate keys
  df_inla <- working_data_split %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(field_map, by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID" = "Original_ID"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    mutate(
      Y = case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ .data[[transform_name]],
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      Y_true_original = .data[[original_var]],
      Y_true_transformed = .data[[transform_name]], 
      ID.Field = Sequential_ID,
      ID.Year = as.integer(ID.Year),
      Month = as.integer(ifelse(is.na(Month), 6, Month)),
      Bloc = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Bloc), "Unknown", as.character(Bloc))),
      Var = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(Var), "Unknown", as.character(Var))),
      irrg_ty = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(irrg_ty), "Unknown", as.character(irrg_ty)))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID.Field), !is.na(ID.Year)) %>%
    arrange(ID.Field, ID.Year, replicate_id)
  
  # Check compatibility
  if (max(df_inla$ID.Field) > nrow(W_matrix)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Spatial structure incompatible. Skipping variable.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("\n🚀 STEP 5: FITTING ENHANCED SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL\n")
  
  # Determine distribution family
  family_to_use <- "gaussian"
  if (!is.null(variable_info$distribution) && variable_info$distribution == "t") {
    family_to_use <- "T"  # Student-t distribution in INLA
    if (verbose) cat("  📊 Using Student-t distribution for robustness\n")
  }
  
  # Fit model
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  fit_result <- tryCatch({
    prec_prior <- list(theta = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.005)))
    
    inla(
      Y ~ 1 + Bloc + irrg_ty +
        f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix,
          group = ID.Year, 
          control.group = list(model = "ar1"),
          hyper = list(prec = prec_prior),
          constr = TRUE),
      data = df_inla,
      family = family_to_use,
      control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
      control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
      control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Full model failed. Trying simpler model...\n")
    
    # Try simpler model
    tryCatch({
      inla(
        Y ~ 1 + Bloc + f(ID.Field, model = "besag", graph = W_matrix, constr = TRUE),
        data = df_inla,
        family = family_to_use,
        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e2) {
      if (verbose) cat("  ❌ Simple model also failed:", e2$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  fitting_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  if (is.null(fit_result) || is.null(fit_result$summary.fitted.values)) {
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Model fitting failed completely\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("  ✅ Model successful! Fitting time:", round(fitting_time, 1), "minutes\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$dic)) cat("  • DIC:", round(fit_result$dic$dic, 2), "\n")
    if (!is.null(fit_result$waic)) cat("  • WAIC:", round(fit_result$waic$waic, 2), "\n")
  }
  
  # Extract predictions
  predictions <- fit_result$summary.fitted.values
  
  # Back-transform predictions if needed
  if (variable_info$transformation == "log") {
    predictions_original <- list(
      mean = exp(predictions$mean) - 1,
      sd = exp(predictions$mean) * predictions$sd,  # Delta method approximation
      `0.025quant` = exp(predictions$`0.025quant`) - 1,
      `0.975quant` = exp(predictions$`0.975quant`) - 1
    )
    
    # Ensure no negative values after transformation
    predictions_original$mean <- pmax(predictions_original$mean, 0)
    predictions_original$`0.025quant` <- pmax(predictions_original$`0.025quant`, 0)
    predictions_original$`0.975quant` <- pmax(predictions_original$`0.975quant`, 0)
    
    if (verbose) cat("  🔄 Back-transformation applied (exp(x) - 1)\n")
  } else {
    predictions_original <- predictions
  }
  
  # Create predictions dataframe with both scales
  df_predicted <- df_inla %>%
    mutate(
      # Transformed scale predictions
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted") := predictions$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_sd") := predictions$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_lower") := predictions$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_transformed_predicted_upper") := predictions$`0.975quant`,
      
      # Original scale predictions  
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted") := predictions_original$mean,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_sd") := predictions_original$sd,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_lower") := predictions_original$`0.025quant`,
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_upper") := predictions_original$`0.975quant`,
      
      # Complete dataset (original scale)
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_complete") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ Y_true_original,
        TRUE ~ predictions_original$mean
      ),
      
      # Prediction type
      !!paste0(variable_key, "_prediction_type") := case_when(
        data_split == "train" ~ "Training",
        data_split == "validation" ~ "Validation", 
        data_split == "predict" ~ "Predicted"
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate validation metrics (on original scale)
  validation_data <- df_predicted %>%
    filter(data_split == "validation", !is.na(Y_true_original), !is.na(predictions_original$mean))
  
  metrics <- list(
    variable = variable_key,
    original_variable = original_var,
    transformation = variable_info$transformation,
    distribution = ifelse(is.null(variable_info$distribution), "gaussian", variable_info$distribution),
    zscore_threshold = variable_info$zscore_threshold,
    n_outliers_removed = n_available - sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))
  )
  
  if (nrow(validation_data) > 5) {
    pred_vals <- validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted")]]
    true_vals <- validation_data$Y_true_original
    
    ss_res <- sum((true_vals - pred_vals)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((true_vals - mean(true_vals))^2)
    r_squared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    metrics$r_squared <- r_squared
    metrics$correlation <- cor(true_vals, pred_vals)
    metrics$rmse <- sqrt(mean((true_vals - pred_vals)^2))
    metrics$mae <- mean(abs(true_vals - pred_vals))
    metrics$mean_error <- mean(true_vals - pred_vals)
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    
    # Coverage probability (original scale)
    in_interval <- sum(validation_data$Y_true_original >= validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_lower")]] & 
                      validation_data$Y_true_original <= validation_data[[paste0(variable_key, "_predicted_upper")]])
    metrics$coverage_prob <- in_interval / nrow(validation_data)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("\n🎯 STEP 6: VALIDATION RESULTS (ORIGINAL SCALE)\n")
      cat("  • Validation obs:", metrics$n_validation, "\n")
      cat("  • R²:", round(metrics$r_squared, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • Correlation:", round(metrics$correlation, 4), "\n") 
      cat("  • RMSE:", round(metrics$rmse, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • MAE:", round(metrics$mae, 4), "\n")
      cat("  • Coverage:", round(metrics$coverage_prob * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("  • Z-score outliers removed:", metrics$n_outliers_removed, "\n")
    }
  } else {
    metrics$r_squared <- NA
    metrics$correlation <- NA
    metrics$rmse <- NA
    metrics$mae <- NA
    metrics$mean_error <- NA
    metrics$n_validation <- nrow(validation_data)
    metrics$coverage_prob <- NA
    
    if (verbose) cat("❌ Insufficient validation data for metrics\n")
  }
  
  # Create return object
  result <- list(
    variable_name = variable_key,
    original_variable = original_var,
    transformation_info = variable_info,
    model_fit = fit_result,
    predictions = df_predicted,
    metrics = metrics,
    fitting_time = fitting_time,
    n_total = n_total,
    n_available = sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]])),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(working_data[[original_var]])),
    pct_available = round(sum(!is.na(working_data[[original_var]]))/n_total*100, 1),
    n_zscore_outliers_removed = metrics$n_outliers_removed
  )
  
  return(result)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: PARALLELIZED PROCESSING OF ALL PROBLEMATIC VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🚀 STARTING PARALLELIZED PROCESSING OF", length(problematic_variables), "VARIABLES:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")

start_processing <- Sys.time()

# Process variables in parallel using foreach
cat("Processing variables in parallel across", cores_to_use, "cores...\n")

enhanced_results_list <- foreach(
  i = seq_along(problematic_variables),
  .combine = 'list',
  .multicombine = TRUE,
  .packages = c('sf', 'INLA', 'dplyr', 'ggplot2', 'viridis', 'spdep', 'readr', 'purrr', 'tibble'),
  .export = c('impute_transformed_variable_with_zscore', 'remove_zscore_outliers', 
              'parcelles_complete', 'W.P1_complete', 'field_mapping', 'year_mapping'),
  .verbose = TRUE,
  .errorhandling = 'pass'
) %dopar% {
  
  # Get variable information
  var_key <- names(problematic_variables)[i]
  var_info <- problematic_variables[[i]]
  
  # Process the variable
  result <- tryCatch({
    impute_transformed_variable_with_zscore(
      variable_info = var_info,
      variable_key = var_key,
      parcelles_data = parcelles_complete,
      W_matrix = W.P1_complete,
      field_map = field_mapping,
      year_map = year_mapping,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Return error information instead of stopping
    list(
      variable_name = var_key,
      error = TRUE,
      error_message = as.character(e),
      processing_time = 0
    )
  })
  
  return(result)
}

# Stop parallel cluster
stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()

end_processing <- Sys.time()
total_processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_processing, start_processing, units = "mins"))

cat("\n🏁 PARALLEL PROCESSING COMPLETED!\n")
cat("Total processing time:", round(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: ANALYZE PROCESSING RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 ANALYZING PROCESSING RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Separate successful results from errors
successful_results <- list()
failed_results <- list()

for (i in seq_along(enhanced_results_list)) {
  result <- enhanced_results_list[[i]]
  if (is.null(result) || (is.list(result) && isTRUE(result$error))) {
    failed_results[[length(failed_results) + 1]] <- result
  } else {
    successful_results[[names(problematic_variables)[i]]] <- result
  }
}

n_successful <- length(successful_results)
n_failed <- length(failed_results)

cat("Processing summary:\n")
cat("• Successful:", n_successful, "/", length(problematic_variables), "\n")
cat("• Failed:", n_failed, "/", length(problematic_variables), "\n")

# Report failed variables
if (n_failed > 0) {
  cat("\n❌ Failed variables:\n")
  for (i in seq_along(failed_results)) {
    result <- failed_results[[i]]
    if (!is.null(result$variable_name)) {
      cat("  •", result$variable_name)
      if (!is.null(result$error_message)) {
        cat(" - Error:", substr(result$error_message, 1, 100))
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}

# Report successful variables
if (n_successful > 0) {
  cat("\n✅ Successfully processed variables:\n")
  for (var_name in names(successful_results)) {
    result <- successful_results[[var_name]]
    cat("  •", var_name, "- R²:", 
        ifelse(is.na(result$metrics$r_squared), "N/A", round(result$metrics$r_squared, 3)),
        "- Time:", round(result$fitting_time, 1), "min\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: CREATE COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📋 CREATING COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS SUMMARY:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 55), "\n", sep="")

if (n_successful > 0) {
  # Create metrics summary table
  metrics_summary <- map_dfr(successful_results, function(result) {
    tibble(
      Variable = result$variable_name,
      Original_Variable = result$original_variable,
      Transformation = result$transformation_info$transformation,
      Distribution = ifelse(is.null(result$transformation_info$distribution), 
                           "gaussian", result$transformation_info$distribution),
      Z_Score_Threshold = result$transformation_info$zscore_threshold,
      N_Total = result$n_total,
      N_Available = result$n_available,
      N_Missing = result$n_missing,
      Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
      N_ZScore_Outliers_Removed = result$n_zscore_outliers_removed,
      N_Validation = result$metrics$n_validation,
      R_Squared = result$metrics$r_squared,
      Correlation = result$metrics$correlation,
      RMSE = result$metrics$rmse,
      MAE = result$metrics$mae,
      Coverage_Prob = result$metrics$coverage_prob,
      Fitting_Time_Min = result$fitting_time,
      DIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$dic), NA, result$model_fit$dic$dic),
      WAIC = ifelse(is.null(result$model_fit$waic), NA, result$model_fit$waic$waic)
    )
  })
  
  # Display summary
  cat("METRICS SUMMARY:\n")
  cat("================\n")
  print(metrics_summary, n = Inf)
  
  # Calculate overall statistics
  cat("\nOVERALL STATISTICS:\n")
  cat("===================\n")
  cat("• Average R²:", round(mean(metrics_summary$R_Squared, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("• Average Correlation:", round(mean(metrics_summary$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("• Average Coverage:", round(mean(metrics_summary$Coverage_Prob, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("• Total Z-score outliers removed:", sum(metrics_summary$N_ZScore_Outliers_Removed), "\n")
  cat("• Average fitting time per variable:", round(mean(metrics_summary$Fitting_Time_Min), 1), "min\n")
  cat("• Total processing time:", round(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: MERGE PREDICTIONS BACK TO COMPLETE DATASET (FIXED JOINS)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 MERGING PREDICTIONS BACK TO COMPLETE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 60), "\n", sep="")

if (n_successful > 0) {
  # Start with original dataset
  parcelles_enhanced <- parcelles_complete
  
  # Add predictions from each successful model
  for (var_name in names(successful_results)) {
    result <- successful_results[[var_name]]
    predictions_df <- result$predictions
    
    cat("Merging", var_name, "predictions...\n")
    
    # Prepare merge columns with unique_observation_key
    merge_cols <- predictions_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, replicate_id,
        matches(paste0("^", var_name, "_.*(_predicted|_complete|_prediction_type)"))
      )
    
    # FIXED: Merge using Final_Cleaned_ID, Year, AND replicate_id to ensure one-to-one relationship
    parcelles_enhanced <- parcelles_enhanced %>%
      left_join(
        merge_cols,
        by = c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year", "replicate_id"),
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )
    
    cat("  • Added", ncol(merge_cols) - 3, "prediction columns for", var_name, "\n")
  }
  
  # Report final dataset size
  cat("✅ Enhanced dataset created:\n")
  cat("  • Observations:", nrow(parcelles_enhanced), "\n")
  cat("  • Variables:", ncol(parcelles_enhanced), "\n")
  
  # Count prediction columns added
  prediction_cols <- names(parcelles_enhanced)[grepl("_predicted|_complete|_prediction_type", names(parcelles_enhanced))]
  cat("  • New prediction columns:", length(prediction_cols), "\n")
}

    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 2. Data Availability Plot
  cat("Creating data availability plot...\n")
  
  availability_plot <- metrics_summary %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, Pct_Available), y = Pct_Available)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = N_ZScore_Outliers_Removed), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Pct_Available, 1), "%")), 
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Z-Score\nOutliers\nRemoved", option = "plasma") +
    labs(
      title = "Data Availability After Z-Score Outlier Removal",
      subtitle = "Percentage of available data and outliers removed",
      x = "Variable",
      y = "Percentage Available (%)",
      caption = "Color indicates number of Z-score outliers removed"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  # 3. Processing Time Plot
  cat("Creating processing time plot...\n")
  
  time_plot <- metrics_summary %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, Fitting_Time_Min), y = Fitting_Time_Min)) +
    geom_col(fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Fitting_Time_Min, 1), "m")), 
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Model Fitting Time by Variable",
      subtitle = "Processing time for each enhanced transformation",
      x = "Variable",
      y = "Fitting Time (minutes)",
      caption = paste("Total processing time:", round(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
```

### VII.3.1. ANALYZE SPATIO-TEMPORAL INLA MODEL OUTPUTS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE SPATIO-TEMPORAL INLA MODEL OUTPUTS - CLAY PERCENTAGE
# Analysis of fitted spatio-temporal model across years
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  SPATIO-TEMPORAL MODEL ANALYSIS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# SMART VISUALIZATION FUNCTIONS (YOUR STYLE)
# ============================================================================

# Smart color palette selection
get_smart_colors <- function(variable, values) {
  if (grepl("pH|ph", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(c("#d73027", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "#a6d96a", "#66bd63", "#1a9850"))
  } else if (grepl("percent|%|Clay|Silt|Sand|pred_mean|prediction", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrBr"))
  } else if (grepl("Carbon|Nitrogen|Organic", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))
  } else if (grepl("uncertainty|sd|residual", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))
  } else if (grepl("Calcium|Magnesium|Potassium|Sodium", variable, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
  } else {
    return(viridis(9, option = "plasma"))
  }
}

# Smart grid calculation
get_smart_grid <- function(n_items) {
  if (n_items <= 1) return(c(1, 1))
  if (n_items == 2) return(c(1, 2))
  if (n_items == 3) return(c(1, 3))
  if (n_items == 4) return(c(2, 2))
  if (n_items <= 6) return(c(2, 3))
  if (n_items <= 9) return(c(3, 3))
  if (n_items <= 12) return(c(3, 4))
  else return(c(ceiling(sqrt(n_items)), ceiling(n_items/ceiling(sqrt(n_items)))))
}

# Variable labels
variable_labels <- list(
  "pred_mean" = "Predicted Clay %",
  "sd" = "Prediction Uncertainty (SD)",
  "residuals" = "Model Residuals",
  "Clay_percent" = "Clay Percentage (%)"
)

# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED PLOTTING FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

# Create high-quality output directories
create_output_directories <- function() {
  main_dir <- "spatiotemporal_analysis_results"
  subdirs <- c("predictions", "uncertainty", "residuals", "diagnostics", "trends")
  
  if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) {
    dir.create(main_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (subdir in subdirs) {
    subdir_path <- file.path(main_dir, subdir)
    if (!dir.exists(subdir_path)) {
      dir.create(subdir_path, recursive = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(main_dir)
}

# Enhanced save function for high-quality plots
save_high_quality_plot <- function(plot, filename, subfolder = "", width = 12, height = 8) {
  # Create full path
  if (subfolder != "") {
    full_path <- file.path(output_dir, subfolder, filename)
  } else {
    full_path <- file.path(output_dir, filename)
  }
  
  # Save PNG (high resolution)
  png_path <- gsub("\\.png$", "", full_path)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(png_path, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Save PDF (vector format)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(png_path, ".pdf"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("  ✓ Saved:", basename(png_path), "(PNG + PDF)\n")
}

cat("\n📈 TEMPORAL TRENDS ANALYSIS:\n")

# Calculate temporal trends by field
temporal_trends <- st_effects_processed %>%
  group_by(Original_Field_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years = n(),
    mean_clay = mean(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    trend_slope = ifelse(n_years > 1, 
                        coef(lm(pred_mean ~ Year))[2], 
                        NA),
    trend_pvalue = ifelse(n_years > 1, 
                         summary(lm(pred_mean ~ Year))$coefficients[2,4], 
                         NA),
    clay_variance = var(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trend_significant = ifelse(!is.na(trend_pvalue), trend_pvalue < 0.05, FALSE),
    trend_direction = case_when(
      !trend_significant ~ "No significant trend",
      trend_slope > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      trend_slope < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "Stable"
    )
  )

cat("Temporal trend summary:\n")
trend_summary <- temporal_trends %>%
  count(trend_direction) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n/sum(n)*100, 1))

print(trend_summary)

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# INLA MODEL SUMMARY TABLES WITH GT
# Create professional summary tables for fixed and random effects
# ============================================================================

library(INLA)
library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  CREATING INLA SUMMARY TABLES WITH GT\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Extract Fixed Effects Summary
# ============================================================================
extract_fixed_effects <- function(inla_model, model_name = "Model") {
  if (is.null(inla_model) || is.null(inla_model$summary.fixed)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fixed_summary <- inla_model$summary.fixed %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Parameter") %>%
    mutate(
      Model = model_name,
      Significant = ifelse(`0.025quant` > 0 | `0.975quant` < 0, "Yes", "No"),
      .before = 1
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Mean = mean,
      SD = sd,
      `Q2.5` = `0.025quant`,
      `Q97.5` = `0.975quant`,
      Mode = mode,
      KLD = kld
    )
  
  return(fixed_summary)
}

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Extract Random Effects Summary  
# ============================================================================
extract_random_effects <- function(inla_model, model_name = "Model") {
  if (is.null(inla_model)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  random_effects <- list()
  
  # Extract hyperparameters (precision parameters)
  if (!is.null(inla_model$summary.hyperpar)) {
    hyper_summary <- inla_model$summary.hyperpar %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Parameter") %>%
      mutate(
        Model = model_name,
        Type = "Hyperparameter",
        .before = 1
      ) %>%
      rename(
        Mean = mean,
        SD = sd,
        `Q2.5` = `0.025quant`,
        `Q97.5` = `0.975quant`,
        Mode = mode
      )
    
    random_effects$hyperparameters <- hyper_summary
  }
  
  # Extract spatial random effects (if available)
  spatial_effects <- NULL
  for (effect_name in names(inla_model$summary.random)) {
    effect_summary <- inla_model$summary.random[[effect_name]]
    if (!is.null(effect_summary) && nrow(effect_summary) > 0) {
      effect_df <- effect_summary %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(
          Model = model_name,
          Effect = effect_name,
          Type = "Random Effect",
          .before = 1
        ) %>%
        rename(
          Mean = mean,
          SD = sd,
          `Q2.5` = `0.025quant`,
          `Q97.5` = `0.975quant`,
          Mode = mode,
          KLD = kld
        )
      
      # Store first few and summary statistics
      if (nrow(effect_df) > 10) {
        # Summary statistics for large random effects
        summary_stats <- effect_df %>%
          summarise(
            Model = first(Model),
            Effect = first(Effect),
            Type = "Random Effect Summary",
            ID = paste("n =", nrow(effect_df)),
            Mean_avg = mean(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            Mean_min = min(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            Mean_max = max(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD_avg = mean(SD, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop'
          ) %>%
          rename(
            Mean = Mean_avg,
            `Min Mean` = Mean_min,
            `Max Mean` = Mean_max,
            `Avg SD` = SD_avg
          )
        
        random_effects[[paste0(effect_name, "_summary")]] <- summary_stats
      } else {
        random_effects[[effect_name]] <- effect_df
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(random_effects)
}

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Create GT Fixed Effects Table
# ============================================================================
create_fixed_effects_table <- function(fixed_effects_list) {
  if (is.null(fixed_effects_list) || length(fixed_effects_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Combine all fixed effects
  combined_fixed <- do.call(rbind, fixed_effects_list)
  
  gt_table <- combined_fixed %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Model") %>%
    tab_header(
      title = "Fixed Effects Summary",
      subtitle = "INLA Bayesian Model Results"
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = c(Mean, SD, Q2.5, Q97.5, Mode),
      decimals = 4
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = KLD,
      decimals = 6
    ) %>%
    data_color(
      columns = Significant,
      colors = c("No" = "#ffebee", "Yes" = "#e8f5e8")
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      Parameter = "Parameter",
      Mean = "Mean",
      SD = "SD",
      Q2.5 = "2.5%",
      Q97.5 = "97.5%",
      Mode = "Mode",
      KLD = "KLD",
      Significant = "Significant"
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size = px(12),
      heading.title.font.size = px(16),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(14),
      row_group.font.weight = "bold"
    ) %>%
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "Significant: 95% credible interval does not include 0",
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = Significant)
    )
  
  return(gt_table)
}

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Create GT Random Effects Table
# ============================================================================
create_random_effects_table <- function(random_effects_list) {
  if (is.null(random_effects_list) || length(random_effects_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Process hyperparameters
  hyperpar_data <- NULL
  for (model_effects in random_effects_list) {
    if (!is.null(model_effects$hyperparameters)) {
      hyperpar_data <- rbind(hyperpar_data, model_effects$hyperparameters)
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(hyperpar_data)) {
    hyper_table <- hyperpar_data %>%
      gt(groupname_col = "Model") %>%
      tab_header(
        title = "Hyperparameters (Precision Parameters)",
        subtitle = "Random Effects Precision Estimates"
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(
        columns = c(Mean, SD, Q2.5, Q97.5, Mode),
        decimals = 4
      ) %>%
      cols_label(
        Parameter = "Parameter",
        Type = "Type",
        Mean = "Mean",
        SD = "SD",
        Q2.5 = "2.5%",
        Q97.5 = "97.5%",
        Mode = "Mode"
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_row_groups()
      ) %>%
      tab_options(
        table.font.size = px(12),
        heading.title.font.size = px(16),
        heading.subtitle.font.size = px(14)
      )
    
    return(hyper_table)
  }
  
  return(NULL)
}

# ============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Create Model Comparison Table
# ============================================================================
create_model_comparison_table <- function(model_list) {
  if (length(model_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  comparison_data <- data.frame()
  
  for (model_name in names(model_list)) {
    model <- model_list[[model_name]]
    if (!is.null(model)) {
      model_info <- data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        DIC = ifelse(!is.null(model$dic$dic), round(model$dic$dic, 2), NA),
        WAIC = ifelse(!is.null(model$waic$waic), round(model$waic$waic, 2), NA),
        Marginal_Likelihood = ifelse(!is.null(model$mlik), round(model$mlik[1], 2), NA),
        N_Observations = ifelse(!is.null(model$.args$data), nrow(model$.args$data), NA),
        N_Fixed_Effects = ifelse(!is.null(model$summary.fixed), nrow(model$summary.fixed), NA),
        N_Random_Effects = ifelse(!is.null(model$summary.random), 
                                  sum(sapply(model$summary.random, nrow)), NA)
      )
      comparison_data <- rbind(comparison_data, model_info)
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(comparison_data) > 0) {
    gt_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
      gt() %>%
      tab_header(
        title = "Model Comparison",
        subtitle = "Information Criteria and Model Statistics"
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(
        columns = c(DIC, WAIC, Marginal_Likelihood),
        decimals = 2
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(
        columns = c(N_Observations, N_Fixed_Effects, N_Random_Effects),
        decimals = 0
      ) %>%
      cols_label(
        Model = "Model",
        DIC = "DIC",
        WAIC = "WAIC", 
        Marginal_Likelihood = "Log ML",
        N_Observations = "N Obs",
        N_Fixed_Effects = "N Fixed",
        N_Random_Effects = "N Random"
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      ) %>%
      data_color(
        columns = DIC,
        colors = scales::col_numeric(
          palette = c("#e8f5e8", "#ffebee"),
          domain = NULL,
          reverse = TRUE
        )
      ) %>%
      data_color(
        columns = WAIC,
        colors = scales::col_numeric(
          palette = c("#e8f5e8", "#ffebee"), 
          domain = NULL,
          reverse = TRUE
        )
      ) %>%
      tab_footnote(
        footnote = "Lower DIC and WAIC indicate better model fit",
        locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(DIC, WAIC))
      )
    
    return(gt_comparison)
  }
  
  return(NULL)
}

# ============================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION: Create Summary Tables
# ============================================================================

# Check which models are available
available_models <- list()
if (exists("fit_spatial_test")) available_models[["Simple Spatial"]] <- fit_spatial_test
if (exists("fit_spatial_full")) available_models[["Spatial with Covariates"]] <- fit_spatial_full  
if (exists("fit_spatiotemporal")) available_models[["Spatio-temporal"]] <- fit_spatiotemporal

if (length(available_models) == 0) {
  cat("❌ No INLA models found. Please run your modeling script first.\n")
} else {
  cat("📊 Creating summary tables for", length(available_models), "models:\n")
  cat("Models found:", paste(names(available_models), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  # Extract fixed effects for all models
  fixed_effects_list <- list()
  for (model_name in names(available_models)) {
    fixed_effects_list[[model_name]] <- extract_fixed_effects(
      available_models[[model_name]], 
      model_name
    )
  }
  
  # Extract random effects for all models
  random_effects_list <- list()
  for (model_name in names(available_models)) {
    random_effects_list[[model_name]] <- extract_random_effects(
      available_models[[model_name]], 
      model_name
    )
  }
  
  # Create tables
  cat("🎨 Creating Fixed Effects Table...\n")
  fixed_table <- create_fixed_effects_table(fixed_effects_list)
  
  cat("🎨 Creating Random Effects Table...\n")  
  random_table <- create_random_effects_table(random_effects_list)
  
  cat("🎨 Creating Model Comparison Table...\n")
  comparison_table <- create_model_comparison_table(available_models)
  
  # Display tables
  if (!is.null(fixed_table)) {
    cat("\n📋 FIXED EFFECTS SUMMARY:\n")
    cat("=" , rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
    print(fixed_table)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(random_table)) {
    cat("\n📋 RANDOM EFFECTS SUMMARY:\n") 
    cat("=", rep("=", 30), "\n", sep="")
    print(random_table)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(comparison_table)) {
    cat("\n📋 MODEL COMPARISON:\n")
    cat("=", rep("=", 20), "\n", sep="")  
    print(comparison_table)
  }
  
  # Save tables as HTML (optional)
  tryCatch({
    if (!is.null(fixed_table)) {
      gtsave(fixed_table, "fixed_effects_summary.html")
      cat("💾 Fixed effects table saved as 'fixed_effects_summary.html'\n")
    }
    
    if (!is.null(random_table)) {
      gtsave(random_table, "random_effects_summary.html") 
      cat("💾 Random effects table saved as 'random_effects_summary.html'\n")
    }
    
    if (!is.null(comparison_table)) {
      gtsave(comparison_table, "model_comparison.html")
      cat("💾 Model comparison saved as 'model_comparison.html'\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("⚠️ Could not save HTML files:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  cat("\n✅ Summary tables created successfully!\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# ADDITIONAL: Create Spatial Effects Summary (if spatial model exists)
# ============================================================================
if (exists("fit_spatial_full") && !is.null(fit_spatial_full)) {
  cat("\n🗺️ Creating Spatial Effects Summary...\n")
  
  if (!is.null(fit_spatial_full$summary.random$ID.Field)) {
    spatial_summary <- fit_spatial_full$summary.random$ID.Field %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(Field_ID = 1:nrow(.)) %>%
      summarise(
        N_Fields = nrow(.),
        Mean_Effect = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Effect = sd(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min_Effect = min(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max_Effect = max(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        Range_Effect = Max_Effect - Min_Effect
      )
    
    spatial_gt <- spatial_summary %>%
      gt() %>%
      tab_header(
        title = "Spatial Random Effects Summary",
        subtitle = "Field-level Spatial Variation"
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(
        columns = c(Mean_Effect, SD_Effect, Min_Effect, Max_Effect, Range_Effect),
        decimals = 4
      ) %>%
      cols_label(
        N_Fields = "N Fields",
        Mean_Effect = "Mean",
        SD_Effect = "SD", 
        Min_Effect = "Minimum",
        Max_Effect = "Maximum",
        Range_Effect = "Range"
      ) %>%
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()
      )
    
    print(spatial_gt)
    
    tryCatch({
      gtsave(spatial_gt, "spatial_effects_summary.html")
      cat("💾 Spatial effects summary saved as 'spatial_effects_summary.html'\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("⚠️ Could not save spatial summary:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
}
```

# VIII. Data Integration : predicted soil to yield data

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED JOIN WITH ALL PARCELS AND ALL YEARS (1992-2025)
# ============================================================================

# Assuming 'parcelles' is shapefile from previous analysis
if (!exists("parcelles")) {
  cat("❌ Shapefile 'parcelles' not found in environment\n")
  cat("Please make sure you've run the previous spatial analysis script first\n")
  stop("Shapefile not available")
}

# Check if df (soil data) exists
if (!exists("df")) {
  cat("❌ Soil data 'df' not found in environment\n")
  cat("Please make sure you've loaded the soil data first\n")
  stop("Soil data not available")
}

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readr)

# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE BEFORE JOIN
# ============================================================================

# Get unique IDs from both datasets
shp_ids <- unique(parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID)
soil_ids <- unique(df$Final_Cleaned_ID)

# Remove NA values
shp_ids <- shp_ids[!is.na(shp_ids)]
soil_ids <- soil_ids[!is.na(soil_ids)]

cat("📊 ID COMPARISON:\n")
cat("Shapefile unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(shp_ids), "\n")
cat("Soil data unique Final_Cleaned_IDs:", length(soil_ids), "\n")

# Find matches
matches <- intersect(shp_ids, soil_ids)
cat("IDs in BOTH datasets:", length(matches), "\n")
cat("Parcels WITHOUT soil data:", length(shp_ids) - length(matches), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# CREATE EXPANDED DATASET WITH ALL YEARS (1992-2025)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📅 CREATING EXPANDED DATASET WITH ALL YEARS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep="")

# Define the year range
years <- 1992:2025
cat("Creating rows for years:", min(years), "to", max(years), "(", length(years), "years )\n")

# Step 1: Create base parcel-year combinations
cat("Step 1: Expanding parcels to include all years...\n")

# Get all unique parcel IDs (including those without soil data)
all_parcel_ids <- unique(parcelles$Final_Cleaned_ID)
all_parcel_ids <- all_parcel_ids[!is.na(all_parcel_ids)]

# Create expanded parcel dataset with all years
parcelles_expanded <- parcelles %>%
  # Convert to regular dataframe temporarily to avoid geometry duplication issues
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # Keep only unique parcels (remove any duplicates)
  distinct(Final_Cleaned_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Create all year combinations
  slice(rep(1:n(), each = length(years))) %>%
  # Add year column
  mutate(Year = rep(years, times = n()/length(years)))

cat("✅ Expanded parcels dataset created:", nrow(parcelles_expanded), "rows\n")
cat("   (", length(all_parcel_ids), "parcels ×", length(years), "years )\n")

# ============================================================================
# PREPARE SOIL DATA FOR JOIN
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 2: Preparing soil data for join...\n")

# Check if soil data has a Year column, if not, try to infer it
if (!"Year" %in% names(df)) {
  cat("⚠️ No 'Year' column found in soil data\n")
  cat("Available columns in soil data:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Try to find year-related columns
  year_cols <- names(df)[grepl("year|Year|YEAR|date|Date|DATE|time|Time", names(df))]
  if (length(year_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Potential year columns found:", paste(year_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

}

# ============================================================================

# Convert soil data Year to integer (this fixes the factor issue)

  df$Year <- as.integer(as.character(df$Year))
} else if (is.character(df$Year)) {

if (na_count_parcelles > 0) {

# Get unique years in soil data
soil_years <- unique(df$Year)
soil_years <- soil_years[!is.na(soil_years)]
cat("Years available in soil data:", paste(sort(soil_years), collapse = ", "), "\n")

soil_data_columns <- names(df)[!names(df) %in% c("Final_Cleaned_ID", "Year")]
numeric_soil_cols <- soil_data_columns[sapply(df[soil_data_columns], is.numeric)]

cat("Numeric soil columns:", length(numeric_soil_cols), "\n")

}

# Perform the enhanced join
cat("Performing left join on Final_Cleaned_ID AND Year...\n")
parcelles_with_soil_complete <- parcelles_expanded %>%

cat("✅ Enhanced join completed!\n")

# ============================================================================
```

## VIII.1. ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE BETWEEN GEOPACKAGE AND CSV DATASETS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE BETWEEN GEOPACKAGE AND CSV DATASETS
# Links soil data with sugarcane data based on Parcel-Year combinations
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  DATASET CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS      \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD GEOPACKAGE DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("📂 LOADING GEOPACKAGE DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_ALL_VARIABLES_enhanced_predictions.gpkg"

if (!file.exists(gpkg_path)) {
  stop("❌ Geopackage file not found at: ", gpkg_path)
}

soil_data <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Geopackage loaded successfully\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(soil_data), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(soil_data), "\n")

# Check key columns
if (!"field" %in% colnames(soil_data)) {
  stop("❌ 'field' column not found in geopackage")
}

  stop("❌ 'Year' column not found in geopackage")
}

cat("• Unique parcels (field):", length(unique(soil_data$field)), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(soil_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(soil_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: LOAD CSV DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📂 LOADING SUGARCANE CSV DATASET:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

csv_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/sugarcane_data_converted.csv"

if (!file.exists(csv_path)) {
  stop("❌ CSV file not found at: ", csv_path)
}

sugarcane_data <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("✅ CSV loaded successfully\n")
cat("• Total observations:", nrow(sugarcane_data), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(sugarcane_data), "\n")

# Show column names
cat("\n📋 CSV Column Names:\n")
print(colnames(sugarcane_data))

# Check for key columns (case-insensitive)
parcel_col <- grep("^parcel$|^parcelle$|^field$|^Final_Cleaned_ID$", 
                   colnames(sugarcane_data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
campaign_col <- grep("^campaign$|^campagne$", 
                     colnames(sugarcane_data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

if (length(parcel_col) == 0) {
  cat("\n❌ No parcel column found. Available columns:\n")
  print(colnames(sugarcane_data))
  stop("Please specify the correct parcel column name")
}

if (length(campaign_col) == 0) {
  cat("\n❌ No campaign column found. Available columns:\n")
  print(colnames(sugarcane_data))
  stop("Please specify the correct campaign column name")
}

cat("\n✅ Key columns identified:\n")
cat("• Parcel column:", parcel_col[1], "\n")
cat("• Campaign column:", campaign_col[1], "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: CONVERT CAMPAIGN TO YEAR
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔄 CONVERTING CAMPAIGN TO YEAR:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Rename columns for consistency
sugarcane_data <- sugarcane_data %>%
  rename(
    Parcel = !!parcel_col[1],
    Campaign = !!campaign_col[1]
  )

# Show sample campaigns
cat("Sample campaigns before conversion:\n")
sample_campaigns <- head(unique(sugarcane_data$Campaign), 10)
print(sample_campaigns)

# Convert campaign to year
# Campaign format: "03-04" means 2003, "23-24" means 2023
convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
  if (is.na(campaign)) return(NA_integer_)
  
  # Extract first part (e.g., "03" from "03-04")
  first_part <- sub("-.*", "", as.character(campaign))
  first_part <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", first_part)  # Remove non-numeric
  
  if (nchar(first_part) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  
  year_short <- as.integer(first_part)
  
  # Convert 2-digit year to 4-digit
  # Assume 00-50 = 2000-2050, 51-99 = 1951-1999
  if (year_short <= 50) {
    year_full <- 2000 + year_short
  } else {
    year_full <- 1900 + year_short
  }
  
  return(year_full)
}

# Apply conversion
sugarcane_data <- sugarcane_data %>%
  mutate(Year = sapply(Campaign, convert_campaign_to_year))

# Show conversion results
cat("\n✅ Campaign to Year conversion completed\n")
cat("Sample conversions:\n")
conversion_sample <- sugarcane_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Campaign), !is.na(Year)) %>%
  distinct(Campaign, Year) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  head(15)
print(conversion_sample)

cat("\nYear statistics:\n")
cat("• Unique years in CSV:", length(unique(sugarcane_data$Year[!is.na(sugarcane_data$Year)])), "\n")
cat("• Year range:", min(sugarcane_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", 
    max(sugarcane_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("• Missing years:", sum(is.na(sugarcane_data$Year)), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: ANALYZE CORRESPONDENCE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔍 ANALYZING PARCEL-YEAR CORRESPONDENCE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Create unique keys for both datasets
soil_data_keys <- soil_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    Key = paste(field, Year, sep = "_"),
    Source = "Soil_Geopackage"
  ) %>%
  distinct(field, Year, Key, Source)

sugarcane_keys <- sugarcane_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  mutate(
    Key = paste(Parcel, Year, sep = "_"),
    Source = "Sugarcane_CSV"
  ) %>%
  distinct(Parcel, Year, Key, Source)

cat("📊 DATASET KEY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("• Unique Soil Parcel-Year combinations:", nrow(soil_data_keys), "\n")
cat("• Unique Sugarcane Parcel-Year combinations:", nrow(sugarcane_keys), "\n")

# Find matches
matches <- inner_join(
  soil_data_keys %>% select(field, Year, Key),
  sugarcane_keys %>% select(Parcel, Year, Key),
  by = "Key"
)

cat("\n🎯 CORRESPONDENCE RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")
cat("✅ MATCHING PARCEL-YEAR COMBINATIONS:", nrow(matches), "\n")
cat("• Percentage of soil data with sugarcane match:", 
    round(nrow(matches) / nrow(soil_data_keys) * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("• Percentage of sugarcane data with soil match:", 
    round(nrow(matches) / nrow(sugarcane_keys) * 100, 2), "%\n")

# Find non-matches
soil_only <- anti_join(
  soil_data_keys %>% select(field, Year, Key),
  sugarcane_keys %>% select(Parcel, Year, Key),
  by = "Key"
)

sugarcane_only <- anti_join(
  sugarcane_keys %>% select(Parcel, Year, Key),
  soil_data_keys %>% select(field, Year, Key),
  by = "Key"
)

cat("\n❌ NON-MATCHING COMBINATIONS:\n")
cat("• Soil data without sugarcane match:", nrow(soil_only), "\n")
cat("• Sugarcane data without soil match:", nrow(sugarcane_only), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: DETAILED ANALYSIS BY YEAR
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📅 CORRESPONDENCE BY YEAR:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Get all years present in either dataset
all_years <- sort(unique(c(soil_data_keys$Year, sugarcane_keys$Year)))

year_analysis <- data.frame()

for (year in all_years) {
  soil_year <- nrow(soil_data_keys %>% filter(Year == year))
  sugarcane_year <- nrow(sugarcane_keys %>% filter(Year == year))
  matches_year <- nrow(matches %>% filter(Year.x == year))
  
  year_analysis <- rbind(year_analysis, data.frame(
    Year = year,
    Soil_Count = soil_year,
    Sugarcane_Count = sugarcane_year,
    Matches = matches_year,
    Match_Rate_Soil = ifelse(soil_year > 0, round(matches_year/soil_year*100, 1), 0),
    Match_Rate_Sugarcane = ifelse(sugarcane_year > 0, round(matches_year/sugarcane_year*100, 1), 0)
  ))
}

print(year_analysis)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PARCEL-LEVEL ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🏗️ PARCEL-LEVEL ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Unique parcels in each dataset
soil_parcels <- unique(soil_data_keys$field)
sugarcane_parcels <- unique(sugarcane_keys$Parcel)

cat("• Unique parcels in soil data:", length(soil_parcels), "\n")
cat("• Unique parcels in sugarcane data:", length(sugarcane_parcels), "\n")

# Find common parcels (regardless of year)
common_parcels <- intersect(soil_parcels, sugarcane_parcels)
cat("• Parcels present in BOTH datasets:", length(common_parcels), "\n")
cat("  (", round(length(common_parcels)/length(soil_parcels)*100, 1), 
    "% of soil parcels)\n", sep = "")
cat("  (", round(length(common_parcels)/length(sugarcane_parcels)*100, 1), 
    "% of sugarcane parcels)\n", sep = "")

soil_only_parcels <- setdiff(soil_parcels, sugarcane_parcels)
sugarcane_only_parcels <- setdiff(sugarcane_parcels, soil_parcels)

cat("• Parcels ONLY in soil data:", length(soil_only_parcels), "\n")
cat("• Parcels ONLY in sugarcane data:", length(sugarcane_only_parcels), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: SAVE ANALYSIS RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING ANALYSIS RESULTS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

output_dir <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/"

# Save matching keys
matches_output <- matches %>%
  select(Field = field, Year = Year.x, Key)
write_csv(matches_output, paste0(output_dir, "matching_parcel_year_combinations.csv"))
cat("✅ Matching combinations saved:", nrow(matches_output), "rows\n")

# Save year analysis
write_csv(year_analysis, paste0(output_dir, "correspondence_by_year.csv"))
cat("✅ Year analysis saved\n")

# Save soil-only keys
write_csv(soil_only %>% select(field, Year, Key), 
          paste0(output_dir, "soil_only_combinations.csv"))
cat("✅ Soil-only combinations saved:", nrow(soil_only), "rows\n")

# Save sugarcane-only keys
write_csv(sugarcane_only %>% select(Parcel, Year, Key), 
          paste0(output_dir, "sugarcane_only_combinations.csv"))
cat("✅ Sugarcane-only combinations saved:", nrow(sugarcane_only), "rows\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 CREATING VISUALIZATIONS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Year correspondence plot
p1 <- ggplot(year_analysis, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Soil_Count, color = "Soil Data"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Sugarcane_Count, color = "Sugarcane Data"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Matches, color = "Matches"), size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Soil_Count, color = "Soil Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Sugarcane_Count, color = "Sugarcane Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Matches, color = "Matches"), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Soil Data" = "steelblue", 
                                 "Sugarcane Data" = "forestgreen",
                                 "Matches" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Parcel-Year Combinations by Year",
    subtitle = paste("Total matches:", nrow(matches), "out of", 
                     max(nrow(soil_data_keys), nrow(sugarcane_keys)), "possible"),
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Parcel-Year Combinations",
    color = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "correspondence_by_year_plot.png"), p1,

cat("✅ Year correspondence plot saved\n")

# Match rate plot

  geom_line(aes(y = Match_Rate_Sugarcane, color = "Sugarcane Match Rate"), size = 1) +

  geom_point(aes(y = Match_Rate_Sugarcane, color = "Sugarcane Match Rate"), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Soil Match Rate" = "steelblue", 
                                 "Sugarcane Match Rate" = "forestgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "Match Rate by Year",

  ylim(0, 100) +
  theme_minimal() +

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "match_rate_by_year_plot.png"), p2,
```

```{r}
# Convert campaign to year
convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
  if (is.na(campaign)) return(NA_integer_)
  
  # Extract first part (e.g., "03" from "03-04")
  first_part <- sub("-.*", "", as.character(campaign))
  first_part <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", first_part)
  
  if (nchar(first_part) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  
  year_short <- as.integer(first_part)
  
  # Convert 2-digit year to 4-digit

  }

}

# Rename and prepare sugarcane data

  select(-any_of(c("geometry", "geom")))

cat("✅ Sugarcane data prepared\n")
cat("• Observations with valid year:", nrow(sugarcane_prepared), "\n")
cat("• Unique field-year combinations:", 
    nrow(distinct(sugarcane_prepared, field, Year)), "\n")

# Show sugarcane columns (excluding field, Year, Campaign)
sugarcane_columns <- setdiff(colnames(sugarcane_prepared), c("field", "Year", "Campaign"))
cat("• Sugarcane variables to add:", length(sugarcane_columns), "\n")

if (length(sugarcane_columns) > 0) {
  cat("\n📋 Sugarcane variables:\n")
  for (i in seq_along(sugarcane_columns)) {
    col_name <- sugarcane_columns[i]
    non_na <- sum(!is.na(sugarcane_prepared[[col_name]]))
    cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-30s (%d non-NA values)\n", i, col_name, non_na))
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CHECK FOR DUPLICATE FIELD-YEAR COMBINATIONS IN SUGARCANE DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔍 CHECKING FOR DUPLICATES IN SUGARCANE DATA:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Check for duplicates
duplicate_check <- sugarcane_prepared %>%
  group_by(field, Year) %>%
  summarise(n_records = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_records > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  cat("⚠️  Found", nrow(duplicate_check), "field-year combinations with multiple records\n")
  cat("• Total duplicate records:", sum(duplicate_check$n_records), "\n")
  
  # Show some examples
  cat("\nExamples of duplicates:\n")
  print(head(duplicate_check, 10))
  
  cat("\n🔧 HANDLING DUPLICATES:\n")
  cat("Strategy: Aggregating numeric columns (mean) and keeping first value for non-numeric\n")
  
  # Aggregate duplicates
  sugarcane_aggregated <- sugarcane_prepared %>%
    group_by(field, Year, Campaign) %>%
    summarise(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      across(where(~!is.numeric(.x)), ~first(na.omit(.x))),
      n_original_records = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cat("✅ Duplicates aggregated\n")
  cat("• Original records:", nrow(sugarcane_prepared), "\n")
  cat("• After aggregation:", nrow(sugarcane_aggregated), "\n")
  
  sugarcane_prepared <- sugarcane_aggregated
  
} else {
  cat("✅ No duplicate field-year combinations found\n")
  
  # Add n_original_records column for consistency
  sugarcane_prepared <- sugarcane_prepared %>%
    mutate(n_original_records = 1)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: MERGE DATASETS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n🔗 MERGING DATASETS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

cat("Merge strategy: LEFT JOIN (keep all soil records, add sugarcane data where available)\n")

# Create merge key
soil_data <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(merge_key = paste(field, Year, sep = "_"))

sugarcane_prepared <- sugarcane_prepared %>%
  mutate(merge_key = paste(field, Year, sep = "_"))

cat("• Soil records:", nrow(soil_data), "\n")
cat("• Sugarcane records:", nrow(sugarcane_prepared), "\n")
cat("• Unique soil merge keys:", length(unique(soil_data$merge_key)), "\n")
cat("• Unique sugarcane merge keys:", length(unique(sugarcane_prepared$merge_key)), "\n")

# Find matching keys
matching_keys <- intersect(soil_data$merge_key, sugarcane_prepared$merge_key)
cat("• Matching merge keys:", length(matching_keys), "\n")
cat("• Match rate:", round(length(matching_keys) / length(unique(soil_data$merge_key)) * 100, 2), "%\n")

# Prepare sugarcane data for merge (remove duplicate key columns)
sugarcane_for_merge <- sugarcane_prepared %>%
  select(-field, -Year) %>%  # These are already in soil_data
  # Prefix sugarcane columns to avoid conflicts
  rename_with(~paste0("SC_", .), .cols = -merge_key)

cat("\n🔄 Performing left join...\n")

# Perform the merge
merged_data <- soil_data %>%
  left_join(sugarcane_for_merge, by = "merge_key", relationship = "many-to-one")

# Remove temporary merge_key
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  select(-merge_key)

cat("✅ Merge completed\n")
cat("• Final dataset rows:", nrow(merged_data), "\n")
cat("• Final dataset columns:", ncol(merged_data), "\n")

# Check how many rows got sugarcane data
rows_with_sugarcane <- sum(!is.na(merged_data$SC_Campaign))
cat("• Rows with sugarcane data:", rows_with_sugarcane, 
    "(", round(rows_with_sugarcane/nrow(merged_data)*100, 2), "%)\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: REORDER COLUMNS (SUGARCANE AT END)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📋 REORDERING COLUMNS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Get soil columns (original) and sugarcane columns (new)
soil_cols <- intersect(original_columns, colnames(merged_data))
sugarcane_cols <- colnames(merged_data)[grepl("^SC_", colnames(merged_data))]
geometry_col <- "geom"

# Reorder: soil columns first, then sugarcane columns, geometry last
if (geometry_col %in% colnames(merged_data)) {
  soil_cols <- setdiff(soil_cols, geometry_col)
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    select(all_of(soil_cols), all_of(sugarcane_cols), all_of(geometry_col))
} else {
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    select(all_of(soil_cols), all_of(sugarcane_cols))
}

cat("✅ Columns reordered\n")
cat("• Soil columns:", length(soil_cols), "\n")
cat("• Sugarcane columns:", length(sugarcane_cols), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(merged_data), "\n")

# Show column structure
cat("\n📊 FINAL COLUMN STRUCTURE:\n")
cat("First 10 soil columns:\n")
print(head(soil_cols, 10))

cat("\nSugarcane columns (all prefixed with 'SC_'):\n")
print(sugarcane_cols)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: GENERATE SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n📊 GENERATING SUMMARY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

# Create summary by year
summary_by_year <- merged_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Records = n(),
    With_Sugarcane_Data = sum(!is.na(SC_Campaign)),
    Pct_With_Sugarcane = round(sum(!is.na(SC_Campaign)) / n() * 100, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year)

cat("Summary by year:\n")
print(summary_by_year)

# Overall statistics
cat("\n📈 OVERALL STATISTICS:\n")
cat("• Total merged records:", nrow(merged_data), "\n")
cat("• Records with sugarcane data:", sum(!is.na(merged_data$SC_Campaign)), "\n")
cat("• Records without sugarcane data:", sum(is.na(merged_data$SC_Campaign)), "\n")
cat("• Overall match rate:", 
    round(sum(!is.na(merged_data$SC_Campaign))/nrow(merged_data)*100, 2), "%\n")

# Check for any completely empty sugarcane columns
empty_sugarcane_cols <- sugarcane_cols[sapply(merged_data[sugarcane_cols], function(x) all(is.na(x)))]
if (length(empty_sugarcane_cols) > 0) {
  cat("\n⚠️  Empty sugarcane columns (all NA):\n")
  print(empty_sugarcane_cols)
} else {
  cat("\n✅ All sugarcane columns have at least some data\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: SAVE MERGED GEOPACKAGE
# ============================================================================
cat("\n💾 SAVING MERGED GEOPACKAGE:\n")
cat("=", rep("=", 40), "\n", sep="")

output_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane.gpkg"

cat("Writing to:", output_path, "\n")
st_write(merged_data, output_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
cat("✅ Merged geopackage saved successfully\n")

# Also save as CSV (attributes only)
csv_output_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane_attributes.csv"
st_drop_geometry(merged_data) %>% write_csv(csv_output_path)
cat("✅ CSV attributes saved:", basename(csv_output_path), "\n")

# Save summary statistics
summary_output_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/MERGE_summary_by_year.csv"
write_csv(summary_by_year, summary_output_path)
cat("✅ Summary statistics saved:", basename(summary_output_path), "\n")
```
