## VIII.3. COMPREHENSIVE SUGARCANE VARIABLES VISUALIZATION

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE SUGARCANE VARIABLES VISUALIZATION
# Creates yearly faceted maps AND standalone maps for each year
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  SUGARCANE VARIABLES VISUALIZATION    \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD MERGED DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("Loading merged dataset...\n")

gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane.gpkg"
merged_data <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)

cat("Dataset loaded:", nrow(merged_data), "observations\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: DEFINE SUGARCANE VARIABLES TO VISUALIZE
# ============================================================================

sugarcane_vars <- c(
  "SC_tc_per_ha_actual",
  "SC_brix_percent",
  "SC_pol_juice_percent",
  "SC_purity_percent",
  "SC_fiber_percent",
  "SC_pol_cane_percent",
  "SC_percent_cane_percent",
  "SC_glucose_cane_percent",
  "SC_hugot_sugar",
  "SC_fiber_content_percent",
  "SC_juice_tons",
  "SC_tmss",
  "SC_tpj",
  "SC_tpc",
  "SC_ts",
  "SC_tsr",
  "SC_drying_duration_actual_days",
  "SC_evaporation_balance",
  "SC_potential_yield"
)

# Check which variables exist
existing_vars <- sugarcane_vars[sugarcane_vars %in% colnames(merged_data)]
missing_vars <- setdiff(sugarcane_vars, existing_vars)

cat("\nVariables found:", length(existing_vars), "\n")
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("Missing variables:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: VARIABLE LABELS AND COLOR SCHEMES
# ============================================================================

get_sugarcane_label <- function(var_name) {
  labels <- list(
    "SC_tc_per_ha_actual" = "Tons Cane per Hectare (t/ha)",
    "SC_brix_percent" = "Brix (%)",
    "SC_pol_juice_percent" = "POL in Juice (%)",
    "SC_purity_percent" = "Purity (%)",
    "SC_fiber_percent" = "Fiber",
    "SC_pol_cane_percent" = "POL in Cane (%)",
    "SC_percent_cane_percent" = "Percent Cane (%)",
    "SC_glucose_cane_percent" = "Glucose in Cane (%)",
    "SC_hugot_sugar" = "Hugot Sugar",
    "SC_fiber_content_percent" = "Fiber Content (%)",
    "SC_juice_tons" = "Juice Tons",
    "SC_tmss" = "TMSS (Tons Millable Stalks Sugar)",
    "SC_tpj" = "TPJ (Tons POL Juice)",
    "SC_tpc" = "TPC (Tons POL Cane)",
    "SC_ts" = "TS (Total Sugar)",
    "SC_tsr" = "TSR (Total Sugar Recovered)",
    "SC_drying_duration_actual_days" = "Drying Duration (days)",
    "SC_evaporation_balance" = "Evaporation Balance",
    "SC_potential_yield" = "Potential Yield"
  )
  return(labels[[var_name]] %||% var_name)
}

get_sugarcane_colors <- function(var_name) {
  var_lower <- tolower(var_name)
  
  if (grepl("yield|tc_per_ha|juice_tons", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlGn"))
  } else if (grepl("brix|pol|sugar|purity", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"))
  } else if (grepl("fiber", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Oranges"))
  } else if (grepl("glucose", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Purples"))
  } else if (grepl("drying|duration", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))
  } else if (grepl("evaporation", var_lower)) {
    return(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu"))
  } else {
    return(viridis(9, option = "viridis"))
  }
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
# ============================================================================

output_dir <- "sugarcane_comprehensive_visualizations"
subdirs <- c(
  "01_faceted_yearly_maps",
  "02_standalone_yearly_maps",
  "03_summary_statistics"
)

for (subdir in subdirs) {
  dir_path <- file.path(output_dir, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) {
    dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

cat("\nOutput directory created:", output_dir, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: ANALYSIS AND VISUALIZATION FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

visualize_sugarcane_variable <- function(var_name, data, output_base_dir) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Check data availability
  var_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]))
  
  n_total <- nrow(data)
  n_available <- nrow(var_data)
  pct_available <- round(n_available / n_total * 100, 1)
  
  cat("Data availability:\n")
  cat("  Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
  cat("  Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
  
  if (n_available < 10) {
    cat("  Insufficient data. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get years
  years_available <- sort(unique(var_data$Year))
  n_years <- length(years_available)
  
  cat("  Years with data:", paste(years_available, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  Value range:", round(min(var_data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "-",
      round(max(var_data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  
  # Get variable label and colors
  var_label <- get_sugarcane_label(var_name)
  var_colors <- get_sugarcane_colors(var_name)
  
  # Calculate value range (remove outliers for better visualization)
  q01 <- quantile(var_data[[var_name]], 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q99 <- quantile(var_data[[var_name]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  var_data_filtered <- var_data %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] >= q01, .data[[var_name]] <= q99)
  
  value_range <- range(var_data_filtered[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ========================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 1: FACETED YEARLY MAP
  # ========================================================================
  
  cat("  Creating faceted yearly map...\n")
  
  # Calculate grid dimensions
  if (n_years <= 3) {
    ncol_facet <- n_years
    nrow_facet <- 1
  } else if (n_years <= 6) {
    ncol_facet <- 3
    nrow_facet <- 2
  } else if (n_years <= 9) {
    ncol_facet <- 3
    nrow_facet <- 3
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 4
    nrow_facet <- ceiling(n_years / 4)
  }
  
  p_faceted <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = var_data_filtered, 
            aes(fill = .data[[var_name]]), 
            color = "white", 
            size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = var_colors,
      name = var_label,
      limits = value_range,
      labels = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1.5,
        barheight = 15,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Year),
      ncol = ncol_facet,
      nrow = nrow_facet,
      scales = "fixed",
      labeller = labeller(Year = function(x) paste("Year", x))
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", 
                               margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", size = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = var_label,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Spatial distribution across years | ",
        "Range: ", round(value_range[1], 2), " - ", round(value_range[2], 2), " | ",
        "N = ", format(n_available, big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
  
  # Save faceted map
  map_width <- max(12, 3.5 * ncol_facet)
  map_height <- max(8, 3 * nrow_facet + 1.5)
  
  faceted_filename <- paste0(var_name, "_faceted_yearly.png")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_base_dir, "01_faceted_yearly_maps", faceted_filename),
    plot = p_faceted,
    width = map_width,
    height = map_height,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("    Saved faceted map:", faceted_filename, "\n")
  
  # ========================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 2: STANDALONE MAPS FOR EACH YEAR
  # ========================================================================
  
  cat("  Creating standalone maps for each year...\n")
  
  # Create subdirectory for this variable's yearly maps
  yearly_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "02_standalone_yearly_maps", var_name)
  if (!dir.exists(yearly_dir)) {
    dir.create(yearly_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (year in years_available) {
    year_data <- var_data_filtered %>%
      filter(Year == year)
    
    if (nrow(year_data) == 0) next
    
    p_year <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = year_data, 
              aes(fill = .data[[var_name]]), 
              color = "white", 
              size = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = var_colors,
        name = var_label,
        limits = value_range,
        labels = function(x) format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2),
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barwidth = 1.5,
          barheight = 20,
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5
        )
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                 margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, 
                                     margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(var_label, "-", year),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Mean: ", round(mean(year_data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), " | ",
          "SD: ", round(sd(year_data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), " | ",
          "N = ", format(nrow(year_data), big.mark = ",")
        )
      )
    
    # Save individual year map
    year_filename <- paste0(var_name, "_", year, ".png")
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(yearly_dir, year_filename),
      plot = p_year,
      width = 12,
      height = 10,
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  cat("    Saved", n_years, "standalone yearly maps\n")
  
  # ========================================================================
  # SUMMARY STATISTICS
  # ========================================================================
  
  summary_stats <- var_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      N_Observations = n(),
      Mean = mean(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Min = min(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Max = max(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Q25 = quantile(.data[[var_name]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q75 = quantile(.data[[var_name]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Return results
  list(
    variable = var_name,
    label = var_label,
    n_available = n_available,
    pct_available = pct_available,
    years = years_available,
    value_range = value_range,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    faceted_plot = p_faceted
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PROCESS ALL SUGARCANE VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nProcessing", length(existing_vars), "sugarcane variables...\n")

all_results <- list()
processing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  Label = character(),
  N_Available = integer(),
  Pct_Available = numeric(),
  N_Years = integer(),
  Years = character(),
  Min_Value = numeric(),
  Max_Value = numeric(),
  Status = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(existing_vars)) {
  var_name <- existing_vars[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(existing_vars), "] ", var_name, "\n", sep = "")
  
  tryCatch({
    result <- visualize_sugarcane_variable(
      var_name = var_name,
      data = merged_data,
      output_base_dir = output_dir
    )
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      all_results[[var_name]] <- result
      
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Label = result$label,
        N_Available = result$n_available,
        Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
        N_Years = length(result$years),
        Years = paste(result$years, collapse = ", "),
        Min_Value = result$value_range[1],
        Max_Value = result$value_range[2],
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("  SUCCESS\n")
    } else {
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Label = get_sugarcane_label(var_name),
        N_Available = 0,
        Pct_Available = 0,
        N_Years = 0,
        Years = "",
        Min_Value = NA,
        Max_Value = NA,
        Status = "Insufficient Data",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("  SKIPPED - Insufficient data\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Label = get_sugarcane_label(var_name),
      N_Available = 0,
      Pct_Available = 0,
      N_Years = 0,
      Years = "",
      Min_Value = NA,
      Max_Value = NA,
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
    cat("  ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: CREATE SUMMARY STATISTICS FILES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating summary statistics...\n")

# Save processing summary
write.csv(
  processing_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", "processing_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Create detailed statistics for each variable
for (var_name in names(all_results)) {
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  write.csv(
    result$summary_stats,
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_yearly_statistics.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE COMPREHENSIVE SUMMARY REPORT
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating comprehensive report...\n")

report_text <- paste0(
  "SUGARCANE VARIABLES COMPREHENSIVE VISUALIZATION REPORT\n",
  "======================================================\n",
  "Generated: ", Sys.time(), "\n\n",
  
  "PROCESSING SUMMARY\n",
  "------------------\n",
  "Total variables processed: ", nrow(processing_summary), "\n",
  "Successfully visualized: ", sum(processing_summary$Status == "Success"), "\n",
  "Insufficient data: ", sum(processing_summary$Status == "Insufficient Data"), "\n",
  "Errors: ", sum(grepl("Error", processing_summary$Status)), "\n\n",
  
  "OUTPUT STRUCTURE\n",
  "----------------\n",
  "01_faceted_yearly_maps/: Faceted maps showing all years together\n",
  "02_standalone_yearly_maps/: Individual maps for each variable-year combination\n",
  "03_summary_statistics/: CSV files with detailed statistics\n\n",
  
  "VARIABLE DETAILS\n",
  "----------------\n"
)

for (i in 1:nrow(processing_summary)) {
  row <- processing_summary[i, ]
  report_text <- paste0(
    report_text,
    sprintf("\n%d. %s (%s)\n", i, row$Label, row$Variable),
    sprintf("   Status: %s\n", row$Status),
    sprintf("   Available data: %d observations (%.1f%%)\n", 
            row$N_Available, row$Pct_Available),
    sprintf("   Years covered: %s (%d years)\n", row$Years, row$N_Years)
  )
  
  if (row$Status == "Success") {
    report_text <- paste0(
      report_text,
      sprintf("   Value range: %.2f - %.2f\n", row$Min_Value, row$Max_Value)
    )
  }
}

# Write report
writeLines(
  report_text,
  file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", "COMPREHENSIVE_REPORT.txt")
)

# ============================================================================
# STEP 9: CREATE COMPARISON VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating comparison visualizations...\n")

if (nrow(processing_summary[processing_summary$Status == "Success", ]) > 0) {
  
  # Data availability comparison
  p_availability <- processing_summary %>%
    filter(Status == "Success") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Label, Pct_Available), y = Pct_Available)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Pct_Available, 1), "%")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(processing_summary$Pct_Available) * 1.1)) +
    labs(
      title = "Data Availability by Variable",
      subtitle = "Percentage of observations with non-missing values",
      x = "Variable",
      y = "Data Availability (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", "data_availability_comparison.png"),
    p_availability,
    width = 12,
    height = max(6, nrow(processing_summary) * 0.4),
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat("VISUALIZATION COMPLETE!\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSUMMARY:\n")
cat("  Successfully visualized:", sum(processing_summary$Status == "Success"), 
    "variables\n")
cat("  Total maps created:\n")
cat("    - Faceted yearly maps:", sum(processing_summary$Status == "Success"), "\n")

total_standalone <- 0
for (var in names(all_results)) {
  total_standalone <- total_standalone + length(all_results[[var]]$years)
}
```

### VIII.3.1. CATEGORICAL SUGARCANE VARIABLES VISUALIZATION \[variety & crop cycle\]

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CATEGORICAL SUGARCANE VARIABLES VISUALIZATION
# Creates yearly faceted maps AND standalone maps for SC_variety and SC_crop_cycle
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  CATEGORICAL VARIABLES VISUALIZATION  \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD MERGED DATASET
# ============================================================================
cat("Loading merged dataset...\n")

gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane.gpkg"
merged_data <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)

cat("Dataset loaded:", nrow(merged_data), "observations\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PREPROCESS CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPreprocessing categorical variables...\n")

# Convert SC_variety to uppercase and clean
if ("SC_variety" %in% colnames(merged_data)) {
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    mutate(SC_variety = toupper(trimws(as.character(SC_variety))))
  
  # Replace empty strings with NA
  merged_data$SC_variety[merged_data$SC_variety == "" | merged_data$SC_variety == "NA"] <- NA
  
  cat("  SC_variety converted to uppercase\n")
  cat("  Unique varieties:", length(unique(na.omit(merged_data$SC_variety))), "\n")
}

# Clean SC_crop_cycle
if ("SC_crop_cycle" %in% colnames(merged_data)) {
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    mutate(SC_crop_cycle = trimws(as.character(SC_crop_cycle)))
  
  merged_data$SC_crop_cycle[merged_data$SC_crop_cycle == "" | merged_data$SC_crop_cycle == "NA"] <- NA
  
  cat("  SC_crop_cycle cleaned\n")
  cat("  Unique crop cycles:", length(unique(na.omit(merged_data$SC_crop_cycle))), "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: DEFINE COLOR PALETTES
# ============================================================================

# Create comprehensive color palette for varieties
create_variety_palette <- function(varieties) {
  n_varieties <- length(varieties)
  
  if (n_varieties <= 12) {
    # Use Set3 and Paired for up to 12 varieties
    colors <- c(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))
  } else if (n_varieties <= 24) {
    colors <- c(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))
  } else {
    # Use viridis for many varieties
    colors <- viridis(n_varieties, option = "turbo")
  }
  
  # Create named vector
  palette <- setNames(colors[1:n_varieties], varieties)
  return(palette)
}

# Create color palette for crop cycle (discrete but gradient-like)
create_crop_cycle_palette <- function(cycles) {
  n_cycles <- length(cycles)
  
  # Use magma for gradient effect but discrete
  colors <- viridis(n_cycles, option = "magma", begin = 0.15, end = 0.95)
  
  # Create named vector
  palette <- setNames(colors, cycles)
  return(palette)
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CREATE OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
# ============================================================================

output_dir <- "sugarcane_categorical_visualizations"
subdirs <- c(
  "01_faceted_yearly_maps",
  "02_standalone_yearly_maps",
  "03_summary_statistics"
)

for (subdir in subdirs) {
  dir_path <- file.path(output_dir, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) {
    dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

cat("\nOutput directory created:", output_dir, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: VISUALIZATION FUNCTION FOR CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

visualize_categorical_variable <- function(var_name, data, output_base_dir) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Processing:", var_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Check data availability
  var_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]))
  
  n_total <- nrow(data)
  n_available <- nrow(var_data)
  pct_available <- round(n_available / n_total * 100, 1)
  
  cat("Data availability:\n")
  cat("  Total observations:", n_total, "\n")
  cat("  Available (non-NA):", n_available, "(", pct_available, "%)\n")
  
  if (n_available < 10) {
    cat("  Insufficient data. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get all unique categories and years
  all_categories <- sort(unique(var_data[[var_name]]))
  years_available <- sort(unique(var_data$Year))
  n_years <- length(years_available)
  n_categories <- length(all_categories)
  
  cat("  Years with data:", paste(years_available, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  Number of categories:", n_categories, "\n")
  cat("  Categories:", paste(all_categories, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Define variable-specific properties
  var_label <- ifelse(var_name == "SC_variety", "Sugarcane Variety", "Crop Cycle")
  
  # Create color palette based on variable type
  if (var_name == "SC_variety") {
    color_palette <- create_variety_palette(all_categories)
  } else {
    color_palette <- create_crop_cycle_palette(all_categories)
  }
  
  # ========================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 1: FACETED YEARLY MAP (with ALL categories in legend)
  # ========================================================================
  
  cat("  Creating faceted yearly map...\n")
  
  # Calculate grid dimensions
  if (n_years <= 3) {
    ncol_facet <- n_years
    nrow_facet <- 1
  } else if (n_years <= 6) {
    ncol_facet <- 3
    nrow_facet <- 2
  } else if (n_years <= 9) {
    ncol_facet <- 3
    nrow_facet <- 3
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 4
    nrow_facet <- ceiling(n_years / 4)
  }
  
  # Ensure factor levels include all categories
  var_data_facet <- var_data %>%
    mutate(!!var_name := factor(.data[[var_name]], levels = all_categories))
  
  p_faceted <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = var_data_facet, 
            aes(fill = .data[[var_name]]), 
            color = "white", 
            size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_palette,
      name = var_label,
      drop = FALSE,  # Show all categories even if not present
      guide = guide_legend(
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        ncol = ifelse(n_categories <= 6, 1, 2),
        override.aes = list(size = 5)
      )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(Year),
      ncol = ncol_facet,
      nrow = nrow_facet,
      scales = "fixed",
      labeller = labeller(Year = function(x) paste("Year", x))
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", 
                               margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", size = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(var_label, "- Spatial Distribution Across Years"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Total categories: ", n_categories, " | ",
        "Total observations: ", format(n_available, big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
  
  # Save faceted map
  map_width <- max(14, 3.5 * ncol_facet + 3)  # Extra width for legend
  map_height <- max(8, 3 * nrow_facet + 1.5)
  
  faceted_filename <- paste0(var_name, "_faceted_yearly.png")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_base_dir, "01_faceted_yearly_maps", faceted_filename),
    plot = p_faceted,
    width = map_width,
    height = map_height,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat("    Saved faceted map:", faceted_filename, "\n")
  
  # ========================================================================
  # VISUALIZATION 2: STANDALONE MAPS FOR EACH YEAR (with year-specific legend)
  # ========================================================================
  
  cat("  Creating standalone maps for each year...\n")
  
  # Create subdirectory for this variable's yearly maps
  yearly_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "02_standalone_yearly_maps", var_name)
  if (!dir.exists(yearly_dir)) {
    dir.create(yearly_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (year in years_available) {
    year_data <- var_data %>%
      filter(Year == year)
    
    if (nrow(year_data) == 0) next
    
    # Get categories present in this year
    year_categories <- sort(unique(year_data[[var_name]]))
    year_palette <- color_palette[year_categories]
    
    # Create factor with only present categories
    year_data <- year_data %>%
      mutate(!!var_name := factor(.data[[var_name]], levels = year_categories))
    
    # Calculate statistics for subtitle
    category_counts <- year_data %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      count(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
      arrange(desc(n))
    
    top_category <- category_counts[[var_name]][1]
    top_count <- category_counts$n[1]
    top_pct <- round(top_count / nrow(year_data) * 100, 1)
    
    p_year <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = year_data, 
              aes(fill = .data[[var_name]]), 
              color = "white", 
              size = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = year_palette,
        name = var_label,
        drop = TRUE,  # Only show present categories
        guide = guide_legend(
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          ncol = ifelse(length(year_categories) <= 8, 1, 2),
          override.aes = list(size = 5)
        )
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                 margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, 
                                     margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey40"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "cm"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(var_label, "-", year),
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Categories present: ", length(year_categories), " | ",
          "Most common: ", top_category, " (", top_pct, "%) | ",
          "N = ", format(nrow(year_data), big.mark = ",")
        )
      )
    
    # Save individual year map
    year_filename <- paste0(var_name, "_", year, ".png")
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(yearly_dir, year_filename),
      plot = p_year,
      width = 14,
      height = 10,
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  
  cat("    Saved", n_years, "standalone yearly maps\n")
  
  # ========================================================================
  # SUMMARY STATISTICS
  # ========================================================================
  
  # Overall frequency table
  overall_freq <- var_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    count(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
    mutate(
      Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  
  colnames(overall_freq)[1] <- var_label
  
  # Yearly frequency table
  yearly_freq <- var_data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(Year, .data[[var_name]]) %>%
    summarise(N_Observations = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    mutate(Percentage = round(N_Observations / sum(N_Observations) * 100, 2)) %>%
    arrange(Year, desc(N_Observations))
  
  colnames(yearly_freq)[2] <- var_label
  
  # Return results
  list(
    variable = var_name,
    label = var_label,
    n_available = n_available,
    pct_available = pct_available,
    n_categories = n_categories,
    categories = all_categories,
    years = years_available,
    overall_frequency = overall_freq,
    yearly_frequency = yearly_freq,
    color_palette = color_palette,
    faceted_plot = p_faceted
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: PROCESS CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
# ============================================================================

categorical_vars <- c("SC_variety", "SC_crop_cycle")
existing_vars <- categorical_vars[categorical_vars %in% colnames(merged_data)]

cat("\nProcessing", length(existing_vars), "categorical variables...\n")

all_results <- list()
processing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  Label = character(),
  N_Available = integer(),
  Pct_Available = numeric(),
  N_Categories = integer(),
  N_Years = integer(),
  Categories = character(),
  Status = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(existing_vars)) {
  var_name <- existing_vars[i]
  
  cat("\n[", i, "/", length(existing_vars), "] ", var_name, "\n", sep = "")
  
  tryCatch({
    result <- visualize_categorical_variable(
      var_name = var_name,
      data = merged_data,
      output_base_dir = output_dir
    )
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      all_results[[var_name]] <- result
      
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Label = result$label,
        N_Available = result$n_available,
        Pct_Available = result$pct_available,
        N_Categories = result$n_categories,
        N_Years = length(result$years),
        Categories = paste(result$categories, collapse = ", "),
        Status = "Success",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("  SUCCESS\n")
    } else {
      summary_row <- data.frame(
        Variable = var_name,
        Label = ifelse(var_name == "SC_variety", "Sugarcane Variety", "Crop Cycle"),
        N_Available = 0,
        Pct_Available = 0,
        N_Categories = 0,
        N_Years = 0,
        Categories = "",
        Status = "Insufficient Data",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
      cat("  SKIPPED - Insufficient data\n")
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    summary_row <- data.frame(
      Variable = var_name,
      Label = ifelse(var_name == "SC_variety", "Sugarcane Variety", "Crop Cycle"),
      N_Available = 0,
      Pct_Available = 0,
      N_Categories = 0,
      N_Years = 0,
      Categories = "",
      Status = paste("Error:", e$message),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    processing_summary <- rbind(processing_summary, summary_row)
    cat("  ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: CREATE SUMMARY STATISTICS FILES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating summary statistics...\n")

# Save processing summary
write.csv(
  processing_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", "processing_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Create detailed statistics for each variable
for (var_name in names(all_results)) {
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  
  # Overall frequency
  write.csv(
    result$overall_frequency,
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_overall_frequency.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Yearly frequency
  write.csv(
    result$yearly_frequency,
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_yearly_frequency.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Color palette
  palette_df <- data.frame(
    Category = names(result$color_palette),
    Color = result$color_palette,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  write.csv(
    palette_df,
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_color_palette.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: CREATE FREQUENCY VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating frequency comparison visualizations...\n")

for (var_name in names(all_results)) {
  result <- all_results[[var_name]]
  
  # Overall frequency bar chart
  p_freq <- ggplot(result$overall_frequency, 
                   aes(x = reorder(.data[[result$label]], n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = .data[[result$label]]), alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", Percentage, "%)")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = result$color_palette, guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(result$label, "- Overall Frequency Distribution"),
      subtitle = paste0("Total observations: ", format(result$n_available, big.mark = ",")),
      x = result$label,
      y = "Number of Observations"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_frequency_distribution.png")),
    p_freq,
    width = 12,
    height = max(6, result$n_categories * 0.5),
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Yearly frequency heatmap
  p_heatmap <- ggplot(result$yearly_frequency, 
                      aes(x = factor(Year), y = .data[[result$label]], fill = Percentage)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_viridis(option = "plasma", name = "Percentage (%)",
                       guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste(result$label, "- Distribution Across Years"),
      subtitle = "Percentage of observations by category and year",
      x = "Year",
      y = result$label
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(output_dir, "03_summary_statistics", 
              paste0(var_name, "_yearly_heatmap.png")),
    p_heatmap,
    width = max(10, length(result$years) * 1.5),
    height = max(6, result$n_categories * 0.6),
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

```{r}

# ============================================================================
# EXTRACT SUBSET AND EXPORT TO CSV
# ============================================================================

# Load the geopackage

output_csv <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/final_dataset_for_analysis_categorial.csv"

cat("Loading geopackage...\n")

# Function to extract campaign year from campaign variable
extract_campaign_year <- function(campaign_string) {
  if (is.na(campaign_string) || campaign_string == "") {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  campaign_clean <- trimws(as.character(campaign_string))
  
  if (grepl("-", campaign_clean)) {
    year_part <- strsplit(campaign_clean, "-")[[1]][1]
    
    if (nchar(year_part) == 2) {
      year_num <- as.numeric(year_part)
      
      if (year_num <= 30) {
        campaign_year <- 2000 + year_num
      } else {
        campaign_year <- 1900 + year_num
      }
    } else if (nchar(year_part) == 4) {
      campaign_year <- as.numeric(year_part)
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
    
    return(campaign_year)
  }
  
  return(NA)
}

# Create campaign_year variable

  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille_complete",
  
  # Soil ratios
  "Mg_K_Ratio_complete",
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio_complete",
  
  #Management
  "SC_drying_duration_actual_days",
  
  # Rainfall
  "growing_season_rainfall_mm",
  
  # Basic weather - Temperature
  "temp_mini_mean",
  "temp_maxi_mean",
  "temp_moy_mean",
  "ampl_mean",
  
  # Basic weather - Humidity
  "h_mini_mean",

  "h_moy_mean",
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================

output_csv <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/final_dataset_for_analysis_categorial.csv"

cat("Loading geopackage...\n")
parcels <- st_read(input_gpkg, quiet = TRUE)

# Function to extract campaign year from campaign variable
extract_campaign_year <- function(campaign_string) {
  if (is.na(campaign_string) || campaign_string == "") {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  campaign_clean <- trimws(as.character(campaign_string))
  
  if (grepl("-", campaign_clean)) {
    year_part <- strsplit(campaign_clean, "-")[[1]][1]
    
    if (nchar(year_part) == 2) {
      year_num <- as.numeric(year_part)
      
      if (year_num <= 30) {
        campaign_year <- 2000 + year_num
      } else {
        campaign_year <- 1900 + year_num
      }
    } else if (nchar(year_part) == 4) {
      campaign_year <- as.numeric(year_part)
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
    
    return(campaign_year)
  }
  
  return(NA)
}

# Create campaign_year variable
cat("Extracting campaign year...\n")
parcels$campaign_year <- sapply(parcels$SC_Campaign, extract_campaign_year)

cat("Valid campaign years:", sum(!is.na(parcels$campaign_year)), "out of", nrow(parcels), "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# FIX SC_HARVEST ISSUES
# ============================================================================

cat("Fixing SC_harvest issues...\n")

# First, standardize the encoding issue with "Mécanique"
parcels$SC_harvest <- as.character(parcels$SC_harvest)
parcels$SC_harvest[!is.na(parcels$SC_harvest) & grepl("M.*canique", parcels$SC_harvest, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Mécanique"

# Create a lookup table for each parcel's harvest type by year
harvest_lookup <- parcels %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(field, campaign_year, SC_harvest) %>%
  filter(!is.na(campaign_year))

# Function to get harvest value from adjacent years
get_adjacent_harvest <- function(field_id, target_year, lookup_data) {
  parcel_data <- lookup_data %>% filter(field == !!field_id)
  
  # Get values from adjacent years
  prev_year <- parcel_data %>% filter(campaign_year == target_year - 1) %>% pull(SC_harvest)
  next_year <- parcel_data %>% filter(campaign_year == target_year + 1) %>% pull(SC_harvest)
  
  # Remove NA values
  adjacent_values <- c(prev_year, next_year)
  adjacent_values <- adjacent_values[!is.na(adjacent_values)]
  
  if (length(adjacent_values) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  } else if (length(adjacent_values) == 1) {
    return(adjacent_values[1])
  } else {
    # If both years available and they match, use that value
    if (adjacent_values[1] == adjacent_values[2]) {
      return(adjacent_values[1])
    } else {
      # If they differ, use the most recent one (next year)
      return(adjacent_values[length(adjacent_values)])
    }
  }
}

# Fix 2010 (all NA)
cat("Fixing 2010 SC_harvest values...\n")
rows_2010 <- which(parcels$campaign_year == 2010)
cat("Found", length(rows_2010), "rows for year 2010\n")

for (i in rows_2010) {
  new_value <- get_adjacent_harvest(parcels$field[i], 2010, harvest_lookup)
  parcels$SC_harvest[i] <- new_value
}

# Fix 2021 (all incorrectly set to "Manuelle")
cat("Fixing 2021 SC_harvest values...\n")
rows_2021 <- which(parcels$campaign_year == 2021)
cat("Found", length(rows_2021), "rows for year 2021\n")

for (i in rows_2021) {
  new_value <- get_adjacent_harvest(parcels$field[i], 2021, harvest_lookup)
  parcels$SC_harvest[i] <- new_value
}

cat("SC_harvest correction complete!\n")
cat("Current SC_harvest distribution:\n")
print(table(parcels$SC_harvest, parcels$campaign_year, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\n")

# ============================================================================

  # Soil ratios

  #Management

  # Rainfall
```

```{r}
  # Get values from adjacent years
  prev_year <- parcel_data %>% filter(campaign_year == target_year - 1) %>% pull(SC_harvest)
  next_year <- parcel_data %>% filter(campaign_year == target_year + 1) %>% pull(SC_harvest)
  
  # Remove NA values
  adjacent_values <- c(prev_year, next_year)
  adjacent_values <- adjacent_values[!is.na(adjacent_values)]
  
  if (length(adjacent_values) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  } else if (length(adjacent_values) == 1) {
    return(adjacent_values[1])
  } else {
    # If both years available and they match, use that value
    if (adjacent_values[1] == adjacent_values[2]) {
      return(adjacent_values[1])
    } else {
      # If they differ, use the most recent one (next year)
      return(adjacent_values[length(adjacent_values)])
    }
  }
}

# Fix 2010 (all NA)
cat("Fixing 2010 SC_harvest values...\n")
rows_2010 <- which(parcels$campaign_year == 2010)
cat("Found", length(rows_2010), "rows for year 2010\n")

for (i in rows_2010) {
  new_value <- get_adjacent_harvest(parcels$field[i], 2010, harvest_lookup)
  parcels$SC_harvest[i] <- new_value
}

# Fix 2021 (all incorrectly set to "Manuelle")
cat("Fixing 2021 SC_harvest values...\n")
rows_2021 <- which(parcels$campaign_year == 2021)
cat("Found", length(rows_2021), "rows for year 2021\n")

for (i in rows_2021) {
  new_value <- get_adjacent_harvest(parcels$field[i], 2021, harvest_lookup)
  parcels$SC_harvest[i] <- new_value
}

cat("SC_harvest correction complete!\n")
cat("Current SC_harvest distribution:\n")
print(table(parcels$SC_harvest, parcels$campaign_year, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\n")

# Check which variables exist
existing_vars <- variables_to_keep[variables_to_keep %in% names(parcels)]
missing_vars <- variables_to_keep[!variables_to_keep %in% names(parcels)]
```
